papers.method_zh: 采用混合双温模型-分子动力学（Two Temperature Model-Molecular Dynamics, TTM-MD）模拟，构建了具有不同晶粒拓扑（随机化 vs. 等轴晶）、晶粒尺寸及残余拉/压应力构型的微观结构信息原子模型。

papers.title: Quantum-metric Bloch oscillations in weakly inhomogeneous electric fields
papers.abstract: Geometric analogs of Bloch oscillations studied so far have relied on Berry curvature. We show that a weakly inhomogeneous electric field adds a distinct quantum-metric term to semiclassical wavepacket dynamics, generating an oscillatory real-space contribution even when the Berry curvature vanishes. The associated transport response comprises an intrinsic and a scattering-time-dependent part. In the regime studied, the latter can dominate and approach finite saturation at high field when the relative field inhomogeneity is held fixed. A tilted Dirac model illustrates the mechanism. Realistic platforms will likely require synthetically engineered superlattices, with a finite quantum metric and an adequate band gap.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“semiclassical wavepacket dynamics”、“tilted Dirac model”、“semiclassical”等表明该工作基于半经典理论框架，未提及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：弱非均匀电场下布洛赫振荡的量子几何效应，具体关注量子度量（quantum metric）对波包动力学的贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱非均匀电场中，即使贝里曲率为零，量子度量也会导致实空间振荡输运；该输运响应包含本征部分和依赖于散射时间的部分，后者在固定场非均匀性下可随场强增大而趋于有限饱和。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱非均匀电场中，即使贝里曲率为零，量子度量也会导致实空间振荡输运；该输运响应包含本征部分和依赖于散射时间的部分，后者在固定场非均匀性下可随场强增大而趋于有限饱和。；创新点：此前布洛赫振荡的几何类比仅依赖贝里曲率，本工作首次指出弱非均匀电场可引入独立的量子度量项，产生无贝里曲率时的振荡实空间贡献。
papers.method_zh: 采用半经典波包动力学理论，结合弱非均匀电场的处理，并利用倾斜狄拉克模型（tilted Dirac model）进行机制演示。

papers.title: Toward the Rational Design of Molecular Field-Coupled Nanocomputing Candidates
papers.abstract: Molecular Field-Coupled Nanocomputing (MolFCN) is a promising beyond-CMOS paradigm in which information is propagated electrostatically rather than through charge transport, enabling ultra-low-power logic. Identifying molecules with stable logic states, efficient clock-field switching, and reliable information propagation, however, remains an open challenge. In this Letter, we introduce LUFFY (Layered Unified Framework for MolFCN systematic analYsis), a framework for the rational design and validation of molecular candidates for MolFCN architectures. Starting from 27 synthetically accessible molecules, we combine conformational sampling and electrostatic analysis in neutral and oxidized states to derive robust descriptors of molecular response. In particular, we extract the V${in}$-to-Aggregated-Charge Transcharacteristics (VACTs), capturing the field-induced charge response, and introduce energy-averaged models validated via ab initio molecular dynamics to account for conformational diversity. Finally, we use the resulting molecular responses to evaluate device-level propagation and demonstrate stable information transfer. These results directly link molecular structure to functional information flow, identifying conformationally robust electrostatic response as a key requirement for MolFCN operation. Overall, this work establishes a unified and transferable framework for the identification and validation of MolFCN molecular candidates, bridging molecular design and circuit-level functionality. By unifying previously fragmented approaches into a sustainable methodology, LUFFY enables rational and scalable molecular discovery and establishes a foundation for data-driven design strategies that accelerate the development of ultra-low-power information processing technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“conformational sampling and electrostatic analysis”、“ab initio molecular dynamics”、“energy-averaged models”等计算与理论建模方法，未涉及实验合成或测量。；研究对象：分子场耦合纳米计算（MolFCN）候选分子。具体为27种可合成分子，研究其在电场作用下的电荷响应与信息传播能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了LUFFY框架，通过提取分子在氧化态和中性态下的场致电荷响应特征（VACTs），并引入考虑构象多样性的能量平均模型，成功将分子结构与功能性信息流直接关联，识别出构象稳健的静电响应是MolFCN运行的关键要求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了LUFFY框架，通过提取分子在氧化态和中性态下的场致电荷响应特征（VACTs），并引入考虑构象多样性的能量平均模型，成功将分子结构与功能性信息流直接关联，识别出构象稳健的静电响应是MolFCN运行的关键要求。；创新点：建立了从分子设计到电路级功能的统一、可迁移的筛选与验证框架，将此前零散的方法整合为可持续方法论，为数据驱动的分子发现奠定基础。摘要未突出说明与已有具体方法的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: LUFFY（分层统一框架）：结合构象采样与静电分析（中性/氧化态），提取Vin-聚集电荷转移特性（VACTs）；采用基于从头算分子动力学（ab initio molecular dynamics）验证的能量平均模型；最后在器件层面评估信息传播稳定性。

papers.title: Topologically Driven Giant Effective Spin Mixing Conductance in Antiferromagnetic FeSn/Py Heterostructures
papers.abstract: The topological semimetal FeSn antiferromagnet, characterized by its kagome lattice, two-dimensional flat bands, and Dirac-like surface states, holds immense promise for spintronic applications. In this work, for the first time, we investigate the spin pumping behavior in epitaxial-FeSn/Py (Ni$_{80}$Fe$_{20}$) heterostructures. We report a giant effective spin mixing conductance (g$^{\uparrow \downarrow}_{\mathrm{eff}}$) of $(116\pm 7)$~nm$^{-2}$, which is nearly one order of magnitude higher than that of standard Pt/Py heterostructures. The insertion of a 3 nm Al spacer layer results in a two-fold reduction in the effective damping, confirming the interfacial origin of the large g$^{\uparrow\downarrow}_{\mathrm{eff}}$. Consistently, we observe an order-of-magnitude higher inverse spin Hall effect voltage in the FeSn/Py system compared to a reference Pt/Py film stack. We attribute the giant g$^{\uparrow\downarrow}_{\mathrm{eff}}$ to the direct interfacing of the Py layer with the topologically active [001]-kagome surface of epitaxial-FeSn. These findings establish the critical role of topologically active interfaces for advanced quantum-material-based spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“investigate the spin pumping behavior”、“we report”、“we observe”等实验性描述，涉及样品制备（epitaxial-FeSn/Py heterostructures）和测量（spin pumping, inverse spin Hall effect voltage）。；研究对象：拓扑半金属FeSn（反铁磁，具有kagome晶格）与Py（Ni₈₀Fe₂₀）构成的异质结，以及其中的自旋泵浦行为和有效自旋混合电导。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在FeSn/Py异质结中观测到巨大的有效自旋混合电导（g^↑↓_eff = (116±7) nm⁻²），比标准Pt/Py异质结高近一个数量级；同时观察到逆自旋霍尔效应电压也高出一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在FeSn/Py异质结中观测到巨大的有效自旋混合电导（g^↑↓_eff = (116±7) nm⁻²），比标准Pt/Py异质结高近一个数量级；同时观察到逆自旋霍尔效应电压也高出一个数量级。；创新点：首次研究外延FeSn反铁磁拓扑半金属与Py异质结中的自旋泵浦行为，并将巨大的有效自旋混合电导归因于Py层与FeSn的[001] kagome拓扑表面直接接触，强调了拓扑活性界面对自旋电子学器件的重要性。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（epitaxial）生长FeSn薄膜，制备FeSn/Py异质结；通过自旋泵浦实验测量有效阻尼和有效自旋混合电导；插入Al间隔层（3 nm）进行界面效应验证；测量逆自旋霍尔效应电压并与Pt/Py参考样品对比。

papers.title: High-throughput study of electrical conductivity in ordered metals
papers.abstract: We present a computational framework that integrates machine learning with high-throughput \textit{ab initio} calculations to screen over 2.8 million compounds for metallic transport. We identify several intermetallic candidates with predicted high conductivities comparable to that of aluminum ($36.59 \times 10^6$~S/m). We perform full electron--phonon coupling calculations for the top-performing materials, yielding results in excellent agreement with available experimental data. Our analysis reveals that while the noble metals (Ag, Au, Cu) define the practical ceiling for conductivity due to their unique electronic structure and low scattering, compounds like $\text{LiBePt}_2$ can achieve comparable performance by utilizing valence electrons from light elements to shift high-scattering $d$-states beneath the Fermi level. This study not only identifies novel high-performance conductors but also demonstrates the predictive power of combining statistical learning with detailed ab initio calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：computational framework、machine learning、high-throughput ab initio calculations、electron–phonon coupling calculations）；研究对象：有序金属中的电导率，具体筛选了超过280万种化合物，重点关注高导电性金属间化合物（如LiBePt₂等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了若干预测电导率可与铝（36.59×10⁶ S/m）媲美的金属间化合物，并揭示贵金属（Ag、Au、Cu）因独特电子结构和低散射而定义导电性实际上限，而LiBePt₂等化合物可通过利用轻元素价电子将高散射d态移至费米能级以下，实现相近性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了若干预测电导率可与铝（36.59×10⁶ S/m）媲美的金属间化合物，并揭示贵金属（Ag、Au、Cu）因独特电子结构和低散射而定义导电性实际上限，而LiBePt₂等化合物可通过利用轻元素价电子将高散射d态移至费米能级以下，实现相近性能。；创新点：将统计学习与详细的第一性原理计算相结合，实现了对大量未知化合物导电性的高通量预测，并揭示了轻元素调控d态位置以提升导电性的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习结合高通量第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations），对超过280万种化合物进行金属输运筛选；对性能最优材料进行完整的电子-声子耦合计算（full electron–phonon coupling calculations）。

papers.title: Nonlinear frequency shift and bistability of magnon-polarons
papers.abstract: We investigate the nonlinear dynamics of strongly coupled surface acoustic waves (SAWs) and spin waves (SWs) in a magnetoacoustic resonator based on a YIG/ZnO heterostructure by combining microwave reflection measurements with microfocused Brillouin light scattering spectroscopy. In the linear regime, the electrical response reveals clear hybridization between standing SAW cavity modes and finite-wave-vector SWs, resulting in pronounced avoided crossings. At elevated drive powers, the hybrid system exhibits a strongly field-dependent nonlinear response characterized by a positive frequency shift of the driven SW mode. Using the vector Hamiltonian formalism for nonlinear spin-wave dynamics, we show that this shift is dominated by a cross-shift term. In our resonator geometry, this contribution becomes significant because the standing SAW cavity mode simultaneously excites counterpropagating SWs with wave vectors $+k$ and $-k$. For suitable field detuning, the nonlinear shift drives the SW mode into resonance with the SAW excitation, leading to a strong enhancement of the magnon population, broadband nonlinear scattering, and bistable foldover behavior. Beyond the foldover threshold, both the magnon and phonon responses stabilize. These results establish SAW-driven $k \neq 0$ magnon-phonon hybrids as a promising platform for nonlinear magnetoacoustics and wave-based information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论分析）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“combining microwave reflection measurements with microfocused Brillouin light scattering spectroscopy”（结合微波反射测量与微聚焦布里渊光散射光谱学）这一实验手段，并使用了“vector Hamiltonian formalism”（矢量哈密顿形式）进行理论解释。；研究对象：基于YIG/ZnO异质结构的磁声谐振器中，强耦合的表面声波（SAWs）与自旋波（SWs）构成的磁振子-极化激元（magnon-polarons）的非线性动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强驱动功率下，混合系统表现出强烈的场依赖性非线性响应，其特征是驱动自旋波模式的正频率移动。该非线性频移主要由交叉频移项主导，并能在特定条件下驱动自旋波模式与表面声波共振，导致磁振子数增强、宽带非线性散射和双稳态折叠行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强驱动功率下，混合系统表现出强烈的场依赖性非线性响应，其特征是驱动自旋波模式的正频率移动。该非线性频移主要由交叉频移项主导，并能在特定条件下驱动自旋波模式与表面声波共振，导致磁振子数增强、宽带非线性散射和双稳态折叠行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但明确指出该工作建立了由表面声波驱动的非零波矢（k≠0）磁振子-声子混合体系，作为非线性磁声学和基于波的信息处理的一个有前景的平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上结合了微波反射测量和微聚焦布里渊光散射光谱学。理论上使用了用于非线性自旋波动力学的矢量哈密顿形式。

papers.title: Quasinormal mode quantization of bound and propagating photons in complex lightguiding nanostructures for integrated devices
papers.abstract: Open optical or plasmonic resonators are placed on and connected through surfaces or via waveguides, forming complex lightguiding nanostructures, e.g. for integrated photonic quantum devices. We derive general boundary conditions for quasinormal modes that account for the structure's specific geometry. We then present a general quantization scheme for multiple, interacting quasinormal-mode cavities coupled to quantum emitters and to a non-bosonic bath of propagating photons on waveguides or a surface. We derive a system-bath Hamiltonian with rigorously defined coupling elements that can be computed using Maxwell solvers, including light-matter coupling between the electromagnetic field and quantum emitters. We define system-bath correlation functions for an effective, bath-mediated, and time-delayed interaction between the quasinormal modes and quantum emitters, which is a main ingredient commonly used to simulate open quantum system dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive general boundary conditions、present a general quantization scheme、derive a system-bath Hamiltonian。；研究对象：开放光学或等离激元谐振器构成的复杂导光纳米结构，例如集成光子量子器件中的波导或表面耦合系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了适用于复杂几何结构的准正则模通用边界条件，并建立了多个相互作用的准正则模腔与量子发射体及非玻色子传播光子浴耦合的量子化方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了适用于复杂几何结构的准正则模通用边界条件，并建立了多个相互作用的准正则模腔与量子发射体及非玻色子传播光子浴耦合的量子化方案。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但主要新意在于：针对复杂导光纳米结构，给出了可计算耦合元素的准正则模量子化方案，并定义了用于模拟开放量子系统动力学的有效、浴介导、时间延迟相互作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：准正则模的边界条件推导、系统-浴哈密顿量的构建、耦合元素的严格定义（可通过麦克斯韦求解器计算）、系统-浴关联函数的定义。

papers.title: Theory-Guided, Machine-Learning-Accelerated Discovery of a 3D Carbon Nested Nodal-Surface Semimetal
papers.abstract: Extending the Dirac physics of two-dimensional (2D) graphene into three dimensions (3D) carbon allotropes with higher-dimensional band degeneracies remains a central challenge in topological materials science. Here, we propose a general symmetry-engineering principle that systematically transforms graphene's Dirac cone into a 3D nodal surface via controlled layering and registry shift, and employ this principle to guide a machine-learning-accelerated inverse design. By integrating a crystal diffusion variational autoencoder(CDVAE) with a Crystal Transformer, we discover a novel, dynamically and mechanically stable carbon allotrope named \textbf{Netsene} (bct-C$_{24}$), which crystallizes in the body-centered tetragonal \textit{I4/mcm} space group. First-principles calculations confirm that Netsene is a unique nested nodal-surface semimetal: it hosts a complex, double-bowl-shaped nodal-surface system around the Fermi level, protected by non-symmorphic symmetries, alongside Dirac-like linear crossings with Fermi velocities comparable to graphene ($\sim 9 \times 10^5$~m/s). Its non-trivial bulk topology manifests in drumhead surface states, including a nearly flat band. Netsene provides a structurally robust, bulk platform that unifies ultrahigh carrier mobility, topological nodal surfaces, and potential correlation physics, demonstrating the power of theory-guided, machine-learning-accelerated discovery for engineering topological quantum phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“提出对称性工程原理”、“第一性原理计算”、“机器学习加速逆向设计”等关键词。；研究对象：一种新型三维碳同素异形体，命名为Netsene (bct-C$_{24}$)，其晶体结构属于体心四方空间群 *I4/mcm*。具体物理现象为嵌套节面半金属（nested nodal-surface semimetal）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种名为Netsene的三维碳同素异形体，它是一种独特的嵌套节面半金属，在费米能级附近拥有由非点式对称性保护的复杂双碗状节面系统，并具有与石墨烯相当的费米速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种名为Netsene的三维碳同素异形体，它是一种独特的嵌套节面半金属，在费米能级附近拥有由非点式对称性保护的复杂双碗状节面系统，并具有与石墨烯相当的费米速度。；创新点：提出了一种通用的对称性工程原理，系统地将二维石墨烯的狄拉克物理扩展到具有高维能带简并的三维碳同素异形体中，并成功通过理论指导的机器学习加速方法发现了一个具有嵌套节面（而非单一节面）的新型拓扑半金属。
papers.method_zh: 理论引导的机器学习加速逆向设计。具体方法包括：1. 提出对称性工程原理（通过控制层叠和错位将石墨烯的狄拉克锥转化为三维节面）；2. 使用晶体扩散变分自编码器（CDVAE）结合Crystal Transformer进行材料逆向设计；3. 采用第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations）验证其动力学和力学稳定性、电子能带结构及拓扑性质。

papers.title: Gyromagnetic Quantum Friction in Rayleigh Vorticity Baths
papers.abstract: We identify an intrinsic zero-temperature relaxation channel for near-surface spins gyromagnetically coupled to Rayleigh-wave vorticity. This surface-mode contribution requires no thermal phonons, unlike Raman relaxation, and is fixed by Rayleigh vorticity rather than material-specific $g$-factor modulation. The Rayleigh-vorticity bath is super-Ohmic and evanescent with depth, producing field and depth scalings of spin relaxation. These scalings establish shallow spin sensors and hybrid surface-acoustic-wave spin interfaces as detectors of Rayleigh-wave acoustic quantum friction in solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“identify”“fixed by”“producing scalings”等理论推导和模型构建关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：近表面自旋与瑞利波涡度之间的回磁耦合导致的量子摩擦现象，具体涉及浅层自旋传感器和混合表面声波自旋界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种本征的零温弛豫通道：近表面自旋通过回磁耦合与瑞利波涡度相互作用，无需热声子即可发生弛豫，且该弛豫由瑞利涡度而非材料特定的g因子调制决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种本征的零温弛豫通道：近表面自旋通过回磁耦合与瑞利波涡度相互作用，无需热声子即可发生弛豫，且该弛豫由瑞利涡度而非材料特定的g因子调制决定。；创新点：首次识别出瑞利波涡度作为零温下自旋弛豫的固有量子摩擦来源，区别于传统的拉曼弛豫机制，并建立了自旋弛豫与表面声波量子摩擦之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于回磁耦合与瑞利波涡度浴的相互作用，推导了自旋弛豫随磁场和深度的标度关系，并指出该涡度浴具有超欧姆谱特征且随深度衰减。

papers.title: Superconductivity in doped spin multimer systems
papers.abstract: Binding energy, which quantifies pair formation, is a key factor in the emergence of superconductivity. Here, we show that even when multiple spins are complexly coupled, hole-doped systems, which can be mapped onto the universal hardcore boson model in the strong-binding-energy limit, exhibit promising signatures of superconductivity. We analytically and numerically demonstrate this concept in the double Kondo lattice model. Using the density-matrix renormalization group method, we show that a pairing state is maintained via a crossover even for parameters away from the strong-coupling regime. Additionally, we find that once binding energies are sufficiently generated, pair correlations develop similarly regardless of the details of local spin correlations. Our findings suggest useful guidelines for research on superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytically and numerically demonstrate、density-matrix renormalization group method、strong-binding-energy limit、universal hardcore boson model）；研究对象：掺杂自旋多聚体（doped spin multimer systems）中的超导电性，具体以双Kondo晶格模型（double Kondo lattice model）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强结合能极限下，空穴掺杂的自旋多聚体系统可映射为通用硬核玻色子模型，并展现出超导迹象；即使偏离强耦合区域，配对态仍可通过交叉（crossover）维持，且一旦结合能充分产生，配对关联的发展对局域自旋关联的细节不敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强结合能极限下，空穴掺杂的自旋多聚体系统可映射为通用硬核玻色子模型，并展现出超导迹象；即使偏离强耦合区域，配对态仍可通过交叉（crossover）维持，且一旦结合能充分产生，配对关联的发展对局域自旋关联的细节不敏感。；创新点：揭示了在复杂自旋耦合的多聚体系统中，超导配对的关键驱动力是结合能（binding energy），而非局域自旋关联的具体细节，为超导研究提供了新的指导原则。摘要未突出说明与已有具体实验或理论工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导（analytical demonstration）与数值计算（numerical demonstration）相结合，具体采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）方法。

papers.title: CNN-Based Classifier for Automated Identification of Magnetic States in Spin Dynamics Simulations
papers.abstract: The identification and classification of different magnetic states are essential for understanding the complex behavior of magnetic systems. Traditional approaches that rely on handcrafted features or manual inspection often fall short, particularly when dealing with subtle or topologically complex spin textures. In this study, we present an automated deep learning model that employs an EfficientNetV1B0 Convolutional Neural Network to classify nine distinct magnetic states, including both ferromagnetic (FM) and antiferromagnetic (AFM) spin textures such as AFM skyrmions and AFM stripe domains. The spin configurations are generated through atomistic spin dynamics simulations using the Spirit code, then visualized with VFRendering to produce RGB images, which serve as inputs to the classification model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“atomistic spin dynamics simulations”（原子自旋动力学模拟）、“Spirit code”（计算代码）、“CNN-based classifier”（基于卷积神经网络的分类器）。；研究对象：磁性系统中的自旋纹理，具体包括铁磁（FM）和反铁磁（AFM）自旋纹理，如反铁磁斯格明子（AFM skyrmions）和反铁磁条状畴（AFM stripe domains）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出该工作提出了一种基于EfficientNetV1B0卷积神经网络的深度学习模型，能够自动识别九种不同的磁性状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出该工作提出了一种基于EfficientNetV1B0卷积神经网络的深度学习模型，能够自动识别九种不同的磁性状态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用Spirit代码进行原子自旋动力学模拟生成自旋构型，然后通过VFRendering将自旋构型可视化为RGB图像，最后将这些图像输入到EfficientNetV1B0卷积神经网络分类模型中进行自动分类。

papers.title: Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless-type Transition in Site Percolation on the Diamond Hierarchical Lattice
papers.abstract: We study site percolation on the diamond hierarchical lattice, a finite-dimensional fractal network, using an exact generating-function analysis. In contrast to bond percolation, site percolation on this lattice does not undergo a transition from a nonpercolating phase to a percolating phase. Instead, the system exhibits a nonpercolating phase for $p<p_{\rm c}$ and a critical phase for $p>p_{\rm c}$. In the critical phase, the size of the largest cluster remains subextensive, scaling as $N^{ψ(p)}$, where the fractal exponent $ψ(p)$ varies continuously with $p$. By analyzing the renormalization-group recursion relation in the vicinity of $p_{\rm c}$, we show that the correlation length exhibits a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless-type essential singularity, $ξ(p)\sim \exp \left({\rm const}/\sqrt{p_{\rm c}-p}\right)$ for $p \to p_{\rm c}^-$, which is further confirmed by finite-size scaling analyses showing excellent data collapse. These results demonstrate that critical phases in percolation can emerge even on finite-dimensional networks and that exponential volume growth is not necessary for such phases to appear. We argue that the critical phase on the diamond hierarchical lattice stems from site dilution remaining relevant under renormalization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用精确生成函数分析、重整化群递归关系、有限尺寸标度分析等理论方法。；研究对象：金刚石层级晶格上的位点逾渗（site percolation），一种有限维分形网络中的逾渗相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系不存在从非逾渗相到逾渗相的常规转变，而是存在一个非逾渗相（p<p_c）和一个临界相（p>p_c）。在临界相中，最大团簇尺寸呈亚广延标度行为，且关联长度在p_c附近表现出Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless型本质奇异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系不存在从非逾渗相到逾渗相的常规转变，而是存在一个非逾渗相（p<p_c）和一个临界相（p>p_c）。在临界相中，最大团簇尺寸呈亚广延标度行为，且关联长度在p_c附近表现出Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless型本质奇异性。；创新点：首次在有限维网络（而非指数体积增长系统）中发现逾渗问题中的临界相，并证明该临界相源于位点稀释在重整化下保持相关（relevant）。摘要未突出说明与已有逾渗理论（如常规BKT相变）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 精确生成函数分析、重整化群递归关系分析、有限尺寸标度分析。

papers.title: The exact solution of the Koga-Widom-Indekeu model and related models of wetting in fluid mixtures
papers.abstract: We show how a broad class of two-component square-gradient models of wetting may be solved exactly for the surface tensions and density profile paths, and clarify how the presence or absence of critical point wetting, in binary and ternary mixtures, is related to universality and symmetry principles at critical end points. We begin by solving a model of fluid interfaces, first introduced by Koga and Widom, in ternary mixtures showing three phase coexistence. Numerical studies had revealed interesting wetting transitions, as well as curious geometrical properties of the profile paths in the density plane, and led these authors to conjecture expressions for the surface tensions. These conjectures were extended by Koga and Indekeu and predicted that partial wetting may persist up to the line of critical end points, i.e. critical point wetting was absent. Here, we obtain the exact density profiles and surface tensions for the Koga-Widom-Indekeu (KWI) model using complex analysis and drawing on the theory of algebraic curves. The exact solution determines the location and order of wetting transitions in the surface phase diagram, confirming that critical point wetting is absent. The model also displays the remarkable property that microscopic density profiles are mapped, by a conformal transform, onto the shape of a macroscopic drop near the contact line whose tensions satisfy the Neumann triangle. Two related models, which illustrate the role of the component isotropy, are also discussed. These models suggest that a universality principle governs wetting in fluid mixtures, resolving contradicting results from earlier studies: Critical point wetting is present if the order-parameter components of the mixture describe Ising-like criticality, but is absent if there is a local XY symmetry. Implications for wetting transitions in more microscopic models and in experiments are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact solution、square-gradient models、complex analysis、algebraic curves。；研究对象：流体混合物中的润湿现象，具体为Koga-Widom-Indekeu（KWI）模型及其相关两组分平方梯度模型，涉及三元混合物中的三相共存和临界端点润湿行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精确求解了KWI模型的密度分布和表面张力，确认临界点润湿在该模型中不存在；揭示了润湿行为受序参量分量对称性（Ising型 vs. 局域XY对称性）的普适性原理支配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精确求解了KWI模型的密度分布和表面张力，确认临界点润湿在该模型中不存在；揭示了润湿行为受序参量分量对称性（Ising型 vs. 局域XY对称性）的普适性原理支配。；创新点：首次对KWI模型给出精确解，验证了此前数值研究中对表面张力表达式的猜想，并严格确定了润湿转变的位置和级次；通过对比相关模型，澄清了早期研究中关于临界点润湿存在与否的矛盾结论，提出了基于序参量对称性的普适性分类。
papers.method_zh: 采用复分析和代数曲线理论，对两组分平方梯度模型进行精确求解，得到密度分布路径和表面张力的解析表达式；通过共形变换将微观密度分布映射为宏观液滴形状，并利用Neumann三角形分析接触线张力。

papers.title: Electrohydraulic Fields Generated by Active Transport at Tissue Interfaces
papers.abstract: Living cells and tissues can generate complex patterns of electric fields and fluid flows which can play important role in physiology. Both, fields and flows are rooted in ion transport across biological interfaces: cell membranes and epithelial cell layers. Here we develop a unified electrohydraulic framework that combines electric fields, osmotic pressures, and fluid flows, emphasising their couplings. We consider an active, permeable interface that drives electrohydraulic fields in the surrounding bulk. We show that spatially heterogeneous ion transport acts as a distributed current source, generating long-range electric fields, osmotic gradients, and fluid flows. Using this framework, we show that patterns of ion pumping at cell and tissue boundaries can simultaneously produce large-scale electric fields and fluid flows due to electrohydraulic coupling. A key insight is that an external electric field and an internal dipolar pumping pattern can be physically equivalent and can generate the same pattern of ion current and fluid flows. The induced dipolar osmotic pressure can drive self-propulsion through bulk osmotic coupling, with a mobility determined by interfacial permeability and system size, a mechanism distinct from classical electrophoresis or electro-osmosis. We further show that for strong fields a new effect emerges. Nonlinear coupling can lead to isotropic swelling of a hollow ball of cells. This can explain recent experiments on epithelial organoids. Finally, we show that feedback between ion transport and resulting electric fields can drive spontaneous symmetry breaking, generating dipolar or multipolar fields and patterns. Our work highlights the importance of electrohydraulic coupling in the emergence in currents and fields in the biological systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a unified electrohydraulic framework、show、highlight。；研究对象：生物组织界面（如细胞膜、上皮细胞层）上由主动离子输运产生的电水动力学场，包括电场、渗透压和流体流动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空间异质性的离子输运可作为分布式电流源，通过电水动力学耦合同时产生大尺度电场和流体流动；外部电场与内部偶极泵浦模式在物理上等价，可产生相同的离子电流和流体流动模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空间异质性的离子输运可作为分布式电流源，通过电水动力学耦合同时产生大尺度电场和流体流动；外部电场与内部偶极泵浦模式在物理上等价，可产生相同的离子电流和流体流动模式。；创新点：揭示了外部电场与内部偶极泵浦模式的物理等价性；提出由偶极渗透压驱动的自推进机制，其迁移率由界面渗透性和系统尺寸决定，区别于经典电泳或电渗；发现强场下非线性耦合可导致细胞空心球的各向同性膨胀，解释上皮类器官实验；展示了离子输运与电场反馈可自发破缺对称性，产生偶极或多极场模式。
papers.method_zh: 构建统一的电水动力学理论框架，将电场、渗透压和流体流动耦合起来，分析主动、可渗透界面对周围体相中电水动力学场的驱动作用，并考虑非线性耦合效应。

papers.title: High-field Magnetotransport Studies of Surface Conducting Diamonds
papers.abstract: The observation of strong and tunable spin-orbit interaction (SOI) in surface conducting diamond opens up a new avenue for building diamond-based spintronics. Herein we provide a comprehensive method to analyze the magnetotransport behavior of surface conducting hydrogen-terminated diamond (H-diamond) Hall bar devices and Al/Al2O3/V2O5/H-diamond MOSFETs, respectively. By adopting a significantly improved theoretical magneto transport model, the reduced magnetoconductance can be accurately explained both within and outside the quantum diffusive regime. The model is valid for all doping strategies of surface conducting diamond tested. From this analysis, we find that the orbital magnetoresistance, a classical effect distinct from the SOI, dominates the magnetotransport in surface conducting diamond at high magnetic fields. Furthermore, local hole mobilities as high as 1000 ~ 3000 cm2/Vs have been observed in this work, indicating the possibility of diamond-based electronics with ultra-high hole mobilities at cryogenic temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提及“magnetotransport studies”、“Hall bar devices”、“MOSFETs”等实验测量手段。；研究对象：表面导电的氢终端金刚石（H-diamond）霍尔条器件以及Al/Al₂O₃/V₂O₅/H-diamond MOSFET结构中的磁输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在表面导电金刚石中，高磁场下的磁输运主要由经典的轨道磁电阻效应主导，而非自旋-轨道相互作用；同时观测到低温下高达1000~3000 cm²/Vs的空穴迁移率，表明金刚石基电子器件具有超高迁移率的潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在表面导电金刚石中，高磁场下的磁输运主要由经典的轨道磁电阻效应主导，而非自旋-轨道相互作用；同时观测到低温下高达1000~3000 cm²/Vs的空穴迁移率，表明金刚石基电子器件具有超高迁移率的潜力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用改进的理论磁输运模型，对氢终端金刚石霍尔条器件和MOSFET的磁电导数据进行拟合分析，涵盖量子扩散区内外。

papers.title: Direct observation of the transverse near field of an edge excitation and associated slow secondary dynamics in a fractional quantum Hall state
papers.abstract: We report stroboscopic time-resolved photoluminescence (PL) microscopy and spectroscopy revealing the transverse near field of an edge excitation in a $ν=1/3$ fractional quantum Hall (FQH) state. Time-resolved $y$-$t$ maps reveal an immediate PL response extending more than $30~μ\mathrm{m}$ into the bulk transverse to the edge when the edge magnetoplasmon (EMP) passes the mesa boundary. The nearly instantaneous nature of this long-range response identifies it as the non-radiative, quasi-electrostatic near field, revealing the EMP as a spatially extended collective excitation rather than a strictly one-dimensional charge-density oscillation. We also observe secondary bulk-side responses distinct from the immediate transverse near-field response. The coexistence of these immediate and secondary responses shows that electrically launched edge excitations produce bulk-side dynamics on widely separated time scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：stroboscopic time-resolved photoluminescence (PL) microscopy and spectroscopy（频闪时间分辨光致发光显微与光谱学）。；研究对象：ν=1/3 分数量子霍尔（FQH）态中的边缘激发（edge excitation），具体为边缘磁等离激元（EMP）及其横向近场与次级体态动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验直接观测到边缘磁等离激元（EMP）在通过台面边界时，会在体态横向方向产生超过30微米的瞬时光致发光响应，表明EMP是一种空间扩展的集体激发而非严格一维电荷密度振荡；同时观察到与瞬时响应时间尺度显著分离的次级体态动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验直接观测到边缘磁等离激元（EMP）在通过台面边界时，会在体态横向方向产生超过30微米的瞬时光致发光响应，表明EMP是一种空间扩展的集体激发而非严格一维电荷密度振荡；同时观察到与瞬时响应时间尺度显著分离的次级体态动力学。；创新点：首次通过光学手段直接观测到分数量子霍尔态边缘激发的横向近场，揭示了EMP的空间扩展特性及其引发的多时间尺度体态动力学。
papers.method_zh: 采用频闪时间分辨光致发光显微与光谱学技术，通过时间分辨的y-t空间映射（y-t maps）直接成像边缘激发的横向近场分布。

papers.title: Nonlinear Photonic Tripartite Phase
papers.abstract: Anderson localization is usually understood as a transition between extended and localized phases, with criticality confined to a single mobility edge. Recent advances predict that quasiperiodic systems can instead host a finite critical window bounded by mobility edges, in which localized, critical and extended states coexist. Yet both the experimental realization of this regime and whether interactions can provide controlled access to it remain unknown. Here, we realize such a tripartite phase in a nonlinear quasiperiodic photonic lattice and show that Kerr nonlinearity, acting as an effective interaction, enables state-selective access to the critical window. By tracking wavepacket dynamics, we distinguish localized, critical and extended transport regimes and uncover a state-selective response: rather than simply reinforcing localization through self-trapping, weak nonlinearity drives low-energy localized states into the critical window, whereas stronger nonlinearity restores localization. By contrast, critical, extended and high-energy localized states evolve monotonically towards self-trapped behaviour. Our results reveal a state-selective mechanism by which interactions provide controlled access to a pre-existing critical window in quasiperiodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Here, we realize such a tripartite phase in a nonlinear quasiperiodic photonic lattice”，并描述了实验观测波包动力学过程。；研究对象：非线性准周期光子晶格中的安德森局域化现象，具体研究局域态、临界态和扩展态共存的三分相（tripartite phase），以及克尔非线性（Kerr nonlinearity）作为有效相互作用对临界窗口的选择性调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非线性准周期光子晶格中实现了局域、临界和扩展态共存的三分相，并发现克尔非线性能够提供状态选择性调控：弱非线性驱动低能局域态进入临界窗口，而强非线性则恢复局域化；临界态、扩展态和高能局域态则单调地趋向自俘获行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非线性准周期光子晶格中实现了局域、临界和扩展态共存的三分相，并发现克尔非线性能够提供状态选择性调控：弱非线性驱动低能局域态进入临界窗口，而强非线性则恢复局域化；临界态、扩展态和高能局域态则单调地趋向自俘获行为。；创新点：首次在实验上实现了准周期系统中局域、临界和扩展态共存的三分相，并揭示了非线性相互作用（克尔效应）能够提供状态选择性的可控途径进入临界窗口，而非简单地增强局域化。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建非线性准周期光子晶格，通过追踪波包动力学（wavepacket dynamics）区分局域、临界和扩展输运区域；利用克尔非线性作为有效相互作用，实现状态选择性调控。

papers.title: Anomalous acoustoelectric signatures of chiral superconductivity
papers.abstract: The identification of unconventional pairing in two-dimensional materials is a central challenge in modern condensed matter physics. While chiral p-wave superconductivity offers a promising platform for topological quantum computing, its detection remains elusive due to the inherent limitations of optical probes in the two-dimensional limit. We propose the anomalous acoustoelectric effect as a robust, alternative to optical signature of p-wave paring symmetry. We demonstrate that an acoustic wave induces a transverse dc current resulting in a measurable condensate phase difference on sample boundaries originating from the anisotropic scattering of quasiparticles in the absence of an external magnetic field. Crucially, the quasiparticle-mediated acoustoelectric response dominates near the critical temperature and, unlike the superconducting condensate, is not suppressed by electron-hole asymmetry factor. These results establish the anomalous acoustoelectric effect as a high-sensitivity electrical probe of the chiral order parameter, providing a tool for experimental detecting of unconventional pairing in superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“We propose”“We demonstrate”“These results establish”等理论推导和预言性表述，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：二维手性超导体中的反常声电效应，具体针对手性p波配对对称性及其探测方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出反常声电效应可作为探测手性p波超导配对对称性的稳健替代光学手段：声波可在无外磁场条件下诱导横向直流电流，并在样品边界产生可测量的凝聚相位差，该响应在临界温度附近由准粒子主导，且不被电子-空穴不对称因子抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出反常声电效应可作为探测手性p波超导配对对称性的稳健替代光学手段：声波可在无外磁场条件下诱导横向直流电流，并在样品边界产生可测量的凝聚相位差，该响应在临界温度附近由准粒子主导，且不被电子-空穴不对称因子抑制。；创新点：首次提出利用反常声电效应作为手性超导序参量的高灵敏度电学探针，克服了二维极限下光学探测的固有局限性，并指出该响应在临界温度附近具有优于超导凝聚态响应的特性（不受电子-空穴不对称因子抑制）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于准粒子各向异性散射机制推导声波诱导的横向直流电流与凝聚相位差，并比较其与超导凝聚态响应的差异。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Irreversibility of Training Algorithms
papers.abstract: The training algorithms for AI systems all introduce far-from-equilibrium dynamical processes, and understanding the irreversibility of these algorithms is a fundamental step towards understanding the learning dynamics of modern AI systems. In this work, we establish a general framework for defining and analyzing the irreversibility of training algorithms. We show that four different ways to characterize the irreversibility of dynamical processes are equivalent to leading order in the step size $η$: numerical backward error $φ_{\rm DE}$, time-renormalized correction $φ_{\rm TR}$, microscopic time reversal asymmetry $φ_{\rm TA}$, and the (regularized) stochastic-thermodynamic entropy production $φ_{\rm ST}$. The irreversibility gives rise to a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking emergent force that generically breaks non-isometric continuous reparametrization symmetries, preserves orthogonal symmetries, and leads to a universal preference for those learning trajectories that minimize the entropy production rate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：建立理论框架、定义与分析、等价性证明、对称性分析。；研究对象：AI系统训练算法的热力学不可逆性，具体关注训练过程中远离平衡态的动力学过程及其熵产生。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 训练算法的不可逆性在步长η的领头阶上等价于四种不同表征方式（数值后向误差、时间重整化修正、微观时间反演不对称性、随机热力学熵产生），并导致一种打破时间反演对称性的涌现力，该力倾向于选择熵产生率最小的学习轨迹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：训练算法的不可逆性在步长η的领头阶上等价于四种不同表征方式（数值后向误差、时间重整化修正、微观时间反演不对称性、随机热力学熵产生），并导致一种打破时间反演对称性的涌现力，该力倾向于选择熵产生率最小的学习轨迹。；创新点：首次将训练算法的不可逆性与随机热力学熵产生建立严格等价关系，并揭示不可逆性导致的对称性破缺机制及其对学习轨迹的普适偏好。
papers.method_zh: 通过建立一般性理论框架，从数学上证明四种不可逆性表征方式在步长η领头阶的等价性，并分析对称性破缺性质（非等距连续重参数化对称性被破坏，正交对称性被保持）。

papers.title: First-Principles Study of Fe Adsorption and Its Effects on the Mechanical and Electrical Properties of Monolayer and Bilayer Biphenylene Networks
papers.abstract: Biphenylene network (BPN) is a 2D carbon allotrope that exhibits promising potential for applications. In this work, we systematically investigated the adsorption characteristics of Fe atoms on monolayer and bilayer BPN. Structural optimization and adsorption energy analysis reveal that, for monolayer BPN, the average adsorption gradually enhances with increasing Fe coverage, indicating a strengthening of Fe-substrate interactions. The most stable configuration is identified at an Fe/C ratio of 50 %. For bilayer BPN, the energetically preferred adsorption site for Fe atom is located at the center of the interlayer four-membered ring, with an average adsorption energy of -4.3 eV. Mechanical properties are further evaluated for pristine and Fe-decorated BPN. The results demonstrate that monolayer and bilayer BPN possess relatively high in-plane Young's and shear moduli, indicative of excellent in-plane mechanical stability. Fe adsorption is found to have only a minor effect on the in-plane mechanical properties of both monolayer and bilayer BPN, suggesting that the in-plane stiffness is predominantly governed by the intrinsic carbon framework. In contrast, the out-of-plane mechanical response of bilayer BPN is significantly affected by Fe incorporation. The effective out-of-plane elastic constant C33 of pristine bilayer BPN is calculated to be 24.59 GPa, indicating relatively weak interlayer interactions and facile deformation along the out-of-plane direction. Notably, this property can be substantially enhanced by interlayer Fe adsorption, with C33 increasing dramatically to 515.63 GPa upon an Fe/C ratio of 25 %. The calculations on pristine and Fe-decorated BPN reveal pronounced anisotropy in the conductivity, with the value along one direction being significantly higher than that along the other. At 300 K, the overall conductivity is on the order of 10^5 S/m.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：First-Principles Study（第一性原理研究）、Structural optimization（结构优化）、adsorption energy analysis（吸附能分析）。；研究对象：单层和双层联苯烯网络（Biphenylene network, BPN）上Fe原子的吸附行为，以及Fe吸附对其力学和电学性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe吸附对单层和双层BPN的面内力学性能影响很小，但能显著增强双层BPN的层间相互作用，使其面外弹性常数C33从24.59 GPa大幅提升至515.63 GPa（Fe/C比为25%时）。此外，Fe修饰的BPN表现出明显的导电各向异性，室温电导率量级为10^5 S/m。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe吸附对单层和双层BPN的面内力学性能影响很小，但能显著增强双层BPN的层间相互作用，使其面外弹性常数C33从24.59 GPa大幅提升至515.63 GPa（Fe/C比为25%时）。此外，Fe修饰的BPN表现出明显的导电各向异性，室温电导率量级为10^5 S/m。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（First-Principles calculations），具体包括结构优化、吸附能分析、力学性能（面内杨氏模量、剪切模量、面外弹性常数C33）计算以及电导率计算（含温度效应，300 K）。

papers.title: Optical anisotropy and electronic states in the pleochroic material Ca$_3$ReO$_5$Cl$_2$
papers.abstract: Pleochroism is a type of optical anisotropy in which the apparent color of a material varies depending on the polarization and propagation direction of incident light. The oxychloride compound Ca$_3$ReO$_5$Cl$_2$ has recently attracted attention due to its pronounced pleochroism. The paramagnetic state of this compound, characterized by localized Re 5$d$ electrons, is challenging to describe within conventional first-principles methods. In this study, we investigate the optical anisotropy in Ca$_3$ReO$_5$Cl$_2$ using first-principles calculations, with particular focus on the relationship between the optical spectra and electronic states. We employ a ferromagnetically ordered state to effectively capture the localized character of the Re 5$d$ electrons. The calculated dielectric function and absorption coefficient qualitatively reproduce the experimentally observed peak structures. An orbital-resolved analysis indicates that the characteristic optical transitions associated with the pleochroism predominantly involve Re-$d$-dominated electronic states, highlighting the key role of the Re $d$ electrons in the pleochroic optical response of Ca$_3$ReO$_5$Cl$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“calculated dielectric function and absorption coefficient”（计算介电函数和吸收系数）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是氧氯化物化合物 Ca₃ReO₅Cl₂，物理现象是其显著的多色性（pleochroism）以及相关的光学各向异性与电子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过采用铁磁有序态来有效描述局域化的 Re 5d 电子，第一性原理计算定性地重现了实验观测到的介电函数和吸收系数峰结构；轨道分辨分析表明，与多色性相关的特征光学跃迁主要涉及 Re-d 主导的电子态，突出了 Re d 电子在多色性光学响应中的关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过采用铁磁有序态来有效描述局域化的 Re 5d 电子，第一性原理计算定性地重现了实验观测到的介电函数和吸收系数峰结构；轨道分辨分析表明，与多色性相关的特征光学跃迁主要涉及 Re-d 主导的电子态，突出了 Re d 电子在多色性光学响应中的关键作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体通过构建铁磁有序态（ferromagnetically ordered state）来捕捉 Re 5d 电子的局域化特征，并计算了介电函数（dielectric function）和吸收系数（absorption coefficient），进行了轨道分辨分析（orbital-resolved analysis）。

papers.title: Dissipation-Selected Resonant Fronts in a Driven-Dissipative Bose-Hubbard Lattice
papers.abstract: Spatially structured dissipation organizes driven quantum matter beyond Hamiltonian control. We show that a dissipation gradient combined with a Stark-induced detuning ramp selects a nonlinear resonance slice in a two-dimensional driven-dissipative Bose-Hubbard lattice, producing a pinned density front in generalized Gross-Pitaevskii simulations. The underlying resonance condition fixes the front position, while its Airy-like profile obeys a width scaling set by tunneling stiffness and the effective detuning slope. Treating the front as an emergent interface explains how tuning the selected resonance toward the minimum-loss side yields Peierls-Nabarro depinning steps, discrete transverse pattern locking, spatiotemporal chaos, and minimum-loss localization. Center-of-mass and generalized-imbalance diagnostics map these outcomes into a dynamical phase diagram as detuning-ramp slope and dissipation-gradient strength vary. The results suggest structured dissipation as a mechanism for reconfigurable transport barriers and nonequilibrium interfaces in programmable bosonic lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：generalized Gross-Pitaevskii simulations、dynamical phase diagram。；研究对象：驱动-耗散型玻色-哈伯德晶格（driven-dissipative Bose-Hubbard lattice）中的非线性共振前沿（resonant fronts）及其动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过空间结构化的耗散梯度与斯塔克诱导的失谐斜坡（detuning ramp）相结合，可以在二维驱动-耗散玻色-哈伯德晶格中选定一个非线性共振切片，从而产生钉扎的密度前沿。该前沿的宽度由隧穿强度和有效失谐斜率决定，并且通过调节选定的共振位置，可以实现Peierls-Nabarro脱钉步骤、离散横向模式锁定、时空混沌以及最小损耗局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过空间结构化的耗散梯度与斯塔克诱导的失谐斜坡（detuning ramp）相结合，可以在二维驱动-耗散玻色-哈伯德晶格中选定一个非线性共振切片，从而产生钉扎的密度前沿。该前沿的宽度由隧穿强度和有效失谐斜率决定，并且通过调节选定的共振位置，可以实现Peierls-Nabarro脱钉步骤、离散横向模式锁定、时空混沌以及最小损耗局域化。；创新点：提出将结构化耗散（structured dissipation）作为一种可重构的输运屏障和非平衡界面的机制，用于可编程玻色晶格。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义Gross-Pitaevskii方程进行数值模拟，并利用质心和广义不平衡度（generalized-imbalance）诊断方法绘制动力学相图。

papers.title: Spin torque driven mode hybridization and band engineering in nanopatterned magnonic crystals
papers.abstract: Spin wave propagation and dynamic control are essential for reconfigurable magnonic and spintronic devices. Here, tunable mode coupling and band hybridisation are demonstrated in a nanopatterned bicomponent magnonic crystal consisting of a Permalloy/heavy metal bilayer patterned with a two dimensional array of Co nanodots. Using the plane wave method and the linearised Landau Lifshitz equation with a field like torque term, we show that inhomogeneous current induced spin torque produces periodic modulation of the magnonic frequency, enabling dynamic control of spin-wave dispersion. A pronounced avoided crossing between localised and propagating Damon Eshbach modes is observed, leading to tunable hybridisation gaps, band deformation, and enhanced mode mixing. The spin torque induced modulation enables controlled mode conversion and reconfigurable hybrid magnonic states, demonstrating efficient electrical tuning of nanoscale spin-wave dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：plane wave method, linearised Landau Lifshitz equation）；研究对象：一种由坡莫合金/重金属双层膜和二维钴纳米点阵列构成的纳米图案化双组分磁子晶体中的自旋波传播与动力学控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过非均匀电流产生的自旋轨道矩，实现了对磁子晶体中局域模与传播模（Damon Eshbach模）之间能带杂化的动态调控，产生了可调的杂化能隙和能带形变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过非均匀电流产生的自旋轨道矩，实现了对磁子晶体中局域模与传播模（Damon Eshbach模）之间能带杂化的动态调控，产生了可调的杂化能隙和能带形变。；创新点：利用电流诱导的自旋轨道矩对磁子频率进行周期性调制，从而动态控制自旋波色散，实现了对纳米尺度自旋波动力学的电学调控。摘要未突出说明与具体实验结果的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用平面波方法求解包含类场力矩项的线性化Landau-Lifshitz方程，理论计算了自旋波色散关系。

papers.title: Defect Kinematics in 2D Nematics: Contributions from Surface Topology, Intrinsic and Extrinsic Geometry, Solitons, Defect Orientations, and Elastic Anisotropy
papers.abstract: We characterise the particlelike kinematics of charge-carrying topological defects in nematic media via a geometric field theory. This differs from the theory of electromagnetism, with which it is often compared, due to the absence of gauge-invariance. In both approaches, basic defect interactions are governed by a propagator, which depends upon the global topology and/or intrinsic geometry of the surface. For nematic materials, however, the minimisation of the free energy is sensitive to constraints that a gauge invariant theory would otherwise be indifferent to. Hodge theory is used to capture these as `harmonic' excitations, unifying two factors known to additionally affect the kinematics of defects in nematics: relative defect orientations and topological solitons. Perturbations to the form of the energy are also permitted in nematic materials due to gauge \emph{non}invariance. Those that introduce non-linearities in the corresponding Euler--Lagrange equations are shown to result in defect interactions that go beyond pairwise despite the otherwise abelian nature of the underlying U(1) symmetry. We show how this type of induced many-body effect manifests in the cases of non-zero extrinsic curvature and/or elastic anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：geometric field theory、Hodge theory、Euler–Lagrange equations。；研究对象：二维向列相液晶中携带拓扑电荷的缺陷的类粒子运动学，涉及表面拓扑、内禀与外禀几何、孤子、缺陷取向及弹性各向异性对缺陷动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 由于向列相材料缺乏规范不变性，其自由能最小化受到规范不变理论所忽略的约束影响；通过Hodge理论将这些约束统一为“调和”激发，并证明非零外禀曲率和/或弹性各向异性会诱导超越两体相互作用的缺陷多体效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：由于向列相材料缺乏规范不变性，其自由能最小化受到规范不变理论所忽略的约束影响；通过Hodge理论将这些约束统一为“调和”激发，并证明非零外禀曲率和/或弹性各向异性会诱导超越两体相互作用的缺陷多体效应。；创新点：揭示了向列相中因规范非不变性导致的缺陷多体相互作用机制，并统一了缺陷相对取向与拓扑孤子对缺陷运动学的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用几何场论框架，结合Hodge理论分析“调和”激发，并通过引入能量形式的微扰（导致Euler–Lagrange方程非线性）来研究缺陷相互作用。

papers.title: Effect of Pb Substitution at the Mo site on the Magnetic Properties of the Polar Magnet Fe$_2$Mo$_3$O$_8$
papers.abstract: The ternary transition-metal oxide Fe$_2$Mo$_3$O$_8$ is a polar magnet characterized by a layered structure of magnetic Fe honeycomb lattices and non-magnetic Mo kagome lattices. Whereas previous studies have primarily focused on the chemical substitution at the Fe sites to modulate the magnetic properties, the Mo sites have remained largely unexplored due to the strong spin-singlet trimerization of Mo$^{4+}$ ions. In this study, we investigated the effect of substituting non-magnetic Pb$^{4+}$ and Zr$^{4+}$ ions into the Mo sites to intentionally disrupt the Mo trimers. Our results reveal that the disruption of the Mo spin-singlet state induces active spins within the Mo layer, resulting in the emergence of a ferromagnetic-like behavior that persists even at room temperature. Quantitative analysis that takes into account the weight fraction of the main phase suggests an effective spin $S = 1/2$ state per active Mo ion upon trimer disruption. These findings demonstrate that controlling non-magnetic cluster states within a polar host via chemical substitution is a promising approach for designing room-temperature magnetoelectric materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“our results reveal”“quantitative analysis”等实验发现与数据分析表述，未涉及计算或理论推导。；研究对象：极性磁体Fe₂Mo₃O₈，具体研究在Mo位点用Pb⁴⁺和Zr⁴⁺离子替代后对其磁性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Mo位点引入非磁性Pb⁴⁺或Zr⁴⁺离子会破坏Mo⁴⁺离子的自旋单态三聚体，从而在Mo层中激活自旋，导致即使在室温下也出现类似铁磁的行为。每个被破坏的Mo三聚体对应的有效自旋为S=1/2。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Mo位点引入非磁性Pb⁴⁺或Zr⁴⁺离子会破坏Mo⁴⁺离子的自旋单态三聚体，从而在Mo层中激活自旋，导致即使在室温下也出现类似铁磁的行为。每个被破坏的Mo三聚体对应的有效自旋为S=1/2。；创新点：以往研究主要关注Fe位点的化学替代来调控磁性质，而本研究首次探索Mo位点的替代，通过破坏非磁性团簇态（Mo三聚体）来诱导室温铁磁行为，为设计室温多铁材料提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 通过化学替代（Pb⁴⁺、Zr⁴⁺）调控Mo位点，结合主相质量分数校正的定量分析，推测每个活性Mo离子的有效自旋态。

papers.title: Comment on "Entropic Costs of Extracting Classical Ticks from a Quantum Clock"
papers.abstract: A recent Letter by Wadhia et al. reports a realization of a quantum clock using a double quantum dot (DQD) [Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 200407 (2005)]. This Comment identifies two fundamental issues: (I) the claimed ``quantum clock" exhibits only classical behavior and lacks intrinsic temporal correlations between ticks; it is not sufficient for accurate time as a good clock. (II) the thermodynamic analysis misassigns entropy production and conflates amplification with measurement; the reported combined entropy is an engineering dissipation, not a fundamental cost of quantum timekeeping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（Comment）。判断依据：论文标题为“Comment on...”，摘要明确指出指出他人工作的“fundamental issues”，属于对已有论文的批评性理论分析。；研究对象：双量子点（DQD）量子钟系统。具体涉及该系统中“量子钟”的经典行为与热力学分析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作指出：Wadhia等人声称的“量子钟”实际上仅表现出经典行为，缺乏内在的时间关联，不足以作为精确时钟；其热力学分析错误地将工程耗散归因于量子计时的基本熵成本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作指出：Wadhia等人声称的“量子钟”实际上仅表现出经典行为，缺乏内在的时间关联，不足以作为精确时钟；其热力学分析错误地将工程耗散归因于量子计时的基本熵成本。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该Comment的主要新意在于揭示原论文在量子时钟定义和热力学成本归属上的根本性错误。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与逻辑论证。摘要未明确说明具体计算或实验手段，而是通过概念辨析（如区分经典与量子行为、熵产生与放大/测量的混淆）进行批评。

papers.title: A diffuse-interface theory of active nematic interfaces: transport mechanisms and modal structure
papers.abstract: We develop a long-wavelength theory for the linear stability of a flat interface between an active nematic and an isotropic fluid. Starting from a diffuse-interface Cahn--Hilliard--Landau--de Gennes description coupled to Brinkman-screened Stokes hydrodynamics, we project the linearized dynamics onto a small set of interfacial degrees of freedom: the conserved translation, or height, mode; a scalar profile distortion or amplitude mode; and a transverse orientational mode associated with director rotations. Eliminating the gapped scalar profile mode gives a reduced interfacial operator coupling the conserved height mode to the transverse orientational mode. The main result is that activity generates, in the screened diffuse-interface regime, a direct local contribution proportional to $q^2$ in the height sector. This term competes with the passive local diffusive capillary relaxation, which enters at order $q^4$, and defines a local active interfacial channel controlled by the internal structure of the diffuse interface. This mechanism is distinct from the non-analytic $|q|$ and $|q|q^2$ terms characteristic of weakly screened Hele--Shaw/Saffman--Taylor-type transport, which are controlled by long-ranged momentum transport in the surrounding fluid. This framework identifies a diffuse-interface route to active interfacial instability that can operate while the homogeneous active nematic remains linearly stable because of hydrodynamic screening. It also provides a basis for distinguishing local diffuse-interface instabilities, bulk-flow-driven hydrodynamic instabilities, and mixed regimes in active nematic--isotropic interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a long-wavelength theory、project the linearized dynamics、theoretical framework。；研究对象：活性向列相与各向同性流体之间的平坦界面，具体研究该界面的线性稳定性及输运机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性效应在屏蔽扩散界面体系中产生一个与波数平方（q²）成正比的局域界面贡献，该贡献与被动扩散毛细松弛（q⁴阶）竞争，定义了由扩散界面内部结构控制的局域活性界面通道，从而在均匀活性向列相因流体动力学屏蔽而保持线性稳定时，仍可驱动界面失稳。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性效应在屏蔽扩散界面体系中产生一个与波数平方（q²）成正比的局域界面贡献，该贡献与被动扩散毛细松弛（q⁴阶）竞争，定义了由扩散界面内部结构控制的局域活性界面通道，从而在均匀活性向列相因流体动力学屏蔽而保持线性稳定时，仍可驱动界面失稳。；创新点：揭示了与弱屏蔽Hele-Shaw/Saffman-Taylor型输运（由长程动量输运控制）不同的扩散界面活性失稳机制，并区分了局域扩散界面失稳、体流驱动流体动力学失稳及混合失稳三种类型。
papers.method_zh: 采用扩散界面Cahn-Hilliard-Landau-de Gennes理论，耦合Brinkman屏蔽Stokes流体动力学，通过将线性化动力学投影到界面自由度（平移高度模、标量轮廓畸变模、横向取向模）上，并消除有能隙的标量轮廓模，得到约化界面算符。

papers.title: Microwave-Stimulated Serpentinization of Olivine for Geological Hydrogen Production
papers.abstract: Serpentinization of ultramafic rocks is a naturally occurring mineralogical process that can generate molecular hydrogen through the oxidation of ferrous iron during water-rock reaction. Although the resource potential is large, the natural reaction is kinetically limited, and practical hydrogen recovery requires methods that can accelerate conversion without imposing an energy penalty that exceeds the value of the hydrogen produced. This short communication reports a preliminary atmospheric-pressure microwave serpentinization experiment using a water-saturated 2 g crushed olivine sample. Microwave irradiation produced a rapid increase in measured hydrogen concentration compared with conventional hot-plate heating under otherwise similar conditions. The preliminary experiment showed approximately a 12-fold increase in hydrogen concentration and an apparent rate increase from about 2 ppb s$^{-1}$ for conventional heating to about 10 ppb s$^{-1}$ during microwave exposure. These results suggest that electromagnetic stimulation can enhance serpentinization kinetics, likely through rapid volumetric heating, selective coupling to iron-bearing phases, and localized thermal gradients. The result provides an initial experimental basis for evaluating microwave stimulation as a route to accelerated geologic hydrogen production and motivates follow-on measurements using calibrated gas analysis, absorbed-power measurements, dielectric characterization, and elevated-pressure testing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“experiment”、“measured”、“preliminary experiment”、“hot-plate heating”、“microwave exposure”。；研究对象：橄榄石（olivine）的水蛇纹石化反应（serpentinization），用于地质产氢。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微波辐照可显著加速橄榄石的水蛇纹石化反应，使氢气浓度提升约12倍，反应速率从约2 ppb/s（传统加热）增至约10 ppb/s（微波辐照）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微波辐照可显著加速橄榄石的水蛇纹石化反应，使氢气浓度提升约12倍，反应速率从约2 ppb/s（传统加热）增至约10 ppb/s（微波辐照）。；创新点：首次报道了利用微波刺激加速橄榄石水蛇纹石化反应以促进地质产氢的初步实验证据，为电磁刺激增强蛇纹石化动力学提供了实验基础。
papers.method_zh: 大气压下的微波辐照实验，使用2克水饱和的粉碎橄榄石样品，并与传统热板加热进行对比。通过测量氢气浓度变化来评估反应动力学。

papers.title: Conductivity of a Non-Galilean--Invariant Fermi Liquid: Exact Solution of the Kinetic Equation
papers.abstract: We obtain an exact expression for the conductivity of a disordered, non-Galilean-invariant Fermi liquid by solving the kinetic equation with both screened Coulomb and $z=3$ Pomeranchuk critical interactions. While consistent with previous asymptotic results, our solution shows that electron-electron interactions enter the conductivity solely via the quasiparticle scattering time, $τ_\mathrm{ee}$. Accordingly, the crossovers between the collisionless and hydrodynamic regimes occur when $1/τ_\mathrm{ee}$ becomes comparable to the larger of the impurity scattering rate and the probe frequency, $Ω$. In addition, the exact solution yields the optical response in the hydrodynamic regime, $Ω\ll 1/τ_\mathrm{ee}$, which is inaccessible within perturbation theory. Near a $z=3$ Pomeranchuk quantum critical point, consistency between the kinetic-equation and Kubo approaches requires proper inclusion of mass renormalization within the Eliashberg approximation, which also ensures that the crossover between the collisionless and hydrodynamic regimes in the optical conductivity occurs at the Planckian scale $Ω\sim T$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：kinetic equation（动力学方程）、exact solution（精确解）、Kubo approach（久保方法）。；研究对象：非伽利略不变费米液体的电导率，具体涉及无序体系、屏蔽库仑相互作用以及z=3 Pomeranchuk临界相互作用下的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子-电子相互作用仅通过准粒子散射时间τ_ee进入电导率表达式；在z=3 Pomeranchuk量子临界点附近，动力学方程与久保方法的一致性要求正确纳入Eliashberg近似下的质量重整化，从而确保光学电导率中碰撞区与流体动力学区之间的交叉发生在普朗克尺度Ω~T。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子-电子相互作用仅通过准粒子散射时间τ_ee进入电导率表达式；在z=3 Pomeranchuk量子临界点附近，动力学方程与久保方法的一致性要求正确纳入Eliashberg近似下的质量重整化，从而确保光学电导率中碰撞区与流体动力学区之间的交叉发生在普朗克尺度Ω~T。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解包含屏蔽库仑相互作用和z=3 Pomeranchuk临界相互作用的动力学方程，获得电导率的精确表达式；并与久保方法进行对比，结合Eliashberg近似处理质量重整化。

papers.title: Uncovering Antipolar Ordering and Pressure-Tunable Phases in Hexagonal LaN
papers.abstract: We predict an antipolar instability in hexagonal LaN using first-principles density functional theory. Starting from a nonpolar hexagonal phase, we identify competing polar and antipolar zone-center phonon instabilities. Condensation of the polar and antipolar modes stabilizes, respectively, dynamically stable wurtzite (WZ) phase and an hexagonal antipolar (AP) phase which is characterized by alternating local polarization and zero net macroscopic polarization within the unit cell. At ambient conditions, the AP phase is metastable with respect to the WZ phase, and a finite energy barrier exists between these phases, suggesting a possible polarization-switching pathway via the AP intermediate state. The energy barrier between the WZ and AP phases decreases with increasing pressure, indicating enhanced tunability between polar and antipolar states. The sublattice polarization increases with pressure in the AP phase, while it decreases in the WZ phase. We further find that, with increasing pressure, the rock-salt and tetragonal phases of LaN become more stable than the hexagonal phases (AP and WZ). Consequently, the realization of the AP phase is more favorable in the low-pressure regime, where hexagonal phases remain energetically competitive. These results demonstrate pressure-driven competition between polar and antipolar phases in LaN and point toward antiferroelectric-like behavior in this binary nitride system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles density functional theory（第一性原理密度泛函理论）、predict（预测）、identify（识别）。；研究对象：六方相氮化镧（hexagonal LaN）中的反极性有序（antipolar ordering）以及压力可调相（pressure-tunable phases）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在六方LaN中预测了一种反极性（AP）相，该相具有交替的局域极化和零净宏观极化，且与极性纤锌矿（WZ）相之间存在可随压力调控的能量势垒，表现出类似反铁电的行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在六方LaN中预测了一种反极性（AP）相，该相具有交替的局域极化和零净宏观极化，且与极性纤锌矿（WZ）相之间存在可随压力调控的能量势垒，表现出类似反铁电的行为。；创新点：首次在二元氮化物LaN中预测了反极性有序相，并揭示了极性与反极性相之间随压力增强的可调性，指出了该体系中可能存在的反铁电行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）进行计算，分析了非极性六方相中的极性（polar）和反极性（antipolar）声子不稳定性，并计算了不同压力下各相的相对稳定性及极化变化。

papers.title: Rheology and Programmable Gelation of DNA Origami Polymer Tadpoles
papers.abstract: DNA origami is a powerful method to achieve nanoscale folded structures. Despite rapid improvements in folding and purification methods, DNA origami objects are still often produced in small quantities and studied at single molecule scale. Here, we design simple DNA origami-inspired polymers with complex topologies, and study their rheology and viscoelastic properties in dense conditions. First, we designed and purified topologically distinct DNA nanostructures, linear, circular, and "tadpole" polymers, to evaluate how polymer architecture influences entanglement and rheology. Despite their distinct topologies, we observe that all constructs obeyed universal rheological scalings, likely due to their short length. However, upon thermal annealing in the bulk, the DNA origami-like polymers displayed significantly different behaviours. Our results suggest that DNA origami-like polymers could be used to engineer thermoresponsive behaviours in complex fluids by introducing reversible and topology-dependent crosslinking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“设计并纯化”“研究流变学和粘弹性”“热退火”等实验操作和测量手段。；研究对象：基于DNA折纸原理构建的拓扑聚合物（线性、环形和“蝌蚪”形），研究其在高密度条件下的流变学行为和粘弹性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管不同拓扑结构的DNA折纸聚合物在短链条件下均遵循普适的流变标度律，但在体相热退火后，它们表现出显著不同的行为，表明可通过引入可逆且拓扑依赖的交联来设计热响应性复杂流体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管不同拓扑结构的DNA折纸聚合物在短链条件下均遵循普适的流变标度律，但在体相热退火后，它们表现出显著不同的行为，表明可通过引入可逆且拓扑依赖的交联来设计热响应性复杂流体。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 设计并纯化拓扑不同的DNA纳米结构（线性、环形、蝌蚪形），进行流变学测量和粘弹性分析，并结合热退火处理研究其体相行为。

papers.title: MetaDNS: Enhancing Exploration in Discrete Neural Samplers via Well-Tempered Metadynamics
papers.abstract: Sampling from discrete distributions with multiple modes and energy barriers is fundamental to machine learning and computational physics. Recent discrete neural samplers like MDNS suffer from mode collapse and fail to sample high-energy barrier regions between modes, which is critical for free energy estimation and understanding phase transitions. We propose Metadynamics Discrete Neural Sampler (MetaDNS), a general framework integrating well-tempered metadynamics into discrete diffusion or autoregressive samplers. By maintaining an adaptive, history-dependent bias potential along selected low-dimensional coordinates, MetaDNS forces exploration of previously inaccessible regions, enabling free energy reconstruction infeasible with standard neural samplers due to a lack of high-energy samples. On challenging low-temperature benchmarks including Ising, Potts, and the copper-gold binary alloy, MetaDNS reproduces the thermodynamic distribution. Compared to MCMC-based metadynamics, MetaDNS also achieves comparable exploration requiring fewer bias deposition steps.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural samplers, metadynamics, free energy estimation, discrete diffusion。；研究对象：离散分布的多模态采样问题，具体应用于Ising模型、Potts模型以及铜金二元合金（copper-gold binary alloy）等低温度下的统计力学体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出MetaDNS框架，通过引入历史依赖的偏置势，迫使离散神经采样器探索之前无法到达的高能垒区域，从而在低温度基准上成功复现热力学分布，并实现自由能重构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出MetaDNS框架，通过引入历史依赖的偏置势，迫使离散神经采样器探索之前无法到达的高能垒区域，从而在低温度基准上成功复现热力学分布，并实现自由能重构。；创新点：首次将元动力学（metadynamics）思想引入离散神经采样器（如MDNS），解决了此类采样器在多模态分布中因模式坍塌而无法采样高能垒区域的关键问题，并实现了比基于MCMC的元动力学更少的偏置沉积步数。
papers.method_zh: 将well-tempered metadynamics（良好温控元动力学）集成到离散扩散或自回归采样器中，沿选定的低维坐标维护自适应、历史依赖的偏置势，以增强探索能力。

papers.title: Quasiparticle GW for Superconductors: Toward a Unified Treatment of Electron-Phonon and Electron-Plasmon Couplings
papers.abstract: Superconducting two-dimensional materials, and in particular few-layer graphene, offer an exciting platform for low-power electronics, yet the origin of their unconventional superconductivity remains an open question. Prevailing theories, primarily rooted in the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) framework that assumes electron-phonon interactions are the main mechanism of superconductivity, struggle to account quantitatively for the observed phenomena. Recent studies point to a plasmonic pairing mechanism in graphene systems; however, disentangling the relative contributions of phonon- and plasmon-mediated pairing remains challenging due to the lack of a satisfactory first-principles framework capable of accurately capturing dynamical screening effects in the electronic channel. Here, we present a new theoretical framework that extends the quasiparticle self-consistent GW method to the superconducting phase by coupling it with the Eliashberg treatment of both phonon- and plasmon-mediated interactions. Our approach, termed "s-qpGW", is on par with the state-of-the-art Eliashberg theory of superconductivity when applied to bulk metals, and correctly predicts the absence of superconductivity in doped monolayer graphene. To differentiate s-qpGW from conventional Eliashberg approaches, we study a simple model system, graphene with an artificially enhanced density of states, and demonstrate that s-qpGW captures dynamical Coulomb screening effects in ways that standard BCS theory cannot.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical framework、extends the quasiparticle self-consistent GW method、Eliashberg treatment。；研究对象：超导二维材料，特别是少层石墨烯体系中的非常规超导机制，以及电子-声子耦合与电子-等离子体激元耦合的竞争关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个名为“s-qpGW”的新理论框架，能够统一处理声子和等离子体激元介导的超导配对，正确预测了掺杂单层石墨烯中不存在超导性，并揭示了标准BCS理论无法捕捉的动态库仑屏蔽效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个名为“s-qpGW”的新理论框架，能够统一处理声子和等离子体激元介导的超导配对，正确预测了掺杂单层石墨烯中不存在超导性，并揭示了标准BCS理论无法捕捉的动态库仑屏蔽效应。；创新点：首次将准粒子自洽GW方法与Eliashberg理论耦合，实现了对超导相中电子-声子和电子-等离子体激元耦合的统一第一性原理处理，能够区分两种配对机制的相对贡献，并捕捉动态库仑屏蔽效应。
papers.method_zh: 将准粒子自洽GW方法扩展到超导相，并与处理声子和等离子体激元相互作用的Eliashberg理论相结合，构建了“s-qpGW”理论框架。

papers.title: Enhancement in Magnetic and Magnetocaloric Properties of CoFe2O4 Nanofibers at Lower Temperatures
papers.abstract: This research paper investigates new and first insights into the magnetic and magnetocaloric properties of one-dimensional (1D) cobalt ferrite CoFe2O4 (CFO) nanofibers elaborated by sol gel based electrospinning technique, particularly focusing on their behavior at low temperatures for specific applications. The calcined CFO nanofibers microstructural, structural, magnetic, and magnetocaloric properties were explored. The nanofibers (NFs) microstructure, with an average diameter of 210 nm, was examined by scanning and transmission electron microscopies (SEM, TEM). The X-ray diffraction (XRD) of the CFO nanofibers showed a pure cubic close-packed (c.c.p) spinel crystalline structure with the F d 3 -m space group. The Raman spectroscopic studies further confirm the cubic inverse spinel phase. The Magnetic properties were explored as a function of temperature, ranging from 10 to 300 K, a ferromagnetic behaviour was observed with the highest saturation magnetization of 75.87 emu g(-1) and a coercivity of 723 Oe at room temperature. The variation of the magnetic entropy was measured indirectly using the Maxwell approach with an increasing magnetic field. A maximum of Delta(S)=1.71 J K-1 was reached around 32 K. At 180 K, the associated adiabatic temperature change, Delta (Tmax), was 0.93 K, with a large RCP value of 7.58 J kg-1 was measured, which is reasonably high for the corresponding nanoparticles (NPs). This work may suggest that 1D CFO nanofibers offer a promising route for the production of nanostructured magnetic materials, potentially impacting various electronic and electromagnetic device applications at low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：sol gel based electrospinning technique（溶胶-凝胶静电纺丝技术）、SEM、TEM、XRD、Raman光谱、磁性测量。；研究对象：一维钴铁氧体（CoFe₂O₄，CFO）纳米纤维，重点研究其在低温下的磁性和磁热效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在10–300 K温度范围内，CFO纳米纤维表现出铁磁行为，室温下饱和磁化强度高达75.87 emu/g，矫顽力为723 Oe；在约32 K时达到最大磁熵变1.71 J K⁻¹，在180 K时绝热温度变化为0.93 K，相对制冷能力（RCP）为7.58 J kg⁻¹，表明其在低温电子和电磁器件应用中具有潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在10–300 K温度范围内，CFO纳米纤维表现出铁磁行为，室温下饱和磁化强度高达75.87 emu/g，矫顽力为723 Oe；在约32 K时达到最大磁熵变1.71 J K⁻¹，在180 K时绝热温度变化为0.93 K，相对制冷能力（RCP）为7.58 J kg⁻¹，表明其在低温电子和电磁器件应用中具有潜力。；创新点：首次系统研究一维CFO纳米纤维在低温下的磁热效应，并发现其具有较高的磁熵变和相对制冷能力，为低温磁制冷和纳米磁性材料应用提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 采用溶胶-凝胶静电纺丝技术制备CFO纳米纤维；使用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和透射电子显微镜（TEM）表征微观结构；X射线衍射（XRD）和拉曼光谱分析晶体结构；通过变温（10–300 K）磁性测量研究磁性能；利用Maxwell关系间接计算磁熵变。

papers.title: Backward Mapping from Device Targets to Chemical Genomes for Interpretable Discovery of Phase-Stable Lead-Free Double Perovskites with DFT-Validated Design Rules
papers.abstract: Lead-free halide double perovskites are promising alternatives to Pb-based semiconductors, but their discovery is challenging because structural formability, thermodynamic stability, band-gap placement, optical-transition strength, dielectric screening, and carrier transport must all be satisfied within the vast A2BB'X6 space. We present a backward-mapping, genome-guided framework linking device-level targets to chemically interpretable descriptor families for Pb-free double-perovskite discovery. From 13,088 charge-balanced compositions, we apply a halide-aware workflow integrating geometric formability filtering, six-family chemical-genome descriptor encoding, evolutionary-optimized machine learning surrogates, SHAP-based interpretation, and DFT phenotype closure. Stability is modeled using Ehull-derived labels, while a band-gap surrogate predicts scalar-relativistic PBE Eg for target-driven selection. The funnel reduces the search space to seven DFT-validated candidates: K2BePdF6, K2MnCdCl6, Rb2TeCuBr6, Cs2SnGeBr6, Cs2GeSrBr6, Cs2NiBaI6, and Cs2AgInCl6, all verified for structural assignability, band-edge character, effective masses, dielectric response, optical absorption, conductivity, reflectivity, energy-loss spectra, and XRD fingerprints. Functional rules emerge from stability-function coupling rather than band-gap optimization alone, providing an interpretable inverse-design paradigm to accelerate Pb-free double-perovskite discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：DFT-validated、machine learning surrogates、evolutionary-optimized、genome-guided framework）；研究对象：无铅卤化物双钙钛矿（A₂BB'X₆体系），具体包括K₂BePdF₆、K₂MnCdCl₆、Rb₂TeCuBr₆、Cs₂SnGeBr₆、Cs₂GeSrBr₆、Cs₂NiBaI₆、Cs₂AgInCl₆等候选材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过逆向映射框架，从器件目标出发筛选出7个经DFT验证的稳定无铅双钙钛矿候选材料，并发现稳定性与功能性的耦合规则（而非仅优化带隙）是加速发现的关键。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过逆向映射框架，从器件目标出发筛选出7个经DFT验证的稳定无铅双钙钛矿候选材料，并发现稳定性与功能性的耦合规则（而非仅优化带隙）是加速发现的关键。；创新点：提出从器件目标到化学描述符的逆向映射范式，将稳定性建模（基于Ehull）与带隙代理模型结合，并通过SHAP提取可解释的设计规则，而非仅依赖带隙优化。
papers.method_zh: 采用“逆向映射-基因组引导”框架，具体包括：卤素感知几何成形性过滤、六族化学基因组描述符编码、进化优化的机器学习代理模型、SHAP可解释性分析、以及DFT（PBE标量相对论带隙、Ehull稳定性标签）表型闭合验证。

papers.title: Diagrammatic Monte Carlo for Fermionic Rényi Entanglement Entropy
papers.abstract: We develop a direct diagrammatic Monte Carlo framework for the Renyi entanglement entropy of interacting lattice fermions. The method starts from the fermionic graded-swap representation of Z_n[A]=Tr_Aρ_A^n, which converts the entropy problem into a replicated path integral with mixed temporal boundary conditions on the entangling region. In this representation the replica momenta are half-shifted, q_m=(2m+1)π/n, and the interaction expansion has a determinant form suitable for connected-determinant summation. We combine this expansion with a many-configuration Markov-chain Monte Carlo sampler to obtain order-by-order corrections for very large systems to very high orders. As a benchmark, we compare the order-by-order coefficients of a 3*3 Hubbard cluster with exact diagonalization. We then report a production calculation for a large periodic lattice with a square subregions. The dominant system-size limitation is therefore memory rather than a conventional auxiliary-field sign problem. The results provide a step toward diagrammatic calculations of fermionic entanglement observables in regimes where direct quantum Monte Carlo sampling is costly or sign-problem limited.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：diagrammatic Monte Carlo framework、replicated path integral、Markov-chain Monte Carlo sampler）；研究对象：相互作用晶格费米子的Rényi纠缠熵
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发展了一种直接图解蒙特卡洛框架，可计算大尺寸周期性晶格中方子区域费米子Rényi纠缠熵，且主要系统尺寸限制来自内存而非传统辅助场符号问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发展了一种直接图解蒙特卡洛框架，可计算大尺寸周期性晶格中方子区域费米子Rényi纠缠熵，且主要系统尺寸限制来自内存而非传统辅助场符号问题。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于费米子分级交换表示将纠缠熵问题转化为具有混合时间边界条件的复制路径积分，采用半移位复制动量（q_m=(2m+1)π/n）和行列式形式的相互作用展开，结合多构型马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样器进行逐阶修正计算。

papers.title: Tunneling spectra of $\mathrm{TaO}_x$ junctions for van der Waals superconductors
papers.abstract: Tunneling spectroscopy and its evolution are crucial for elucidating the intricate electronic structure and emergent phenomena in quantum materials.Nevertheless, high-quality measurements -- specifically those tracking evolution across temperature and external fields -- remain a formidable challenge. We have fabricated a high-quality $\mathrm{TaO}_x$-based planar tunneling junction by using magnetron sputtering for van der Waals (vdW) superconductors. Using the vdW superconductor $\mathrm{Bi}_2\mathrm{Sr}_2\mathrm{CaCu}_2\mathrm{O}_{8+δ}$ (Bi2212) as a benchmark, this platform yields high-quality tunneling spectra, reproducing the electronic signatures obtained from scanning tunneling spectra acquired from atomically clean surfaces under ultra-high vacuum conditions. This architecture enables high-precision spectroscopy across extensive temperature and magnetic field ranges, offering a universal strategy for probing the electronic structures of diverse two-dimensional systems and facilitating future explorations of material properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：fabricated、tunneling spectroscopy、magnetron sputtering、scanning tunneling spectra。；研究对象：基于TaOₓ的平面隧穿结，用于探测范德瓦尔斯超导体的电子结构，以Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ（Bi2212）为基准材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用磁控溅射制备的TaOₓ平面隧穿结可获得高质量隧穿谱，其电子特征与超高真空下原子级清洁表面的扫描隧道谱一致，并能在宽温区和宽磁场范围内实现高精度谱学测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用磁控溅射制备的TaOₓ平面隧穿结可获得高质量隧穿谱，其电子特征与超高真空下原子级清洁表面的扫描隧道谱一致，并能在宽温区和宽磁场范围内实现高精度谱学测量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 磁控溅射制备TaOₓ基平面隧穿结，结合隧穿谱测量技术，并与扫描隧道谱进行对比验证。

papers.title: Chiral superconductors from parent states with non-uniform Berry curvature: Momentum-space vortices, BdG topology, and thermal Hall conductivity
papers.abstract: We investigate chiral superconductivity emerging from parent electronic states with non-uniform Berry curvature, motivated by recent experiments in rhombohedral graphene multilayers. Using the continuum $λ_N$-model-a tunable platform with independently controllable Berry curvature profiles-we solve the full BCS gap equation on a continuum Chern band beyond the weak-coupling limit. We find that a non-uniform Berry curvature of the parent band enriches the superconducting order parameter, leading to the formation of momentum-space vortices in the gap function away from high-symmetry points. By tuning the Berry curvature profile, we identify distinct regimes associated with vortex nucleation and vortex number saturation, and show that the nucleation of momentum-space vortices tends to lower the condensation energy. We then show analytically that the parent band Chern number constrains the number of momentum-space vortices that can nucleate in the gap-independent of details of the $λ_N$-model. We also provide a gauge-invariant formulation for computing the Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) Berry curvature for continuum models, and find that it is determined by a momentum-space phase current. The winding of this current around vortices in the occupied region in turn determines the BdG Chern number. Finally, we discuss how thermal Hall measurements can be used to probe the formation of momentum-space vortices. Our results highlight the crucial role of Berry curvature in shaping chiral superconductivity, and offer guiding principles for its identification in systems such as rhombohedral graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：continuum model、BCS gap equation、analytically show、gauge-invariant formulation。；研究对象：手性超导体，具体研究从具有非均匀贝里曲率的母态（如菱方石墨烯多层膜）中涌现的手性超导现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 母态能带的非均匀贝里曲率会导致超导能隙函数在动量空间中形成涡旋，且母态能带的陈数限制了动量空间涡旋的数量；这些涡旋会降低凝聚能，并可通过热霍尔效应进行探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：母态能带的非均匀贝里曲率会导致超导能隙函数在动量空间中形成涡旋，且母态能带的陈数限制了动量空间涡旋的数量；这些涡旋会降低凝聚能，并可通过热霍尔效应进行探测。；创新点：揭示了非均匀贝里曲率对超导序参量的丰富作用（动量空间涡旋的成核与饱和），建立了母带陈数与动量空间涡旋数量的解析约束关系，并提出了通过热霍尔电导测量探测动量空间涡旋的可行方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续λ_N模型（一种可独立调控贝里曲率分布的可调平台），在全连续陈带中求解完整BCS能隙方程（超越弱耦合极限），并构建规范不变的BdG贝里曲率计算方法。

papers.title: Observation of Altermagnetic Order Switching in Bulk MnTe by Polarized Neutron Diffraction
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic order, characterized by the Néel vector, breaks time-reversal symmetry (TRS) even in the nonrelativistic limit. Although spin-polarized and anomalous transport phenomena emerge with this order, they are mutually compensated by TRS-connected antiphase domains with opposite Néel vectors. Here we employ polarized neutron diffraction to directly probe the altermagnetic order in MnTe. Pronounced nuclear-magnetic interference terms were observed, providing direct evidence of a net Néel vector in the bulk crystal. Moreover, a weak ferromagnetic moment (WFM), originating from relativistic spin-orbit coupling, was found to be coupled with the altermagnetic order. Both the altermagnetic order and the WFM can be switched by milli-Tesla-scale magnetic field cooling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“polarized neutron diffraction”（极化中子衍射）、“observed”（观测到）、“direct evidence”（直接证据）。；研究对象：体相MnTe中的交变磁序（altermagnetic order）及其与弱铁磁矩的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过极化中子衍射直接观测到体相MnTe中存在净奈尔矢量（Néel vector），证实了交变磁序；同时发现由相对论自旋-轨道耦合产生的弱铁磁矩与交变磁序耦合，且两者均可通过毫特斯拉量级的磁场冷却实现翻转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过极化中子衍射直接观测到体相MnTe中存在净奈尔矢量（Néel vector），证实了交变磁序；同时发现由相对论自旋-轨道耦合产生的弱铁磁矩与交变磁序耦合，且两者均可通过毫特斯拉量级的磁场冷却实现翻转。；创新点：首次利用极化中子衍射直接探测体相MnTe中的交变磁序，并实验证实了交变磁序与弱铁磁矩的耦合及其在极低磁场下的可翻转性。
papers.method_zh: 极化中子衍射（polarized neutron diffraction），用于探测核-磁干涉项；磁场冷却（magnetic field cooling）用于翻转磁序。

papers.title: Quantifying the coupling between strain and cation valence in high entropy oxide thin films using electron microscopy
papers.abstract: High entropy oxides (HEOs) are a class of materials with vast compositional space and tunable properties, making them attractive for applications in thermoelectrics, magnetism, ionic conduction, and beyond. However, their metastable nature makes the local structure, and consequently their properties, highly sensitive to growth conditions. It is therefore essential to probe the local modulations in atomic, chemical, and electronic structure as a function of growth conditions. Here, advanced S/TEM techniques, including 4D-STEM combined with electron energy loss spectroscopy and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy are used to investigate the effect of substrate temperature on structure and strain at the nanoscale regime in HEO thin films. We quantify how nanoscale strain variations correlate with Co valence and subtle chemical differences in the films with the same nominal composition but different growth temperatures. Our results demonstrate that identical HEO compositions can accommodate distinct strain and defect states in thin film form and highlight how synthesis conditions can be leveraged to manipulate strain and Co valence. These findings establish a framework to tailor functional properties via strain and valence control in high entropy oxide thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“advanced S/TEM techniques, including 4D-STEM combined with electron energy loss spectroscopy and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy”等实验手段。；研究对象：高熵氧化物（HEO）薄膜。具体研究生长温度对薄膜纳米尺度结构、应变以及Co价态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相同名义组分的高熵氧化物薄膜在不同生长温度下，可以容纳不同的应变和缺陷状态，且纳米尺度应变变化与Co价态及细微化学差异存在关联。这表明可通过调控合成条件来操控应变和Co价态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相同名义组分的高熵氧化物薄膜在不同生长温度下，可以容纳不同的应变和缺陷状态，且纳米尺度应变变化与Co价态及细微化学差异存在关联。这表明可通过调控合成条件来操控应变和Co价态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 先进扫描透射电子显微镜（S/TEM）技术，包括四维扫描透射电子显微镜（4D-STEM）、电子能量损失谱（EELS）和能量色散X射线光谱（EDS）。

papers.title: Large-flavor route to a stable U(1) Dirac spin liquid on the maple-leaf lattice
papers.abstract: The $\mathrm{U}(1)$ Dirac spin liquid provides a useful organizing framework for frustrated magnets: it offers an algebraic parent state from which competing orders, confinement patterns, and low-energy spectral features can be understood. Whether such a state can occur as a stable ground state of a two-dimensional spin Hamiltonian remains an open question, because monopole events of the compact gauge field can proliferate and confine the spinons. Here, we show that the maple-leaf lattice provides a distinct route to this problem. Its Dirac spin liquid realizes QED$_3$ with $N_f=12$ Dirac fermions, substantially more than the $N_f=4$ theories of the triangular and kagome lattices. We classify the fundamental monopoles under the full microscopic symmetry group and find five charge-one spin-singlet monopoles that are trivial under lattice symmetries, time reversal, and spin rotation. The phase is therefore not protected by symmetry in the usual sense: its stability depends on whether these allowed monopoles are dynamically irrelevant. Available large-$N_f$ and Monte Carlo estimates place the charge-one monopole dimension close to the relevance threshold in $(2+1)$ dimensions, making the maple-leaf lattice a concrete large-flavor platform for testing the stability of compact QED$_3$ in a quantum magnet. The same monopole classification gives direct numerical predictions, identifying the symmetry sectors in which singlet, triplet, and quintet monopole excitations should appear. This provides a route to testing the $N_f=12$ Dirac spin liquid through symmetry-resolved exact diagonalization and variational studies of maple-leaf spin Hamiltonians.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：QED₃、monopole classification、large-\(N_f\)、Monte Carlo estimates。；研究对象：枫叶晶格（maple-leaf lattice）上的U(1)狄拉克自旋液体（Dirac spin liquid），具体研究其作为二维自旋哈密顿量稳定基态的可能性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 枫叶晶格上的狄拉克自旋液体实现了\(N_f=12\)的QED₃理论，远多于三角/蜂窝晶格的\(N_f=4\)；其单极子分类表明存在五个电荷-1自旋单态单极子，在对称性下平凡，因此该相的稳定性取决于这些单极子是否在动力学上无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：枫叶晶格上的狄拉克自旋液体实现了\(N_f=12\)的QED₃理论，远多于三角/蜂窝晶格的\(N_f=4\)；其单极子分类表明存在五个电荷-1自旋单态单极子，在对称性下平凡，因此该相的稳定性取决于这些单极子是否在动力学上无关。；创新点：提出枫叶晶格作为“大味数”（large-flavor）平台，为检验紧致QED₃在量子磁体中的稳定性提供了具体途径；同时通过单极子分类给出对称性分辨的数值预言，可直接用于精确对角化和变分研究。
papers.method_zh: 采用对称性分类方法，对紧致规范场的基本单极子（monopole）在完整微观对称群（晶格对称性、时间反演、自旋旋转）下进行分类；并引用大\(N_f\)展开和蒙特卡洛估计来评估单极子算符的标度维度。

papers.title: Robust fluctuating intertwined charge stripes in the Emery model
papers.abstract: The single-band Hubbard model is one of the most extensively studied models in condensed matter physics, giving rise to intertwined spin and charge stripes that coexist with, or lie in the vicinity of, superconductivity in the phase diagram.
