However, whether the low energy physics of the single-band Hubbard model is fully equivalent to the multi-band (multi-orbital) Emery model remains an unsettled question. While the intertwined stripes and nematicity have been studied in the single-band Hubbard model, a comprehensive picture in the Emery model is lacking. In this paper, we focus on the less investigated intertwined charge stripes using complementary density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and determinant quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC) techniques. Our ground state DMRG confirms the presence of the oxygen-centered charge stripes at a reduced amplitude in the Emery model parameter regime widely used in the study of intertwined stripes. Close analysis of the oxygen orbital structure of the static charge correlation function from DQMC reveals the charge stripe pattern in real-space, showcasing stronger charge density modulation on $p$-orbitals pointing along ``the rivers of charge'', consistent with DMRG. For the parameter set with the largest fermion signs, we managed to reach a temperature where the system first demonstrated tendencies to form purely unidirectional spin and charge stripes, and the $B_{1g}$ component becomes dominant in the bond-charge nematic susceptibility. This observation correlates with the doping dependence of the kinetic energy anisotropy, suggesting a close relation between the nematicity and charge stripes in the Emery model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“density matrix renormalization group (DMRG)”、“determinant quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC)”、“ground state DMRG”、“static charge correlation function”。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是Emery模型（多轨道模型）中的交织电荷条纹（intertwined charge stripes）以及与之相关的向列性（nematicity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Emery模型中，氧中心电荷条纹（oxygen-centered charge stripes）以减小的振幅存在，且电荷密度调制主要沿“电荷河流”方向的p轨道；在特定参数下，系统首次展现出纯单向自旋和电荷条纹的倾向，且向列性与电荷条纹之间存在密切关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Emery模型中，氧中心电荷条纹（oxygen-centered charge stripes）以减小的振幅存在，且电荷密度调制主要沿“电荷河流”方向的p轨道；在特定参数下，系统首次展现出纯单向自旋和电荷条纹的倾向，且向列性与电荷条纹之间存在密切关联。；创新点：该工作首次在广泛用于研究交织条纹的Emery模型参数区间内，系统地研究了此前较少被关注的电荷条纹，并揭示了其与向列性之间的关联。摘要未突出说明与单带Hubbard模型结果的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用了互补的密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）和行列式量子蒙特卡洛（DQMC）技术。DMRG用于基态计算，DQMC用于分析静态电荷关联函数的氧轨道结构以及向列性磁化率。

papers.title: Dominant vibronic relaxation channels in a europium-based molecular qubit
papers.abstract: Molecular spin qubits offer a versatile platform for quantum information processing due to their synthetic tunability and well-defined electronic structure. Here, a fitted-parameter-free computational framework combining density functional theory (DFT), time-dependent DFT (TD-DFT), and Redfield theory is applied to investigate the longitudinal spin-lattice relaxation time $T_1$ of the Eu nuclear spin qubit Eu(dpphen)(NO3)3. Using a single-molecule gas-phase model, the experimental long relaxation component $T_{1,\mathrm{long}} = 41.39$ s is reproduced within a factor of 1.4 (calculated: 55.88 s at 4.2 K), indicating that the slow relaxation channel is governed by intramolecular vibronic coupling. In contrast, the calculated $T_{1,\mathrm{short}}$ deviates by a factor of 66, highlighting the importance of crystal lattice and intermolecular effects absent from the model. The experimental $^5D_0 \rightarrow {}^7F_0$ optical transition is reproduced to within 1.1%, supporting the accuracy of the electronic structure description. Vibrational analysis identifies a large-amplitude dpphen rocking mode at a frequency of $332.02~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$ as the dominant vibronic coupling channel, while electric field gradient (EFG) derivative analysis independently identifies another nitrate-rocking mode at $180.57~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$ as the primary modulator of the nuclear spin environment via nitrate motion. These results are consistent with a near-maximal quadrupole asymmetry parameter $η= 0.941$, which creates state mixing through off-diagonal quadrupolar terms. Overall, the results establish a single-molecule relaxation baseline and suggest targeted ligand rigidification and substitution strategies to suppress decoherence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：DFT、TD-DFT、Redfield理论、无拟合参数计算框架）；研究对象：铕基分子自旋量子比特Eu(dpphen)(NO3)3的核自旋纵向弛豫时间T1及主导振动耦合通道
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验测得的慢弛豫分量T1,long=41.39 s被单分子气相模型在1.4倍误差内复现（计算值55.88 s，4.2 K），表明慢弛豫通道由分子内振动耦合主导；而快弛豫分量T1,short的计算偏差达66倍，凸显了晶格和分子间效应的重要性。识别出两种主导振动耦合模式：dpphen摇摆模（332.02 cm⁻¹）和硝酸根摇摆模（180.57 cm⁻¹）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验测得的慢弛豫分量T1,long=41.39 s被单分子气相模型在1.4倍误差内复现（计算值55.88 s，4.2 K），表明慢弛豫通道由分子内振动耦合主导；而快弛豫分量T1,short的计算偏差达66倍，凸显了晶格和分子间效应的重要性。识别出两种主导振动耦合模式：dpphen摇摆模（332.02 cm⁻¹）和硝酸根摇摆模（180.57 cm⁻¹）。；创新点：首次对Eu核自旋量子比特的T1时间进行无拟合参数的第一性原理计算，并定量区分了分子内振动耦合与晶格/分子间效应对弛豫的不同贡献。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）、含时密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）与Redfield理论相结合的无拟合参数计算框架；电场梯度（EFG）导数分析。

papers.title: Persistence of asymptotic variance under transport: from hyperfluctuation to stealthy hyperuniformity
papers.abstract: We introduce $p$-uniformity to characterize the scaling of density fluctuations in spatial random systems in $\mathbb{R}^d$, ranging from hyperfluctuation to stealthy hyperuniformity. Our central theorem establishes sufficient conditions to preserve $p$-uniformity under transport. The first condition, a finite $(d+p)$-th moment of the transport distance, allows for a Taylor expansion of the transport. The second condition controls the corresponding terms. We thus solve a previously stated open problem; indeed we extend it, since our result applies to a general $p$-uniform source in any dimension, and the source and transport may be dependent. As an application, we construct new classes of point processes that are isotropic and $p$-uniform with arbitrarily high $p$, and that can be simulated in linear time. We conclude with an outlook on a converse statement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce（引入理论概念）、central theorem（中心定理）、Taylor expansion（泰勒展开）、open problem（开放问题）。；研究对象：空间随机系统中密度涨落的标度行为，具体涵盖从超涨落（hyperfluctuation）到隐形超均匀性（stealthy hyperuniformity）的连续谱系，并研究该标度性质在输运（transport）下的保持性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了在输运变换下保持密度涨落标度（p-均匀性）的充分条件：输运距离的有限(d+p)阶矩允许泰勒展开，且相应项可控。该结果解决了此前提出的开放问题，并推广至任意维度的p-均匀源及源与输运可能相关的情形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了在输运变换下保持密度涨落标度（p-均匀性）的充分条件：输运距离的有限(d+p)阶矩允许泰勒展开，且相应项可控。该结果解决了此前提出的开放问题，并推广至任意维度的p-均匀源及源与输运可能相关的情形。；创新点：首次给出输运变换下密度涨落标度保持的充分条件，解决了此前未解决的开放问题，并将结果推广至一般维度、一般p值及源与输运相关的情形。摘要未突出说明与具体物理系统的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用数学分析框架：定义p-均匀性（p-uniformity）作为刻画密度涨落标度的新概念，通过泰勒展开和矩条件建立保持性定理，并应用于构造可线性时间模拟的各向同性高p值点过程。

papers.title: Geometric Origin of the Non-Adiabaticity Parameter and Self-Limiting Instability in Driven Nonlinear Systems
papers.abstract: We establish that the non-adiabaticity parameter has a direct geometric interpretation as the instantaneous evolution speed of a driven quantum state in projective Hilbert space under the Fubini Study metric. In contrast to conventional asymptotic approaches, the proposed framework provides a strictly local geometric criterion that allows non-adiabatic instability and its nonlinear suppression to be evaluated continuously at each stage of the driven evolution. We further show that an occupation-dependent nonlinear regulator Usuppresses the effective geometric evolution speed, leading to bounded low-occupancy dynamics. The resulting crossover parameter provides a compact criterion for self-limited non-adiabatic instability in driven nonlinear bosonic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：geometric interpretation、theoretical framework、criterion。；研究对象：驱动非线性玻色系统中的非绝热不稳定性及其自限效应，具体涉及量子态在投影希尔伯特空间中的几何演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非绝热参数可直接解释为量子态在Fubini-Study度量下的瞬时演化速度，并发现占据数依赖的非线性调节器可抑制有效几何演化速度，从而产生自限性非绝热不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非绝热参数可直接解释为量子态在Fubini-Study度量下的瞬时演化速度，并发现占据数依赖的非线性调节器可抑制有效几何演化速度，从而产生自限性非绝热不稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Fubini-Study度量的几何理论框架，提出严格局域几何判据，用于连续评估驱动演化各阶段的非绝热不稳定性及其非线性抑制。

papers.title: Generation of Quantum Turbulence by Neutrino Cooling in Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: The interior crust and much of the liquid core of neutron stars is believed to be a quantum liquid mixture of neutron and proton superfluids and a relativistic electron liquid. Quantized vortices in the neutron superfluid and quantized flux lines in the proton superconductor are topological defects of these hadronic condensates. I consider the formation of the superfluid state in young neutron stars under non-equilibrium conditions imposed by the neutrino cooling rate. The nonequilibrium phase transition implies that the onset of superfluidity is accompanied by the generation of quantized vortices based on the mechanism envisioned by Kibble in the context cosmic string formation in an evolutionary models of an expanding universe, and further developed by Zurek for nonequilibrium phase transitions in quantum liquids such as \Hefour. I discuss the Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM) and scaling relations for topological defect formation starting from the Cooper pair fluctuation propagator for temperatures approaching $T_c$. I then calculate the predicted vortex densities based on Urca and modified Urca cooling mechanisms in the cores of neutron stars for several models of the superfluid gap and transition temperature of the interior neutron superfluid. In all cases studied the KZM leads to a large density of topological defects in the condensate phase, which in 3D form a random network of vortex lines and loops, i.e. the generation of quantum turbulence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Kibble-Zurek机制（KZM）、非平衡相变、标度关系、理论计算。；研究对象：中子星内部中子超流体与质子超导体中由中微子冷却驱动的量子湍流生成，具体涉及超流涡旋与磁通线的拓扑缺陷形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中子星冷却过程中，非平衡相变通过Kibble-Zurek机制导致大量拓扑缺陷（涡旋线与环）的生成，形成三维随机网络，即量子湍流。所有研究的超流能隙与转变温度模型均预测高密度缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中子星冷却过程中，非平衡相变通过Kibble-Zurek机制导致大量拓扑缺陷（涡旋线与环）的生成，形成三维随机网络，即量子湍流。所有研究的超流能隙与转变温度模型均预测高密度缺陷。；创新点：将Kibble-Zurek机制（原用于宇宙弦形成与量子液体非平衡相变）应用于中子星超流态形成，并定量结合具体冷却机制（Urca过程）与超流模型预测涡旋密度。摘要未突出说明与已有中子星超流研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于Cooper对涨落传播子，在接近临界温度Tc时推导Kibble-Zurek机制的标度关系；利用Urca与修正Urca冷却机制计算中子星核心中中子超流体的涡旋密度。

papers.title: Posterior Collapse as Automatic Spectral Pruning
papers.abstract: We show that posterior collapse in $β$-VAEs implements automatic spectral pruning. A latent mode collapses if its contribution to reconstruction is below the cutoff set by $β$. Equilibrium solutions with different $β$ thus reveal a cascade of collapses as latent modes decouple from least to most useful. We derive this as a consequence of the loss via a Landau stability analysis. We define a latent-rescaling-invariant order parameter that ranks active latent modes and whose collapse thresholds identify which effective variables to inspect first. In the linear Gaussian case, the collapse spectrum, utility spectrum, and normalized PCA spectrum coincide, and each collapse follows a mean-field law. We test these predictions on the WorldClim dataset.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Landau stability analysis、推导、理论预测）；研究对象：β-VAE（变分自编码器）中的后验坍缩（posterior collapse）现象，将其类比为自动谱剪枝（automatic spectral pruning）过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 后验坍缩在β-VAE中实现了自动谱剪枝：当潜在模式的贡献低于由β设定的截断阈值时，该模式坍缩；不同β下的平衡解揭示了潜在模式从最不重要到最重要的级联坍缩过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：后验坍缩在β-VAE中实现了自动谱剪枝：当潜在模式的贡献低于由β设定的截断阈值时，该模式坍缩；不同β下的平衡解揭示了潜在模式从最不重要到最重要的级联坍缩过程。；创新点：将后验坍缩重新解释为一种自动谱剪枝机制，并建立了其与Landau稳定性分析和平均场理论的联系，同时定义了可用于识别关键有效变量的序参量。摘要未突出说明与已有VAE理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 通过Landau稳定性分析（Landau stability analysis）从损失函数推导出后验坍缩的级联行为；定义了潜在重标定不变的序参量（latent-rescaling-invariant order parameter）来排序活跃的潜在模式；在线性高斯情形下，将坍缩谱、效用谱与归一化PCA谱进行了理论对比，并验证了每个坍缩遵循平均场定律。

papers.title: Ising surface defects can get dirty
papers.abstract: Real critical systems, such as uniaxial ferromagnets in the 3d Ising universality class, are constrained by boundaries and subject to random couplings. We consider the Wilson-Fisher fixed point in $4-ε$ dimensions subject to a random magnetic field localized on a two-dimensional surface, which becomes co-dimension 1 in the physical $ε\to1$ limit. Using the replica method for the disordered field, we find that the ordinary boundary condition is stable under disorder but also discover a non-trivial ``dirty" boundary condition which can be reached by tuning the disorder strength or the local temperature. We also investigate the logarithmic structure of the defect spectrum and how it emerges via the replica formalism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用Wilson-Fisher不动点、replica方法等理论框架，在$4-\varepsilon$维度下进行解析计算。；研究对象：三维Ising普适类（如单轴铁磁体）中，受二维表面局域随机磁场影响的临界系统，即“脏”的Ising表面缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在随机磁场作用下，普通边界条件对无序是稳定的，但通过调节无序强度或局域温度，可以到达一个非平凡的“脏”边界条件。此外，还揭示了缺陷谱的对数结构及其在replica形式论中的出现方式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在随机磁场作用下，普通边界条件对无序是稳定的，但通过调节无序强度或局域温度，可以到达一个非平凡的“脏”边界条件。此外，还揭示了缺陷谱的对数结构及其在replica形式论中的出现方式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用replica方法处理无序场，在$4-\varepsilon$维度下对Wilson-Fisher不动点进行微扰分析，并考虑物理极限$\varepsilon\to1$（即三维情形）。

papers.title: Summarizing Time-Varying Digital Image Correlation Strain Fields Using Sankey Diagrams
papers.abstract: Digital Image Correlation (DIC) enables dense, time-resolved measurement of surface strain in deforming materials, providing insight into strain localization and failure mechanisms. However, the resulting strain fields are typically explored frame-by-frame through spatial visualizations, making global temporal patterns difficult to discern. We present a visual summarization approach that represents the evolution of high-strain regions as a single Sankey diagram constructed from superlevel sets of the von Mises equivalent strain field. By tracking connected components over time via spatial overlap, the diagram encodes the birth, persistence, merging, and disappearance of strain concentrations. Applied to four tensile test datasets with varying notch geometries, the approach compactly captures differences in deformation regimes and qualitative precursors to failure, complementing traditional spatial strain visualizations with a global temporal overview.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确基于Digital Image Correlation (DIC)实验测量技术，并应用于实际拉伸测试数据集。；研究对象：论文研究的是变形材料表面的应变场演化，具体针对不同缺口几何形状的拉伸试样，关注应变局部化和失效机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于Sankey图的可视化总结方法，能够将高应变区域的时空演化（包括应变集中的产生、持续、合并和消失）压缩为单一图表，从而捕捉不同缺口几何形状下变形模式的差异和失效前的定性前兆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于Sankey图的可视化总结方法，能够将高应变区域的时空演化（包括应变集中的产生、持续、合并和消失）压缩为单一图表，从而捕捉不同缺口几何形状下变形模式的差异和失效前的定性前兆。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该方法的核心新意在于：将传统逐帧空间可视化难以辨别的全局时间模式，转化为单一Sankey图进行紧凑总结，从而补充了传统空间应变可视化，提供了全局时间概览。
papers.method_zh: 采用数字图像相关（DIC）技术获取高密度、时间分辨的表面应变场；通过von Mises等效应变场的超水平集（superlevel sets）提取高应变区域，并利用空间重叠追踪连通分量随时间的变化，最终构建Sankey图。

papers.title: Long-range nonstabilizerness of topologically encoded states from mutual information
papers.abstract: We study long-range nonstabilizerness (LRN), namely the obstruction to remove nonstabilizerness with shallow-depth local quantum circuits. In one-dimensional settings, the mutual information between disconnected spatial regions has proven to be a powerful tool to diagnose LRN. In this work, we focus on encoded states of two-dimensional topologically-ordered systems, and explore the ability of the mutual information to serve as a diagnostic of LRN. Focusing on the concrete setting of lattice models defined on a torus, we show that information about LRN can be gained from the analysis of the mutual information between non-overlapping regions containing non-contractible loops, and of the change of such mutual information under modular real-space transformations. We exemplify this idea in the toric code and the non-abelian string-net model with doubled Fibonacci topological order. In the former case, we show that the mutual information provides a full classification, certifying LRN for all encoded non-stabilizer states. In the latter case, instead, our approach does not lead to a full classification, as it detects LRN for all states except from a finite subset with special transformation properties under the modular group. Finally, we discuss how our results on LRN constrain the logical gates that can be implemented fault-tolerantly on the torus.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study, show, analyze, discuss（无实验或计算数据，纯理论分析）。；研究对象：二维拓扑有序系统的编码态中的长程非稳定化（long-range nonstabilizerness, LRN），具体以环面（torus）上的晶格模型（toric code 和 doubled Fibonacci 拓扑序的非阿贝尔 string-net 模型）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 互信息（mutual information）可以用于诊断二维拓扑编码态中的长程非稳定化：在 toric code 中，互信息能完全分类所有编码的非稳定子态并证明其具有 LRN；在 doubled Fibonacci 模型中，互信息能检测除少数具有特殊模变换性质的态之外的所有态的 LRN。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：互信息（mutual information）可以用于诊断二维拓扑编码态中的长程非稳定化：在 toric code 中，互信息能完全分类所有编码的非稳定子态并证明其具有 LRN；在 doubled Fibonacci 模型中，互信息能检测除少数具有特殊模变换性质的态之外的所有态的 LRN。；创新点：将原本在一维系统中用于诊断长程非稳定化的互信息方法推广到二维拓扑有序系统，并展示了其在 toric code 和 doubled Fibonacci 模型中的诊断能力与局限性，同时讨论了 LRN 对环面上容错逻辑门实现的约束。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：利用互信息（mutual information）作为诊断工具，分析环面上包含非收缩环（non-contractible loops）的非重叠区域之间的互信息，以及这些互信息在模空间实空间变换（modular real-space transformations）下的变化。

papers.title: Factorization rule for multitime correlations in non-Markovian open quantum systems
papers.abstract: Experiments performed on quantum systems often measure multitime correlation functions. When quantum systems are weakly coupled to their environment, the time evolution of such correlation functions can be reduced to that of the reduced density matrix by the quantum regression theorem (QRT). While no QRT is available for general non-Markovian open quantum systems, we show that for time-independent Hamiltonians and finite memory times $τ_c$, an exact factorization rule exists that relates higher-order multitime correlations to products of lower-order correlations. Consequently, all information needed to reconstruct $n$-time correlations is contained in a temporal volume of $\mathcal{O}(τ_c^n)$. On the example of quantum dots coupled to phonons, we demonstrate that this factorization makes numerical calculations of multitime correlations extremely efficient and even enables semianalytical solutions in systems where the standard QRT breaks down.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact factorization rule、theoretical framework、semianalytical solutions。；研究对象：非马尔可夫开放量子系统中的多时间关联函数，具体以量子点-声子耦合系统为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于时间无关哈密顿量和有限记忆时间τ_c，存在一个精确的因子化规则，将高阶多时间关联函数表示为低阶关联函数的乘积，从而使得数值计算极为高效，甚至可在标准量子回归定理失效的系统中实现半解析解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于时间无关哈密顿量和有限记忆时间τ_c，存在一个精确的因子化规则，将高阶多时间关联函数表示为低阶关联函数的乘积，从而使得数值计算极为高效，甚至可在标准量子回归定理失效的系统中实现半解析解。；创新点：首次证明在非马尔可夫开放量子系统中存在精确的因子化规则，突破了标准量子回归定理仅适用于马尔可夫系统的限制，并揭示了n时间关联函数的信息仅需包含在大小为O(τ_c^n)的时间体积内。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于时间无关哈密顿量和有限记忆时间假设，建立多时间关联函数的精确因子化规则；数值验证：以量子点-声子耦合系统为例，展示该规则在计算多时间关联函数中的高效性。

papers.title: A Boundary-Layer Mechanism for One-Third Scaling in Online Softmax Classification
papers.abstract: Hard-label classification is usually trained with smooth surrogate losses, most prominently softmax cross-entropy. We isolate an asymptotic mechanism by which this mismatch between smooth surrogate and discrete labels produces power-law learning curves in an online teacher-student model. After subtracting the mean logit, the thermodynamic-limit dynamics close in centered variables: a growing centered student-teacher alignment $D$ and the residual student variance $Δ$. At late times, examples away from teacher decision boundaries are already classified confidently and contribute exponentially little. Only boundary layers of width $O(D^{-1})$ remain active, while the noise of fixed-learning-rate online gradient descent maintains a nonzero $Δ$. As a function of the training time $α$ the late-time solution yields a $α^{-1/3}$ power law not only for the test loss but also for the generalization error $ε_g$, i.e., one minus test accuracy. This is much slower than the $α^{-1}$ Bayes-optimal reference for the same model. We further show that learning-rate schedules can improve the generalization error towards a $ε_g \sim α^{-1/2}$ power law. Simulations support the predicted order parameter dynamics and learning curves. Controlled experiments with correlated Gaussian inputs and whitened pretrained features show that data structure can dominate transients. Therefore, our result is an asymptotic, complementary mechanism rather than an alternative to spectral explanations of neural scaling laws.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：asymptotic mechanism、thermodynamic-limit dynamics、power-law learning curves、teacher-student model）；研究对象：在线softmax分类任务中的学习动力学，具体为教师-学生模型（teacher-student model）中硬标签分类与平滑代理损失（softmax交叉熵）之间的不匹配机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在在线梯度下降训练下，测试损失和泛化误差（1减去测试准确率）随训练时间α呈α^{-1/3}幂律衰减，远慢于贝叶斯最优的α^{-1}；通过调整学习率可将泛化误差改善至α^{-1/2}幂律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在在线梯度下降训练下，测试损失和泛化误差（1减去测试准确率）随训练时间α呈α^{-1/3}幂律衰减，远慢于贝叶斯最优的α^{-1}；通过调整学习率可将泛化误差改善至α^{-1/2}幂律。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过热力学极限下的序参量动力学（中心化的学生-教师对齐D和学生残差方差Δ）推导边界层机制；数值模拟：验证序参量动力学和幂律学习曲线，并采用相关高斯输入和白化预训练特征进行对照实验。

papers.title: Simultaneously monitoring Ga adsorption and desorption kinetics on GaN(0001) using four in situ techniques
papers.abstract: We present a systematic investigation of Ga adsorption and desorption kinetics on the wurtzite GaN(0001) surface using four in situ techniques operated simultaneously: reflection high-energy electron diffraction, laser reflectometry, line-of-sight quadrupole mass spectrometry, and optical pyrometry. Flux- and temperature-dependent experiments are performed for Ga coverages ranging from the submonolayer to the droplet regime. Despite their distinct transient responses, the signals from all four techniques and their trends with surface coverage are quantitatively reproduced by a unified kinetic model of Ga adsorption, diffusion, and desorption. An Arrhenius analysis of the Ga adlayer desorption yields an activation energy of (2.87 $\pm$ 0.04) eV.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用四种原位技术同时进行实验，并进行了通量和温度依赖的测量。；研究对象：GaN(0001)表面（纤锌矿结构）上镓（Ga）的吸附与脱附动力学过程，覆盖范围从亚单层到液滴态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过四种原位技术同时监测，发现尽管各技术的瞬态响应不同，但其信号及随表面覆盖度的变化趋势均可被一个统一的动力学模型定量复现。对Ga吸附层脱附的Arrhenius分析得到激活能为(2.87 ± 0.04) eV。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过四种原位技术同时监测，发现尽管各技术的瞬态响应不同，但其信号及随表面覆盖度的变化趋势均可被一个统一的动力学模型定量复现。对Ga吸附层脱附的Arrhenius分析得到激活能为(2.87 ± 0.04) eV。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 同时使用四种原位技术：反射高能电子衍射、激光反射测量、视线四极质谱和光学高温计。结合通量和温度依赖实验，并建立统一的Ga吸附、扩散和脱附动力学模型进行定量分析。

papers.title: Silicate cosmic dust grain collisions in the interstellar medium: A molecular dynamics study
papers.abstract: (abridged) We aim to predict the most important parameters for grain-grain collision outcomes for models of interstellar grain population evolution on astrophysical scales: the threshold velocity above which colliding grains shatter, the threshold for vaporization, and resulting distributions of grain sizes. We use molecular dynamics simulations which evolve the dynamics of each atom in a dust grain to explore the outcomes of collisions between silicate grains of radii $a \in [5,50]~Å$ at velocities $0.1-20$ km/s. We run simulations of grains with two materials: amorphous SiO$_2$ and an amorphous silicate of composition suggested by Draine \& Hensley (2021). With these simulations, we quantify the collision velocity dependence of shattered and vaporized mass fractions, and the resulting size distributions of shattering products. We find grain shattering thresholds are $\sim$6 km/s for both amorphous SiO$_2$ and astrodust material, which is a factor of $\sim$2 higher than the canonical value for silicates of 2.7 km/s from Jones et al. (1996). This discrepancy is mostly alleviated by correcting an error in the expression for these velocity thresholds derived in Tielens et al. (1994). We find that the size distributions of shattered products are generally not consistent with the power law distributions predicted by this previous model. We also find that their expression fails to predict the fraction of shattered or vaporized material observed in our numerical simulations. The model of Hirashita \& Kobayashi (2013) for the same quantities similarly fails to match the simulations. We provide updated shattering velocity thresholds for standard candidate grain materials to the astrophysics community. Broadly, our updated threshold velocities that astrophysical dust grains may be more robust to shattering in the interstellar medium than previously assumed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular dynamics simulations（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：星际介质中硅酸盐宇宙尘埃颗粒（非晶SiO₂及Draine & Hensley 2021提出的非晶硅酸盐成分）之间的碰撞过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硅酸盐尘埃颗粒的碎裂阈值速度约为6 km/s，比此前文献中常用的2.7 km/s高出约2倍，表明星际尘埃颗粒可能比以往认为的更不易碎裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硅酸盐尘埃颗粒的碎裂阈值速度约为6 km/s，比此前文献中常用的2.7 km/s高出约2倍，表明星际尘埃颗粒可能比以往认为的更不易碎裂。；创新点：通过原子尺度的分子动力学模拟，修正了Tielens et al. (1994)推导的碎裂阈值速度表达式中的错误，并指出此前Jones et al. (1996)及Hirashita & Kobayashi (2013)的模型无法准确预测模拟中观察到的碎裂/汽化质量分数及产物尺寸分布（幂律分布假设不成立）。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学模拟，追踪尘埃颗粒中每个原子的动力学行为，模拟半径a∈[5,50] Å的硅酸盐颗粒在0.1-20 km/s速度范围内的碰撞，并量化碎裂与汽化质量分数及产物尺寸分布。

papers.title: A path-finding algorithm for computing minimal-weight-matching centrosymmetry parameter
papers.abstract: In 2020, Peter Larsen reported flaws in the methods for centrosymmetry parameter computation in the existing molecular dynamics and analysis packages. He proposed an intuitive an mathematically rigorous formulation for centrosymmetry parameter in terms of minimal-weight matching (MWM) on a fully-connected graph of atomic neighbors. He proposed using Edmonds' blossom algorithm for computing such a matching. In this paper, we investigate an alternative algorithm for MWM CSP computation using path finding approach and A* algorithm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“algorithm”、“computing”、“path finding approach”、“A* algorithm”，属于算法设计与计算实现类研究。；研究对象：论文研究的是计算“中心对称参数”（centrosymmetry parameter, CSP）的算法，具体针对基于最小权重匹配（minimal-weight matching, MWM）的CSP计算方法。研究对象并非特定材料或物理体系，而是计算方法和算法本身。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要贡献在于提出了一种替代Edmonds开花算法的路径搜索方法（基于A*算法）来计算最小权重匹配中心对称参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要贡献在于提出了一种替代Edmonds开花算法的路径搜索方法（基于A*算法）来计算最小权重匹配中心对称参数。；创新点：针对Peter Larsen在2020年提出的基于Edmonds开花算法的MWM CSP计算方法，本文提出了一种替代性的路径搜索算法（A*算法）来实现相同的计算目标。
papers.method_zh: 采用路径搜索（path-finding）方法，具体使用A*算法（A-star algorithm）来计算原子邻居全连接图上的最小权重匹配，从而得到中心对称参数。

papers.title: Klein tunneling of the laser coherence
papers.abstract: We study theoretically the lasing synchronization of the two arrays of lasers with the complex mode dispersion, separated by a spectrally detuned barrier. We demonstrate that for lasing at the Dirac point, the synchronization persists for an order of magnitude higher barriers than in the arrays with a usual parabolic dispersion or a purely dissipative coupling. We interpret this effect as the Klein tunneling of the laser coherence through the barrier. Our numerical findings are supported by an analysis of the delocalization of the linearized eigenmodes of the arrays, which enhances the synchronization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“We study theoretically”、“numerical findings”、“analysis of the linearized eigenmodes”。；研究对象：激光阵列的同步现象，具体为两个具有复模式色散的激光阵列通过一个光谱失谐势垒分离后的锁相同步行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在狄拉克点工作的激光阵列，其同步性可以承受比通常抛物线色散或纯耗散耦合阵列高一个数量级的势垒强度。该效应被解释为激光相干性的克莱因隧穿。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在狄拉克点工作的激光阵列，其同步性可以承受比通常抛物线色散或纯耗散耦合阵列高一个数量级的势垒强度。该效应被解释为激光相干性的克莱因隧穿。；创新点：首次将凝聚态物理中的克莱因隧穿概念应用于激光相干性的同步问题，并揭示了在狄拉克点色散下同步对势垒的异常鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟。具体包括：对激光阵列的线性化本征模进行退局域化分析，以解释同步增强的机制。

papers.title: A Utility-Driven Bounded-Confidence Model for Opinion Dynamics
papers.abstract: We introduce a utility-driven bounded-confidence model of opinion dynamics in which opinions associated with higher utility exert stronger social influence. In the regime where all agents belong to a single opinion cluster, we derive a stochastic differential equation for the mean opinion and show that its stationary distribution is Gibbs-like, with an effective potential determined by the utility landscape and an inverse temperature controlled by the learning rate and the number of agents. For multimodal utility functions, the dynamics exhibit metastability and spontaneous switching between competing opinion states. The reduced stochastic description also captures the evolution and merging of multiple opinion clusters, in agreement with agent-based simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：utility-driven bounded-confidence model、stochastic differential equation、stationary distribution、agent-based simulations。；研究对象：舆论动力学（opinion dynamics）中的观点演化过程，具体研究在效用驱动下的有限置信模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单观点簇状态下，平均观点的稳态分布具有吉布斯形式，其有效势由效用景观决定，逆温度由学习率和代理人数控制；在多峰效用函数下，系统表现出亚稳态性和观点状态之间的自发切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单观点簇状态下，平均观点的稳态分布具有吉布斯形式，其有效势由效用景观决定，逆温度由学习率和代理人数控制；在多峰效用函数下，系统表现出亚稳态性和观点状态之间的自发切换。；创新点：将效用驱动机制引入有限置信模型，使高效用观点具有更强的社会影响力，并建立了从微观动力学到宏观稳态分布的随机热力学类比（吉布斯分布、有效势、逆温度）。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（随机微分方程、稳态分布分析）与基于智能体的数值模拟（agent-based simulations）相结合。

papers.title: Beyond Scalar Objectives: Expert-Feedback-Driven Autonomous Experimentation for Scientific Discovery at the Nanoscale
papers.abstract: Self-driving laboratories or autonomous experimentation are emerging as transformative platforms for accelerating scientific discovery. Bayesian optimization (BO) is among the most widely used machine learning frameworks for these purposes, but these BO-based frameworks rely on predefined scalar descriptors to guide experimentation. In many situations, the determination of an appropriate scalar descriptor can be challenging, and may fail to capture subtle yet scientifically important phenomena apparent to experts with interdisciplinary insight. To overcome this limitation, here we develop deep-kernel pairwise learning (DKPL), an approach for autonomous microscopy experiments which incorporates human expertise and interdisciplinary scientific knowledge into an active learning loop. Instead of relying on explicit scalar objectives, DKPL enables experts to directly evaluate which experimental output is more promising using interdisciplinary knowledge. DKPL then learns a latent utility function from these expert judgements to guide subsequent autonomous microscopy experiments. We demonstrate DKPL's performance in learning physically meaningful nanoscale structures while effectively prioritizing high-information measurement regions using an experimental model dataset with known ground truth. We further apply DKPL to analyze the character of ferroelectric domain walls, where we find DKPL capable of distinguishing between high and low characteristic domain-wall angles in bismuth ferrite, and able to discover both head-to-head and tail-to-tail domain-wall character in erbium manganite. This development establishes an approach to integrate expert knowledge into autonomous microscopy experiments and demonstrates a pathway toward expert-guided self-driving laboratories capable of addressing scientific problems beyond the limits of scalar-metrics-driven learning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与机器学习方法结合）。判断依据：开发了自主实验方法（deep-kernel pairwise learning），并应用于实际材料体系（铁电畴壁）的实验数据分析。；研究对象：纳米尺度下的铁电材料，具体包括：铋铁氧体（bismuth ferrite）中的铁电畴壁角度特征，以及锰酸铒（erbium manganite）中的头对头（head-to-head）和尾对尾（tail-to-tail）畴壁类型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为深度核成对学习（DKPL）的自主实验方法，能够将人类专家的跨学科知识直接融入主动学习循环中，从而在无需预定义标量目标函数的情况下，有效学习并区分铁电畴壁的物理特征（如角度高低和畴壁类型）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为深度核成对学习（DKPL）的自主实验方法，能够将人类专家的跨学科知识直接融入主动学习循环中，从而在无需预定义标量目标函数的情况下，有效学习并区分铁电畴壁的物理特征（如角度高低和畴壁类型）。；创新点：突破了传统贝叶斯优化依赖预定义标量描述符的限制，首次将人类专家的跨学科判断（而非标量目标）直接嵌入自主实验的主动学习循环中，实现了专家引导的、超越标量指标驱动的科学发现。
papers.method_zh: 深度核成对学习（DKPL）框架，结合贝叶斯优化（BO）与主动学习，通过专家直接比较实验输出结果的优劣来学习潜在效用函数，并以此指导后续自主显微实验。使用了已知真实值的实验模型数据集进行性能验证。

papers.title: Universalities of Defects in Quantum Field Theories
papers.abstract: Defects are both physically rich objects and powerful tools in modern quantum field theory. They are extended operators, such as boundaries, impurities, and probe particles, embedded in many-body systems. In this dissertation, we study the universal aspects of defect dynamics from the perspective of symmetry principles. We bring together several themes, including defect renormalization group flows, effective string theory, and impurities in atomic quantum gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：量子场论、对称性原理、重整化群流、有效弦理论。；研究对象：量子场论中的缺陷（Defects），包括边界、杂质、探针粒子等扩展型算符，以及它们在多体系统中的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从对称性原理出发，揭示了缺陷动力学（如缺陷重整化群流、有效弦理论、原子量子气体中的杂质行为）的普适性（Universalities）特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从对称性原理出发，揭示了缺陷动力学（如缺陷重整化群流、有效弦理论、原子量子气体中的杂质行为）的普适性（Universalities）特征。；创新点：将缺陷重整化群流、有效弦理论和原子量子气体中的杂质问题等多个主题统一在对称性原理的视角下，探讨其普适性。摘要未突出说明具体的技术创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：量子场论（QFT）、对称性分析、缺陷重整化群（Defect RG）、有效弦理论（Effective String Theory）。

papers.title: Optics-microwave entanglement and state teleportation mediated by a cavity magnomechanical system
papers.abstract: Generating usable output-entanglement in continuous variable systems can serve as a viable resource for improving applications in quantum information science. In this work, we show how to generate steady-state output-entanglement in a two-stage conversion setup between optical and microwave photon which employs resonantly coupled magnetic and mechanical excitations, as proposed in Phys. Rev. Applied 18, 044059 (2022). We show that the entanglement can be maximized for the same set of parameters which optimize the frequency-conversion efficiency, and that it can be leveraged for a teleportation-based state-transfer protocol for coherent input-states with fidelity close to unity. We propose an implementation based on an Yittrium Iron Garnet disk of micrometer scale, and use both simulation results and reasonable estimates to assess the performance under optimized conditions. We find a maximum teleportation fidelity of 0.75 for the proposed setup.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show how to generate、propose an implementation、simulation results）；研究对象：基于腔磁力机械系统的光学-微波纠缠生成与量子态隐形传态，具体体系为微米级钇铁石榴石（YIG）圆盘。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在优化频率转换效率的参数条件下，可最大化稳态输出纠缠，并实现保真度接近0.75的相干输入态隐形传态协议。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在优化频率转换效率的参数条件下，可最大化稳态输出纠缠，并实现保真度接近0.75的相干输入态隐形传态协议。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟：基于连续变量系统的两阶段转换方案（参考Phys. Rev. Applied 18, 044059 (2022)），结合共振耦合的磁子和机械激发，通过仿真结果与合理估计评估性能。

papers.title: Journey in quantum metrology and sensing from foundations to applications: a review
papers.abstract: We present a review on quantum metrology and sensing, from its foundations to current applications. Highlights of the review include consideration of both frequentist and Bayesian approaches to parameter estimation; single as well as multiparameter estimation; estimation for different encoding processes comprising unitary as well as noisy channels, quantum thermometry, and channels involving indefinite causal order; different estimation strategies incorporating also recent advances like quantum error correction-aided methods and reservoir engineering; usefulness of quantum Fisher information to detect resources; applications of quantum metrology in diverse arenas covering quantum many-body sensors, sensing protocols in atomic ensembles, atom-photon systems, and continuous-variable systems, quantum imaging, quantum illumination, atomic clocks and atom interferometry, etc; and experimental realizations of quantum sensors in different physical platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有综述性质）。关键词：review、frequentist and Bayesian approaches、theoretical framework、quantum Fisher information。；研究对象：量子计量学与量子传感，涵盖从基础理论到当前应用的全景，包括参数估计、编码过程、不同物理平台（如量子多体传感器、原子系综、原子-光子系统、连续变量系统、量子成像、量子照明、原子钟、原子干涉仪等）中的传感协议。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统综述了量子计量学与传感在频率学派与贝叶斯参数估计、单参数与多参数估计、不同编码过程（包括幺正通道、噪声通道、量子测温、涉及不定因果序的通道）中的进展，并展示了量子Fisher信息在资源检测中的用途，以及量子纠错辅助方法、储层工程等新策略的应用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统综述了量子计量学与传感在频率学派与贝叶斯参数估计、单参数与多参数估计、不同编码过程（包括幺正通道、噪声通道、量子测温、涉及不定因果序的通道）中的进展，并展示了量子Fisher信息在资源检测中的用途，以及量子纠错辅助方法、储层工程等新策略的应用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有综述的具体新意，但覆盖了从基础到应用、从单参数到多参数、从理想通道到噪声通道及不定因果序通道的广泛内容，并整合了量子纠错辅助等近期进展。
papers.method_zh: 综述性理论分析，涵盖参数估计的两种统计框架（频率学派与贝叶斯）、量子Fisher信息理论、量子纠错辅助方法、储层工程等，并提及不同物理平台上的实验实现。

papers.title: Dropout Universality: Scaling Laws and Optimal Scheduling at the Edge-of-Chaos
papers.abstract: We develop a mean-field theory of dropout as a perturbation of critical signal propagation at the edge of chaos. Dropout shifts the perfect-alignment fixed point, making the depth scale for information propagation finite even at critical initialization. We derive critical and crossover scaling laws for correlation decay and establish that smooth activations and kinked, ReLU-like activations constitute distinct universality classes, with different critical exponents and a universal two-parameter scaling collapse in detuning and dropout strength. The distinction traces to the analytic structure of the correlation map: smooth activations admit a Taylor expansion near perfect alignment, while kinked activations develop a branch point with universal non-analyticity. As a corollary, the framework yields saturated dropout profiles under fixed budget; a rank-flow tie-breaker then selects front-loaded schedules, substantially reducing held-out test loss at no extra computational cost, with accuracy gains as a consistent secondary effect. We test the predictions in MLPs and Vision Transformers and discuss CNN/ResNet extensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：mean-field theory、scaling laws、universality classes、theoretical framework）；研究对象：神经网络中Dropout正则化技术对信号传播临界动力学的影响，具体研究深度神经网络在混沌边缘（edge-of-chaos）的标度行为与最优调度策略。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Dropout扰动使临界初始化下的信息传播深度尺度变为有限，并揭示光滑激活函数与ReLU类激活函数属于不同普适类，具有不同临界指数；基于此理论推导出的前加载调度（front-loaded schedules）可在不增加计算成本下显著降低测试损失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Dropout扰动使临界初始化下的信息传播深度尺度变为有限，并揭示光滑激活函数与ReLU类激活函数属于不同普适类，具有不同临界指数；基于此理论推导出的前加载调度（front-loaded schedules）可在不增加计算成本下显著降低测试损失。；创新点：首次将Dropout纳入临界信号传播的普适类框架，建立其与混沌边缘动力学的严格标度理论，并揭示光滑与非光滑激活函数在非解析性上的本质区别（光滑激活可泰勒展开，ReLU类激活出现分支点非解析性）。
papers.method_zh: 平均场理论（mean-field theory）分析Dropout作为临界信号传播的微扰；推导相关函数衰减的临界标度律与交叉标度律；通过秩流平局决胜（rank-flow tie-breaker）确定最优调度；在MLP和Vision Transformer中验证预测，并讨论CNN/ResNet扩展。

papers.title: What We Talk About When We Talk About Dissipative Quantum Chaos
papers.abstract: Dissipative quantum chaos is an emerging theory that is expected to extend the ideas, concepts, and methodology of conventional Hamiltonian quantum chaos from coherent evolution to open quantum dynamics. The new theory should provide a set of tools to distinguish chaotic open quantum systems from integrable ones, as well as quantitative measures of their chaoticity (or, conversely, integrability). The foundations of this theory were laid in the late 1980s, and from the very start it was clear that, like its Hamiltonian predecessor, it had to be based on the spectral properties of the operators governing open quantum evolution. After these first steps, the field remained relatively quiet for many years and it is only over the last decade that the development of dissipative quantum chaos has received a strong boost, as confirmed by a large number of publications on this topic and, very recently, the first experiments performed to test its theoretical predictions. In this chapter, we review these recent developments and outline the basic foundations of dissipative quantum chaos.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：emerging theory、review、theoretical predictions、foundations）；研究对象：耗散量子混沌（dissipative quantum chaos），即从传统哈密顿量子混沌向开放量子动力学扩展的理论体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 耗散量子混沌理论的基础建立于1980年代末，其核心思想是通过支配开放量子演化算符的谱性质来区分混沌与可积开放量子系统，并量化其混沌程度。近十年来该领域获得显著发展，并已有首次实验验证其理论预言。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：耗散量子混沌理论的基础建立于1980年代末，其核心思想是通过支配开放量子演化算符的谱性质来区分混沌与可积开放量子系统，并量化其混沌程度。近十年来该领域获得显著发展，并已有首次实验验证其理论预言。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（该文为综述性质，系统梳理了耗散量子混沌近年来的发展及基础框架）。
papers.method_zh: 基于开放量子系统演化算符的谱分析（spectral properties of operators governing open quantum evolution），属于理论框架构建与综述。

papers.title: Matrix Product Operator Encodings of the Magnus Expansion and Dyson Series
papers.abstract: We introduce a matrix product operator (MPO) encoding of the Magnus expansion and the Dyson series for one-dimensional quantum lattice models with time-dependent Hamiltonians. The MPO construction can be made accurate up to arbitrary order in the time step, it can be applied to both finite and infinite systems, and it can handle long-range interactions. The resulting MPO can be combined with state-of-the-art time evolution algorithms based on matrix product states, allowing for drastic improvements in simulating evolution under time-dependent Hamiltonians. Our MPO construction can also be used for the optimization of quantum circuits in the context of quantum simulation of time-dependent Hamiltonians.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：matrix product operator encoding、time evolution algorithms、quantum circuits optimization。；研究对象：一维量子晶格模型，特别是具有含时哈密顿量的系统，包括有限和无限系统，以及长程相互作用体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于矩阵乘积算符（MPO）的编码方法，可精确到时间步长的任意阶，用于实现马格努斯展开和戴森级数，从而显著改进含时哈密顿量下的量子模拟效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于矩阵乘积算符（MPO）的编码方法，可精确到时间步长的任意阶，用于实现马格努斯展开和戴森级数，从而显著改进含时哈密顿量下的量子模拟效率。；创新点：首次将MPO编码应用于马格努斯展开和戴森级数，支持任意阶精度、有限/无限系统及长程相互作用，并可直接与现有MPS时间演化算法结合，同时适用于含时哈密顿量的量子模拟电路优化。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：矩阵乘积算符（MPO）编码；结合基于矩阵乘积态（MPS）的最先进时间演化算法；可用于量子电路优化。

papers.title: Testing Superpositions of Detector Trajectories
papers.abstract: We propose a realizable experiment to test the response of a particle detector prepared in a superposition of locations interacting with a relativistic quantum field. Using a beamsplitter to prepare two superposed branches of a modulated laser probe, these branches are directed to intersect a pancake-shaped Bose-Einstein condensate at two separate locations. The branches are then recombined with another beamsplitter. Heterodyning one of the outputs, the response function corresponding to an Unruh-deWitt detector in a superposition of locations interacting with a (2+1)-dimensional massless scalar field is shown to appear in the difference photocurrent power spectrum. Operating beyond the standard quantum limit using squeezed light, we estimate the signal-to-noise ratio $SNR\gtrsim 10$ for extracting the response function over a broad set of baseband frequencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+实验提案。判断依据：提出可实现的实验方案（propose a realizable experiment），包含理论推导（response function corresponding to an Unruh-deWitt detector）和实验设计（beamsplitter, Bose-Einstein condensate, squeezed light）。；研究对象：粒子探测器处于位置叠加态时与相对论性量子场相互作用的响应。具体体系为：调制激光探针经分束器产生两个叠加分支，与盘状玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）在两个不同位置相交，再经另一分束器复合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量差拍光电流功率谱，可以提取出处于位置叠加态的Unruh-deWitt探测器与(2+1)维无质量标量场相互作用的响应函数；使用压缩光超越标准量子极限后，在宽基带频率范围内信噪比可达SNR≳10。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量差拍光电流功率谱，可以提取出处于位置叠加态的Unruh-deWitt探测器与(2+1)维无质量标量场相互作用的响应函数；使用压缩光超越标准量子极限后，在宽基带频率范围内信噪比可达SNR≳10。；创新点：首次提出在实验室可实现的方案，用于测试粒子探测器处于位置叠加态时与量子场的相互作用响应，并利用压缩光实现超越标准量子极限的测量灵敏度。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Unruh-deWitt探测器模型与(2+1)维无质量标量场耦合。实验手段：分束器制备激光探针的叠加路径、BEC作为探测器介质、外差探测（heterodyning）提取差拍光电流功率谱、压缩光（squeezed light）提升信噪比。

papers.title: Algebraic locality and non-invertible Gauss laws
papers.abstract: We study algebraic locality principles on a 2+1D closed lattice in the presence of a Gauss law for a non-invertible symmetry. Prior work in arXiv:2509.03589 showed that when enforcing the Gauss law of an invertible symmetry, the principle of "Haag duality" is preserved exactly, and "disjoint additivity" is preserved after appropriate treatment of discreteness artifacts. Here we show that for a large class of non-invertible on-site symmetries, Haag duality is preserved exactly only for sufficiently nice, "cuspless" regions. For cusped regions, we instead have a weak form of Haag duality that requires adding a collar. Our results apply to double models with a purely magnetic constraint, and to the more general framework of constraints induced by the on-site action of a Hopf algebra. In particular, we treat a class of extended string-net models explicitly. We also demonstrate disjoint additivity for double models based on a group, and a weakened form of disjoint additivity in the setting of a general Hopf algebra.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：algebraic locality principles、Haag duality、disjoint additivity、Hopf algebra、string-net models。；研究对象：2+1维闭格点系统上非可逆对称性的高斯定律，以及由此引发的代数局域性原理，具体包括双模型（double models）和扩展的弦网模型（string-net models）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于一大类非可逆在位对称性，Haag对偶性仅在无尖点（cuspless）的足够光滑区域中精确成立；对于有尖点的区域，需要添加一个“领圈”（collar）才能保持弱形式的Haag对偶性。此外，基于群的双模型满足不交可加性，而一般Hopf代数框架下仅满足弱化的不交可加性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于一大类非可逆在位对称性，Haag对偶性仅在无尖点（cuspless）的足够光滑区域中精确成立；对于有尖点的区域，需要添加一个“领圈”（collar）才能保持弱形式的Haag对偶性。此外，基于群的双模型满足不交可加性，而一般Hopf代数框架下仅满足弱化的不交可加性。；创新点：将先前针对可逆对称性高斯定律的Haag对偶性结果（arXiv:2509.03589）推广到非可逆对称性情形，揭示了尖点区域对Haag对偶性的破坏以及需要添加领圈的弱化形式，并系统处理了基于Hopf代数的更一般框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于代数局域性原理（Haag对偶性、不交可加性），利用Hopf代数的在位作用诱导的约束条件，对双模型和扩展弦网模型进行严格推导。

papers.title: Chiral Electromagnetic Surface Waves on Chern-Simons Interfaces
papers.abstract: We show that Maxwell theory with a codimension-$1$ Chern-Simons interface supports chiral electromagnetic surface waves on the interface, even when the bulk theory on both sides is conventional vacuum electrodynamics in infinite space. Solving the exact boundary value problem we find that the Chern-Simons interaction acts with opposite sign on the two helicities oriented along the interface, giving rise to one normalizable mode localized on the interface. This mode is a gapless chiral surface photon with linear dispersion and a frequency-independent index of refraction set by the Chern-Simons coefficient. This mode exists despite the absence of ambient material response or geometric confinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Maxwell theory, Chern-Simons interface, solving the exact boundary value problem。；研究对象：具有余维数为1的Chern-Simons界面的电磁系统，具体研究该界面上支持的手性电磁表面波。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使界面两侧的体材料均为无限空间中的常规真空电动力学，Chern-Simons界面仍能支持一种无能隙的手性表面光子模式，该模式具有线性色散和由Chern-Simons系数决定的频率无关折射率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使界面两侧的体材料均为无限空间中的常规真空电动力学，Chern-Simons界面仍能支持一种无能隙的手性表面光子模式，该模式具有线性色散和由Chern-Simons系数决定的频率无关折射率。；创新点：该手性表面波的存在不依赖于环境材料响应或几何约束（如波导或边界），仅由Chern-Simons界面本身产生，这与传统表面电磁波需要介质或几何限制的机制不同。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解精确的边界值问题，分析Chern-Simons相互作用对沿界面传播的两种手性（螺旋度）的相反符号作用，从而推导出局域在界面上的归一化模式。

papers.title: Conditional Entropy of Heat Diffusion on Temporal Networks
papers.abstract: Many complex systems can be modeled by temporal networks, whose organization often evolves through distinct structural phases. Detecting the change points that delimit these phases is both important and challenging. In this work, we extend the conditional entropy of heat diffusion from static graphs to temporal networks and study its properties. We provide an upper bound and explain how discrepancies from it arise from the presence of asymmetric temporal paths. Moreover, we show that this quantity is monotone in time, yielding an information-theoretic analog of the second law of thermodynamics for inhomogeneous diffusion on temporal networks. We then introduce a local version of conditional entropy, designed to probe diffusion over finite temporal windows, and show that it provides an informative signal for change-point detection in continuous-time temporal networks. We evaluate the proposed methodology on synthetic benchmarks, including comparative experiments with existing nonparametric baselines in the snapshot setting, and then apply it to a real-world temporal contact network from a French primary school. Finally, we show how to use detected change points to perform community detection on targeted sub-intervals, improving the quality and interpretability of the clustering results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。判断依据：推导了条件熵的上界和单调性等理论性质，并在合成基准和真实数据上进行了数值评估。；研究对象：时间网络上的热扩散过程，以及由此产生的结构相变检测问题。具体体系包括合成的时间网络基准模型和法国一所小学的真实接触网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将静态图上的热扩散条件熵推广到时间网络，发现该量在时间上是单调的，构成了时间网络上非均匀扩散的信息论版热力学第二定律。其局部版本可作为连续时间网络中变点检测的有效信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将静态图上的热扩散条件熵推广到时间网络，发现该量在时间上是单调的，构成了时间网络上非均匀扩散的信息论版热力学第二定律。其局部版本可作为连续时间网络中变点检测的有效信号。；创新点：1. 首次将静态图的条件熵概念系统性地推广到时间网络，并建立了其与热力学第二定律的类比。2. 提出了局部条件熵，用于有限时间窗口内的扩散探测，并展示了其在连续时间网络变点检测中的有效性。3. 展示了利用检测到的变点进行子区间社区检测，以提升聚类质量和可解释性。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（给出条件熵的上界，分析不对称时间路径导致的偏差）；数值模拟（在合成基准上评估变点检测性能，并与快照设定下的非参数基线方法对比）；真实数据应用（法国小学接触网络）。

papers.title: Dimers and discrete breathers in Bose-Einstein condensates in a quasi-periodic potential
papers.abstract: A quasi-one-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensate loaded into a quasi-periodic potential created by two sub-lattices of comparable amplitudes and incommensurate periods is considered. Although the conventional tight-binding approximation is not applicable in this setting, the description can still be reduced to a discrete model that accounts for the modes below the mobility edge. In the respective discrete lattice, where no linear hopping exists, solutions and their dynamics are governed solely by nonlinear interactions. Families of nonlinear modes, including those with no linear limit, are described with a special focus on dimers, which correspond to breather solutions of the Gross-Pitaevskii equation with a quasi-periodic potential. The breathers are found to be stable for negative scattering lengths. Localization and stable propagation of breathers are also observed for positive scattering lengths at relatively weak and moderate nonlinearities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“描述可简化为离散模型”“非线性模式族描述”“求解”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：准一维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）在准周期势中的二聚体（dimers）与离散呼吸子（discrete breathers）。具体体系为由两个振幅相近、周期不可公度的子晶格构成的准周期势场中的BEC。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无线性跳迁的离散晶格中，非线性相互作用单独主导了模式的存在与动力学；负散射长度下呼吸子稳定，正散射长度下在较弱至中等非线性强度时也能实现局域化与稳定传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无线性跳迁的离散晶格中，非线性相互作用单独主导了模式的存在与动力学；负散射长度下呼吸子稳定，正散射长度下在较弱至中等非线性强度时也能实现局域化与稳定传播。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用超越传统紧束缚近似的离散模型描述，该模型仅保留迁移率边以下的模式；通过求解含准周期势的Gross-Pitaevskii方程，分析非线性模式（包括无线性极限的模式）及其动力学行为。

papers.title: Discernible signatures of fractionally charged anyons in a Pfaffian-Laughlin state
papers.abstract: Understanding the nature of quasihole excitations, i.e., anyons that have fractional charge and statistics, has been a challenging problem in condensed matter physics. Our theoretical approach to this problem has been to consider a quantum dot, containing a few charged particles, coupled to the incompressible fluid. It has provided important insights into the energetics of Laughlin quasiholes. Photoluminescence (PL) spectroscopy studies of this system have been able to probe these quasiholes that have confirmed our expectations. Turning to the Pfaffian state, we now observe that such a system is also able to provide valuable information about the Pfaffian quasiholes, viz., the energy dispersion, the charge density distribution and the quasihole creation energy. The energy dispersion of e/4 quasiholes derived here, clearly reflect the interaction between the quantum dot and the incompressible Pfaffian state. PL spectroscopy experiments on the 5/2 Pfaffian-Laughlin state could perhaps shed light on the energetics of these elusive quasiparticles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretical approach、energy dispersion、charge density distribution、quasihole creation energy）；研究对象：Pfaffian-Laughlin态中的准空穴激发（任意子），具体关注其分数电荷（e/4）和统计性质，以及量子点与不可压缩流体的耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将含少量带电粒子的量子点耦合到不可压缩流体，可以提取Pfaffian态准空穴的能量色散、电荷密度分布和准空穴产生能，其中e/4准空穴的能量色散清晰反映了量子点与不可压缩Pfaffian态之间的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将含少量带电粒子的量子点耦合到不可压缩流体，可以提取Pfaffian态准空穴的能量色散、电荷密度分布和准空穴产生能，其中e/4准空穴的能量色散清晰反映了量子点与不可压缩Pfaffian态之间的相互作用。；创新点：将此前用于Laughlin准空穴研究的量子点-流体耦合理论框架推广到Pfaffian态，从而能够系统提取Pfaffian准空穴的关键物理量（能量色散、电荷密度、产生能），并指出光致发光（PL）光谱实验可能为5/2 Pfaffian-Laughlin态中这些难以捉摸的准粒子提供实验探测途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：构建包含少量带电粒子的量子点模型，并将其与不可压缩流体耦合；通过分析准空穴的能谱和电荷分布来研究其性质。摘要未提及具体数值计算方法（如精确对角化、蒙特卡洛等）。

papers.title: Hybrid Improper Ferroelectricity and Moiré Superlattices-induced Exciton Quantization in Layered 2D Halide Perovskite
papers.abstract: 2D Ruddlesden-Popper perovskites are compelling platforms for quantum-confined optoelectronics. However, polar order in iodide composition remains rare under ambient conditions, and the mechanistic origin of anomalous photoluminescence in this class of perovskite is still speculative. Here, we demonstrate that solution-grown $(PA)_2FAPb_2I_7$ single crystals develop an inadvertent moiré superlattice through pseudo-merohedral twinning, driven by hybrid improper ferroelectricity in which trilinear mode coupling between two primary zone-boundary modes ($X_2^+$ and $X_3^-$) and a secondary $Γ_4^-$ polar displacement simultaneously breaks inversion symmetry and imposes a ca. 5.17° rotational misalignment between adjacent layers. This symmetry breaking activates one of the highest piezoelectric coefficients $d_{33}$ (ca. 20 pm/V) reported among 2D perovskites. This misalignment generates a moiré superlattice that undergoes a thermally driven commensurate-incommensurate transition, switching between a periodic confinement potential that quantizes excitons into an equidistant photoluminescence ladder at 123 K and a disordered incommensurate phase with broadened emission at 298 K. These emissions are attributed to moiré-confined excitons, resolving a longstanding debate on anomalous secondary photoluminescence in layered 2D perovskites and opening pathways to twistronics, photoferroelectrics and piezo-optoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：solution-grown single crystals、photoluminescence、piezoelectric coefficient测量）；研究对象：二维Ruddlesden-Popper卤化物钙钛矿(PA)₂FAPb₂I₇单晶中的杂化非本征铁电性、莫尔超晶格及其诱导的激子量子化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过杂化非本征铁电性驱动的伪缺面孪晶，在(PA)₂FAPb₂I₇中自发形成约5.17°转角莫尔超晶格，该超晶格在低温下将激子量子化为等间距光致发光阶梯，并激活了二维钙钛矿中最高之一的压电系数d₃₃（约20 pm/V）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过杂化非本征铁电性驱动的伪缺面孪晶，在(PA)₂FAPb₂I₇中自发形成约5.17°转角莫尔超晶格，该超晶格在低温下将激子量子化为等间距光致发光阶梯，并激活了二维钙钛矿中最高之一的压电系数d₃₃（约20 pm/V）。；创新点：首次在二维碘基Ruddlesden-Popper钙钛矿中实现杂化非本征铁电性，并揭示其通过层间转角自发形成莫尔超晶格，从而将激子量子化为等间距发光阶梯，解决了该类材料中异常二次光致发光起源的长期争议。
papers.method_zh: 溶液法生长单晶；光致发光光谱（PL）测量（123 K和298 K）；压电系数d₃₃测量；通过对称性分析识别出三线性模式耦合（X₂⁺、X₃⁻与Γ₄⁻）驱动铁电性；热驱动公度-非公度相变分析。

papers.title: Observation of a tripartite quantum phase for coexisting extended, localized, and critical states
papers.abstract: The disordered quantum world hosts three fundamental types of states: extended, localized, and critical, of which the critical states are confined to fine-tuned critical points or mobility edges in randomly disordered systems. The tripartite phase, with all three types of states coexisting over finite spectral windows, represents a hallmark distinction between quasiperiodic and truly random systems in the localization physics. Here, we report the realization of this exotic phase in a quasi-periodically driven orbital optical lattice with ultracold atoms. The optical lattice with a quasiperiodic Floquet modulation coupling s and p orbitals is realized in experiment and shown to host the tripartite phase from exact theory. We develop a two-stage protocol to precisely prepare and detect the three types of quantum states. The characteristic exponents of these states are determined from expansion dynamics, showing their distinct universal transport properties. Our study marks a significant advancement in exploring unconventional critical phenomena and localization physics with ultracold atoms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：realize、experiment、ultracold atoms、expansion dynamics）；研究对象：准周期驱动轨道光学晶格中的超冷原子体系，具体研究扩展态、局域态和临界态三种量子态共存的三分量子相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验实现了准周期驱动光学晶格中扩展态、局域态和临界态在有限谱窗口内共存的三分量子相，并通过膨胀动力学确定了三种态的特征指数，展示了它们不同的普适输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验实现了准周期驱动光学晶格中扩展态、局域态和临界态在有限谱窗口内共存的三分量子相，并通过膨胀动力学确定了三种态的特征指数，展示了它们不同的普适输运性质。；创新点：首次在实验上实现了准周期系统中扩展态、局域态和临界态共存的三分量子相，验证了该相是准周期系统与真正随机系统在局域化物理中的标志性区别。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建了具有准周期Floquet调制的s-p轨道耦合光学晶格，采用两阶段协议精确制备和探测三种量子态，通过膨胀动力学测量确定特征指数。

papers.title: Temperature-induced optical enhancement near a localization transition
papers.abstract: Quasiperiodic systems are an intermediate class of systems between periodic crystals and disordered systems, famously exhibiting metal-insulator transitions (MITs) even in one dimension. While their transport properties have been studied extensively, a systematic analysis of the finite-frequency optical conductivity near the critical point has been lacking. In this work, we carry out a detailed study of the optical conductivity in the paradigmatic Aubry-André model. We find that the zero-temperature low-frequency optical signal is strongly restructured by the quasiperiodic potential, exhibiting an optical gap that closes discontinuously as the system approaches the MIT. Most strikingly, we uncover a mechanism for a strong enhancement of the low-frequency finite temperature optical conductivity at certain resonant frequencies. This enhancement stems from the thermal activation of Pauli-blocked transitions between strongly resonant van Hove singularities. This mechanism provides new insight into finite-frequency transport in quasiperiodic systems and a new pathway for manipulating optical properties near a localization transition. Furthermore, our findings establish the optical response as a powerful, experimentally accessible tool for probing non-trivial quasiperiodicity effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：carry out a detailed study（理论研究）、optical conductivity（光学响应计算）、Aubry-André model（模型计算）。；研究对象：准周期系统中的光学响应，具体为Aubry-André模型在金属-绝缘体相变（MIT）临界点附近的有限频率光学电导率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现零温低频光学信号在MIT附近呈现不连续闭合的光学能隙；同时揭示了一种通过热激活Pauli阻塞跃迁实现低频光学电导率显著增强的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现零温低频光学信号在MIT附近呈现不连续闭合的光学能隙；同时揭示了一种通过热激活Pauli阻塞跃迁实现低频光学电导率显著增强的机制。；创新点：首次系统分析了准周期系统在MIT临界点附近的有限频率光学响应，并发现了由热激活van Hove奇点间跃迁导致的光学增强新机制，为通过光学手段探测准周期效应提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 基于Aubry-André模型，对有限频率光学电导率进行系统性的理论计算与分析，重点考察温度、频率及准周期势强度的影响。

papers.title: Phonon Interactions in Metal Halide Perovskites elucidated by Raman Scattering
papers.abstract: There is a growing consensus that the exceptional optoelectronic properties of metal halide perovskites (MHPs) are largely due to the peculiar interplay between the inorganic cage lattice, composed of a labile network of corner-sharing metal halide octahedra, and the A-site cationic sublattice. This interaction significantly affects the vibrational spectrum of MHPs (phonon frequencies, linewidths, and lifetimes), resulting from the effects of lattice potential anharmonicity and/or static/dynamic disorder. Raman scattering is a suitable technique to probe phonon interactions in solids, allowing for the in-situ characterization of chemical environments, revealing the nature of lattice vibrations. In this perspective, the available experimental evidence of the aforementioned interplay will be reviewed with special emphasis on understanding Raman signatures depending on whether the coupling is principally mediated by hydrogen bonding or steric hindrance. The controversy about the origin of a strong Raman background, steeply rising towards zero Raman shift and called central peak, will be specifically addressed. This background signal, which is typically observed in the temperature range of stability of cubic and tetragonal phases when the A-site cation dynamics unfold, will be shown to be mostly due to disorder-induced second-order acoustic-phonon Raman scattering. This interpretation receives support from other semiconductor systems with nanoscale structural disorder, where the central Raman peak arises either from the vertical misalignment of Ge quantum dots in multi-stack heterostructures or from the interface roughness exhibited by short-period GaAs/AlAs superlattices. In this way, a unifying picture of phonon interactions in MHPs and how they impact different Raman processes is provided, which is key to interpreting their Raman spectra.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Raman scattering、experimental evidence、review）；研究对象：金属卤化物钙钛矿（MHPs）中的声子相互作用，特别是无机笼状晶格与A位阳离子亚晶格之间的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金属卤化物钙钛矿中强烈的拉曼背景（中心峰）主要源于无序诱导的二阶声学声子拉曼散射，而非其他机制；该背景信号在立方相和四方相稳定温度范围内、A位阳离子动力学活跃时出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金属卤化物钙钛矿中强烈的拉曼背景（中心峰）主要源于无序诱导的二阶声学声子拉曼散射，而非其他机制；该背景信号在立方相和四方相稳定温度范围内、A位阳离子动力学活跃时出现。；创新点：提出了一个统一的图像来解释金属卤化物钙钛矿中的声子相互作用如何影响不同拉曼过程，并澄清了关于中心峰起源的争议，将其归因于无序诱导的二阶声学声子拉曼散射。
papers.method_zh: 拉曼散射光谱（Raman scattering），并结合对已有实验证据的综述分析，以及与其他半导体体系（如Ge量子点多层异质结构、GaAs/AlAs短周期超晶格）的类比。

papers.title: Huge ultrafast spin Seebeck effect mediated by laser-excited superdiffusive magnon currents
papers.abstract: Subpicosecond laser excitation of ferromagnetic metals induces strongly nonequilibrium dynamics involving scattering and transport of electrons, phonons, and magnons. Widely used theoretical approaches, such as the three-temperature model and diffusion equations, are ill-suited to capture these processes on ultrafast timescales. Here, we present an ab initio-parameterized microscopic framework that incorporates nonthermal magnon scattering and transport via the quantum Boltzmann equation. We apply this approach to simulate ultrafast laser-induced demagnetization in bcc Fe films. The model predicts an ultrafast spin Seebeck effect, characterized by a strong burst of fast-moving magnonic spin current reaching technologically relevant amplitudes. Furthermore, we identify a superdiffusive transport regime: a crossover from initially ballistic magnon transport to a diffusive regime at later times. To connect our theoretical predictions to experimentally accessible observables, we calculate the magneto-optical Kerr angles resulting from the predicted depth-resolved magnetization profiles. Our framework provides a route to describe ultrafast nonthermal magnon transport beyond diffusive models and will aid in the design and interpretation of time-resolved spin-transport experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：ab initio-parameterized microscopic framework、quantum Boltzmann equation、simulate）；研究对象：激光激发下bcc Fe薄膜中的超快自旋塞贝克效应及超扩散磁子流
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模型预测了由激光激发的超快自旋塞贝克效应，产生强脉冲式快速移动的磁子自旋流，其幅度达到技术相关水平；并识别出从初始弹道磁子输运到后期扩散输运的超扩散输运区间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模型预测了由激光激发的超快自旋塞贝克效应，产生强脉冲式快速移动的磁子自旋流，其幅度达到技术相关水平；并识别出从初始弹道磁子输运到后期扩散输运的超扩散输运区间。；创新点：提出了超越扩散模型、能够描述超快非热磁子输运的理论框架，解决了三温度模型和扩散方程在超快时间尺度上的不适用问题。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理参数化的微观框架，通过量子玻尔兹曼方程描述非热磁子散射与输运，模拟bcc Fe薄膜的超快激光诱导退磁过程，并计算磁光克尔角以连接实验可观测信号。

papers.title: Strange metallicity in the Kagome metal Ni$_3$In: a DMFT investigation
papers.abstract: Strange metallicity, characterized by a linear temperature dependence of the resistivity, is observed in a broad range of correlated materials, including heavy-fermion compounds and cuprate superconductors. It has also recently been reported for the Kagome metal Ni$_3$In, where almost localized and itinerant electronic degrees of freedom coexist as a result of a partially flat band. We investigate the correlated electronic structure and transport properties of Ni$_3$In with dynamical mean field theory (DMFT) calculations performed on a minimal single-band Hubbard model, constructed from compact molecular orbitals. Despite the large band filling, even for moderate Hubbard repulsion, we observe a non-Fermi-liquid like frequency dependence of the self-energy, as well as the formation of local magnetic moments. With increased hole doping, a crossover to a heavy Fermi-liquid regime is found. We interpret these results in terms of an effective model for the partially filled narrow band near $k_z=0$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：DMFT calculations、single-band Hubbard model、self-energy。；研究对象：Kagome金属Ni₃In中的奇异金属态（strange metallicity），具体关注其关联电子结构和输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Ni₃In中，即使对于中等强度的Hubbard排斥，也能观察到自能的非费米液体频率依赖以及局域磁矩的形成；随着空穴掺杂增加，系统会交叉到重费米液体区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Ni₃In中，即使对于中等强度的Hubbard排斥，也能观察到自能的非费米液体频率依赖以及局域磁矩的形成；随着空穴掺杂增加，系统会交叉到重费米液体区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于紧凑分子轨道构建的最小单带Hubbard模型，采用动力学平均场理论（DMFT）进行计算。

papers.title: Pulse-Driven Reconfiguration of Fractional Polar Topology in Zr-Substituted Barium Titanate
papers.abstract: Polar topological textures in ferroelectrics can host internal structure beyond a single integer topological charge. Here, effective-Hamiltonian molecular-dynamics simulations are used to examine whether such internal fractional topology can be reconfigured by local electric excitation in ordered 12.5% Zr-substituted barium titanate. Chemical doubling along the polar axis stabilizes a coupled nanodomain texture consisting of alternating Q = -2 antiskyrmionic and Q = +4 skyrmionic slices, in which the local topological charge fragments into six -1/3 and six +2/3 localized contributions, denoted here as topological quarks, separated by Bloch-point-like singular conversion regions. Picosecond local electric-field pulses applied to selected vortex-core columns drive reconfiguration of the internal dipolar texture of a 2.6 nm nanodomain. Under a binary pulse-mask protocol addressing the six vortex cores, all 64 masks lead, within the chosen low-temperature simulation protocol, to distinct relaxed metastable configurations. The switching calculations are performed in a cryogenic regime, and the programmed states remain stable over at least 1 ns of field-free evolution on the simulation timescale. The resulting configurations are distinguishable both by sector-resolved topological fingerprints and by their real-space polarization fields. These results provide a computational proof of concept that fractional polar topology in a ferroelectric nanodomain can be locally reconfigured by ultrafast electric excitation and used as a multistate configurational degree of freedom in an idealized low-temperature setting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用了“effective-Hamiltonian molecular-dynamics simulations”（有效哈密顿量分子动力学模拟）作为主要研究手段。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是12.5% Zr取代的钛酸钡（Zr-substituted barium titanate）中的极性拓扑结构，具体为一种由交替的Q = -2反斯格明子切片和Q = +4斯格明子切片组成的耦合纳米畴结构，其内部存在分数化的拓扑电荷（拓扑“夸克”）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过皮秒级局域电场脉冲，可以重新配置铁电纳米畴中分数化的极性拓扑结构，并产生多种可区分的亚稳态构型，为多态信息存储提供了概念验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过皮秒级局域电场脉冲，可以重新配置铁电纳米畴中分数化的极性拓扑结构，并产生多种可区分的亚稳态构型，为多态信息存储提供了概念验证。；创新点：首次通过计算证明了在铁电纳米畴中，由分数化拓扑电荷（如-1/3和+2/3的拓扑“夸克”）构成的内部结构可以通过超快局域电激发进行局部重新配置，并作为多态可配置自由度使用。摘要未明确说明与之前工作的具体差异，但强调了“内部分数拓扑”的可重构性这一新概念。
papers.method_zh: 具体采用了有效哈密顿量分子动力学（effective-Hamiltonian molecular-dynamics）模拟方法。通过施加皮秒级局域电场脉冲到选定的涡旋核心列，并采用二进制脉冲掩码协议（binary pulse-mask protocol）来驱动拓扑结构的重构。

papers.title: Dynamical systems on ultra small-world networks
papers.abstract: Despite the knowledge that social, economical, and ecological networks are often of a small-world nature with inter-nodal distance growing even slower than logarithmically with system size, we often assume theoretical systems to be outside of this regime, to make them easier to treat analytically. Here we derive a framework to apply the powerful dynamical mean-field theory on highly heterogeneous networks that is able to account for more of the degree correlations naturally arising from network constraints, known as structural cut-offs. We apply this framework to the well-studied and understood disordered Lotka-Volterra model, and show typically reported observables such as survival rates and stability for these systems on ultra small-world networks. We find much better agreement for these variables for all ranges of exponents for simulated power-law networks as well as empirically sourced networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive a framework”（推导框架）、“apply dynamical mean-field theory”（应用动力学平均场理论）以及“show typically reported observables”（展示典型可观测量的理论结果），属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：超小世界网络上的动力学系统，具体以无序Lotka-Volterra模型为研究对象，探讨其生存率与稳定性等性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超小世界网络（节点间距离随系统大小增长慢于对数）上，所发展的动力学平均场框架能够更好地预测模拟幂律网络和经验网络在不同指数范围内的生存率与稳定性，与已有理论相比与模拟结果吻合更佳。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超小世界网络（节点间距离随系统大小增长慢于对数）上，所发展的动力学平均场框架能够更好地预测模拟幂律网络和经验网络在不同指数范围内的生存率与稳定性，与已有理论相比与模拟结果吻合更佳。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 发展了适用于高度异质性网络的动力学平均场理论框架，该框架能够考虑由网络约束（即结构截断）自然产生的度相关性。将该框架应用于无序Lotka-Volterra模型，并与模拟的幂律网络及经验网络的结果进行对比。

papers.title: Physical completion of the Navier-Stokes equations
papers.abstract: The incompressible Navier-Stokes equations contain viscous dissipation but no thermal noise. I show, using a topological argument based on Poincaré's lemma, that the fluctuation-dissipation relation for the full nonlinear dynamics can be derived without the linearisation or structural assumptions that all previous derivations require. The nonlinear convective term is Hamiltonian (energy-preserving and phase-space-volume-preserving) and drops out of the Fokker-Planck equilibrium condition exactly, so the noise derived from linearised fluctuations near equilibrium is in fact exact for the full nonlinear system. This result proves, rather than assumes, the reversible/irreversible decomposition that the GENERIC framework postulates, provided Poincaré's lemma holds on the phase space. The resulting stochastic system, with a physical molecular-scale spectral cutoff, is trivially globally well-posed: a finite-dimensional stochastic differential equation with non-degenerate noise and a confining Lyapunov function. It has a unique Gibbs equilibrium and converges to it exponentially. The difficulty of the Clay Millennium Prize Problem arises entirely from two idealisations, zero temperature and infinite spectral resolution, neither of which is satisfied by any physical fluid.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：拓扑论证、Poincaré引理、Fokker-Planck方程、GENERIC框架、随机微分方程。；研究对象：不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程的物理完备化问题，具体涉及流体动力学中涨落-耗散关系的非线性推广，以及经典Navier-Stokes方程（Clay千禧年问题）的物理正则化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过拓扑论证（Poincaré引理）证明，无需线性化或结构假设，即可从完整非线性Navier-Stokes动力学推导出涨落-耗散关系；非线性对流项恰好从Fokker-Planck平衡条件中消去，因此基于近平衡线性化涨落导出的噪声对完整非线性系统精确成立。该结果证明，在相空间满足Poincaré引理的前提下，GENERIC框架所假设的可逆/不可逆分解是严格成立的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过拓扑论证（Poincaré引理）证明，无需线性化或结构假设，即可从完整非线性Navier-Stokes动力学推导出涨落-耗散关系；非线性对流项恰好从Fokker-Planck平衡条件中消去，因此基于近平衡线性化涨落导出的噪声对完整非线性系统精确成立。该结果证明，在相空间满足Poincaré引理的前提下，GENERIC框架所假设的可逆/不可逆分解是严格成立的。；创新点：首次在不依赖线性化或结构假设的条件下，从拓扑原理严格推导出完整非线性Navier-Stokes方程的涨落-耗散关系；揭示Clay千禧年问题的困难完全源于“零温度”和“无限谱分辨率”两个理想化假设，而任何实际物理流体均不满足这些条件。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：运用Poincaré引理进行拓扑论证，结合Fokker-Planck方程平衡条件分析，建立非线性涨落-耗散关系；引入物理分子尺度谱截断，将系统转化为有限维随机微分方程（非退化噪声+约束Lyapunov函数），证明其全局适定性、唯一Gibbs平衡态及指数收敛性。

papers.title: Ultra-Confinement of Polaritons in Single Atomic Layer Ag Photonic Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Light scattering by two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals heterostructures (vdWHs) is immense, especially given their infinitesimal volume, thus enabling strong light-matter interactions. Surface 2D polariton waves manifest through large concentration of electromagnetic field in vertical direction, normal to their propagation. By confining vdWH materials into 2D photonic shapes, one can manipulate and compress light in lateral directions. Scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy is a perfect tool for direct imaging of the propagating polaritons and studying the properties of confined polaritons in nanostructures. Though, thus far the quantitative analysis, such the wavelength extraction, has been challenged for confined polaritons by incapability of mapping of the wave period on sub-wavelength scale and difficulty of identifying an adequate substrate's "background" to subtract. Here, an analytical approach is developed to reveal the local propagation constant of confined polaritons under abovementioned constraints and map it with the sub-wavelength resolution. Applied to analysis of the SiC/2D-Ag/EG (epitaxial graphene) photonic nanostructures, the technique uncovered that the polaritons are highly confined in both vertical ($\simλ$/50) and lateral directions ($\simλ$/40) by 2D metal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy（散射型扫描近场光学显微镜）、analytical approach（分析方法）。；研究对象：单原子层银（2D-Ag）光子量子点中的极化子（polaritons），具体体系为SiC/2D-Ag/EG（外延石墨烯）光子纳米结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作开发的分析方法揭示了在SiC/2D-Ag/EG纳米结构中，极化子在垂直方向（~λ/50）和横向方向（~λ/40）均被高度压缩，实现了超强局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作开发的分析方法揭示了在SiC/2D-Ag/EG纳米结构中，极化子在垂直方向（~λ/50）和横向方向（~λ/40）均被高度压缩，实现了超强局域化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：该工作解决了此前对受限极化子进行定量分析（如波长提取）的难题，即无法在亚波长尺度上映射波周期以及难以识别合适的基底“背景”进行扣除。
papers.method_zh: 散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）直接成像，并结合一种新开发的分析方法（用于提取受限极化子的局部传播常数，实现亚波长分辨率的映射）。

papers.title: Occupation Dynamics of Floquet-Volkov States and Spectral Sum Rule
papers.abstract: Time-periodic light fields can dress electronic states in quantum materials, forming Floquet states whose dynamic occupation determines transient material properties. Here by using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (TrARPES), we reveal the transient occupation of Floquet-Volkov states in two semiconductors, black phosphorus and MoSe$_2$. While the occupation of the light-induced sidebands, directly reflected by TrARPES spectral weight, strongly depends on the driving field, we find that the total spectral weight obtained by summing up all sidebands is conserved upon below-gap driving. Our work provides critical insights into the Floquet population dynamics, which are essential for light-field tailoring of transient material properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱（TrARPES）进行测量，并直接分析光谱权重。；研究对象：黑磷（black phosphorus）和MoSe₂两种半导体材料中，由时间周期光场驱动的Floquet-Volkov态及其瞬态占据行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光致边带的光谱权重强烈依赖于驱动光场，但将所有边带求和得到的总光谱权重在亚带隙驱动条件下是守恒的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光致边带的光谱权重强烈依赖于驱动光场，但将所有边带求和得到的总光谱权重在亚带隙驱动条件下是守恒的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱（TrARPES），用于直接探测Floquet-Volkov态的瞬态占据及其光谱权重。

papers.title: Unconventional Magnetism: Symmetry Classification, Hybrid-parity and Unconstrained-parity Classes
papers.abstract: Unconventional magnetism has emerged as a transformative frontier in condensed matter physics. Such phases are characterized by substantial non-relativistic spin splitting (NSS) in symmetry-compensated magnets. They have been classified by the parity of their spin textures under momentum inversion, leading to the paradigms of altermagnets (even-parity) and odd-parity magnets. However, the full symmetry landscape remains largely unexplored. In this Letter, we present a systematic classification framework for unconventional magnetism based on the representation theory of the spin textures and the associated parity properties. Within this framework, we predict two previously unidentified classes beyond the established pure-parity categories: hybrid-parity magnets (HPMs) and unconstrained-parity magnets (UPMs), where the spin textures exhibit contrasting parities among their Cartesian components and the parity of the spin textures is ill-defined, respectively. We derive universal symmetry criteria that categorize HPMs into three distinct types. Importantly, by combining the spin splitting characteristics of altermagnets and odd-parity magnets, HPMs can enable the coexistence of the spin current and Edelstein effects. Taking FePO4 as an example, we perform first-principles calculations to demonstrate this coexistence. Finally, we discuss the potential applications of HPMs in spintronic devices. Our work provides a comprehensive symmetry classification of unconventional magnetism and establishes HPMs as a promising platform for multi-functional spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“基于自旋纹理的表示理论”进行“系统分类”，并“推导了普适的对称性判据”，属于理论框架构建；同时，以FePO4为例进行了“第一性原理计算”作为验证。；研究对象：非常规磁性材料，具体指在对称性补偿磁体中产生显著非相对论性自旋劈裂（NSS）的磁性相。论文重点研究了其中自旋纹理的宇称分类，并预测了新的磁性类别：混合宇称磁体（HPMs）和无约束宇称磁体（UPMs）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现并预测了两种超越传统纯宇称（偶宇称的交替磁体、奇宇称磁体）分类的新磁性类别：混合宇称磁体（HPMs）和无约束宇称磁体（UPMs）。其中，HPMs能够同时实现自旋流效应和Edelstein效应，为多功能自旋电子学提供了新平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现并预测了两种超越传统纯宇称（偶宇称的交替磁体、奇宇称磁体）分类的新磁性类别：混合宇称磁体（HPMs）和无约束宇称磁体（UPMs）。其中，HPMs能够同时实现自旋流效应和Edelstein效应，为多功能自旋电子学提供了新平台。；创新点：该工作首次系统地建立了超越纯宇称（偶宇称/奇宇称）的非常规磁性分类框架，并明确预测了“混合宇称磁体”（HPMs）和“无约束宇称磁体”（UPMs）这两个此前未被识别的磁性类别。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 1. **理论框架**：基于自旋纹理的表示理论及其宇称性质，对非常规磁性进行系统分类。2. **对称性分析**：推导了将HPMs分为三种不同类型所需的普适对称性判据。3. **第一性原理计算**：以FePO4为例，通过计算验证了HPMs中自旋流效应和Edelstein效应的共存。

papers.title: Ferroelectric KNbO3 nanoplatelets for thermally driven pyrocatalytic hydrogen evolution and dye degradation
papers.abstract: Day- and night-induced thermal cycling offers a promising route for harvesting ambient thermal energy to drive sustainable hydrogen production and pollutant degradation. Pyroelectric materials enable this process by converting temperature fluctuations into surface charges capable of promoting catalytic water splitting and advanced oxidation reactions. In this work, we demonstrate efficient pyrocatalytic hydrogen evolution and Rhodamine B (RhB) degradation using orthorhombic ferroelectric Potassium niobate (KNbO$_3$) nanoplatelets (KN-np). Under thermal cycling between 20 and 50 $^\circ$C, KN-np achieved a hydrogen yield of 680 $μ$mol g$^{-1}$ after 30 thermal cycles, corresponding to an average hydrogen production rate of 22.67 $μ$mol g$^{-1}$ per cycle. In addition, KN-np exhibited excellent pyrocatalytic activity toward RhB degradation, reaching 84% removal after only 16 thermal cycles with an apparent kinetic rate constant of 0.11 cycle$^{-1}$. The remarkable catalytic performance is attributed to the strong spontaneous polarization and excellent pyroelectric properties of the KNbO$_3$ nanoplatelets, which promote efficient charge generation and interfacial redox reactions. These findings highlight the potential of KNbO$_3$ nanostructures as efficient pyrocatalysts for clean hydrogen production and environmental remediation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的材料合成（KNbO₃纳米片）、实验测试（热循环催化产氢、染料降解）及性能表征（产氢速率、降解效率）。；研究对象：正交相铁电铌酸钾（KNbO₃）纳米片（KN-np）及其在热驱动热催化产氢和罗丹明B（RhB）降解中的性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在20–50°C热循环条件下，KNbO₃纳米片实现了680 μmol g⁻¹的氢气产量（30次循环）和84%的RhB降解率（16次循环），表现出高效的热催化活性，归因于其强自发极化和优异的热电性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在20–50°C热循环条件下，KNbO₃纳米片实现了680 μmol g⁻¹的氢气产量（30次循环）和84%的RhB降解率（16次循环），表现出高效的热催化活性，归因于其强自发极化和优异的热电性能。；创新点：首次展示了KNbO₃纳米片在热催化产氢和染料降解中的高效性能，利用昼夜温差驱动的热循环实现环境热能收集与催化应用。
papers.method_zh: 采用热循环实验（20–50°C）驱动催化反应，测量氢气产量（气相色谱）和RhB降解率（紫外-可见光谱），并计算表观动力学速率常数（0.11 cycle⁻¹）。材料为合成的正交相铁电KNbO₃纳米片。

papers.title: Interaction Controlled Molecular Probing of Length Scale Dependent Glassy Dynamics in Polymer Melts
papers.abstract: Single molecule probes are widely used to characterize dynamic heterogeneity in glass forming liquids, but interpreting probe dynamics remains challenging because the measured response depends on how the probe couples to its host environment. Using molecular dynamics simulations of dilute probe dimers embedded in a supercooled polymer melt, we show that the probe--host interaction strength determines which heterogeneous environment of the host matrix is reflected in the probe dynamics. Weakly interacting probes partially decouple from their local cages and remain able to access dynamically active environments, whereas strongly interacting probes are more constrained within less mobile, cage-like environments. This interaction-dependent response provides a microscopic basis for the variation in fragility inferred from the probe dynamics, even though the intrinsic host dynamics remains essentially unperturbed. By comparing probe rotational relaxation with the wavevector-dependent structural relaxation and dynamic susceptibility of the host, we establish a scale-dependent correspondence between probe dynamics and host dynamic heterogeneity. Our results show that molecular probes do not simply report the bulk host relaxation, but instead encode the spatial scale and heterogeneous environment associated with the probe--host interaction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular dynamics simulations（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：过冷聚合物熔体中稀溶液探针二聚体的动力学行为，以及探针-宿主相互作用如何影响对玻璃态动态异质性的探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 探针与宿主之间的相互作用强度决定了探针所反映的宿主基质异质环境类型：弱相互作用探针部分脱离局域笼子，能访问动态活跃区域；强相互作用探针则被限制在低迁移率的笼状环境中。探针动力学并非简单报告宿主整体弛豫，而是编码了与探针-宿主相互作用相关的空间尺度和异质环境。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：探针与宿主之间的相互作用强度决定了探针所反映的宿主基质异质环境类型：弱相互作用探针部分脱离局域笼子，能访问动态活跃区域；强相互作用探针则被限制在低迁移率的笼状环境中。探针动力学并非简单报告宿主整体弛豫，而是编码了与探针-宿主相互作用相关的空间尺度和异质环境。；创新点：揭示了探针-宿主相互作用强度是决定探针动力学反映何种宿主异质环境的关键微观因素，并建立了探针动力学与宿主动态异质性之间的尺度依赖对应关系，为解释由探针动力学推断出的脆度变化提供了微观基础。
