papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学模拟，在过冷聚合物熔体中嵌入稀溶液探针二聚体，通过改变探针-宿主相互作用强度，分析探针旋转弛豫与宿主波矢依赖的结构弛豫及动态磁化率之间的对应关系。

papers.title: Designing Magnetic Topological Insulator Trilayers for Highly-Efficient Spin-Orbit Torque Switching
papers.abstract: Spin-orbit torque (SOT) enables efficient electrical control of magnetization, offering a pathway towards low-power spintronic devices. Magnetic topological insulators (TIs), with spin-momentum-locked surface states and intrinsic ferromagnetism, provide a unique platform for realizing SOT switching of edge current chirality in quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) insulators. In this work, we employ molecular beam epitaxy to synthesize a series of magnetic TI trilayers with controlled layer thicknesses on heat-treated SrTiO3(111) substrates. Electrical transport measurements reveal that SOT-driven magnetization reversal and the associated switching of edge current chirality are governed by the SrTiO3(111) substrate-induced charging effect, which generates an asymmetric chemical-potential alignment between the top and bottom magnetic TI layers. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the switching polarity and efficiency can be tuned through heterostructure design, gate voltage, and in-plane magnetic field, consistent with SOT symmetry. These findings identify chemical potential asymmetry as the origin of the large SOT switching ratio in magnetic TI trilayers and establish a route for electrical control of edge current chirality in QAH insulators. This work advances the understanding of SOT switching mechanism in magnetic topological materials and paves the way for next-generation, energy-efficient QAH-based logic and memory devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：molecular beam epitaxy（分子束外延）、electrical transport measurements（电输运测量）。；研究对象：磁性拓扑绝缘体三层异质结（magnetic TI trilayers），具体研究其自旋轨道矩（SOT）驱动的磁化翻转及边缘电流手性开关行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现SrTiO₃(111)衬底诱导的充电效应导致顶层与底层磁性拓扑绝缘体层之间产生不对称化学势对齐，这是实现大SOT开关比的关键机制；开关极性和效率可通过异质结构设计、栅极电压和面内磁场进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现SrTiO₃(111)衬底诱导的充电效应导致顶层与底层磁性拓扑绝缘体层之间产生不对称化学势对齐，这是实现大SOT开关比的关键机制；开关极性和效率可通过异质结构设计、栅极电压和面内磁场进行调控。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子束外延（MBE）在热处理后的SrTiO₃(111)衬底上生长一系列厚度可控的磁性拓扑绝缘体三层异质结，并通过电输运测量研究SOT驱动的磁化反转和边缘电流手性开关行为。

papers.title: Designer Quantum States in Magnetic Topological Insulator Multilayers
papers.abstract: Magnetic topological insulators (TIs) provide a highly tunable platform for engineering quantum states that emerge from the interplay between topology and magnetism. In this review article, we summarize experimental progress over the past decade in designing magnetic TI multilayers by molecular beam epitaxy (MBE). By treating magnetically doped and undoped TI layers as topological Legos, we discuss how layer thickness, magnetic doping, heterostructure architecture, and stacking sequence can be used to control magnetic exchange gaps, interlayer coupling, and the Chern number C with atomic-layer precision. We first briefly review the realization of the C = 1 quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) effect in uniformly Cr-doped (Bi,Sb)2Te3 films in 2013 and uniformly V-doped (Bi,Sb)2Te3 films in 2015. We then discuss how Cr-doped and undoped (Bi,Sb)2Te3 layers can be combined to realize the C = 1 QAH effect in magnetically modulation-doped trilayers, including its extension into the three-dimensional (3D) regime. Next, we review the development of high-C QAH states, engineered plateau phase transitions, mesoscopic QAH devices, and electrical switching of chiral edge-current chirality. Finally, we discuss the realizations of axion insulator and C = 1/2 parity anomaly states in asymmetric magnetic TI trilayers. These advances establish magnetic TI multilayers as a versatile materials platform for creating new designer quantum states, including synthetic Weyl semimetal and QAH metal phases, and for probing the topological magnetoelectric effect in thick axion insulators and 3D QAH insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。关键词：review article、summarize experimental progress。；研究对象：磁性拓扑绝缘体多层膜（magnetic topological insulator multilayers），具体为Cr掺杂或V掺杂的(Bi,Sb)2Te3薄膜及其异质结构，以及由此实现的量子反常霍尔效应、轴子绝缘体、奇偶反常态等量子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将磁性掺杂与未掺杂的拓扑绝缘体层作为“拓扑乐高”进行堆叠，可以原子层精度地调控磁交换能隙、层间耦合和陈数（C），从而设计出包括C=1量子反常霍尔效应、高C量子反常霍尔态、轴子绝缘体、C=1/2奇偶反常态以及合成外尔半金属和量子反常霍尔金属在内的多种新型量子态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将磁性掺杂与未掺杂的拓扑绝缘体层作为“拓扑乐高”进行堆叠，可以原子层精度地调控磁交换能隙、层间耦合和陈数（C），从而设计出包括C=1量子反常霍尔效应、高C量子反常霍尔态、轴子绝缘体、C=1/2奇偶反常态以及合成外尔半金属和量子反常霍尔金属在内的多种新型量子态。；创新点：系统总结了利用磁性拓扑绝缘体多层膜作为“拓扑乐高”平台，通过层厚、掺杂、异质结构构型和堆叠顺序的原子级精确调控，实现从二维到三维、从低陈数到高陈数、从量子反常霍尔效应到轴子绝缘体及奇偶反常态等一系列可设计量子态的实验进展。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长技术，结合磁掺杂与未掺杂拓扑绝缘体层的多层膜结构设计（如调制掺杂三明治结构、不对称三明治结构），以及输运测量（如量子反常霍尔效应、手性边缘电流电学开关等）。

papers.title: Role of Bi3+ ion substitution on the piezocatalytic degradation performance of lead-free BaTi0.89Sn0.11O3 at low vibrational energy
papers.abstract: Harnessing low ultrasonic vibration energy to drive piezocatalytic reactions has attracted increasing attention in response to current environmental and energy challenges. In this study, we investigate the effect of heterovalent bismuth doping on the piezocatalytic degradation of Rhodamine B (RhB) under low-power ultrasonic excitation. Bismuth ions (Bi$^{3+}$) were substituted into the lead-free ferroelectric BaTi${0.89}$Sn${0.11}$O$_3$, yielding BTSn11-xBi with x = 0, 0.02, and 0.04. The powders were synthesized by the sol-gel method as submicron cubes. The structural, morphological, optical, and piezocatalytic properties were strongly influenced by the Bi content. Compared with pristine BTSn11 and BTSn11-0.04Bi, the BTSn11-0.02Bi sample exhibited the lowest band gap (3.22 eV), the smallest particle size (283 nm), the highest piezoelectric current (approximately 8 microA cm$^{-2}$), and the lowest coercive field required to obtain piezoresponse force microscopy hysteresis loops. As a result, BTSn11-0.02Bi showed the highest RhB degradation efficiency and the largest apparent kinetic rate constant, confirming its superior piezocatalytic performance. Total organic carbon measurements revealed significant mineralization of RhB. In addition, BTSn11-0.02Bi demonstrated good reusability and stability, maintaining high degradation efficiency over three consecutive cycles. These results highlight the potential of Bi-doped BTSn11 ferroelectric materials, particularly BTSn11-0.02Bi, as efficient piezocatalysts for environmental remediation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“synthesized by the sol-gel method”、“piezoelectric current measurements”、“piezoresponse force microscopy”等实验手段。；研究对象：Bi³⁺离子掺杂的无铅铁电材料BaTi₀.₈₉Sn₀.₁₁O₃（BTSn11），具体研究其作为压电催化剂在低振动能量下对罗丹明B（RhB）的降解性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 适量Bi³⁺掺杂（x=0.02）的BTSn11样品（BTSn11-0.02Bi）具有最低的带隙（3.22 eV）、最小的颗粒尺寸（283 nm）、最高的压电电流（约8 μA cm⁻²）和最低的矫顽场，从而表现出最优异的RhB压电催化降解效率和最大的表观动力学速率常数，且具有良好的可重复使用性和稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：适量Bi³⁺掺杂（x=0.02）的BTSn11样品（BTSn11-0.02Bi）具有最低的带隙（3.22 eV）、最小的颗粒尺寸（283 nm）、最高的压电电流（约8 μA cm⁻²）和最低的矫顽场，从而表现出最优异的RhB压电催化降解效率和最大的表观动力学速率常数，且具有良好的可重复使用性和稳定性。；创新点：系统研究了异价Bi³⁺掺杂对无铅铁电BTSn11在低功率超声激发下压电催化降解性能的影响，并发现中等掺杂浓度（x=0.02）可同时优化带隙、颗粒尺寸、压电电流和矫顽场，从而显著提升催化效率。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 溶胶-凝胶法合成亚微米立方体粉末；X射线衍射、扫描/透射电镜等结构形貌表征；紫外-可见光谱测量带隙；压电电流测量；压电力显微镜（PFM）获取电滞回线；紫外-可见分光光度计监测RhB降解；总有机碳（TOC）测量评估矿化程度；循环实验测试稳定性。

papers.title: Ligand-mediated Origin of Altermagnetic Spin-Splitting
papers.abstract: Altermagnets host spin-split electronic bands despite zero net magnetization, opening new routes for spintronics beyond conventional ferromagnets. Going beyond symmetry-based classifications, which specify allowed terms but not their hierarchy, here we use first-principles calculations and Wannier Hamiltonian engineering to uncover the microscopic bonding contributions of altermagnetic spin splitting in the $g$-wave altermagnet Co$_{1/4}$NbSe$_2$. We show that the splitting is captured by a short-range tight-binding model, establishing its local origin. By selectively controlling hopping channels, we demonstrate that the dominant contribution arises not from direct magnetic-ion hopping, but from ligand-mediated hybridization that transfers anisotropy to itinerant states. This identifies ligand-assisted coupling as the key mechanism of altermagnetic spin splitting and provides a microscopic bridge between minimal models and symmetry guided first-principles material searches, enabling real-space design of altermagnetic functionality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、Wannier Hamiltonian engineering（Wannier哈密顿量工程）、tight-binding model（紧束缚模型）。；研究对象：g波交变磁体Co₁/₄NbSe₂中交变磁自旋劈裂的微观成键起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁自旋劈裂的主要贡献并非来自磁性离子（Co）的直接跃迁，而是来自配体（Se）介导的杂化作用，该作用将各向异性传递给巡游电子态，从而产生自旋劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁自旋劈裂的主要贡献并非来自磁性离子（Co）的直接跃迁，而是来自配体（Se）介导的杂化作用，该作用将各向异性传递给巡游电子态，从而产生自旋劈裂。；创新点：超越了仅基于对称性的分类（仅说明允许的项，不说明其层级），首次从微观成键角度揭示了配体辅助耦合是交变磁自旋劈裂的关键机制，为最小模型与对称性引导的第一性原理材料搜索之间建立了微观桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（DFT）结合Wannier哈密顿量工程，构建短程紧束缚模型，并通过选择性控制跃迁通道来分析各跃迁路径对自旋劈裂的贡献。

papers.title: Fermion condensation in a generalized Hatsugai-Kohmoto model with momentum-mixing Landau interactions
papers.abstract: The Hatsugai-Kohmoto (HK) model is an exactly solvable electronic lattice model where the interaction between electrons with opposite spin is diagonal in momentum space. We generalize the HK model by introducing momentum-mixing Landau interactions. Within a self-consistent mean-field analysis we find that the ground state of this model exhibits a partially flat energy band, in agreement with the fermion condensation scenario proposed by Khodel and Shaginyan [JETP Lett. 51, 553 (1990)]. Inspired by Andersons pseudospin formulation of BCS theory, we show that the HK model with Landau interactions can be mapped onto a generalized Ising model where each site of the reciprocal lattice hosts two Ising spins. In the pseudospin picture the emergence of a partially flat electronic band corresponds to the smoothing of a magnetic domain wall. Moreover, guided by the pseudospin picture, we propose an exactly solvable variant of the HK model which has a unique ground state for all densities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“exactly solvable model”、“self-consistent mean-field analysis”、“mapped onto a generalized Ising model”等理论分析关键词。；研究对象：广义Hatsugai-Kohmoto (HK) 模型，该模型在动量空间中引入混合朗道相互作用，研究其基态中的费米子凝聚现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型的基态呈现部分平坦的能带，与Khodel和Shaginyan提出的费米子凝聚（fermion condensation）图像一致；通过赝自旋映射，该平坦能带的出现对应于磁畴壁的平滑化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型的基态呈现部分平坦的能带，与Khodel和Shaginyan提出的费米子凝聚（fermion condensation）图像一致；通过赝自旋映射，该平坦能带的出现对应于磁畴壁的平滑化。；创新点：将HK模型推广至包含动量混合的朗道相互作用，并利用安德森BCS赝自旋形式化方法，揭示了费米子凝聚与磁畴壁平滑之间的对应关系；此外，提出了一个在所有密度下都具有唯一基态的精确可解HK模型变体。
papers.method_zh: 自洽平均场分析；将模型映射为广义伊辛模型（每个倒格点有两个伊辛自旋）；提出一个精确可解的HK模型变体。

papers.title: Random Matrix Spectra from Boltzmann-Weighted Lattice Ensembles
papers.abstract: We introduce a random matrix framework for studying statistical-mechanical lattice systems through spectral observables. Equilibrium configurations sampled from a Boltzmann measure are mapped to matrix ensembles whose covariance structure is inherited from the spatial correlations of the underlying model. This construction maps real-space correlation functions to a momentum-space variance profile, providing a direct bridge between statistical-mechanical correlations and correlated random matrix ensembles. We derive this variance profile in finite-correlation-length and critical regimes, and compute spectral moments within a Wick-contraction expansion. A complementary self-consistent description of the bulk density is developed using the resolvent formalism. These analytical methods are benchmarked against Monte Carlo data for the two-dimensional Ising model and three-dimensional Edwards--Anderson spin glasses. In both cases, the spectra evolve from the semicircle law at high temperature to model-dependent critical forms reflecting the structure of correlations. The framework, therefore, provides a quantitative spectral route to probing collective behavior in ordered and disordered statistical systems, while also defining a class of physically motivated correlated random matrix ensembles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：random matrix framework、analytical methods、resolvent formalism、Monte Carlo benchmark）；研究对象：统计力学晶格系统，具体包括二维伊辛模型和三维Edwards-Anderson自旋玻璃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将玻尔兹曼权重采样的平衡构型映射为随机矩阵系综，发现谱密度从高温下的半圆律演化为依赖于模型结构的临界形式，从而提供了一条通过谱特征探测有序与无序统计系统中集体行为的定量路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将玻尔兹曼权重采样的平衡构型映射为随机矩阵系综，发现谱密度从高温下的半圆律演化为依赖于模型结构的临界形式，从而提供了一条通过谱特征探测有序与无序统计系统中集体行为的定量路径。；创新点：建立了实空间关联函数与动量空间方差分布之间的直接桥梁，从而将统计力学关联与关联随机矩阵系综联系起来，并定义了物理动机明确的关联随机矩阵系综类。
papers.method_zh: 构建了从统计力学晶格系统到随机矩阵系综的映射框架，利用Wick收缩展开计算谱矩，并采用预解式形式论发展体态密度的自洽描述；数值上通过蒙特卡洛模拟对二维伊辛模型和三维Edwards-Anderson自旋玻璃进行基准测试。

papers.title: Stacking-order-dependent electronic properties of MoTe2/WSe2 moiré bilayers
papers.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) moiré bilayers have realized a wide range of strongly correlated and topological phenomena. The physics in these materials is often sensitive to the interlayer stacking order. Polarization-resolved optical second harmonic generation (SHG) is the most used technique for stacking order characterization but unverified for most heterobilayers. Here we calibrate the optical SHG for angle-aligned MoTe2/WSe2 bilayers by the scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM). We directly compare the transport and magnetic properties and the electronic phase diagram for two distinct stacking orders. With the calibrated stacking order assignment, we clarify the interpretation of earlier results, including the nature of the Chern insulator, mechanism of an electric-field-tuned metal-insulator transition at half band filling, and the Kondo lattice physics. Our work provides a consistent picture of the relation between the stacking order and the electronic properties of MoTe2/WSe2 moiré bilayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：calibrate、scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM)、directly compare transport and magnetic properties。；研究对象：MoTe₂/WSe₂莫尔双层异质结中依赖于堆叠顺序的电子性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过STEM校准光学二次谐波（SHG）对堆叠顺序的指认，澄清了此前关于Chern绝缘体性质、半填充电场调控金属-绝缘体转变机制以及Kondo晶格物理的解释，建立了堆叠顺序与电子性质之间一致的关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过STEM校准光学二次谐波（SHG）对堆叠顺序的指认，澄清了此前关于Chern绝缘体性质、半填充电场调控金属-绝缘体转变机制以及Kondo晶格物理的解释，建立了堆叠顺序与电子性质之间一致的关系。；创新点：首次利用STEM对MoTe₂/WSe₂异质双层中的SHG堆叠顺序指认进行校准，并基于此统一解释了此前存在争议的多个物理现象。
papers.method_zh: 极化分辨光学二次谐波（SHG）结合扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）校准，直接比较两种不同堆叠顺序下的输运性质、磁性质和电子相图。

papers.title: Destructive interference of second harmonic generation in AA stacked MoTe$_2$/WSe$_2$
papers.abstract: The stacking configuration of two-dimensional materials critically governs their optical and electronic responses. Monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDC) lack inversion symmetry and exhibit exciton-enhanced second-harmonic generation (SHG). In TMDC bilayers, 60° (0°) stacking is conventionally expected to suppress (enhance) SHG owing to destructive (constructive) interference of the layer-resolved nonlinear polarizations. Here, we report an unconventional destructive SHG interference in nearly 0°-stacked (AA-stacked) MoTe2/WSe2 heterobilayers using two independent probes: atomic-resolution imaging and stacking-sensitive exciton hybridization measurements. Supported by ab initio GW and Bethe-Salpeter equation calculations, we show that distinct two-photon resonances associated with the WSe2 C exciton and the MoTe2 D exciton generate a nearly $π$ phase difference ($Δφ$) in their second-order nonlinear susceptibilities $χ^{(2)}$, leading to the anomalous destructive interference. We further demonstrate that in small-angle twisted MoTe2/WSe2, the SHG polarization state is governed by the interplay between twist angle $α$ and phase difference $Δφ$, and can be mapped onto trajectories on the Poincaré sphere. At excitation energies satisfying $Δφ$ + 3$α$ = 180°, the SHG output becomes nearly circularly polarized (ellipticity ~ 0.91) and undergoes an abrupt 90° azimuthal rotation, corresponding to a geometric polarization singularity in the parameter space. Our findings open new routes for exciton-resonance engineered nonlinear photonics and stacking-resolved optical functionality in moiré materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用两种独立探针：原子级分辨率成像和堆叠敏感激子杂化测量”，以及“基于第一性原理GW和Bethe-Salpeter方程计算”。；研究对象：AA堆叠的MoTe₂/WSe₂异质双层中的二次谐波产生（SHG）干涉现象，特别是非常规的相消干涉及其与激子共振、扭转角的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在近乎0°堆叠（AA堆叠）的MoTe₂/WSe₂异质双层中，由于WSe₂的C激子和MoTe₂的D激子对应的双光子共振在二阶非线性极化率χ⁽²⁾上产生接近π的相位差，导致反常的二次谐波相消干涉。在特定激发能量下，SHG输出可变为近圆偏振，并发生90°方位角旋转，对应参数空间中的几何偏振奇点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在近乎0°堆叠（AA堆叠）的MoTe₂/WSe₂异质双层中，由于WSe₂的C激子和MoTe₂的D激子对应的双光子共振在二阶非线性极化率χ⁽²⁾上产生接近π的相位差，导致反常的二次谐波相消干涉。在特定激发能量下，SHG输出可变为近圆偏振，并发生90°方位角旋转，对应参数空间中的几何偏振奇点。；创新点：揭示了在传统认为应增强SHG的0°堆叠（AA堆叠）构型中，因激子共振相位差导致反常相消干涉的机制，并展示了通过扭转角和激发能量调控SHG偏振态（包括在庞加莱球上的轨迹和偏振奇点）的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用原子级分辨率成像和堆叠敏感激子杂化测量两种独立探针；理论上采用第一性原理GW方法和Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）计算。

papers.title: Probing topological phase transitions via nonlinear Hall response in strained moiré dice lattice
papers.abstract: Valley polarized twisted bilayer dice lattice hosts topologically nontrivial flat bands far from charge neutrality due to broken time reversal symmetry, whereas the ones in the vicinity of it remain topologically trivial. However, when both valleys are taken into consideration, the time reversal symmetry is preserved, which poses a serious hindrance to enumerate the valley specific topological phases that rely on the detection of the Berry curvature. In this work, we demonstrate that such a twisted structure with an applied uniaxial strain exhibits a nonlinear Hall effect far from charge neutrality. We ascertain that the nonlinear anomalous Hall signals can serve as a probe for topological phase transitions associated with a specific energy state that is constrained to reside at the lower edge of the middle subband and controlled via a staggered mass. Specifically, we show that the nonlinear anomalous Hall response undergoes a sign reversal across the topological phase boundaries. By tuning the carrier density, we compute the nonlinear Hall response obtained from the Berry curvature dipole, both in the chiral limit, and also when the chiral symmetry is broken. It is further seen that the nonlinear Hall effect is significantly enhanced in the broken chiral symmetry regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”、“ascertain”、“show”、“compute”等词汇，描述了理论推导和数值计算过程，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：论文研究的是在施加单轴应变的moiré骰子晶格（dice lattice）中，由非线性霍尔效应探测拓扑相变的现象。具体体系为谷极化的扭曲双层骰子晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 研究发现，在远离电荷中性的能带中，非线性反常霍尔信号可以作为探测拓扑相变的探针，其信号在拓扑相边界处会发生符号反转。此外，在手性对称性破缺的情况下，非线性霍尔效应会显著增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：研究发现，在远离电荷中性的能带中，非线性反常霍尔信号可以作为探测拓扑相变的探针，其信号在拓扑相边界处会发生符号反转。此外，在手性对称性破缺的情况下，非线性霍尔效应会显著增强。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 论文采用了理论分析与数值计算相结合的方法。具体计算了由贝里曲率偶极子（Berry curvature dipole）贡献的非线性霍尔响应，并分别在手性极限（chiral limit）和手性对称性破缺（broken chiral symmetry）两种情况下进行了计算。通过调节交错质量（staggered mass）和载流子密度来研究拓扑相变。

papers.title: Shear-Mode Raman Imaging of Ferroelectric Switching in Multilayer 3$R$-MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: We use shear-mode Raman imaging to track ferroelectric switching in multilayer 3$R$-MoS$_2$. Within a single flake, mechanically segmented regions respond independently and follow distinct pathways. Partially polarized end states indicate that domain walls can reside between selected layer pairs, producing partial stacking transformations. The dwell time of intermediate states varies widely, indicating that pinning sites strongly influence the dynamics. Second-harmonic generation measurements further reveal three characteristic sample-boundary and domain-wall orientations, including a prevalent chiral direction near the zigzag-armchair bisector. These results provide a direct, noninvasive view of domain-wall-mediated switching in a prototypical sliding ferroelectric and identify pinning and exfoliation-created boundaries as key factors governing its dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：Raman imaging、second-harmonic generation measurements。；研究对象：多层3R相二硫化钼（3R-MoS₂）中的铁电开关行为，具体为滑移铁电体中的畴壁介导开关动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多层3R-MoS₂中，机械分割的区域独立响应并遵循不同路径；部分极化终态表明畴壁可驻留在特定层对之间，产生部分堆叠转变；钉扎位点和剥离产生的边界是控制开关动力学的关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多层3R-MoS₂中，机械分割的区域独立响应并遵循不同路径；部分极化终态表明畴壁可驻留在特定层对之间，产生部分堆叠转变；钉扎位点和剥离产生的边界是控制开关动力学的关键因素。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 剪切模式拉曼成像（shear-mode Raman imaging）用于追踪铁电开关过程；二次谐波产生（second-harmonic generation）测量用于揭示样品边界和畴壁取向。

papers.title: Oxygen-Pressure-Limited Recovery of the Hematite α-Fe$_2$O$_3$(0001) Surface from a Reduced Fe$_3$O$_4$(111)-Like Layer
papers.abstract: The oxidation kinetics of hematite α-Fe$_2$O$_3$(0001) surfaces are vital for its applications in catalysis, environmental remediation, and industrial processes. Despite prior studies, the roles of temperature, oxygen partial pressure, and oxygen chemical potential in controlling nucleation and growth kinetics are not fully understood. Using real-time Low Energy Electron Microscopy/Diffraction (LEEM/LEED), we systematically investigate the oxidation of a reduced Fe$_3$O$_4$(111)-like surface layer to hematite under controlled conditions. We show that complete recovery of the hematite surface termination is closely linked to the nucleation and lateral growth of a two-dimensional honeycomb (H) phase. While higher temperatures accelerate nucleation, they slow lateral growth at constant oxygen pressure, indicating that oxygen supply limits the oxidation rate. Below an oxygen partial pressure threshold (~2$\times$10$^{-6}$ mbar), growth dramatically slows, underscoring the critical role of oxygen availability. Below a certain oxygen pressure threshold, the growth time rapidly increases. Our study elucidates the interplay between thermodynamics and kinetics in hematite surface oxidation, informing strategies to optimize surface properties for catalytic and industrial processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：real-time Low Energy Electron Microscopy/Diffraction (LEEM/LEED)、systematically investigate、oxidation kinetics。；研究对象：赤铁矿α-Fe₂O₃(0001)表面从还原态Fe₃O₄(111)类表面层氧化恢复的过程，具体关注温度、氧分压和氧化学势对成核与生长动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 赤铁矿表面完全恢复与二维蜂窝（H）相的成核和横向生长密切相关；氧分压低于约2×10⁻⁶ mbar时，生长速度急剧减慢，表明氧气供应是限制氧化速率的关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：赤铁矿表面完全恢复与二维蜂窝（H）相的成核和横向生长密切相关；氧分压低于约2×10⁻⁶ mbar时，生长速度急剧减慢，表明氧气供应是限制氧化速率的关键因素。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用实时低能电子显微镜/衍射（LEEM/LEED）在受控条件下系统观测还原Fe₃O₄(111)类表面层氧化为赤铁矿的过程。

papers.title: Observation of spin-free interatomic orbital angular momentum in a chiral crystal
papers.abstract: The inherent spin-orbit interaction of electrons inevitably couples spin to the orbital angular momentum (OAM), posing a fundamental challenge to spin-free orbital transport. Here, we propose a novel strategy to achieve spin-decoupled OAM states in crystalline solids. Using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), we resolve well-isolated s-orbital bands in a chiral Te crystal, clearly separated from the p-orbital manifold. Combined circular dichroism ARPES and first-principles calculations reveal that these bands host OAM arising exclusively from interatomic hopping, with no intra-atomic contribution. Spin-resolved ARPES further confirms the absence of SAM, providing decisive evidence of spin-free OAM states. These findings establish the existence of OAM without spin polarization in crystalline solids and highlight the essential role of inter-atomic OAM. This work provides a general framework for designing spinless OAM states, opening an opportunity toward pure orbital currents for orbitronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES)、spin-resolved ARPES、first-principles calculations，实验为主，辅以计算验证）；研究对象：手性碲（Te）晶体中自旋解耦的轨道角动量（OAM）态，具体为s轨道能带中纯原子间跃迁产生的轨道角动量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在手性Te晶体中观测到了无自旋极化的纯轨道角动量（OAM）态，证明晶体中可存在仅由原子间跃迁贡献、无自旋伴随的轨道角动量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在手性Te晶体中观测到了无自旋极化的纯轨道角动量（OAM）态，证明晶体中可存在仅由原子间跃迁贡献、无自旋伴随的轨道角动量。；创新点：首次在晶体固体中实验证实了无自旋极化的轨道角动量态，并揭示了原子间跃迁（而非原子内贡献）是产生这种纯轨道角动量的关键机制，为设计无自旋轨道电流提供了通用框架。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）解析孤立s轨道能带；圆二色性ARPES结合第一性原理计算分析OAM来源；自旋分辨ARPES确认无自旋角动量（SAM）。

papers.title: Magnetism of single crystalline breathing pyrochlore spinel AgInCr4S8
papers.abstract: Single crystals of \ce{AgInCr4S8} were grown by chemical vapor transport and crystallographic ordering of Ag/In that results in a breathing pyrochlore motif of Cr$^{3+}$ was verified by x-ray and neutron diffraction. Long-range antiferromagnetic order is observed below a Néel temperature of $T_{\mathrm N}$ $\approx$ 9.6 K. The magnetic properties are characterized using ac and dc magnetization, specific heat capacity, and single crystal neutron diffraction measurements. The specific heat data are characterized by a small lambda anomaly near 9.5 K and the estimated magnetic entropy reaches $\approx$ $\frac{1}{3}$ of the expected value by 3$T_{\mathrm N}$, suggesting significant short-range order in the paramagnetic phase. Single crystal neutron diffraction evidences an incommensurate spin structure with propagation vector $\textbf{\textit{k}}$ = (0,0,$δ$) and $δ$ = 0.343 at 5 K. The minimal model that accounts for the data consists of ferromagnetic layers of Cr atoms, with magnetic moments lying in the plane of the layers and modulating in the perpendicular direction to form a helical structure propagating along $\textbf{\textit{k}}$. This study represents a rare investigation of single crystals within the family of breathing pyrochlore materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及单晶生长、X射线/中子衍射、磁化率、比热、单晶中子衍射等实验手段。；研究对象：呼吸型焦绿石硫尖晶石单晶 AgInCr4S8 中 Cr³⁺ 离子的磁性行为，包括其长程反铁磁序、短程有序以及非公度螺旋磁结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AgInCr4S8 在奈尔温度 TN ≈ 9.6 K 以下呈现长程反铁磁有序，其磁结构为一种非公度螺旋结构（传播矢量 k = (0,0,δ)，δ = 0.343），且顺磁相中存在显著的短程有序，磁熵仅恢复约1/3。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AgInCr4S8 在奈尔温度 TN ≈ 9.6 K 以下呈现长程反铁磁有序，其磁结构为一种非公度螺旋结构（传播矢量 k = (0,0,δ)，δ = 0.343），且顺磁相中存在显著的短程有序，磁熵仅恢复约1/3。；创新点：这是对呼吸型焦绿石材料家族中单晶样品的罕见研究，首次通过单晶中子衍射直接确定了该体系中 Cr³⁺ 的非公度螺旋磁结构。
papers.method_zh: 化学气相输运法生长单晶；X射线与中子衍射验证Ag/In有序排列及呼吸型焦绿石结构；交流/直流磁化率测量、比热测量、单晶中子衍射确定磁结构与相变特征。

papers.title: Spin Peltier effect in graphene
papers.abstract: In this work, we theoretically investigate the spin-Peltier effect in a heterostructure composed of graphene and a ferromagnetic insulator (FI). Using a microscopic formalism based on the characteristic spin-flip scattering length at the graphene/FI interface, we analyze how spin accumulation in graphene gives rise to a temperature difference across the junction. We show that, in the presence of an external magnetic field, the electronic spectrum of graphene is quantized into Landau levels, which strongly modifies the available spin-flip scattering channels. In particular, crossings between Landau levels significantly enhance the spin-flip scattering amplitude, leading to a pronounced amplification of the spin-Peltier response. Our results suggest that measurements of the spin-induced temperature difference in graphene-FI heterostructures can serve as a sensitive probe of discrete electronic energy levels. More broadly, this work provides a theoretical framework for understanding spin-driven thermal effects in hybrid systems combining Dirac materials and magnetic insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“microscopic formalism”、“analyze”、“suggest”。；研究对象：石墨烯/铁磁绝缘体（FI）异质结中的自旋佩尔捷效应（spin-Peltier effect）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在外部磁场下，石墨烯的电子能谱量子化为朗道能级，朗道能级间的交叉会显著增强自旋翻转散射振幅，从而大幅放大自旋佩尔捷响应。该效应可作为探测离散电子能级的灵敏探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在外部磁场下，石墨烯的电子能谱量子化为朗道能级，朗道能级间的交叉会显著增强自旋翻转散射振幅，从而大幅放大自旋佩尔捷响应。该效应可作为探测离散电子能级的灵敏探针。；创新点：首次从理论上研究了狄拉克材料（石墨烯）与磁性绝缘体构成的异质结中的自旋佩尔捷效应，并揭示了朗道能级量子化及其交叉对该效应的显著调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于石墨烯/FI界面特征自旋翻转散射长度的微观理论形式（microscopic formalism），分析了自旋积累如何导致结两侧的温差。

papers.title: Efficient purely organic phosphorescent emitters for programmable luminescent tags: from building blocks to donor-acceptor-donor structures
papers.abstract: Purely organic room-temperature phosphorescence (RTP) emitters are key components of programmable luminescent tags (PLTs), photonic devices for rewritable information storage and UV dosimetry. In this work, we systematically explore the design space of donor-acceptor and donor-acceptor-donor organic phosphorescent emitters in symmetric and asymmetric architectures. Phenoxathiine (PX) is introduced as an alternative donor to thianthrene (TA), combined with benzophenone (BP) or pyridine (Py) as acceptors. Through photophysical characterization, quantum chemical simulations, and PLT device testing, we identify structure-property relationships and, in particular, investigate the impact of the individual moieties on the emission properties and stability. The RTP emission wavelength is primarily tunable through the donor moiety: PX-based emitters emit sky-blue (λ_P = 480 nm), while TA-based emitters emit in the green (λ_P = 520 nm) due to an increased Stokes shift. The acceptor unit strongly influences the phosphorescence quantum yield, with Py-based emitters systematically outperforming BP-based ones. All newly synthesized PX-containing emitters show sufficient performance in PLT devices, though with reduced photostability compared to TA-based counterparts. Together, these results demonstrate that systematic donor-acceptor design enables predictable control over RTP emission properties, advancing the rational development of high-performance RTP-based photonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：关键词包括“photophysical characterization”、“PLT device testing”、“quantum chemical simulations”。；研究对象：纯有机室温磷光（RTP）发射体，具体为基于供体-受体（D-A）和供体-受体-供体（D-A-D）结构的有机分子，用于可编程发光标签（PLT）中的信息存储和紫外剂量测定。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统调控供体单元（phenoxathiine vs. thianthrene）和受体单元（benzophenone vs. pyridine），可以实现对RTP发射波长和磷光量子产率的可预测控制：PX基发射体发射天蓝光（480 nm），TA基发射体发射绿光（520 nm）；吡啶受体基发射体的磷光量子产率优于二苯甲酮受体基发射体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统调控供体单元（phenoxathiine vs. thianthrene）和受体单元（benzophenone vs. pyridine），可以实现对RTP发射波长和磷光量子产率的可预测控制：PX基发射体发射天蓝光（480 nm），TA基发射体发射绿光（520 nm）；吡啶受体基发射体的磷光量子产率优于二苯甲酮受体基发射体。；创新点：首次将phenoxathiine（PX）作为thianthrene（TA）的替代供体引入纯有机RTP体系，并系统比较了供体/受体单元对发射波长、量子产率和光稳定性的独立影响，建立了从分子砌块到器件性能的明确设计规则。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：合成不同对称/不对称结构的D-A和D-A-D分子，进行光物理表征（包括发射波长、量子产率等），并组装PLT器件进行性能测试。理论上：采用量子化学模拟辅助分析结构-性质关系。

papers.title: Microscopic Nonaffine Deformation Theory of LAOS in Polymers
papers.abstract: We develop a molecularly motivated framework connecting large-amplitude oscillatory shear (LAOS) nonlinearities in entangled polymers to frequency-dependent nonaffine relaxation in disordered solids. The central idea is that the first harmonic in LAOS measures the residual phase-locked elastic response, whereas the higher harmonics encode the Fourier signature of strain-dependent nonaffine relaxation. The finite-amplitude modulus is interpreted as a local tangent stiffness of the evolving microstructure, in the spirit of elastoplastic and incremental nonaffine models. For entangled polymers, the analogue of the decreasing coordination number in cage-breaking theories of glass mechanics is identified not with the tube-orientation tensor itself, but with the fraction of surviving tube constraints. This distinction leads naturally to a crossover description controlled by a characteristic strain amplitude $γ_c$, rather than by universal fixed power-law exponents. The fitted value $N_{\max}\simeq1.72$ indicates that the present experimental data approach a strong but not fully saturated nonlinear state, remaining below the ideal limiting value predicted for complete constraint collapse. Finally, a constraint-counting argument combining an eight-chain affine network representation with the central-force nonaffine isostatic threshold gives a limiting estimate $|\mathrm{NLI}|_{\max}=3$. The results support the interpretation of the NLI as a Fourier-resolved dynamic nonaffinity parameter and establish a bridge between tube-based polymer dynamics, LAOS harmonic analysis, elastoplastic rheology, and microscopic nonaffine lattice dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：molecularly motivated framework、theoretical framework、constraint-counting argument。；研究对象：缠结高分子（entangled polymers）在大振幅振荡剪切（LAOS）下的非线性流变行为，以及与之相关的无序固体中的非仿射松弛（nonaffine relaxation）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LAOS中的一次谐波测量残余的锁相弹性响应，而高次谐波编码了应变依赖的非仿射松弛的傅里叶特征；缠结高分子中管约束的存活分数（而非管取向张量本身）是控制非线性响应的关键微观量，导致由特征应变幅度γ_c描述的交叉行为，而非普适的幂律指数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LAOS中的一次谐波测量残余的锁相弹性响应，而高次谐波编码了应变依赖的非仿射松弛的傅里叶特征；缠结高分子中管约束的存活分数（而非管取向张量本身）是控制非线性响应的关键微观量，导致由特征应变幅度γ_c描述的交叉行为，而非普适的幂律指数。；创新点：首次将LAOS谐波分析中的非线性强度指数（NLI）解释为傅里叶分辨的动态非仿射参数，并建立了基于管的高分子动力学、LAOS谐波分析、弹塑性流变学与微观非仿射晶格动力学之间的桥梁。摘要未突出说明与已有具体实验或理论模型的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个分子层面的理论框架，将缠结高分子的LAOS非线性与频率依赖的非仿射松弛联系起来；采用弹塑性模型和增量非仿射模型的思想，将有限振幅模量解释为微观结构演化的局部切线刚度；通过约束计数论证，结合八链仿射网络表示与中心力非仿射等静阈值，给出了非线性强度指数（NLI）的极限估计。

papers.title: Properties of the skyrmion crystal SkX-2 in the Heisenberg triangular lattice with scalar chirality
papers.abstract: Skyrmion crystals have been primarily discovered under a magnetic field for materials with non-centrosymmetric interactions. More recent developments have investigated the stability of skyrmion crystals in itinerant magnets without magnetic field. In this study, we find that a type of skyrmion crystal with two topological charges per unit cell and no magnetization at the ferromagnetic point in reciprocal space, SkX-2, is naturally stabilized in an $SO(3)$-symmetric model with short-range interactions realized by the Heisenberg model on the triangular lattice with scalar chirality. We complement our numerical results with a theoretical analysis that quantitatively describes the transition from the ferromagnetic ground state to the SkX-2 and the evolution of the topological charge density. Despite the constraints given by the Mermin-Wagner theorem at finite temperature, the SkX-2 exhibits both a first-order phase transition associated with translation symmetry breaking and a continuous transition to a floating solid, depending on the charge density controlled by the model parameters. Finally, the tetrahedral phase supported by an antiferromagnetic interaction in our model is found to host $\mathbb{Z}_2$-vortices at finite temperature, suggesting the existence of an additional vortex topological transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论分析、数值结果、模型研究。；研究对象：三角晶格海森堡模型中标量手性驱动的斯格明子晶体SkX-2的物性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无外加磁场、具有短程相互作用的SO(3)对称模型中，一种每个原胞携带两个拓扑电荷、倒空间铁磁点处无磁化的斯格明子晶体SkX-2可自然稳定存在；该体系在有限温度下同时存在平移对称性破缺的一级相变和向浮动固体的连续相变，且反铁磁相互作用支持的四极相中存在Z₂涡旋。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无外加磁场、具有短程相互作用的SO(3)对称模型中，一种每个原胞携带两个拓扑电荷、倒空间铁磁点处无磁化的斯格明子晶体SkX-2可自然稳定存在；该体系在有限温度下同时存在平移对称性破缺的一级相变和向浮动固体的连续相变，且反铁磁相互作用支持的四极相中存在Z₂涡旋。；创新点：首次在无磁场、仅含短程相互作用的SO(3)对称模型中实现SkX-2的稳定存在，并揭示了其有限温度下由电荷密度调控的多种相变行为（包括一级相变和连续相变），以及反铁磁相互作用下Z₂涡旋拓扑相的存在。
papers.method_zh: 基于三角晶格上海森堡模型与标量手性项的数值计算，并结合理论分析定量描述从铁磁基态到SkX-2的相变过程及拓扑电荷密度的演化。

papers.title: Attached Split Ring Resonator Cavity for Magnon Photon Coupling
papers.abstract: We present a chip scale planar cavity platform based on an attached split ring resonator (ASRR) integrated with yttrium iron garnet (YIG) structures to achieve strong magnon photon coupling in a compact hybrid system. The ASRR geometry was numerically optimized by tuning inter ring spacing, gap width, substrate thickness, and permittivity, resulting in a quality factor of Q = 190 at 5.48 GHz, enabling strong microwave magnetic field confinement and reduced radiative losses. The optimized cavity was coupled to YIG elements of three geometries: full ring, half ring, and disk. Full electromagnetic simulations show that the full ring geometry exhibits balanced performance with coupling strength 115 MHz and cooperativity 13.10, while the half ring shows a comparable coupling strength of 108 MHz and slightly higher cooperativity 13.50, despite edge induced demagnetizing effects. In contrast, the disk geometry couples at lower bias magnetic fields and achieves the strongest interaction (135 MHz, 25.30), enabled by improved microwave magnetic field overlap. These results demonstrate that geometry, rather than magnetic volume alone, is a key design parameter for tailoring magnon photon coupling, providing a practical framework for lithography compatible, on chip hybrid magnonic and quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：numerically optimized, full electromagnetic simulations）；研究对象：基于附着开口环谐振器（ASRR）与钇铁石榴石（YIG）结构集成的紧凑型杂化系统，具体研究磁子-光子强耦合现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: YIG的几何形状（而非仅磁体积）是调控磁子-光子耦合强度的关键设计参数；圆盘几何结构在较低偏置磁场下实现了最强的耦合（135 MHz，协同性25.30）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：YIG的几何形状（而非仅磁体积）是调控磁子-光子耦合强度的关键设计参数；圆盘几何结构在较低偏置磁场下实现了最强的耦合（135 MHz，协同性25.30）。；创新点：提出了一种芯片级、与光刻兼容的平面腔平台（ASRR），并系统揭示了YIG几何形状对耦合性能的独立调控作用，为片上杂化磁子-量子器件提供了实用框架。
papers.method_zh: 数值优化（通过调节环间距、间隙宽度、衬底厚度和介电常数优化ASRR几何结构），全电磁仿真（模拟ASRR腔与三种YIG几何结构——全环、半环、圆盘的耦合）。

papers.title: Thermodynamic and structural behavior of one-dimensional divalent patchy hard rods: Wertheim's first-order thermodynamic perturbation theory versus exact results
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic and structural properties of divalent patchy hard rods confined to a one-dimensional channel by modeling the bonding sites as attractive square-well (SW) patches located at the rod tips. The zero-range sticky limit is recovered by letting the well width vanish while keeping the stickiness parameter finite. While Wertheim's first-order thermodynamic perturbation theory (TPT1) becomes exact in this sticky limit, it fails for finite-range site-site interactions. We show that the theory can be made exact in one dimension by replacing the standard law of mass action with an exact relation between the density and the fraction of unbonded sites, together with an exact bonding free-energy contribution. Finite-range SW sites produce a richer structural behavior than sticky sites, including monotonic and oscillatory asymptotic decay of the pair correlation function, separated by the Fisher--Widom line. In the monotonic regime, the correlation length exhibits an absolute maximum defining the Widom line, while in the oscillatory regime it may display a local maximum and minimum, whose locus defines the ``Extrema of the Correlation length under Oscillatory decay'' (ECO) line. These features disappear in the sticky limit, where the system remains entirely in the oscillatory regime. We also show that the high-pressure behavior of the correlation length changes from $ξ\sim p^2$ for finite-range SW sites to $ξ\sim p^3$ in the sticky limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Wertheim's first-order thermodynamic perturbation theory (TPT1)、exact results、理论分析。；研究对象：一维通道中受限的二价斑块硬棒体系，其键合位点位于棒端，为吸引性方阱（square-well, SW）斑块。研究其热力学与结构性质，包括有限程SW位点与零程粘性极限（sticky limit）下的行为差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Wertheim的一阶热力学微扰理论（TPT1）在零程粘性极限下是精确的，但对有限程位点-位点相互作用失效。通过用精确的密度与未键合位点分数关系替代标准质量作用定律，并引入精确的键合自由能贡献，可使该理论在一维中变得精确。有限程SW位点产生比粘性位点更丰富的结构行为，包括对关联函数的单调与振荡衰减（由Fisher-Widom线分隔），以及相关长度的极大值（Widom线）和极值线（ECO线）。在高压下，相关长度的标度行为从有限程SW位点的ξ~p²变为粘性极限下的ξ~p³。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Wertheim的一阶热力学微扰理论（TPT1）在零程粘性极限下是精确的，但对有限程位点-位点相互作用失效。通过用精确的密度与未键合位点分数关系替代标准质量作用定律，并引入精确的键合自由能贡献，可使该理论在一维中变得精确。有限程SW位点产生比粘性位点更丰富的结构行为，包括对关联函数的单调与振荡衰减（由Fisher-Widom线分隔），以及相关长度的极大值（Widom线）和极值线（ECO线）。在高压下，相关长度的标度行为从有限程SW位点的ξ~p²变为粘性极限下的ξ~p³。；创新点：揭示了TPT1在一维有限程斑块体系中失效的本质，并提出了使其精确化的修正方案。首次系统比较了有限程SW位点与零程粘性极限下结构行为的差异，包括Fisher-Widom线、Widom线、ECO线以及相关长度的高压标度律。
papers.method_zh: 采用Wertheim的一阶热力学微扰理论（TPT1）进行理论计算，并与精确结果进行对比。通过让方阱宽度趋于零同时保持粘性参数有限，恢复零程粘性极限。利用精确的密度-未键合位点分数关系修正TPT1，并分析对关联函数的渐近衰减行为。

papers.title: Competing anisotropies and phase transitions in the $q$-state clock model with a $p$-fold crystalline field
papers.abstract: We study the two-dimensional $q$-state clock model in the presence of an additional $p$-fold symmetry-breaking crystalline field using Monte Carlo simulations. While the pure clock model exhibits Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) transitions for sufficiently large $q$, the effect of competing discrete anisotropies on this topological phase remains nontrivial. We show that even weak crystalline fields qualitatively modify the phase diagram by suppressing the BKT phase and inducing transitions to states with true long-range order. The resulting behavior depends sensitively on the interplay between the intrinsic $\mathbb{Z}_q$ symmetry and the imposed $\mathbb{Z}_p$ anisotropy. In particular, in the six-state clock model for $p=2$ we observe qualitatively different scenarios depending on the sign of the field: a single transition for $h_2>0$ and a two-step ordering process for $h_2<0$ with an intermediate ordered phase. For $p=3$, the system exhibits a direct transition consistent with three-state Potts criticality. These results demonstrate that the phase structure cannot be inferred from symmetry considerations alone, but is governed by the competition between distinct locking mechanisms. Our findings provide a discrete counterpart to the multi-frequency sine-Gordon description of generalized $XY$ models and illustrate how additional anisotropies reshape topological phase transitions in two dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Monte Carlo simulations（蒙特卡洛模拟）、phase diagram（相图）、symmetry-breaking（对称性破缺）。；研究对象：二维q态时钟模型（q-state clock model）在额外p重对称性破缺晶场（p-fold crystalline field）下的相变行为，特别是竞争性离散各向异性对拓扑相变的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使微弱的晶场也会通过抑制BKT相并诱导出具有真正长程序的状态，从而定性改变相图；相结构由不同锁定机制之间的竞争决定，不能仅从对称性推断。例如，六态时钟模型在p=2时，场符号不同会导致单步或两步有序过程；p=3时则出现与三态Potts临界性一致的直接相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使微弱的晶场也会通过抑制BKT相并诱导出具有真正长程序的状态，从而定性改变相图；相结构由不同锁定机制之间的竞争决定，不能仅从对称性推断。例如，六态时钟模型在p=2时，场符号不同会导致单步或两步有序过程；p=3时则出现与三态Potts临界性一致的直接相变。；创新点：揭示了离散各向异性竞争（内禀Z_q对称性与外加Z_p各向异性）如何重塑二维拓扑相变，为广义XY模型的多频正弦-戈登描述提供了离散对应物。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulations）对二维q态时钟模型进行数值研究，系统考察了不同p重晶场强度下的相变行为。

papers.title: Multiferroic Properties of Electrospun CFO-BCTSn Nanocomposites for Magnetoelectric and Magnetic Field Sensing Applications
papers.abstract: Multiferroic CFO-BCTSn composite nanofibers were synthesized using a sol-gel electrospinning method. Electron microscopy revealed well-defined fibers with diameters of 120-150 nm. Structural analyses using X-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy confirmed the coexistence of the spinel CFO phase and the perovskite BCTSn phase without detectable secondary phases. Magnetic hysteresis measurements demonstrated the magnetic behavior of the nanofibers, while piezoresponse force microscopy confirmed their piezoelectric properties. Magnetoelectric coupling was evidenced by differences between the magnetic hysteresis loops of electrically poled and unpoled samples. These lead-free composite nanofibers show potential for nanoscale magnetoelectric devices and magnetic field sensing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了材料合成（sol-gel electrospinning）、结构表征（XRD、Raman、HRTEM）和性能测试（磁滞回线、压电力显微镜）等实验手段。；研究对象：多铁性CFO-BCTSn复合纳米纤维。具体为钴铁氧体（CFO，磁致伸缩相）与钛酸钡钙锡（BCTSn，压电相）组成的无铅复合纳米纤维。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功合成了直径120-150 nm的CFO-BCTSn复合纳米纤维，证实了尖晶石CFO相与钙钛矿BCTSn相共存且无杂相，并观察到电学极化后磁滞回线的变化，表明存在磁电耦合效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功合成了直径120-150 nm的CFO-BCTSn复合纳米纤维，证实了尖晶石CFO相与钙钛矿BCTSn相共存且无杂相，并观察到电学极化后磁滞回线的变化，表明存在磁电耦合效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：采用无铅压电相BCTSn替代传统含铅压电材料（如PZT），与磁致伸缩相CFO复合，通过静电纺丝制备一维纳米纤维结构，并验证了其多铁性与磁电耦合效应。
papers.method_zh: 溶胶-凝胶静电纺丝法合成；扫描/透射电子显微镜（SEM/TEM）观察形貌；X射线衍射（XRD）、拉曼光谱（Raman）、高分辨透射电镜（HRTEM）分析晶体结构；磁滞回线测量表征磁性；压电力显微镜（PFM）表征压电性；通过对比极化与未极化样品的磁滞回线差异来证明磁电耦合。

papers.title: Hubbard-$U$-corrected electron-phonon interactions in strongly correlated materials via the finite-displacement method
papers.abstract: Although the density functional theory plus Hubbard $U$ correction method (DFT+U) is broadly used to study electronic structure of strongly correlated materials, the extension of this method to electron-phonon $g$ matrices has received limited attention. Here, we implement an algorithm that integrates DFT+U method with the finite-displacement method for the calculations of phonons and electron-phonon $g$ matrices. The Hubbard $U$ corrections are applied not only to electronic and phonon structures, but, more importantly, also to electron-phonon $g$ matrices. We demonstrate our algorithm in two prototypical correlated materials: infinite-layer nickelates LaNiO$_2$ and ruthenium dioxide RuO$_2$. We find that: i) While the Hubbard $U$ corrections weakly increase the electron-phonon interaction of 20% hole-doped LaNiO$_2$, its total electron-phonon coupling remains small and is insufficient to account for the observed superconducting transition temperature of about 10-30 K. Our results contrast with the recent work showing that the full GW corrections yield an elevated electron-phonon coupling of 20% hole-doped LaNiO$_2$ five times larger than its DFT value. We attribute this discrepancy to the differences in the Fermi surface topology between DFT+$U$ and GW methods. ii) The inclusion of Hubbard $U$ corrections eliminates the imaginary phonon modes of RuO$_2$ under strain on the TiO$_2$ substrate and substantially reduces the electron-phonon coupling. Our results alleviate the discrepancy between the reported large theoretical electron-phonon coupling and the low superconducting transition temperature observed experimentally. Our work provides an algorithm that fully includes the Hubbard $U$ corrections on electron-phonon properties of correlated materials, and highlights the importance of Fermi surface shape and correlation effects on phonon spectrum and electron-phonon $g$ matrices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：DFT+U、finite-displacement method、算法实现、计算演示。；研究对象：强关联材料中的电子-声子相互作用，具体体系为无限层镍酸盐 LaNiO₂ 和二氧化钌 RuO₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Hubbard U 修正对 LaNiO₂ 的电子-声子耦合增强有限，不足以解释其约10-30 K的超导转变温度；对 RuO₂ 则消除了应变下的虚声子模并显著降低电子-声子耦合，缓解了理论计算与实验观测超导温度之间的分歧。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Hubbard U 修正对 LaNiO₂ 的电子-声子耦合增强有限，不足以解释其约10-30 K的超导转变温度；对 RuO₂ 则消除了应变下的虚声子模并显著降低电子-声子耦合，缓解了理论计算与实验观测超导温度之间的分歧。；创新点：首次将 DFT+U 修正完整地纳入电子-声子 g 矩阵的有限位移法计算中，而不仅限于电子结构和声子结构，并揭示了费米面拓扑和关联效应对电子-声子耦合的关键影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用 DFT+U 方法与有限位移法相结合的算法，同时计算声子谱和电子-声子耦合矩阵 g，并将 Hubbard U 修正一致地应用于电子结构、声子结构以及电子-声子 g 矩阵。

papers.title: In-Plane Ferromagnetism and Critical Dynamics in Alkali-Deficient K$_{1-x}$CrTe$_2$ (with $x \approx$ 0.3) Single Crystals
papers.abstract: Layered chromium tellurides are model systems for studying low-dimensional magnetism in van der Waals materials. We report the synthesis and characterization of K$_{1-x}$CrTe$_2$ single crystals ($x \approx 0.3$), which crystallize in the $Cm$ space group with trigonal prismatic K$^+$ coordination, unlike the octahedral environments of more stoichiometric ACrX$_2$ compounds. Magnetization measurements show a sharp ferromagnetic transition at $T_{\rm C}=117$ K and in-plane magnetic anisotropy, supported by density functional theory. Neutron diffraction reveals ferromagnetic alignment of Cr spins within and between layers. This contrasts with the out-of-plane A-type antiferromagnetism in LiCrTe$_2$ and NaCrTe$_2$, but resembles CrTe$_2$. These differences likely arise from changes in interlayer spacing, Cr oxidation state, or stacking. AC susceptibility and $μ$SR indicate short-range order above $T_{\rm C}$ and dynamic behavior below. Overall, K$_{1-x}$CrTe$_2$ provides a tunable platform for studying spin orientation and dimensionality in two-dimensional magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：synthesis, characterization, magnetization measurements, neutron diffraction, AC susceptibility, μSR）；研究对象：碱金属缺位的层状铬碲化物单晶 K₁₋ₓCrTe₂（x ≈ 0.3），具体研究其晶体结构、面内铁磁有序及临界动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: K₁₋ₓCrTe₂ 在 T_C = 117 K 处发生尖锐的铁磁相变，且磁各向异性为面内取向，与 LiCrTe₂ 和 NaCrTe₂ 的层间反铁磁序不同，而与 CrTe₂ 类似；在 T_C 以上存在短程有序，以下存在动态行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：K₁₋ₓCrTe₂ 在 T_C = 117 K 处发生尖锐的铁磁相变，且磁各向异性为面内取向，与 LiCrTe₂ 和 NaCrTe₂ 的层间反铁磁序不同，而与 CrTe₂ 类似；在 T_C 以上存在短程有序，以下存在动态行为。；创新点：首次报道了具有三角棱柱配位环境的 K₁₋ₓCrTe₂ 单晶，揭示了其面内铁磁序与层间距、Cr 氧化态或堆垛方式的关系，为二维磁体中自旋取向和维度调控提供了可调平台。
papers.method_zh: 单晶合成与结构表征（X射线衍射确定 Cm 空间群）、磁化强度测量、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、中子衍射、交流磁化率（AC susceptibility）以及 μSR（μ子自旋弛豫）实验。

papers.title: Multiple Superconducting Phases in Palladium Deuteride Induced by Nuclear-Spin Isotope Effect
papers.abstract: We study the superconducting properties of high-quality PdD$_{x}$ films. The resistivity shows a sharp drop at $T$ $\sim$1.7 K, marking the superconducting transition. However, a finite resistivity persists and vanishes at $\sim$0.6 K. The temperature and magnetic-field dependences of the resistivity exhibit multiple anomalies within the superconducting state, revealing distinct superconducting phases. Such anomalies are absent in PdH$_{x}$ films. These results demonstrate a clear qualitative difference between the superconducting phase diagrams of PdD$_{x}$ and PdH$_{x}$, highlighting the role of nuclear-spin isotope effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：resistivity shows、temperature and magnetic-field dependences、superconducting phase diagrams。；研究对象：高质量PdDₓ薄膜的超导性质，以及核自旋同位素效应（对比PdHₓ）对超导相图的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PdDₓ薄膜在超导态中表现出多个异常电阻行为，揭示存在多个不同的超导相；而PdHₓ薄膜中未观察到这些异常，表明核自旋同位素效应导致了PdDₓ与PdHₓ超导相图的定性差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PdDₓ薄膜在超导态中表现出多个异常电阻行为，揭示存在多个不同的超导相；而PdHₓ薄膜中未观察到这些异常，表明核自旋同位素效应导致了PdDₓ与PdHₓ超导相图的定性差异。；创新点：首次在PdDₓ中观察到由核自旋同位素效应诱导的多个超导相，并与PdHₓ进行对比，突出了同位素效应对超导相图的关键影响。
papers.method_zh: 电阻率测量（温度依赖和磁场依赖），通过分析电阻随温度和磁场的变化来探测超导态内的多相结构。

papers.title: Origin of Persistent Boundary Motion in Confined Active Matter
papers.abstract: Active matter systems under confinement display persistent surface motion and a strong boundary affinity. However, despite extensive studies of their positional dynamics, much less attention has been given to the corresponding orientational behavior. Here, using molecular simulations of an active Brownian particle confined within a hard circular boundary and the Fokker-Planck equation, we show that the positional distribution of the particle is directly coupled to orientational fluctuations, as characterized by the conditional orientational distribution. Confinement generates two preferred tangential orientational states connected by stochastic flipping pathways: rapid boundary-localized switching and slower bulk-mediated excursions. Further, the positional distribution exhibits a nontrivial power-law decay with distance from the boundary that is closely linked to curvature-induced bistable orientational states and the variance of the associated conditional distribution. The mean waiting time between flips exhibits power-law dependence on the confinement strength. Our results establish that the interplay between orientational fluctuations, bistability, positional accumulation, and stochastic switching governs the observed dynamics of active particles under confinement, providing a framework for understanding transport, exploration, and escape processes in confined active systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：使用分子模拟（molecular simulations）和福克-普朗克方程（Fokker-Planck equation）进行分析。；研究对象：受限活性物质（confined active matter），具体为硬圆形边界内单个活性布朗粒子（active Brownian particle）的边界持续运动（persistent boundary motion）及其取向行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 受限活性粒子的位置分布与取向涨落直接耦合，边界曲率诱导出双稳态取向态（两个切向偏好取向），粒子通过快速边界局域翻转和缓慢体相介导的路径在这两个态之间随机切换，导致位置分布呈现非平凡的幂律衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：受限活性粒子的位置分布与取向涨落直接耦合，边界曲率诱导出双稳态取向态（两个切向偏好取向），粒子通过快速边界局域翻转和缓慢体相介导的路径在这两个态之间随机切换，导致位置分布呈现非平凡的幂律衰减。；创新点：首次系统研究了受限活性物质中取向行为（而非仅位置动力学），揭示了取向涨落、双稳态、位置累积与随机切换之间的耦合机制，并建立了等待时间与受限强度的幂律关系。
papers.method_zh: 活性布朗粒子的分子模拟（molecular simulations of active Brownian particle）结合福克-普朗克方程（Fokker-Planck equation）理论分析。

papers.title: High-performance linear-scaling electronic structure method via chromatic superposition states
papers.abstract: We introduce a high-performance linear-scaling electronic structure method that employs chromatic superposition states (CSS) as a low-dimensional, high-fidelity representation, which can be orders of magnitude smaller than the full Hilbert space. Grounded in the system's finite correlation length, the CSS representation aggregates the uncorrelated orbitals into a single basis via a graph-coloring scheme, and is independent of the system size yet accurately preserves all sparse operators in solving the Kohn-Sham equations. The projection onto CSSs is efficiently computed by employing the block-Lanczos Krylov method which features high hardware efficiency and linear-scaling cost, enabling fast calculation of large-scale Kohn-Sham density matrix. We show that this method already outperforms previous linear-scaling density matrix purification method by more than one order of magnitude in computational speed at even small scale, while preserving high accuracy. The practical utility of the CSS method is demonstrated through molecular dynamics simulation of a 10000 $H_2O$, and self-consistent calculation of a 1-million $H_2O$ with modest resources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：linear-scaling electronic structure method、Kohn-Sham equations、block-Lanczos Krylov method。；研究对象：论文研究的是大规模电子结构计算中的线性标度方法，具体应用于水分子体系（H₂O）的分子动力学模拟和自洽计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于色叠加态（CSS）的高性能线性标度电子结构方法，该方法在保持高精度的同时，计算速度比传统线性标度密度矩阵纯化方法快一个数量级以上，并能以适中资源完成百万原子级水分子体系的自洽计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于色叠加态（CSS）的高性能线性标度电子结构方法，该方法在保持高精度的同时，计算速度比传统线性标度密度矩阵纯化方法快一个数量级以上，并能以适中资源完成百万原子级水分子体系的自洽计算。；创新点：CSS表示基于系统有限关联长度，其维度远小于完整希尔伯特空间且与系统尺寸无关，同时精确保留所有稀疏算符，从而在极小规模下即显著超越现有线性标度方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用了色叠加态（CSS）作为低维高保真表示，结合图着色方案将非关联轨道聚合为单一基组；通过块Lanczos Krylov方法高效计算CSS投影，实现线性标度求解Kohn-Sham密度矩阵。

papers.title: Topological phononics
papers.abstract: Topological phononics extends the foundational concepts of topological condensed matter physics to the realm of lattice vibrations and classical mechanical waves, unlocking robust, defect-immune states and phenomena beyond the reach of conventional phononic engineering. This review provides a unified, systematic framework for understanding topological phonons across natural and artificial systems, spanning solid-state materials, acoustic/mechanical metamaterials, and non-Hermitian platforms. We cover the core theoretical principles -- from Berry curvature and symmetry-protected topological invariants to bulk-boundary correspondence -- alongside experimental advances in probing topological phonon states via inelastic scattering and momentum-resolved techniques for solid-state phonons as well as pump-probe measurements in acoustic/mechanical metamaterials. Key topics include Weyl/Dirac/nodal-line phonons in crystalline solids, symmetry-engineered topological phases in metamaterials, non-Hermitian effects (exceptional points, skin effect), and emergent directions such as Floquet engineering, synthetic dimensions, and real-space topological textures (skyrmions, merons). We also highlight technological applications in robust waveguides, on-chip surface-acoustic-wave devices, and acoustofluidics, while outlining future challenges and opportunities in quantum phononics, nonlinear topological phenomena, and interdisciplinary integration with photonics and electronics. This review serves as a comprehensive guide across physics, materials science, and engineering, bridging fundamental theory with cutting-edge experiments and innovations in topological phononics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（综述）。判断依据：关键词“review”、“theoretical principles”、“systematic framework”。；研究对象：拓扑声子学，涵盖固体材料、声学/力学超材料和非厄米平台中的拓扑声子态，包括Weyl/Dirac/ nodal-line声子、对称性工程拓扑相、非厄米效应（奇异点、趋肤效应）以及Floquet工程、合成维度、实空间拓扑纹理（斯格明子、meron）等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拓扑声子学将拓扑凝聚态物理的基本概念扩展到晶格振动和经典机械波领域，实现了超越传统声子工程的鲁棒、免疫缺陷的态和现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拓扑声子学将拓扑凝聚态物理的基本概念扩展到晶格振动和经典机械波领域，实现了超越传统声子工程的鲁棒、免疫缺陷的态和现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（该文为综述，旨在提供统一、系统的框架，覆盖自然与人工系统，并展望量子声子学、非线性拓扑现象等新兴方向）。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括贝里曲率、对称性保护的拓扑不变量、体-边界对应原理；实验进展涉及非弹性散射和动量分辨技术（用于固体声子）以及泵浦-探测测量（用于声学/力学超材料）。

papers.title: Transferable 3D Convolutional Neural Networks for Elastic Constants Prediction in Nanoporous Metals
papers.abstract: The topology of nanoporous metals is crucial for determining their mechanical response. In this work, we generated 6,000 gold and 422 silver nanoporous structures and calculated three components of elastic modulus with Molecular Dynamics simulations, resulting in 19,263 data points. This study compared two distinct approaches of predicting elastic modulus: a Fully-Connected neural network trained on precomputed topological descriptors, and several 3D Convolutional neural network architectures adapted from computer vision. The 3D CNNs outperformed the descriptor-based baseline model ($R^2 = 0.704$), with to-performing DenseNet-201 architecture achieving $R^2 = 0.955$. Additionally, the effects of training grid resolution, dataset size, and descriptor integration into a model were investigated. We further demonstrated model robustness through Transfer learning: a pretrained model was fine-tuned on a much smaller dataset of denser gold structures and the dataset of denser silver structures. Finally, the trained model was employed to evaluate the mechanical properties of 100,000 stochastic nanoporous gold structures and identify the Pareto optimal designs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Molecular Dynamics simulations（分子动力学模拟）、neural network（神经网络）、Transfer learning（迁移学习）。；研究对象：纳米多孔金属（Nanoporous metals），具体为金（gold）和银（silver）的纳米多孔结构。研究其弹性模量（elastic modulus）的预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于3D卷积神经网络（3D CNN）的模型在预测纳米多孔金属弹性模量方面，显著优于基于传统拓扑描述符的全连接神经网络模型（R²从0.704提升至0.955）。该模型具有良好的可迁移性，可通过迁移学习在小数据集上实现有效预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于3D卷积神经网络（3D CNN）的模型在预测纳米多孔金属弹性模量方面，显著优于基于传统拓扑描述符的全连接神经网络模型（R²从0.704提升至0.955）。该模型具有良好的可迁移性，可通过迁移学习在小数据集上实现有效预测。；创新点：将计算机视觉领域的3D卷积神经网络架构（如DenseNet）直接应用于纳米多孔金属的弹性常数预测，并证明了其相对于传统描述符方法的优越性。同时，展示了该模型通过迁移学习在小数据集上泛化的能力，并利用训练好的模型对十万个随机纳米多孔金结构进行了力学性能评估和帕累托最优设计识别。
papers.method_zh: 1. 使用分子动力学（MD）模拟生成6000个金和422个银的纳米多孔结构，并计算其弹性模量的三个分量，共获得19263个数据点。2. 对比了两种预测方法：一种是在预计算拓扑描述符上训练的全连接神经网络；另一种是多种从计算机视觉领域改编而来的3D卷积神经网络架构（其中表现最佳的是DenseNet-201）。3. 研究了训练网格分辨率、数据集大小以及将描述符集成到模型中的影响。4. 通过迁移学习验证模型鲁棒性：将预训练模型在更小的致密金结构和致密银结构数据集上进行微调。

papers.title: Monte Carlo simulation of selective adsorption in a binary hard-disk mixture on patterned adhesive surfaces
papers.abstract: Selective adsorption in a two-dimensional model of a binary hard-disk mixture on patterned adhesive surfaces is studied using grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations. The two species have equal diameters and equal bulk chemical potentials, but different attraction strengths to adhesive domains. Thus, affinity-driven selectivity is separated from particle-size asymmetry and unequal chemical potentials. The surface pattern is defined by domain size, domain surface coverage, and ordered or disordered arrangement of circular domains. The results show that selectivity depends strongly on surface geometry, especially at low and intermediate chemical potentials. Domains comparable to the particle size enhance selectivity by forming adsorption regions with large particle-domain overlap, whereas larger domains can provide high selectivity at low chemical potentials. For small domains, further reduction in size can also increase selectivity as the system approaches a uniform attractive surface with corresponding effective affinity parameters of the species.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Monte Carlo simulation”、“grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations”。；研究对象：二元硬圆盘混合物在图案化粘附表面上的选择性吸附现象。具体为：两种直径相等、体相化学势相等、但对粘附域吸引力强度不同的圆盘物种，在由圆形粘附域（具有不同尺寸、表面覆盖率和有序/无序排列）构成的图案化表面上的吸附行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 选择性强烈依赖于表面几何结构，尤其是在低和中等化学势下。当粘附域尺寸与粒子尺寸相当时，通过形成粒子-域大重叠的吸附区域可增强选择性；而较大的域在低化学势下也能提供高选择性；对于小域，进一步减小尺寸可提高选择性，使体系趋近于具有相应有效亲和力参数的均匀吸引表面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：选择性强烈依赖于表面几何结构，尤其是在低和中等化学势下。当粘附域尺寸与粒子尺寸相当时，通过形成粒子-域大重叠的吸附区域可增强选择性；而较大的域在低化学势下也能提供高选择性；对于小域，进一步减小尺寸可提高选择性，使体系趋近于具有相应有效亲和力参数的均匀吸引表面。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用巨正则蒙特卡洛模拟（grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations）对二维模型体系进行研究。

papers.title: The Topography Trap: Sifting Interlayer Excitons from Strain-Related Artifacts in Real-World 2D Hetrostructures
papers.abstract: Novel excitonic phenomena emerging in transition metal dichalcogenide (TMDC) heterostructures belong to the most exciting topics in contemporary physics of van der Waals materials. Interlayer excitons (IXs) stand out among those due to their long radiative lifetimes and tunability by electric fields, strain, and twist angle. However, many ambiguities persist in the optical identification and manipulation of IXs, highlighting the need for reliable spectroscopic criteria that distinguish interlayer species from spurious signals. Here, we present a decision-tree protocol that evaluates interlayer coupling via intralayer exciton quenching and correlates photoluminescence (PL) with atomic force microscopy (AFM) to correctly assign room-temperature PL features in TMDC-based heterostructures. Applying this protocol, we identify momentum-direct IX between the K valleys of the two layers (KK-IX) in MoS2-MoSe2 and MoS2-WSe2 heterostructures at room temperature. In contrast, our protocol contests the reported bright, momentum-indirect, twist-angle-independent $Γ$K-IX in MoS2-WSe2. Comprehensive experimental data, including infrared and tip-enhanced photoluminescence (TEPL) with sub-diffraction-limited resolution, show no compelling evidence for this excitonic species, despite numerous reports. Instead, the spectroscopic features previously assigned to this $Γ$K-IX originate from locally strained WSe2 at topographical inhomogeneities of the heterostructure interface, underscoring the need for robust, spatially resolved characterization of real-world samples in this highly accessible field and providing a generally applicable framework for identifying interlayer excitons in 2D semiconductor heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：photoluminescence (PL), atomic force microscopy (AFM), tip-enhanced photoluminescence (TEPL), experimental data。；研究对象：基于过渡金属硫族化合物（TMDC）的二维异质结构中的层间激子（interlayer excitons, IXs），具体材料体系为MoS₂-MoSe₂和MoS₂-WSe₂异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一套决策树协议，用于区分真实的层间激子与由样品表面形貌不均匀性引起的应变相关伪信号。该协议在MoS₂-MoSe₂和MoS₂-WSe₂异质结中确认了室温下的动量直接KK-IX，但否定了此前广泛报道的动量间接、与转角无关的ΓK-IX，证明其光谱特征实际上来源于异质结界面形貌不均匀处局部应变的WSe₂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一套决策树协议，用于区分真实的层间激子与由样品表面形貌不均匀性引起的应变相关伪信号。该协议在MoS₂-MoSe₂和MoS₂-WSe₂异质结中确认了室温下的动量直接KK-IX，但否定了此前广泛报道的动量间接、与转角无关的ΓK-IX，证明其光谱特征实际上来源于异质结界面形貌不均匀处局部应变的WSe₂。；创新点：提出了一个系统性的、基于决策树的实验协议，用于在真实（非理想）二维异质结样品中可靠地区分层间激子与应变相关的伪信号，并以此纠正了此前关于ΓK-IX的误判，强调了空间分辨表征在避免光谱误读中的必要性。
papers.method_zh: 结合了光致发光（PL）光谱、原子力显微镜（AFM）、红外光谱以及具有亚衍射极限分辨率的尖端增强光致发光（TEPL）技术。通过层内激子猝灭评估层间耦合，并将PL特征与AFM形貌进行空间关联分析。

papers.title: Unifying Plasticity in Ordered and Disordered Matter using Topological and Geometrical Descriptors
papers.abstract: Identifying the regions responsible for plastic flow in amorphous solids remains an open problem, since structural disorder seems to prevent the direct application of concepts such as dislocations, topological defects that successfully describe irreversible deformations in crystalline systems. Here, we introduce fields of dislocation, disclination, and incompatibility densities, that reduce to the standard sources of plasticity in crystals and assess their predictive power in amorphous materials. We find that, in a simulated two-dimensional glass as well in two- and three-dimensional experimental granular systems, these fields exhibit strong spatial correlations with $D^2_{\text{min}}$, the standard measure used to locate plastic events under shear in disordered solids. Unlike $D^2_{\text{min}}$, these fields also allow to disentangle rotational and translational contributions to the plastic events, revealing that rotational defects becoming dominant in three dimensions. Our approach paves the way for a unified description of plasticity in crystalline and amorphous solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：simulated two-dimensional glass、experimental granular systems、fields of dislocation/disclination/incompatibility densities。；研究对象：非晶态固体（amorphous solids）中的塑性流动（plastic flow），具体包括模拟的二维玻璃以及二维和三维实验颗粒体系（granular systems）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入位错、向错和不匹配密度场，这些场在非晶材料中与标准塑性事件定位量 \( D^2_{\text{min}} \) 存在强空间关联，且能区分塑性事件中的旋转与平移贡献，揭示三维体系中旋转缺陷占主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入位错、向错和不匹配密度场，这些场在非晶材料中与标准塑性事件定位量 \( D^2_{\text{min}} \) 存在强空间关联，且能区分塑性事件中的旋转与平移贡献，揭示三维体系中旋转缺陷占主导。；创新点：提出了一套统一的场论框架，使原本仅适用于晶体（如位错）的塑性缺陷概念可直接应用于非晶态无序材料，并首次在三维体系中识别出旋转缺陷的主导作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于拓扑与几何描述符（topological and geometrical descriptors）构建位错密度、向错密度和不匹配密度场；在模拟二维玻璃和实验二维/三维颗粒体系中，将这些场与 \( D^2_{\text{min}} \) 进行空间相关性分析。

papers.title: Field-tunable spin-valley transport in monolayer MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: We study field-controlled spin-valley transport in monolayer MoS$_2$ through a single electrostatic barrier and a uniform off-resonant elliptically polarized irradiation. Starting from the massive Dirac Hamiltonian with intrinsic spin-orbit coupling, we use a high-frequency Floquet expansion to obtain an effective static model with a laser-renormalized mass (gap) term. We solve the scattering problem by spinor matching and derive the exact analytic expression for the transmission. The numerical results show that the drive tunes both the spin-valley-dependent propagation threshold inside the barrier and the Fabry-Pérot phase, creating controllable pass/stop bands. By varying both the laser intensity (amplitude) and the polarization shape, we show that the same junction can be switched between broadband valley filtering and resonance-selective operation, and the valley contrast remains visible in the Landauer conductance. Our findings establish an efficient route for realizing optically reconfigurable valleytronic and spintronic functionalities in MoS$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Floquet展开、解析散射解、数值计算。；研究对象：单层MoS₂中的自旋-谷输运现象，具体研究通过单个静电势垒和均匀非共振椭圆偏振光调控的场控输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节激光强度（振幅）和偏振形状，可以在同一个MoS₂结中实现从宽带谷滤波到共振选择性操作的切换，并且谷对比度在Landauer电导中仍然可见。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节激光强度（振幅）和偏振形状，可以在同一个MoS₂结中实现从宽带谷滤波到共振选择性操作的切换，并且谷对比度在Landauer电导中仍然可见。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于具有内禀自旋-轨道耦合的大质量狄拉克哈密顿量，采用高频Floquet展开获得激光重正化质量（能隙）的有效静态模型；通过旋量波函数匹配法求解散射问题，推导出透射率的精确解析表达式。

papers.title: Anisotropic Crystallization Kinetics and Interfacial Dynamics of Phase-Change Material Sb$_2$S$_3$ from Machine Learning Force Field Simulations
papers.abstract: The phase-change material antimony sulfide (Sb$_2$S$_3$) relies on rapid and reversible phase transitions between crystalline and amorphous states, which are critical for their performance in data storage and photonics applications. In this work, a machine learning force field is developed based on the moment tensor potential approach, allowing us to understand the atomistic origin of the structural evolution and crystallization kinetics in Sb$_2$S$_3$ for the first time, by enabling large-scale molecular dynamics simulations (up to 7680 atoms for 40 ns). Sb$_2$S$_3$ shows anisotropic growth rates with the [100] facet exhibiting the fastest growth due to the strong Sb-S covalent bonding along its quasi-1D ribbon-like structure of its crystalline phase. The activation energy for crystal growth is found to be 0.55-0.57 eV, whereas that for diffusion is around 1.16-1.56 eV. The lower activation energy for crystal growth indicates that its heterogeneous crystallization is interface controlled rather than diffusion limited, unlike GST and GeTe with atomic attachment at the solid-liquid interface being energetically favoured over long range atomic transport. These findings provide key insights into the structural, thermodynamic, and kinetic properties of Sb$_2$S$_3$, paving the way for optimizing its functionality including switching speed, reliability, and energy efficiency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning force field、molecular dynamics simulations、moment tensor potential。；研究对象：相变材料硫化锑（Sb₂S₃）的结晶动力学与界面动力学，特别是其各向异性结晶行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sb₂S₃的结晶速率呈现各向异性，[100]晶面生长最快，归因于其准一维带状晶体结构中沿该方向的强Sb-S共价键；其结晶为界面控制型而非扩散控制型，活化能（0.55-0.57 eV）远低于扩散活化能（1.16-1.56 eV），与GST和GeTe不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sb₂S₃的结晶速率呈现各向异性，[100]晶面生长最快，归因于其准一维带状晶体结构中沿该方向的强Sb-S共价键；其结晶为界面控制型而非扩散控制型，活化能（0.55-0.57 eV）远低于扩散活化能（1.16-1.56 eV），与GST和GeTe不同。；创新点：首次通过原子尺度模拟揭示了Sb₂S₃结晶动力学的微观起源，包括各向异性生长机制及其与准一维晶体结构的关系，并明确了其结晶为界面控制型而非扩散控制型。
papers.method_zh: 基于矩张量势（moment tensor potential）方法开发机器学习力场，进行大规模分子动力学模拟（最多7680原子、40 ns），研究Sb₂S₃的结构演化与结晶动力学。

papers.title: Generalized Phase Diagrams for Graphene CVD growth on Copper
papers.abstract: Understanding the competition between first-layer lateral expansion and second-layer nucleation is essential for layer-controlled graphene growth via chemical vapor deposition (CVD). Building on our previous phase diagram framework based on the dimensionless parameters $α$ and $Γ$, we develop an enhanced model incorporating two previously neglected effects: thermal-expansion-induced substrate strain and chemical desorption of carbon monomers via reverse dehydrogenation. First-principles calculations are employed to determine the strain-dependent diffusion and attachment barriers on both exposed and graphene-covered Cu(111) surfaces. By mapping the multi-step CVD process into an effective quasi-physical vapor deposition, we construct a generalized phase diagram characterized by the coupled effects of $α$, $Γ$, and a newly introduced desorption parameter $Z$. Our results show that tensile strain expands the bilayer graphene (BLG) growth window for critical nucleus sizes $i^*>1$. In contrast, chemical desorption suppresses BLG formation in the high-$Γ$ regime via $Z$-dependent monomer depletion. This unified framework provides a predictive guide for the rational synthesis of high-quality bilayer graphene by linking macroscopic growth parameters to microscopic layer-selection mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“first-principles calculations”、“mapping the multi-step CVD process”、“construct a generalized phase diagram”。；研究对象：铜基底上化学气相沉积（CVD）生长石墨烯的相图，特别是第一层横向扩展与第二层成核之间的竞争机制，以及双层石墨烯（BLG）的可控生长。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拉伸应变可扩大双层石墨烯（BLG）的生长窗口（当临界核尺寸i*>1时），而化学脱附通过Z依赖的单体消耗抑制高Γ区间的BLG形成。该框架将宏观生长参数与微观层选择机制联系起来，为高质量双层石墨烯的理性合成提供了预测性指导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拉伸应变可扩大双层石墨烯（BLG）的生长窗口（当临界核尺寸i*>1时），而化学脱附通过Z依赖的单体消耗抑制高Γ区间的BLG形成。该框架将宏观生长参数与微观层选择机制联系起来，为高质量双层石墨烯的理性合成提供了预测性指导。；创新点：在前期基于α和Γ的相图框架基础上，首次引入了两个此前被忽略的效应：热膨胀引起的衬底应变和通过反向脱氢反应导致的碳单体化学脱附。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算确定应变依赖的扩散势垒和附着势垒（在裸露和石墨烯覆盖的Cu(111)表面）；通过将多步CVD过程映射为有效的准物理气相沉积（quasi-physical vapor deposition），构建了由无量纲参数α、Γ和新引入的脱附参数Z耦合控制的广义相图。

papers.title: What Lies Between Crystal and Randomly Packed Structures? A General Characterization of Non-Periodic Order
papers.abstract: In this paper we address the characterization of the structure of condensed materials, periodic and non-periodic. Carrying out an extensive study of over 7000 different groundstate structures of a 2D lattice model of binary packing, we find a predominance of non-periodic structures (over 96%) that extend across the entire range of possible diversities. These non-periodic structures are resolved by establishing whether a structure will accommodate or reject additional local structures. This property, structural selectivity, is treated as a signature of an underlying ordering principle. The major result of the paper is the determination that roughly 35% of the non-periodic structures are selective and, hence, ordered in some way. This selectivity extends up to a diversity of ~ 9, well beyond the upper threshold for diversity in periodically ordered states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：2D lattice model、groundstate structures、binary packing、diversity。；研究对象：凝聚态材料中周期性与非周期性结构的表征，具体研究二维晶格模型二元堆积的基态结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超过7000种基态结构中，非周期性结构占主导（超过96%），其中约35%的非周期性结构具有“结构选择性”，即有序性，其多样性可达约9，远超周期性有序态的上限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超过7000种基态结构中，非周期性结构占主导（超过96%），其中约35%的非周期性结构具有“结构选择性”，即有序性，其多样性可达约9，远超周期性有序态的上限。；创新点：提出并应用“结构选择性”这一概念来区分非周期性结构是否具有内在有序性，并定量揭示了非周期性有序态在多样性上远超周期性有序态。
papers.method_zh: 通过大规模计算研究二维晶格模型（binary packing）的基态结构，分析超过7000种结构，利用“结构选择性”（structural selectivity）作为有序性判据。

papers.title: Giant nonlinear conductivity in 2D electron gas from substrate-induced dipolar scattering
papers.abstract: Despite a surge of interest in the nonlinear transport in 2D materials, a fundamental puzzle remains: existing theoretical frameworks are unable to quantitatively account for the giant nonlinear conductivities ($\gtrsim 1 \frac{μ\text{m}}{Ω\text{V}}$) recently reported in 2D van der Waals heterostructures. Here, we introduce a mechanism based on electron scattering from a substrate-induced periodic dipole array. We show that the strict kinematic constraints, inherent to 2D scattering, lead to a singular enhancement of the nonlinear response, fundamentally dictating a natural scale of $1 \frac{μ\text{m}}{Ω\text{V}}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“introduce a mechanism”（提出机制）、“show that”（理论推导）、“theoretical frameworks”（理论框架），未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：二维电子气（2D electron gas）在衬底诱导的周期性偶极子阵列散射下的非线性输运现象，具体针对二维范德华异质结中报道的巨大非线性电导率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维散射固有的严格运动学约束会导致非线性响应的奇异增强，从而自然决定了巨大非线性电导率（约1 μm/Ω·V）的物理尺度，解决了现有理论无法定量解释实验观测的难题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维散射固有的严格运动学约束会导致非线性响应的奇异增强，从而自然决定了巨大非线性电导率（约1 μm/Ω·V）的物理尺度，解决了现有理论无法定量解释实验观测的难题。；创新点：提出了衬底诱导周期性偶极子散射这一新机制，并指出二维散射的运动学约束是导致非线性响应奇异增强的关键，从而为实验上观测到的巨大非线性电导率提供了定量理论解释。
papers.method_zh: 基于电子从衬底诱导的周期性偶极子阵列散射的物理机制，进行理论分析，利用二维散射的运动学约束推导非线性电导率的增强规律。

papers.title: Carrier-doping effect and anomalous transport properties in Ni-doped CeCoIn5 investigated by Hall resistivity measurements
papers.abstract: We investigated the effects of Ni doping on carrier density and anomalous electrical transport properties in CeCo$_{1-x}$Ni$_x$In$_5$ ($x \leq 0.3$) by performing Hall resistivity measurements. The carrier density, estimated from the Hall coefficient $R_{\rm H}$ at a temperature of 0.5 K in high magnetic fields, increases linearly with $x$, indicating that the doped Ni ions act as electron dopants. In CeCoIn$_5$, the magnitude of $-R_{\rm H}$ is strongly enhanced at magnetic fields near the superconducting upper critical field $H_{c2}$ and in the low-field region above the superconducting transition temperature $T_c$. However, these anomalies are found to be significantly suppressed by Ni doping. Possible origins of this suppression in $-R_{\rm H}$ are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：Hall resistivity measurements（霍尔电阻率测量）。；研究对象：Ni掺杂的CeCoIn₅重费米子超导体，具体为CeCo₁₋ₓNiₓIn₅（x ≤ 0.3）体系中的载流子掺杂效应和异常电输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ni掺杂使载流子密度随掺杂量x线性增加，表明Ni离子作为电子掺杂剂；同时，CeCoIn₅中在超导上临界场Hc₂附近及超导转变温度Tc以上低场区出现的霍尔系数异常（-R_H增强）被Ni掺杂显著抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ni掺杂使载流子密度随掺杂量x线性增加，表明Ni离子作为电子掺杂剂；同时，CeCoIn₅中在超导上临界场Hc₂附近及超导转变温度Tc以上低场区出现的霍尔系数异常（-R_H增强）被Ni掺杂显著抑制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 霍尔电阻率测量（Hall resistivity measurements），通过在高磁场、0.5 K温度下提取霍尔系数R_H来估算载流子密度。

papers.title: Strain-Tuned Incommensurate Kekulé Spiral Order in Twisted Bilayer Graphene: a Quantum Many-Body Study
papers.abstract: The understanding of quantum many-body states in twisted bilayer graphene at the magic angle has been greatly improved both in experiment and in theory. However, away from the exactly solvable chiral limit and the sign-problem-free charge neutrality point, the calculation of the ground state properties and the identification of the phase diagram are challenging due to the exponential increase in the complexity, which has rendered explanations of experimentally observed insulating and superconducting phases restricted largely to the perturbative level. Here we focus on the filling factors $ν= \pm2$ away from charge neutrality and address the question of the strain dependence of the interacting ground state. We adjust our continuous field momentum-space quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) method to treat the sign problem approximately, and perform a quantum many-body study together with exact diagonalization (ED) and Hartree-Fock (HF) mean field. Leveraging this combined protocol of QMC, ED, and HF, we investigate the strain-tuned transition from the Kramers intervalley coherent (KIVC) state to the incommensurate Kekulé spiral state (IKS). Our computational protocol sheds light on the KIVC-IKS transition in a projected correlated flat-band setting, and opens the door for further understanding of the rich phase diagram of twisted bilayer graphene and other strongly-correlated flat-band systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：quantum Monte Carlo, exact diagonalization, Hartree-Fock mean field）；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（twisted bilayer graphene）在远离电荷中性点（填充因子ν=±2）时的应变调控基态，特别是Kramers区间相干态（KIVC）与非公度Kekulé螺旋态（IKS）之间的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合量子蒙特卡洛、精确对角化和哈特里-福克平均场方法，揭示了应变可调控KIVC态到IKS态的转变，为理解魔角扭曲双层石墨烯的丰富相图提供了计算途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合量子蒙特卡洛、精确对角化和哈特里-福克平均场方法，揭示了应变可调控KIVC态到IKS态的转变，为理解魔角扭曲双层石墨烯的丰富相图提供了计算途径。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 连续场动量空间量子蒙特卡洛（QMC，近似处理符号问题）、精确对角化（ED）、哈特里-福克平均场（HF）联合计算协议。

papers.title: Tuning the low-energy band structure in twisted bilayer WSe2
papers.abstract: Tuning the electronic structures of two-dimensional (2D) material-based heterostructures is of crucial importance for their use in functional next-generation electronics. Here, through angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy with nanoscale spatial resolution (nano-ARPES), we systematically track the evolution of the near-Fermi-level electronic structure of bilayer WSe2 over a large range of twist angle. While the momentum positioning of the valence band maxima is independent of twist angle, we find that the energetic separation between the hole bands at the K point of the Brillouin zone and the higher binding-energy hole band at Γ can be varied in excess of 100 meV. We explore the mechanisms underpinning this evolution and discuss the implications for tuning both the size of the band gaps, and the efficiency of the spin-dependent electron-phonon coupling channels in homobilayer transition metal dichalcogenide devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了 nano-ARPES（纳米空间分辨角分辨光电子能谱）进行测量。；研究对象：扭转双层二硒化钨（twisted bilayer WSe₂）的低能电子能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在较大扭转角范围内，价带顶的动量位置不随扭转角变化，但布里渊区 K 点空穴带与 Γ 点更高结合能空穴带之间的能量分离可被调控超过 100 meV。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在较大扭转角范围内，价带顶的动量位置不随扭转角变化，但布里渊区 K 点空穴带与 Γ 点更高结合能空穴带之间的能量分离可被调控超过 100 meV。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 纳米空间分辨角分辨光电子能谱（nano-ARPES），用于系统追踪近费米能级电子结构随扭转角的演化。

papers.title: Interacting donor-acceptor pairs as the origin of coupled spin-optical signals in hexagonal boron nitride
papers.abstract: Optically addressable spin defects in hexagonal boron nitride hold promise for room-temperature quantum technologies, but their microscopic identities remain largely unknown. Using first principles calculations, we show that coupled spin optical signals arise from interacting donor acceptor pairs, not the commonly believed isolated defects. Intra and inter pair separations control charge transfer, electronic structure, and spin coupling, thereby greatly modulating zero phonon lines, phonon sidebands, lifetimes, and the sign of optically detected magnetic resonance contrast. Importantly, we identify two distinct charge-state-dependent coupling regimes and extend this picture to correlated defect ensembles, explaining the wide diversity of experimental observations. Our results establish a microscopic framework for coupled defect behavior and provide design principles for spin-active quantum emitters in wide bandgap semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的自旋缺陷，具体为相互作用施主-受主对（donor-acceptor pairs）及其产生的自旋-光学耦合信号。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 六方氮化硼中耦合的自旋-光学信号并非来自通常认为的孤立缺陷，而是源于相互作用的施主-受主对。施主-受主对内部及对间的距离控制着电荷转移、电子结构和自旋耦合，从而显著调制零声子线、声子边带、寿命以及光探测磁共振（ODMR）对比度的符号。
