papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个基于信息论的统一框架，将软物质的响应性、自适应性和智能性定义为不同架构复杂度的信息通道。研究发现，内部复杂度会提高潜在信息容量，但也会增加信号衰减和耗散，从而存在一个由传输效率、刺激能量和热噪声决定的热力学缩放上限和最优内部复杂度（类卡诺极限）。此外，合成软物质与生物系统在信息处理效率上的巨大差距源于其基本单元的能量尺度不同（1-10 kBT 对比 10^4-10^5 kBT）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个基于信息论的统一框架，将软物质的响应性、自适应性和智能性定义为不同架构复杂度的信息通道。研究发现，内部复杂度会提高潜在信息容量，但也会增加信号衰减和耗散，从而存在一个由传输效率、刺激能量和热噪声决定的热力学缩放上限和最优内部复杂度（类卡诺极限）。此外，合成软物质与生物系统在信息处理效率上的巨大差距源于其基本单元的能量尺度不同（1-10 kBT 对比 10^4-10^5 kBT）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，主要创新在于：1）首次用信息论对“响应性”、“自适应性”和“智能性”这三个在软物质领域定义模糊的术语进行了严格的形式化区分；2）提出了一个统一的、跨类别（软物质、生物、硬物质）比较的复杂度-功能-热力学关系框架；3）揭示了合成软物质与生物系统之间信息处理效率差距的物理起源（能量尺度），并提出了三种可能的架构路线来弥合这一差距。
papers.method_zh: 采用信息论作为理论框架。具体包括：将材料行为建模为三种信息通道（无记忆映射、状态条件映射、反馈修正通道）；提出了三个信息论度量指标（构型多样性 I1、Hazen 功能选择性 I2、刺激-响应信息传递 I3）；并在体积速率（单位体积的 I3）与功率密度的平面上对十个代表性系统进行了基准比较。

papers.title: Optimal Persistence Reveals Hidden Topology in Complex Energy Landscapes
papers.abstract: Infinite persistence marks the topological transition. For finite persistence, the canyon-finding rate Gamma(tau_p) on the p=2 spherical spin glass forms an inverted-U profile, peaking at an optimal tau_p^*. At low temperature (T=0.05), tau_p^* drops from 10 to 5 as N increases through 128, marking the discrete-to-quasi-continuous GOE crossover. For N=1024, the peak is flat between tau_p=5 and 6 within statistical uncertainties, preventing a more precise determination. For N>=128, the canyon width saturates at xi_eff=1, consistent with the measured tau_p^*=5 when beta=0.4. At higher temperatures (T>=0.15), tau_p^*=10 and beta(T) scales as 1/T, with temperature dependence entering only through v_th = sqrt(2T). For T=0.10 and N>=128, high-resolution scans give tau_p^*=8.0; for N<=64 at the same temperature, coarse scans place tau_p^* in the range 8-10. Thus, optimal persistence reveals the hidden topology of the landscape-a principle expected to be generic in disordered landscapes with entropic bottlenecks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：spherical spin glass（球面自旋玻璃）、topological transition（拓扑转变）、canyon-finding rate（峡谷发现率）、GOE crossover（高斯正交系综交叉）。；研究对象：p=2球面自旋玻璃模型中的复杂能量景观（complex energy landscapes），具体研究其拓扑结构随系统尺寸和温度的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最优持久性（optimal persistence）揭示了复杂能量景观中隐藏的拓扑结构：峡谷发现率随持久时间呈倒U形曲线，其峰值位置（最优持久时间）随系统尺寸增大而下降，标志着离散到准连续的高斯正交系综（GOE）交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最优持久性（optimal persistence）揭示了复杂能量景观中隐藏的拓扑结构：峡谷发现率随持久时间呈倒U形曲线，其峰值位置（最优持久时间）随系统尺寸增大而下降，标志着离散到准连续的高斯正交系综（GOE）交叉。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算有限持久时间下的峡谷发现率 Gamma(tau_p)，分析其随系统尺寸 N（64至1024）和温度 T（0.05至0.15以上）的变化，并测量峡谷宽度 xi_eff 及标度关系 beta(T) ~ 1/T。

papers.title: Direct Simulation of LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2 Transport Properties Using an Efficient and Accurate Machine Learning Potential
authors: Constantijn H. J. A. van de Wetering
papers.abstract: The rate capability of layered lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide (NMC) cathode materials plays a decisive role in high-power applications such as fast charging, necessitating a detailed understanding of lithium-ion diffusion. However, the mechanisms governing lithium-ion transport in NMC remain insufficiently understood, both experimentally and computationally. In this study, we employ an advanced and efficient machine learning potential (MLP) to simulate lithium self-diffusion in LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2 (NMC811), enabling direct large-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. The workflow integrates a fine-tuned MACE (Message Passing Atomic Cluster Expansion) foundation model as a structural generator and leverages an active learning strategy applied to a near-ground-state dataset. This approach enables the construction of a reliable MLP for NMC811 in a data-efficient manner using a limited number of density functional theory (DFT) reference calculations. Based on this potential, we performed MD simulations to predict lithium diffusion coefficients. The MLP-based simulations preserve the accuracy of DFT while overcoming its time and length scale limitations, thereby allowing direct simulation of lithium self-diffusion in NMC811.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“machine learning potential”、“molecular dynamics simulations”、“density functional theory”。；研究对象：锂离子在层状正极材料LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2（NMC811）中的自扩散输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构建高效且准确的机器学习势，实现了对NMC811中锂离子自扩散系数的直接大规模分子动力学模拟，模拟精度接近密度泛函理论（DFT），同时克服了DFT在时间和尺度上的限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构建高效且准确的机器学习势，实现了对NMC811中锂离子自扩散系数的直接大规模分子动力学模拟，模拟精度接近密度泛函理论（DFT），同时克服了DFT在时间和尺度上的限制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用微调后的MACE（Message Passing Atomic Cluster Expansion）基础模型作为结构生成器，结合主动学习策略对近基态数据集进行训练，以有限数量的DFT参考计算构建可靠的机器学习势（MLP），并基于该势进行大规模分子动力学（MD）模拟。

papers.title: $G_0W_0$@HF and BSE methods in periodic systems from Hartree-Fock theory: gaussian orbital and density fitting approach
papers.abstract: The $GW$ method for calculating quasi-particle energies of solids commonly begin from a DFT Hamiltonian and Kohn-Sham orbitals in a plane wave basis. Screening of the coulomb interaction is implemented using the inverse dielectric function in the random phase approximation (RPA). We present $G_0W_0$ calculations which begin from the Hartree-Fock method in a basis of gaussian orbitals. The screened coulomb interaction, $W$, is obtained using a $W$ = $v$ + $vΠv$ approach without invoking a plasmon pole approximation. The polarizability, $Π$, in $W$ is treated at the RPA level. RPA polarizabilities require solution of Bethe-Salpeter equations (BSE) for each unique $\textbf{Q}$ point. A strategy for obtaining self-energies which are converged with respect to number of virtual states is employed in which $G_0W_0$ yields the majority of the self-energy and the remaining part from high energy virtual levels is evaluated at second-order. The methods are evaluated by applying them to elemental semiconductors (C, Si) and oxides (MgO and anatase and rutile TiO$_2$). Common errors of HF theory applied to materials include overestimation of both the band gap and valence band widths. These are corrected in the approach employed here. Typically, the RPA screened interaction results in overestimation of band gaps while the $G_0W_0$ self-energy band width renormalization yields band widths for diamond and Si which are in good agreement with experiment. HF calculations are performed in gaussian orbital basis sets and $G_0W_0$ and BSE calculations are performed using density fitting with a coulomb metric.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“G₀W₀ calculations”、“Hartree-Fock method”、“Bethe-Salpeter equations”、“density fitting”。；研究对象：元素半导体（C, Si）和氧化物（MgO, 锐钛矿和金红石TiO₂）的准粒子能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从Hartree-Fock理论出发的G₀W₀方法能够修正HF理论对带隙和价带宽度的过高估计，其中RPA屏蔽相互作用仍会高估带隙，但G₀W₀自能带宽重整化使金刚石和硅的带宽与实验吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从Hartree-Fock理论出发的G₀W₀方法能够修正HF理论对带隙和价带宽度的过高估计，其中RPA屏蔽相互作用仍会高估带隙，但G₀W₀自能带宽重整化使金刚石和硅的带宽与实验吻合良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用高斯轨道基组进行Hartree-Fock计算，在此基础上进行G₀W₀准粒子能量计算；屏蔽库仑相互作用W通过W = v + vΠv方法获得（未使用等离激元极点近似），极化率Π在RPA水平处理，需对每个独特Q点求解Bethe-Salpeter方程；采用一种自能收敛策略：G₀W₀贡献主要自能部分，高能虚态剩余部分用二阶微扰评估；计算中使用了库仑度量的密度拟合技术。

papers.title: Filling-Sensitive Spectral Complexity from Hilbert-Space Holonomy in Fragmented Non-Hermitian Systems
papers.abstract: We show that Hilbert-space holonomy provides a geometric organizing principle for spectral reality in fragmented non-Hermitian many-body systems, complementary to conventional symmetry protection. In two minimal fragmented models, complex spectra can arise only within the most symmetric sectors: half filling in the fermion model and zero magnetization in the spin chain. Adding or removing a single particle, or flipping a single spin, renders the spectra entirely real despite unchanged periodic boundary conditions, reminiscent of boundary-condition sensitivity in systems with a non-Hermitian skin effect. We explain this by viewing nonreciprocal hopping amplitudes as a discrete gauge field on the Krylov graph: trivial holonomy permits a diagonal similarity transformation to the Hermitian limit, whereas nontrivial holonomy obstructs it and allows complex spectra. In certain regimes, trivial holonomy admits an emergent-boundary interpretation, and longer-range models exhibit finite real and complex regions governed by the same criterion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, explain, view as, criterion（理论分析与模型构建）。；研究对象：非厄米多体系统中的碎片化（fragmented）模型，具体包括费米子模型和自旋链模型，以及其中的谱实性（spectral reality）与希尔伯特空间和乐（Hilbert-space holonomy）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米碎片化多体系统的谱实性由希尔伯特空间和乐（holonomy）的几何组织原则决定：在最小碎片化模型中，仅在最对称的扇区（如费米子半填充、自旋链零磁化）出现复谱，而偏离这些扇区则谱全为实，这一现象类似于非厄米趋肤效应中的边界条件敏感性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米碎片化多体系统的谱实性由希尔伯特空间和乐（holonomy）的几何组织原则决定：在最小碎片化模型中，仅在最对称的扇区（如费米子半填充、自旋链零磁化）出现复谱，而偏离这些扇区则谱全为实，这一现象类似于非厄米趋肤效应中的边界条件敏感性。；创新点：提出了希尔伯特空间和乐作为非厄米多体系统谱实性的几何组织原则，补充了传统的对称性保护机制，并揭示了碎片化系统中谱实性对填充数（或磁化）的极端敏感性。
papers.method_zh: 通过构造两个最小碎片化模型（费米子模型和自旋链模型），将非互易跳跃振幅视为Krylov图上的离散规范场，分析其和乐（holonomy）的平凡性：平凡和乐允许通过相似变换将系统对角化为厄米形式，非平凡和乐则阻碍这一变换并允许复谱。在特定参数区域，平凡和乐可解释为涌现边界条件，并推广至长程模型。

papers.title: Polar optical scattering in ellipsoidal nanoclusters
papers.abstract: The influence of the specific geometry of three-dimensional confinement on electron- vibrational coupling in InAs/GaAs nanoclusters shaped as highly oblate ellipsoids of revolution is considered. Optical phonon relaxation processes are analyzed taking into account the law of conservation of angular momentum projection and the spatial symmetry of the dimensional confinement. The conditions for the emission of chiral optical phonons carrying orbital angular momentum along the structure's growth axis are analyzed. Intraband relaxation transitions with the emission of LO phonons with zero angular momentum, with characteristic anisotropy of the emission direction, leading to nonmonotonic size dependences for the e-ph coupling coefficient, are considered.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：considered、analyzed、law of conservation、spatial symmetry。；研究对象：InAs/GaAs 纳米团簇，具体为高度扁平的旋转椭球体形状，研究其三维受限下的电子-振动耦合及光学声子弛豫过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分析了手性光学声子沿结构生长轴发射的条件，并发现发射零角动量 LO 声子的带内弛豫跃迁具有发射方向的特征各向异性，导致电子-声子耦合系数出现非单调的尺寸依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分析了手性光学声子沿结构生长轴发射的条件，并发现发射零角动量 LO 声子的带内弛豫跃迁具有发射方向的特征各向异性，导致电子-声子耦合系数出现非单调的尺寸依赖关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于角动量投影守恒定律和维度受限的空间对称性，对光学声子弛豫过程进行理论分析。

papers.title: The fracture resistance of elastic networks increases with the density of defects like a random walk
papers.abstract: Disordered spring networks are a well-established model system to study fracture in a wide range of materials, from ceramics to polymer networks and mechanical metamaterials, across length scales from the atomistic to the macroscopic. A central quantity characterizing fracture is the apparent fracture energy $G^c$, which measures the resistance to the propagation of a preexisting dominant crack. While it is well established that disorder can increase $G^c$ through crack arrest by local inhomogeneities, its dependence on the degree of disorder remains poorly understood. Here, we study the effect of varying concentrations of missing bonds on crack propagation of an otherwise perfect two-dimensional triangular network of springs. For a given network with a fixed concentration of missing bonds, the apparent fracture energy $G^c(a)$ increases with crack advance $a$. This behavior can be explained by mapping the effect of the missing bonds onto an equivalent local fracture energy landscape $Γ^{loc}(a)$ and applying established theories linking planar crack arrest with fluctuations in $Γ^{loc}(a)$. For increasing fraction of missing bonds $ν$, the standard deviation of the fluctuations of $Γ^{loc}$ increases with $\sqrtν$, which we explain by considering a random-walk-like superposition of perturbations caused by individual missing bonds. We demonstrate that as a consequence of crack arrest by fluctuations in $Γ^{loc}$, the average $G^c(a)$ follows the same $\sqrtν$ scaling. Furthermore, we observe that the probability density of $Γ^{loc}$ has an exponential tail leading to a logarithmic increase of $G^c(a)$ with crack advance $a$. Our results quantitatively link microstructural disorder to macroscopic fracture energy and paves the way for quantitative predictions of the fracture energy in a wide variety of materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：disordered spring networks（无序弹簧网络模型）、mapping（映射）、random-walk-like superposition（随机游走式叠加）。；研究对象：二维三角弹簧网络中由缺失键（missing bonds）引入的无序度对裂纹扩展和断裂韧性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 表观断裂能 \( G^c(a) \) 随裂纹扩展距离 \( a \) 增加而增大，且其平均值随缺失键浓度 \( \nu \) 的平方根 \( \sqrt{\nu} \) 标度增长；这一标度关系源于单个缺失键引起的局部断裂能涨落以类似随机游走的方式叠加。
papers.method_zh: 采用二维三角弹簧网络模型，通过改变缺失键浓度 \( \nu \) 引入无序，模拟裂纹扩展过程；将缺失键效应映射为等效局部断裂能景观 \( \Gamma^{\text{loc}}(a) \)，并应用已有的平面裂纹止裂理论分析涨落对断裂能的影响。

papers.title: Impacts of annealing on structural and photophysical properties of zinc phthalocyanine adsorbed on graphene
papers.abstract: We report the demonstration and analysis by combined scanning-tunneling-microscopy and optical microspectroscopy of a 2D phase change experienced by a self-assembled zinc phthalocyanine (ZnPc) monolayer adsorbed on graphene. To probe the intrinsic properties of individual ZnPc molecules, they are spatially confined within the pores of a self-assembled 2D matrix. This confinement allows us to track a phase change induced by annealing, which we discuss in terms of a planar-square to shuttlecock molecular transition. We show that after annealing of the adsorbed ZnPc, the exposition of Zn atoms to reactants in a supernatant solution is improved, for example, for metal-ligand formation towards 3D self-assembly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：scanning-tunneling-microscopy（扫描隧道显微镜）、optical microspectroscopy（光学显微光谱）、demonstration and analysis（演示与分析）。；研究对象：吸附在石墨烯上的锌酞菁（ZnPc）单分子层，具体研究其退火诱导的二维相变及结构变化对光物理性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 退火处理使自组装的ZnPc单层发生从平面方形到“羽毛球”状分子构型的二维相变，且退火后Zn原子在反应物中的暴露程度提高，有利于金属-配体形成及三维自组装。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：退火处理使自组装的ZnPc单层发生从平面方形到“羽毛球”状分子构型的二维相变，且退火后Zn原子在反应物中的暴露程度提高，有利于金属-配体形成及三维自组装。；创新点：利用空间限域策略追踪单个ZnPc分子的退火诱导相变，并揭示该相变对后续化学反应活性的影响（如改善Zn原子暴露以促进三维自组装）。摘要未突出说明与以往研究在相变机制或表征手段上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 结合扫描隧道显微镜（STM）与光学显微光谱（optical microspectroscopy）进行原位表征；通过将ZnPc分子限制在自组装二维矩阵的孔隙中实现单分子性质探测。

papers.title: The Ultrafast Superconducting Diode Effect
papers.abstract: Nonreciprocal transport is generally observed in superconductors in which time reversal and inversion symmetries are simultaneously broken. This effect, which may become one of the backbones for future superconducting electronics, arises because of asymmetric vortex transport in a magnetic field. However, vortex transport is also intrinsically dissipative and limited in speed. Here, we report on the discovery of ultrafast non-reciprocal transport in centrosymmetric superconductors. For NbN films biased with a quasi-DC supercurrent, picosecond current pulses with the same sign as the bias experience resistive impedance, whereas pulses of opposite polarity encounter an inductive response. Strikingly, the effect is at least three orders of magnitude faster than in conventional superconducting diodes, limited only by ultrafast current-induced depairing. We demonstrate rectification of a 100 GHz signal, with dissipation levels of a few fJ per cycle. We foresee potential for superconducting logic elements, operating at THz bit rates with aJ energy dissipation per operation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we report on the discovery”、“demonstrate rectification”等实验发现和测量结果。；研究对象：超导二极管效应中的非互易输运现象，具体研究对象为中心对称超导体NbN薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称超导体NbN中发现了超快非互易输运效应：准直流超电流偏置下，同号皮秒电流脉冲呈现电阻性阻抗，反号脉冲则呈现感性响应；该效应速度比传统超导二极管快至少三个数量级，仅受超快电流诱导的退配对过程限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称超导体NbN中发现了超快非互易输运效应：准直流超电流偏置下，同号皮秒电流脉冲呈现电阻性阻抗，反号脉冲则呈现感性响应；该效应速度比传统超导二极管快至少三个数量级，仅受超快电流诱导的退配对过程限制。；创新点：首次在中心对称超导体中实现超快（皮秒级）超导二极管效应，速度比传统基于涡旋输运的超导二极管快至少三个数量级，且耗散极低（每周期数fJ），有望用于太赫兹比特率、aJ能耗的超导逻辑元件。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：对NbN薄膜施加准直流超电流偏置，注入皮秒级电流脉冲，测量不同极性脉冲的阻抗响应（电阻性与感性）；实现100 GHz信号的整流，并测量每周期耗散（数fJ量级）。

papers.title: An Energy Integration Free Kubo-Bastin Formula Decomposition
papers.abstract: Kubo formulae play a central role in modern spintronics and condensed matter physics, serving as the foundational ground for studying transport responses in the linear regime. In this work, we propose a reformulation of the widely used Kubo-Bastin decompositions that eliminates the need for numerical energy integration. By performing these integrations analytically for generic periodic systems, our approach drastically reduces computational cost and simplifies the evaluation of transport coefficients.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：reformulation、analytical integration、Kubo-Bastin decompositions。；研究对象：凝聚态物理中线性响应输运系数的计算方法，具体针对Kubo-Bastin公式中的数值能量积分问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需数值能量积分的Kubo-Bastin公式分解新形式，通过解析积分大幅降低计算成本并简化输运系数的评估。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需数值能量积分的Kubo-Bastin公式分解新形式，通过解析积分大幅降低计算成本并简化输运系数的评估。；创新点：首次实现了对Kubo-Bastin分解中能量积分的完全解析处理，从而消除了数值积分带来的计算负担。
papers.method_zh: 基于Kubo-Bastin公式的解析重构，对一般周期性系统进行解析能量积分，避免了传统方法中的数值积分步骤。

papers.title: Tunable Phonon-Driven Magnon Spin Currents in Altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnets have recently attracted considerable interest due to their unique symmetry-governed spintronic properties. Here, we investigate phonon-induced magnon spin currents in a two-dimensional altermagnet. Starting from a microscopic theory of the coupled magnon-phonon system, we derive the nonequilibrium magnon distribution generated by selective phonon excitations. We show that the resulting spin currents exhibit a pronounced d-wave symmetry with respect to the phonon momentum. Moreover, the spin current along the altermagnetic directions can be completely reversed by tuning the phonon frequency. These findings establish altermagnets as promising platforms for realizing highly tunable, phonon-driven coherent terahertz magnon spin currents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：microscopic theory、derive、nonequilibrium magnon distribution。；研究对象：二维交变磁体（altermagnet）中由声子驱动的磁振子自旋电流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维交变磁体中，选择性声子激发可产生具有显著d波对称性的磁振子自旋电流，且沿交变磁方向的电流可通过调节声子频率实现完全反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维交变磁体中，选择性声子激发可产生具有显著d波对称性的磁振子自旋电流，且沿交变磁方向的电流可通过调节声子频率实现完全反转。；创新点：首次在交变磁体中理论预言了可调谐的声子驱动磁振子自旋电流，并揭示了其d波对称性和频率可逆性，为太赫兹相干自旋流器件提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 基于磁振子-声子耦合系统的微观理论，推导了选择性声子激发下的非平衡磁振子分布。

papers.title: Nonlinear Stabilization of Non-Adiabatic Magnonic Dynamics
papers.abstract: We propose a nonlinear magnonic platform for bounded nonadiabatic parametric excitation in nanoscale ferrite structures. The approach is based on the algorithm, where the non-adiabaticity parameter is interpreted as a local measure of the spectral-flow rate associated with, while the nonlinear frequency regulator U represents the anharmonic spectral detuning of the medium. Using Co doped yttrium iron garnet YIG Co as a representative material system, we analyze how nonlinear detuning suppresses uncontrolled parametric growth and drives the system toward a dynamically localized low-occupancy magnonic state. Numerical verification in truncated Fock bases shows that a finite regulator U can suppress leakage into higher-order modes and preserve bounded dynamics under non-adiabatic excitation. The experimentally reported absorbed energy density for ultrafast switching in YIG Co corresponds to an estimated switching energy of approximately 22 aJ for a cell, providing a physically relevant scale for low-energy resonant state formation. We further discuss the role of magnetic damping, exchange-gap confinement, and phonon transparency in maintaining coherent magnonic dynamics over multiple operation cycles. These results suggest that nonlinear self-limited non-adiabatic dynamics in ferrite nanostructures may provide a physical basis for low-energy wave-based information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose、algorithm、numerical verification、theoretical analysis）；研究对象：纳米铁氧体结构（Co掺杂钇铁石榴石YIG Co）中的非绝热参量激发与非线性磁振子动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性频率调节器U能够抑制非绝热参量激发中的失控增长，驱动系统进入动态局域的低占据磁振子态，从而实现有界、自限的非绝热动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性频率调节器U能够抑制非绝热参量激发中的失控增长，驱动系统进入动态局域的低占据磁振子态，从而实现有界、自限的非绝热动力学。；创新点：提出了将非绝热参数与非线性频率调节器结合的平台，用于实现纳米铁氧体中受控的非绝热参量激发，并揭示了非线性自限动力学在低能耗波基信息处理中的潜在物理基础。
papers.method_zh: 基于非绝热参数作为谱流率局部度量的算法，结合非线性频率调节器U的解析框架；在截断Fock基下进行数值验证；以YIG Co为代表性材料系统进行能量尺度估算。

papers.title: Quantum effective action for dissipative semiclassical dynamics
papers.abstract: Using the quantum effective action in the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism, we derive quantum corrections to the semiclassical Langevin dynamics of a dissipative system governed by a macroscopic degree of freedom. We discuss the connection with the Ehrenfest theorem and show that, in the low-temperature and weak-damping regime, quantum corrections are determined by the zero-point energy of fluctuations evaluated at the classical underdamped frequency, closely paralleling the conservative case. We apply these general results to the resistively and capacitively shunted superconducting Josephson junction and to an elongated bosonic junction, where quantum corrections can reach the percent level under realistic conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum effective action、Schwinger-Keldysh formalism、derive quantum corrections、semiclassical Langevin dynamics。；研究对象：耗散系统的半经典朗之万动力学，具体应用于电阻电容分路超导约瑟夫森结和细长玻色子结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温弱阻尼条件下，耗散系统的量子修正由经典欠阻尼频率下的零点涨落能决定，与保守系统的情况类似；在真实条件下，量子修正可达到百分之一量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温弱阻尼条件下，耗散系统的量子修正由经典欠阻尼频率下的零点涨落能决定，与保守系统的情况类似；在真实条件下，量子修正可达到百分之一量级。；创新点：将量子有效作用量方法推广到耗散系统，揭示了耗散系统中量子修正与零点涨落能之间的定量关系，并展示了在超导约瑟夫森结等具体系统中量子修正的可观测性。
papers.method_zh: 采用Schwinger-Keldysh形式论中的量子有效作用量，推导耗散系统半经典朗之万动力学的量子修正，并与埃伦费斯特定理建立联系。

papers.title: Proof of the absence of local conserved quantities in the Holstein model
papers.abstract: Absence of local conserved quantities, or \textit{nonintegrability}, is often assumed when discussing various phenomena in quantum many-body systems, such as thermalization and transport. However, no concrete proof of this property is known in electron--phonon coupled systems, a typical setting for condensed matter physics. In this paper, we show that the one-dimensional Holstein model has no nontrivial local conserved quantities other than the Hamiltonian itself and the total fermion number operator. We further show that the absence of nontrivial local conserved quantities also holds for the more general Holstein--Hubbard model. Our result has accomplished an advance in nonintegrability proofs by expanding their scope to systems in which particles with different statistical properties are mixed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“proof”（证明）、“show”（展示）等理论推导关键词，且未提及任何实验或计算手段。；研究对象：Holstein模型（一维电子-声子耦合系统）及其推广形式Holstein-Hubbard模型中的局域守恒量缺失问题（即非可积性）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了一维Holstein模型除哈密顿量和总费米子数算符外，不存在其他非平凡的局域守恒量；该结论同样适用于更一般的Holstein-Hubbard模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了一维Holstein模型除哈密顿量和总费米子数算符外，不存在其他非平凡的局域守恒量；该结论同样适用于更一般的Holstein-Hubbard模型。；创新点：首次在电子-声子耦合系统（凝聚态物理典型体系）中严格证明了局域守恒量的缺失（非可积性），将非可积性证明的适用范围从纯费米子或纯玻色子系统扩展到混合统计性质粒子的系统。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明方法，具体为通过数学推导证明局域守恒量的不存在性（非可积性证明），将此类证明方法拓展至混合不同统计性质粒子的系统。

papers.title: Predicting Organic Solar Cell Performance and Stability from Fast, Morphology-aware Current-Voltage Modeling
papers.abstract: Understanding the relationship between morphology and performance in organic solar cells is essential for developing devices that are both high performing and resilient to aging. This work introduces a unique method capable of calculating the current-voltage (JV) curve of complex heterojunction morphologies containing up to five phases (donor amorphous, donor crystalline, acceptor amorphous, acceptor crystalline, mixed amorphous) with a very low computation time using morphology-aware descriptors of light absorption, exciton dissociation, non-geminate recombination and free charge carrier mobilities. The method is validated against Monte Carlo and 3D drift-diffusion simulations and applied to P3HT:PCBM and PM6:Y6 systems, shedding light on the physical compromises encountered to optimize device performance and lifetime. Finally, we show that the morphology-performance relationship is dependent on the materials system studied.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：morphology-aware descriptors、Monte Carlo、3D drift-diffusion simulations、current-voltage modeling。；研究对象：有机太阳能电池（organic solar cells）中的复杂异质结形貌，具体涉及P3HT:PCBM和PM6:Y6两种材料体系，包含最多五相（给体非晶、给体结晶、受体非晶、受体结晶、混合非晶）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于形貌描述符的快速电流-电压曲线计算方法，揭示了优化器件性能与寿命之间存在的物理权衡，并发现形貌-性能关系依赖于具体材料体系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于形貌描述符的快速电流-电压曲线计算方法，揭示了优化器件性能与寿命之间存在的物理权衡，并发现形貌-性能关系依赖于具体材料体系。；创新点：提出了一种计算时间极低、能处理多相复杂异质结形貌的JV曲线建模方法，首次将形貌描述符与器件性能及老化稳定性直接关联，并揭示了形貌-性能关系对材料体系的依赖性。
papers.method_zh: 利用形貌感知描述符（涵盖光吸收、激子解离、非孪生复合、自由载流子迁移率）对含多达五相的异质结形貌进行快速JV曲线计算，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟和三维漂移-扩散模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Impact of the Lattice Constant on the Polymorphism of Organic/Inorganic Interfaces
papers.abstract: The polymorphism of organic/metal interfaces influences many of their properties. As a result, a host of contemporary research focuses on analyzing the factors which are pertinent for modifying polymorphism. In this work, we elucidate how the lattice constant of the underlying lattice affects the energetic landscape of adsorbate monolayers for the model system of tetracyanoquinodimethane (TCNQ) on coinage metal surfaces with varying lattice constants. In particular, we focus on how the adsorbateadsorbate and the adsorbate-substrate interaction are affected when increasing the lattice constant and changing the surface chemistry. Based on these investigations, we show that the adsorbate-substrate interaction for some adsorption geometries can change significantly with the lattice constant. In addition, due to a transition from repulsive to attractive adsorbate-adsorbate interactions, polymorphs with tight packing become more favorable, if the lattice constant is increased, resulting in a lattice-constant-based phase transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：elucidate how the lattice constant affects the energetic landscape、based on these investigations、show that。；研究对象：有机/金属界面的多晶型现象，具体为四氰基对醌二甲烷（TCNQ）在具有不同晶格常数的货币金属（coinage metal）表面上的吸附单分子层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了衬底晶格常数如何显著改变吸附质-衬底相互作用以及吸附质-吸附质相互作用，并导致从排斥到吸引的转变，从而引发基于晶格常数的相变，使紧密堆积的多晶型更稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了衬底晶格常数如何显著改变吸附质-衬底相互作用以及吸附质-吸附质相互作用，并导致从排斥到吸引的转变，从而引发基于晶格常数的相变，使紧密堆积的多晶型更稳定。；创新点：系统阐明了晶格常数这一单一几何参数如何通过同时调节吸附质-衬底和吸附质-吸附质相互作用来驱动有机/金属界面的多晶型转变，为理解界面多晶型的调控因素提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 基于模型体系（TCNQ在货币金属表面）的能量景观分析，通过改变晶格常数和表面化学来系统研究吸附质-吸附质与吸附质-衬底相互作用的变化。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如DFT等）。

papers.title: Tracking Coupled Granular Temperature and Entropy Dynamics in Granular Materials via Dielectric Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: In glass-forming liquids, structural dynamics are governed by configurational entropy and temperature, with dielectric relaxation time scaling alongside structural relaxation time as described by the Adam-Gibbs (AG) model. Under Edwards's athermal statistical thermodynamics, a modified AG law similarly governs granular matter, provided that granular temperature and configurational entropy are appropriately defined. This study investigates whether variations in the structural relaxation of granular systems can be probed via thermally activated processes, specifically electric charge hopping and trapping. By progressively reducing the volume of graphite powder to vary its packing fraction, we estimated relative configurational entropy and granular temperature from volumetric data, while evaluating electrical conductivity and capacity via impedance spectroscopy. We demonstrate that the logarithm of the dielectric relaxation time, derived from complex impedance, scales with granular temperature and entropy across both loose and compact states. Consequently, changes in the complex impedance resulting from packing fraction variations are tuned by granule configuration, strictly adhering to an AG-like relationship for thermal systems. These findings establish dielectric spectroscopy as a viable, non-destructive tool for tracing configurational dynamics in granular matter, analogous to its established use in polymers and glass formers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“通过逐步减小石墨粉体积以改变堆积分数”、“通过阻抗谱评估电导率和电容”等实验操作与测量手段。；研究对象：颗粒材料（具体为石墨粉）中的构型动力学，重点关注颗粒温度与构型熵的耦合关系，以及介电弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 颗粒材料的介电弛豫时间（由复阻抗导出）与颗粒温度及构型熵之间存在标度关系，严格遵循类似Adam-Gibbs（AG）模型的热力学关系，表明介电谱可作为一种非破坏性工具追踪颗粒材料的构型动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：颗粒材料的介电弛豫时间（由复阻抗导出）与颗粒温度及构型熵之间存在标度关系，严格遵循类似Adam-Gibbs（AG）模型的热力学关系，表明介电谱可作为一种非破坏性工具追踪颗粒材料的构型动力学。；创新点：将原本用于玻璃形成液体的Adam-Gibbs模型推广至颗粒材料，并首次通过介电谱实验验证了颗粒温度与构型熵对介电弛豫时间的联合调控，建立了介电谱作为追踪颗粒材料构型动力学的非破坏性手段。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过逐步减小石墨粉体积改变堆积分数，从体积数据估算相对构型熵和颗粒温度；同时利用阻抗谱测量电导率和电容，从中提取介电弛豫时间。

papers.title: Orthogonal Decomposition of Discretization-Induced Transport-Information Cost under Rank-Deficient Parametrizations
papers.abstract: When we consider discretization of continuous probability distributions, it inevitably induces irreversible geometric distortion of local measure on the discretized support. While such discretziation-induced distortion is extrinsic to information geometry (IG) alone, we recently demonstrate that the discretization cost can be naturally characterized by the standard Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between continuous distributions as expectation of their infinitesimal parameter variations. The framework is based on the correspondence between optimal transport (OT) and IG, primarily requring the selected parameters directly identifiable with support coordinates. The present work extends the framework to more generalized parametrization theta, particularly the Jacobian between theta and support coordinates is rank-deficient, which generally results in breaking down the interpretation of the discretization-induced costs as information-geometric quantities. To address the problem, we here introduce an orthogonal decomposition of the second-moment tensor onto linear subspace for the covariance matrices generated by parameter fluctuations, based on Frobenius projection. The decomposition naturally separates the discretization cost into observable and unobservable components relative to the chosen parametrization. The present formulation provides a geometric framework for analyzing partial observability of discretization-induced transport-information costs and clarifies the role of parametrization-dependent information loss.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于数学框架的扩展（正交分解、Frobenius投影），未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：离散化概率分布与连续分布之间的几何失真，特别是当参数化（parametrization）的雅可比矩阵秩亏时，离散化诱导的输运-信息代价的分解与可观测性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入基于Frobenius投影的二阶矩张量正交分解，可将离散化诱导的输运-信息代价自然分解为相对于所选参数化的可观测部分与不可观测部分，从而在参数化秩亏时仍能分析代价的几何结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入基于Frobenius投影的二阶矩张量正交分解，可将离散化诱导的输运-信息代价自然分解为相对于所选参数化的可观测部分与不可观测部分，从而在参数化秩亏时仍能分析代价的几何结构。；创新点：将先前仅适用于参数与支撑坐标直接可识别（雅可比满秩）的离散化代价分析框架，推广至参数化雅可比矩阵秩亏的一般情形，并揭示了参数化依赖的信息损失与部分可观测性的几何起源。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架基于最优输运（OT）与信息几何（IG）的对应关系，利用KL散度作为连续分布间离散化代价的刻画，并引入二阶矩张量在参数涨落生成的协方差矩阵线性子空间上的正交分解（Frobenius投影）。

papers.title: Nanoscale Thermal Imaging of Dislocation-Mediated Heat Transport
papers.abstract: Dislocations in crystalline materials are widely exploited to tailor the thermal conductivity of semiconductors and thermoelectrics, yet a critical gap persists: direct measurement of local thermal resistance at individual buried dislocations, along with its spatial extent, remains elusive due to the limitations of conventional thermal probes. Here, we use in situ scanning transmission electron microscopy-electron energy-loss spectroscopy to map nanoscale temperature distributions across a low-angle SrTiO3 grain boundary with periodic dislocation arrays. Our results reveal a temperature drop of 47 K across the dislocation array. The associated temperature-field distortions are concentrated near the dislocation cores, consistent with stronger local thermal resistance at these discrete sites rather than a uniformly distributed resistance along the array. We further identify a distinct two-scale heat transport characteristic near the dislocation array: core-dominated effects over approximately 4.8-6.2 nm and extended inter-core influences over approximately 10.3-14.3 nm. Atomic-scale structural and vibrational analyses further reveal core-associated atomic reconstruction and localized optical-phonon perturbations, providing a microscopic basis for the stronger local thermal resistance inferred near dislocation cores. These findings quantitatively resolve spatial heterogeneity of dislocation-mediated heat transport, uncover its atomic-scale mechanism, and provide a quantitative basis for defect engineering, guiding the design of high-performance thermoelectrics, semiconductors, high-temperature structural alloys, and other functional crystalline materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了“in situ scanning transmission electron microscopy-electron energy-loss spectroscopy”（原位扫描透射电子显微镜-电子能量损失谱）等具体实验手段进行测量。；研究对象：低角度SrTiO3晶界中周期性位错阵列介导的热输运现象，具体关注单个埋藏位错附近的局部热阻及其空间分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验直接测量到位错阵列处存在47 K的温降，并发现热阻并非均匀分布，而是集中在位错核心附近，呈现出核心主导（约4.8-6.2 nm）和核间扩展（约10.3-14.3 nm）的双尺度热输运特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验直接测量到位错阵列处存在47 K的温降，并发现热阻并非均匀分布，而是集中在位错核心附近，呈现出核心主导（约4.8-6.2 nm）和核间扩展（约10.3-14.3 nm）的双尺度热输运特征。；创新点：首次通过实验直接测量了单个埋藏位错附近的局部热阻及其空间范围，克服了传统热探针的局限性，并定量揭示了位错介导热输运的空间异质性及其原子尺度机制。
papers.method_zh: 原位扫描透射电子显微镜-电子能量损失谱（in situ STEM-EELS）用于绘制纳米尺度温度分布；原子尺度的结构和振动分析用于揭示微观机制。

papers.title: High-Throughput Bayesian Optimization of Cement-Salt Hydrates Composites for Seasonal Thermochemical Energy Storage
papers.abstract: Thermochemical energy storage (TCES) based on salt hydrates is a promising route for seasonal heat storage; however, the design of practical sorbent materials remains challenging due to a non-trivial coupling between composition, synthesis feasibility, performance, and cost. Here, focusing on salt-into-matrix cement-based composites, we demonstrate that a high-throughput experimental framework based on Bayesian optimization (BO) can be used to orchestrate the optimization process of composite materials for low-temperature TCES. The explored design space is defined by salt type, salt concentration, water-to-cement ratio, and additive-to-cement ratio, while two competing objectives are pursued in parallel, namely the specific energy and the specific energy cost. The BO-guided campaign identified Pareto-optimal composites based on CaCl$_2$, Zn(NO$_3$)$_2$, and LiCl, highlighting the promise of cement-salt combinations that have been only marginally explored, or not previously reported, in cement-based TCES systems. The best-performing formulation (LiCl-based), achieved an average specific energy of about $\SI{458}{\kilo\joule\per\kilo\gram}$, whereas CaCl$_2$- and Zn(NO$_3$)$_2$-based composites showed lower but still competitive specific energy values combined with more favorable specific energy cost. Overall, the optimized formulations improved the specific energy of previously developed cement-based materials by up to a factor of five, although it remains below that of state-of-the-art composites based on silica gel and expanded vermiculite. Nonetheless, the present materials, notably CaCl$_2$- and Zn(NO$_3$)$_2$-based composites, offer an attractive cost-to-performance balance, highlighting BO as an effective strategy for accelerated TCES materials discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：high-throughput experimental framework、Bayesian optimization、composite materials。；研究对象：基于水泥-盐类水合物复合材料的低温热化学储能体系，具体研究盐类型、盐浓度、水灰比和添加剂比等参数对储能性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过贝叶斯优化引导的高通量实验，发现基于CaCl₂、Zn(NO₃)₂和LiCl的水泥基复合材料在热化学储能中具有最优的帕累托前沿性能，其中LiCl基复合材料平均比能量达约458 kJ/kg，较此前水泥基材料提升最高达五倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过贝叶斯优化引导的高通量实验，发现基于CaCl₂、Zn(NO₃)₂和LiCl的水泥基复合材料在热化学储能中具有最优的帕累托前沿性能，其中LiCl基复合材料平均比能量达约458 kJ/kg，较此前水泥基材料提升最高达五倍。；创新点：首次将贝叶斯优化应用于水泥-盐类水合物复合材料的热化学储能性能优化，发现了此前在水泥基TCES系统中仅被少量探索或未被报道的盐-水泥组合（如Zn(NO₃)₂），并实现了比能量的大幅提升。
papers.method_zh: 采用贝叶斯优化（Bayesian optimization, BO）引导的高通量实验框架，系统探索由盐类型、盐浓度、水灰比和添加剂比构成的设计空间，同时优化比能量和比能量成本两个竞争目标。

papers.title: Diffusing diffusivity selects Pareto tail exponent in random growth with redistribution
papers.abstract: Random multiplicative growth with redistribution generates stationary Pareto wealth tails in the Bouchaud-Mézard model, but assumes a fixed multiplicative noise intensity. This is restrictive for physical and financial growth processes, where volatility (diffusivity) is often fluctuating. We replace the constant noise intensity by a diffusing diffusivity and ask how these fluctuations select the Pareto stationary tail. For a geometric Brownian motion with diffusing diffusivity, the effect is transient: log-returns show non-Gaussian short-time statistics but self-average to a Gaussian form at long times. With redistribution, the same persistence becomes stationary. Agents remaining in high-diffusivity states dominate rare large-wealth events, so the Pareto exponent is not obtained by replacing the diffusivity by its mean. For a two-state diffusivity, an exact tail analysis gives a Pareto exponent interpolating between the high-diffusivity slow-refresh limit and the mean-diffusivity fast-refresh Bouchaud-Mézard limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：random multiplicative growth、exact tail analysis、Bouchaud-Mézard model。；研究对象：随机增长与再分配过程中的财富分布尾部行为，具体为Bouchaud-Mézard模型中扩散率（波动率）自身随机涨落对帕累托尾指数的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当扩散率本身随时间随机涨落时，系统稳态的帕累托尾指数由高扩散率状态的慢刷新极限与平均扩散率的快刷新极限共同插值决定，而非简单用扩散率的平均值替代常数扩散率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当扩散率本身随时间随机涨落时，系统稳态的帕累托尾指数由高扩散率状态的慢刷新极限与平均扩散率的快刷新极限共同插值决定，而非简单用扩散率的平均值替代常数扩散率。；创新点：揭示了在随机增长与再分配模型中，扩散率的涨落会持久性地改变稳态财富分布的尾部指数，且该指数不能通过将扩散率替换为其平均值来获得，从而推广了经典的Bouchaud-Mézard模型。
papers.method_zh: 采用“扩散的扩散率”（diffusing diffusivity）模型替代固定噪声强度，对两态扩散率情形进行精确尾部分析，推导稳态帕累托尾指数的解析表达式。

papers.title: Planckian dissipation from classical hydrodynamics
papers.abstract: In this work we ask what the self-consistency of a classical hydrodynamic description imposes on a quantum system. The quantum fluctuation-dissipation theorem, when read in the time domain, acts as a blurring of the fine details of the correlation functions on a Plankian time-scale. We track this blurring along rays inside the light cone for three phenomenological hydrodynamic equations -- diffusion, telegraph and diffusive-telegraph -- and find that the interior of the cone splits into a classical region, where correlation and response satisfy the classical fluctuation-dissipation relation, and a quantum region, where they deviate sharply from it. Preserving a finite classical region as the temperature is lowered forces the effective relaxation rate to be at least Planckian, recovering bounds on diffusivity, equilibration time and shear viscosity. In this way, Planckian scaling of the diffusion constant emerges not as a quantum constraint on microscopic dynamics, but as the price a system pays to remain describable by classical hydrodynamics down to low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：classical hydrodynamic description、quantum fluctuation-dissipation theorem、phenomenological hydrodynamic equations。；研究对象：经典流体力学描述在量子系统中的自洽性条件，具体涉及扩散、电报方程和扩散-电报方程三种唯象流体力学方程所描述的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典流体力学描述在低温下保持自洽，要求系统的有效弛豫率至少达到普朗克量级，从而恢复对扩散率、平衡时间和剪切粘度的已知下界。普朗克标度行为并非量子微观动力学的约束，而是系统为在低温下仍能被经典流体力学描述所付出的代价。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典流体力学描述在低温下保持自洽，要求系统的有效弛豫率至少达到普朗克量级，从而恢复对扩散率、平衡时间和剪切粘度的已知下界。普朗克标度行为并非量子微观动力学的约束，而是系统为在低温下仍能被经典流体力学描述所付出的代价。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用量子涨落-耗散定理在时域中的模糊化效应（普朗克时间尺度上的关联函数细节模糊），沿光锥内的射线追踪三种唯象流体力学方程（扩散、电报、扩散-电报）的关联与响应行为，分析经典区域与量子区域的划分。

papers.title: Zero-net-magnetization hybrid magnet
papers.abstract: Zero-net-magnetization magnets possess ultradense and ultrafast application potential, benefiting from their intrinsic zero stray field and terahertz dynamics characteristics. Herein, we propose the concept of zero-net-magnetization hybrid magnet, in which magnetic atoms with opposite spin polarization are partially coupled via spatial inversion ($P$) symmetry, partially via rotation/mirror ($C/M$) symmetry or partially without any symmetry correlation. From a local perspective and neglecting the interactions between local regions, hybrid magnet can be regarded as being composed of $PT$-antiferromagnet (possessing the combined symmetry ($PT$) of $P$ and time-reversal ($T$)), altermagnet, or fully compensated ferrimagnet. To realize hybrid magnet, we propose that such system can be constructed by forming heterojunction with three types of zero-net-magnetization magnetic monolayers. We mainly investigate the heterojunction composed of two kinds of zero-net-magnetization magnets, among which one type corresponds to fully compensated ferrimagnet. When heterojunction hybrid magnet exhibits a type-II band alignment, only one of electron doping and hole doping can induce a net magnetic moment, while the other hardly generates any net magnetization. Taking the heterojunction constructed by $PT$-antiferromagnet and fully compensated ferrimagnet as an example, we verify our proposal by means of the tight-binding (TB) model. Finally, taking the $\mathrm{Cr_2C_2S_6}$/$\mathrm{CrMoC_2S_6}$ heterojunction as an example, we perform first-principles calculations combined with electric field modulation to validate our TB model and theoretical proposal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。关键词：提出概念、紧束缚模型、第一性原理计算。；研究对象：零净磁化混合磁体（zero-net-magnetization hybrid magnet），具体包括由PT-反铁磁体、交变磁体或全补偿亚铁磁体构成的异质结体系，并以Cr₂C₂S₆/CrMoC₂S₆异质结为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种新型零净磁化磁体——混合磁体，其内部不同区域的磁性原子通过空间反演对称性、旋转/镜面对称性或无对称性关联部分耦合。在异质结中，当能带对齐为II型时，仅电子掺杂或空穴掺杂之一能诱导净磁矩，另一种几乎不产生净磁化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种新型零净磁化磁体——混合磁体，其内部不同区域的磁性原子通过空间反演对称性、旋转/镜面对称性或无对称性关联部分耦合。在异质结中，当能带对齐为II型时，仅电子掺杂或空穴掺杂之一能诱导净磁矩，另一种几乎不产生净磁化。；创新点：首次提出“零净磁化混合磁体”的概念，将PT-反铁磁体、交变磁体与全补偿亚铁磁体通过异质结方式组合，并揭示了II型能带对齐下掺杂诱导磁矩的非对称行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧束缚模型进行理论验证，并结合第一性原理计算与电场调控对Cr₂C₂S₆/CrMoC₂S₆异质结进行模拟验证。

papers.title: Evaluation of External Magnetic Flux Density in Piezo-Flexomagnetic Nanobeams Using a Hybrid 1D-2D Finite Element Framework
papers.abstract: This study numerically evaluates the external magnetic flux density generated in air by the bending of a piezo-flexomagnetic nanobeam. In several classes of non-contact sensors, the magnetic field induced in the surrounding medium is often more useful than the internal magnetic response. However, most theoretical studies on piezo-flexomagnetic nanostructures neglect the external magnetic domain. The proposed framework employs a coupled hybrid finite element formulation combining a 1D Timoshenko beam model with a 2D magnetostatic problem encompassing both the beam body and the surrounding air domain. The formulation is verified against analytical solutions of magnetically isolated piezo-flexomagnetic beams. The results demonstrate the presence of a significant external magnetic flux distribution in free-standing structures, even in the absence of piezomagnetic coupling. A systematic sensitivity analysis further identifies the material parameters most strongly influencing the external transverse magnetic flux density. These findings provide insight into the design of nanoscale non-contact magnetoelastic sensing systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：numerically evaluates、finite element formulation、analytical solutions）；研究对象：压电-挠曲磁纳米梁（piezo-flexomagnetic nanobeam）在弯曲时于周围空气中产生的外部磁通密度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使在无压磁耦合的情况下，自由悬挂的纳米梁结构也能在外部空气中产生显著的外部磁通分布；通过敏感性分析确定了影响外部横向磁通密度的关键材料参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在无压磁耦合的情况下，自由悬挂的纳米梁结构也能在外部空气中产生显著的外部磁通分布；通过敏感性分析确定了影响外部横向磁通密度的关键材料参数。；创新点：首次在压电-挠曲磁纳米梁的理论研究中明确考虑了外部空气域中的磁场分布，而以往研究通常忽略外部磁响应。
papers.method_zh: 采用一维Timoshenko梁模型与二维静磁问题（涵盖梁体及周围空气域）耦合的混合有限元框架（hybrid 1D-2D finite element formulation），并与磁隔离压电-挠曲磁梁的解析解进行验证。

papers.title: Fractonic Constraints and Magnetic Order in a Dipole-Conserving Spin Chain
papers.abstract: This work investigates the competition between dipole conservation, which imposes strong dynamical constraints and prevents the propagation of isolated spin excitations, and Ising-type interactions that favor ordering. Specifically, we explore the ground state phase diagram of a one-dimensional spin chain in the presence of both fractonic constraints and interactions. Despite the kinetic constraints, the system stabilizes an antiferromagnetic dipole-ordered ground state, where the ordering occurs at the level of spin pairs rather than individual spins. At a large Ising interaction strength, the model undergoes a phase transition from a dipole-ordered phase to a spin antiferromagnetic phase. In contrast, for ferromagnetic Ising interactions, the model exhibits both antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic dipole ordered phases. At sufficiently large negative interaction strength, the dipole ordered phase transitions to a ferromagnetic phase with conventional spin ferromagnetic order. To characterize these distinct phases, we employ density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) simulations alongside large-scale diagonalization. We analyze appropriate order parameters, along with features of the entanglement spectrum and dynamical spectral functions. In limiting cases, the observed transitions can be understood by mapping the dipole conserving model onto effective XXZ models in a restricted Hilbert space of composite spins.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）模拟”和“大规模对角化”等计算方法，并进行了理论映射分析。；研究对象：一维自旋链中偶极子守恒（fractonic约束）与伊辛型相互作用之间的竞争，以及由此产生的基态相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管存在阻止单个自旋激发的运动学约束（fractonic约束），系统仍能稳定一个反铁磁偶极有序基态（自旋对层面的有序）。通过改变伊辛相互作用的强度与符号，系统可发生从偶极有序相到传统自旋反铁磁相或铁磁相的相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管存在阻止单个自旋激发的运动学约束（fractonic约束），系统仍能稳定一个反铁磁偶极有序基态（自旋对层面的有序）。通过改变伊辛相互作用的强度与符号，系统可发生从偶极有序相到传统自旋反铁磁相或铁磁相的相变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）模拟和大规模精确对角化方法。通过分析合适的序参量、纠缠谱和动力学谱函数来表征不同相。在极限情况下，通过将偶极守恒模型映射到复合自旋的限制希尔伯特空间中的有效XXZ模型来理解相变。

papers.title: Octahedral Tilting in Halide Double Perovskites: Disentangling Lone-Pair Chemistry and Geometric Effects
papers.abstract: Halide double perovskites (HDPs) have emerged as promising alternatives to their lead-based counterparts. However, their structural dynamics is less explored than that of conventional halide perovskites. In this work, we investigate octahedral tilting at 0 K and the relative stability of tetragonal and cubic phases of a set of 57 halide double perovskites (HDPs). By combining structural and energetic descriptors with simple geometric metrics, we identify the main trends controlling the stabilization of one-tilt tetragonal phases across this family. We find that both the magnitude of the tilt angles and the energetic preference for tilted phases correlate primarily with the Goldschmidt tolerance factor $t$. The presence of stereochemically active lone-pair cations also correlates with enhanced tilting; however, this trend largely reflects that lone-pair chemistries in HDPs occur together with ionic sizes that shift $t$ away from unity. Consistent with this picture, we observe several compounds without lone pairs that nonetheless exhibit strong octahedral tilting. Finally, using machine-learned interatomic potentials, we connect the 0 K tilting energetics to finite-temperature behavior: compounds with more strongly stabilized tilt phases exhibit higher transition temperatures, and phonon spectra at 350 K reveal soft and broad modes that are consistent with the trends in tolerance factors, tilt angles, and tilt energies at 0 K. Our results provide a systematic reference for structure-stability relationships in HDPs and clarify when lone-pair chemistry is correlated with, rather than the primary cause of, octahedral tilting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“combining structural and energetic descriptors”、“machine-learned interatomic potentials”、“phonon spectra”等计算与理论分析手段，未涉及实验合成或测量。；研究对象：卤化物双钙钛矿（halide double perovskites, HDPs）中的八面体倾斜（octahedral tilting）现象，具体研究57种HDPs在0 K下的四方相与立方相的相对稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 八面体倾斜的角度大小及倾斜相的稳定化能主要与Goldschmidt容忍因子t相关；孤对电子阳离子的存在虽与增强倾斜相关，但这一趋势主要源于其离子尺寸使t偏离1，而非孤对电子化学本身是倾斜的主因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：八面体倾斜的角度大小及倾斜相的稳定化能主要与Goldschmidt容忍因子t相关；孤对电子阳离子的存在虽与增强倾斜相关，但这一趋势主要源于其离子尺寸使t偏离1，而非孤对电子化学本身是倾斜的主因。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合结构描述符、能量描述符与简单几何度量（如容忍因子t）进行趋势分析；利用机器学习原子间势（machine-learned interatomic potentials）连接0 K倾斜能量与有限温度行为，并计算350 K下的声子谱。

papers.title: Green's Function-Free Formalism of Projective Truncation Approximation
papers.abstract: In previous works, the projected truncation approximation (PTA) was developed as a systematic and controlled method to truncate the equation of motion of Green's functions (GFs) for a given quantum or classical many-body Hamiltonian. The static averages are obtained self-consistently with the GF through the spectral theorem. In this work, PTA is reformulated as a self-consistent theory for the reduced density matrices (RDMs) without reference to GF. We separately discuss the issues of determining the dynamical matrix ${\bf M}$ and solving the physical quantities from it. The properties of ${\bf M}$ is clarified and the solution of PTA equations is cast into an over-constrained optimization problem. This makes connection of the present theory to the variational RDM theory. We discuss various issues of PTA under this formalism, including the scheme of alternative inner product, the generalized virial theorem, the generalized Wick's theorem, and the static component problem of PTA.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formalism（形式理论）、self-consistent theory（自洽理论）、reformulated（重新表述）。；研究对象：多体量子或经典哈密顿量系统的约化密度矩阵（RDMs）与投影截断近似（PTA）理论。摘要未明确说明具体材料或体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将原本基于格林函数（GF）运动方程截断的投影截断近似（PTA）重新表述为一种不依赖格林函数、仅针对约化密度矩阵（RDMs）的自洽理论，并将PTA方程的求解转化为一个过约束优化问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将原本基于格林函数（GF）运动方程截断的投影截断近似（PTA）重新表述为一种不依赖格林函数、仅针对约化密度矩阵（RDMs）的自洽理论，并将PTA方程的求解转化为一个过约束优化问题。；创新点：首次将PTA从格林函数框架中解放出来，建立其与变分约化密度矩阵理论的联系，并澄清了动力学矩阵的性质及PTA方程的求解路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。具体包括：重新表述PTA为约化密度矩阵的自洽理论；讨论动力学矩阵M的性质；将PTA方程求解转化为过约束优化问题；并探讨了替代内积方案、广义维里定理、广义Wick定理及PTA静态分量问题。

papers.title: Charge Symmetry Beyond Wyckoff Equivalence
papers.abstract: Crystallographic symmetry is usually taken as a guide to electronic equivalence in crystals: atoms on the same Wyckoff position are expected to have the same charge, whereas atoms on different Wyckoff positions are expected to be electronically distinct. Here we show that both expectations can fail in oppo-site ways: crystallographically equivalent sites can become charge-inequivalent under compression, whereas crystallographically inequivalent sites can remain charge-equivalent at low pressure because of an emergent hidden symmetry. We develop a minimal Landau theory of pressure-induced charge transfer, in which compression enhances the intersite Coulomb energy gained by charge redistribution until it overcomes the onsite charging cost and destabilizes the charge-equivalent state. In BCC Na, all sites are charge-equivalent at low pressure, but compression drives charge transfer between neighboring sites, pro-ducing an electronically symmetry-broken CsCl-type state on an unchanged BCC ionic framework. In hP4 Na, the opposite anomaly occurs: two Na sites occupy distinct Wyckoff positions, yet remain charge-equivalent at low pressure because of an emergent gauge equivalence in the low-energy manifold, giving rise to near-Fermi doublets that appear accidental in conventional space-group analysis. Upon compres-sion, pressure-induced charge transfer breaks this hidden equivalence, splits the near-Fermi doublets, and drives a metal-insulator transition. These two complementary cases establish pressure-induced charge transfer as a mechanism by which electronic equivalence can either fall below or rise above what Wyckoff positions alone would suggest, showing that lattice symmetry constrains but does not uniquely determine the equivalence structure of the electronic state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Landau theory”“minimal Landau theory”“space-group analysis”等理论框架，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：压力诱导的电荷转移现象，以及由此导致的电子等价性偏离Wyckoff位置对称性的行为。具体材料为体心立方（BCC）Na和六方（hP4）Na。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在晶体中，Wyckoff位置相同的原子在压缩下可以变得电荷不等价，而Wyckoff位置不同的原子在低压下由于隐藏对称性可以保持电荷等价。压力诱导的电荷转移是导致电子等价性偏离晶格对称性预期的关键机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在晶体中，Wyckoff位置相同的原子在压缩下可以变得电荷不等价，而Wyckoff位置不同的原子在低压下由于隐藏对称性可以保持电荷等价。压力诱导的电荷转移是导致电子等价性偏离晶格对称性预期的关键机制。；创新点：揭示了电子等价性可以“低于”或“高于”Wyckoff位置所暗示的对称性，即晶格对称性约束但不唯一决定电子态的等价结构。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于最小Landau理论描述压力诱导的电荷转移，分析压缩如何增强电荷重分布带来的位点间库仑能，从而克服位点充电成本并失稳电荷等价态。结合空间群分析和能带结构讨论。

papers.title: Higher-order Weyl nodes driven by helical magnetic order in EuAgAs
papers.abstract: Magnetic topological semimetals provide a fertile ground for exploring how long-range magnetic order can alter electronic band structures and generate novel quasiparticles such as Weyl fermions. Here, we investigate the coupled magnetic and electronic structure of single-crystalline EuAgAs, a hexagonal pnictide whose magnetic ground state has remained elusive. Using neutron diffraction and resonant elastic X-ray scattering, we identify an unusual magnetic ordering sequence with two successive phase transitions at $T_\mathrm{N1} = 12$ K and $T_\mathrm{N2} = 8$ K. We observe two slightly different magnetic propagation vectors, one associated with $T_\mathrm{N1}$ and the other with $T_\mathrm{N2}$. Spherical neutron polarimetry reveals that the magnetic structure is a transverse helix aligned along the $c$ axis with a period that is approximately twice the $c$ lattice parameter. First-principles calculations for the helical phase predict subtle band folding effects and the emergence of effective higher-order Weyl nodes. These topological features appear near the calculated Fermi energy $E_{\mathrm{F}}$ which, however, lies above the position of $E_{\mathrm{F}}$ obtained from angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy so could not be probed in this study.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时使用了中子衍射、共振弹性X射线散射、球面中子极化测量等实验手段，以及第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。；研究对象：六方砷化物单晶 EuAgAs 的磁有序结构及其诱导的电子拓扑性质，具体关注其螺旋磁序与高阶外尔节点的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 EuAgAs 中观测到两次连续磁相变（TN1=12 K 和 TN2=8 K），磁结构为沿 c 轴的横向螺旋，周期约为 c 轴晶格常数的两倍；第一性原理计算预测该螺旋相中会出现能带折叠效应和有效的高阶外尔节点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 EuAgAs 中观测到两次连续磁相变（TN1=12 K 和 TN2=8 K），磁结构为沿 c 轴的横向螺旋，周期约为 c 轴晶格常数的两倍；第一性原理计算预测该螺旋相中会出现能带折叠效应和有效的高阶外尔节点。；创新点：首次确定了 EuAgAs 的磁基态为横向螺旋结构，并揭示了该螺旋磁序可驱动高阶外尔节点的产生。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 中子衍射（neutron diffraction）、共振弹性X射线散射（resonant elastic X-ray scattering）、球面中子极化测量（spherical neutron polarimetry）用于确定磁结构；第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）用于预测电子能带和拓扑特征；角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）用于测量费米能级位置。

papers.title: Cryogenically Enhanced Laser-Induced Amorphous Phase Transitions in Crystalline Silicon
papers.abstract: Amorphization of silicon is crucial to applications in photonics, microelectronics and solar cell technologies. Ultrafast lasers have been used to generate amorphous silicon from crystalline silicon using rapid nonthermal melting and solidification in room temperature. As material temperature can affect cooling rates significantly, adding temperature control in ultrafast laser modification of silicon may allow a new degree of freedom in ultrafast laser modification. In this work, we investigate the role of cryogenic temperature in governing ultrafast damage pathways via single-shot femtosecond laser irradiation of silicon from room temperature down to 24K at 1030nm. Across this temperature range, we observe a pronounced enhancement of amorphization at lower temperatures, revealed through optical microscopy, Raman spectroscopy, and Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM). Raman analysis identifies this ring as an amorphous surface layer, while complementary AFM and SEM imaging show temperature-dependent changes in surface morphology, including localized melt redistribution and refrozen material. To elucidate the physical origins of this behavior, we implement a carrier dependent two-temperature model (nTTM). The simulations reproduce the experimentally observed trends and indicate that reduced phonon population, modified absorption pathways, and altered lattice relaxation dynamics at cryogenic temperatures collectively promote amorphous freezing over recrystallization. This study represents the first detailed examination of silicon under ultrafast irradiation below the liquid-nitrogen regime and reveals temperature-governed mechanisms relevant for advanced silicon microstructuring.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验过程（单发飞秒激光辐照）、多种表征手段（光学显微镜、拉曼光谱、KPFM、AFM、SEM），并使用了理论模型（载流子依赖的双温模型，nTTM）来模拟和解释实验结果。；研究对象：单晶硅在低温（24K至室温）下的超快激光诱导非晶化相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温（24K）环境下，单晶硅在飞秒激光辐照后，其非晶化程度显著增强。低温通过减少声子数量、改变吸收路径和晶格弛豫动力学，共同促进了非晶态的冻结而非再结晶。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温（24K）环境下，单晶硅在飞秒激光辐照后，其非晶化程度显著增强。低温通过减少声子数量、改变吸收路径和晶格弛豫动力学，共同促进了非晶态的冻结而非再结晶。；创新点：这是首次详细研究硅在液氮温度（77K）以下（低至24K）的超快激光辐照行为，揭示了温度调控在超快激光诱导硅非晶化过程中的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，使用1030nm波长的单发飞秒激光辐照从室温到24K的单晶硅；表征手段包括光学显微镜、拉曼光谱、开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）、原子力显微镜（AFM）和扫描电子显微镜（SEM）。理论上，采用载流子依赖的双温模型（nTTM）进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Nearly perfect Fermi surface nesting in hole-doped La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ enables bulk superconductivity without pressure or strain
papers.abstract: The discovery of high-temperature superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates has drawn great attention. However, unlike cuprates and iron-based superconductors, Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates exhibit superconductivity either under high pressure in bulk samples or under compressive strain in thin films. Genuine bulk superconductivity under ambient pressure has remained elusive in these materials, precluding key measurements such as specific heat and superfluid density. In this work, we combine density-functional-theory, dynamical-mean-field-theory, and random-phase-approximation to solve the superconducting gap equation for bulk hole-doped bilayer nickelate La$_{3-x}$Sr$_x$Ni$_2$O$_7$ at ambient pressure. We find that hole doping induces a Ni-$d_{3z^2-r^2}$-derived $γ$ pocket on the Fermi surface, and serves as a tuning parameter for both its size and \textit{shape}. As $x$ approaches 0.4, the $γ$ pocket evolves from circular to diamond-shaped and expands to span half of the Brillouin zone, resulting in nearly perfect Fermi surface nesting with the optimal nesting vector $\textbf{Q} = (π, π)$. This, in turn, strongly enhances antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations and substantially increases the leading superconducting eigenvalue to a level at which superconductivity becomes experimentally observable. Our work provides both a robust mechanism and an experimentally feasible route to inducing the long-sought bulk superconductivity in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ without pressure or strain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。关键词：density-functional-theory, dynamical-mean-field-theory, random-phase-approximation, 求解超导能隙方程。；研究对象：空穴掺杂的双层镍氧化物 La₃₋ₓSrₓNi₂O₇ 在常压下的体超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在空穴掺杂浓度 x 接近 0.4 时，费米面上由 Ni-d₃z²⁻r² 轨道衍生的 γ 口袋演化为菱形并扩展至半个布里渊区，形成近乎完美的费米面嵌套，从而极大增强反铁磁自旋涨落，使超导特征值升高至实验可观测水平，实现常压下的体超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在空穴掺杂浓度 x 接近 0.4 时，费米面上由 Ni-d₃z²⁻r² 轨道衍生的 γ 口袋演化为菱形并扩展至半个布里渊区，形成近乎完美的费米面嵌套，从而极大增强反铁磁自旋涨落，使超导特征值升高至实验可观测水平，实现常压下的体超导电性。；创新点：提出了无需高压或应变、仅通过空穴掺杂即可在 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中实现常压体超导电性的可行实验路径，并揭示了费米面嵌套作为关键机制。
papers.method_zh: 结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、动力学平均场理论（DMFT）和随机相位近似（RPA），求解常压下体相空穴掺杂双层镍氧化物 La₃₋ₓSrₓNi₂O₇ 的超导能隙方程。

papers.title: Multi-mode Floquet NEGF method for driven quantum transport
papers.abstract: We present a non-perturbative Floquet-based non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) method to study electron transport in a quantum system driven simultaneously by multiple independent terms (multi-mode). We first derive the two-mode Floquet NEGF based on two-step transformations of the retarded-advanced Green's function from the Kadanoff-Baym equation. This derivation proceeds by elaborating on the expectation values of the number and current operators. The two-mode Floquet NEGF is then extended to cases with multiple drivings. The method is tested by investigating current suppression in the presence of two drivings. We show that an extra sinusoidal off-diagonal driving can cause substantial modification to the current suppression, provided careful selection of the driving frequency. Consequently, we expect that the established method has broad applications in a wide range of open quantum systems driven by complicated drivings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Floquet-based non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) method、non-perturbative、derivation。；研究对象：受多个独立驱动项（multi-mode）同时驱动的量子系统中的电子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种非微扰的多模Floquet非平衡格林函数方法，并发现额外正弦非对角驱动可在适当频率选择下显著改变电流抑制行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种非微扰的多模Floquet非平衡格林函数方法，并发现额外正弦非对角驱动可在适当频率选择下显著改变电流抑制行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Kadanoff-Baym方程，通过两步变换推导推迟-超前格林函数，建立双模Floquet NEGF方法，再推广至多驱动情形。

papers.title: Finite-temperature crossover from coherent magnons to energy superdiffusion in the PXP model
papers.abstract: The PXP chain was recently shown to exhibit superdiffusive energy transport with Kardar-Parisi-Zhang-like scaling, $z\approx3/2$, joining a growing number of spin chains with this exponent. An understanding of how this anomalous hydrodynamics emerges from microscopics is, however, still lacking. In this work, we show that finite-temperature energy transport in this model provides a window into the emergence of superdiffusion. At finite temperature, the energy autocorrelation function exhibits a crossover from short-time coherent dynamics to long-time hydrodynamics. The short-time behavior is dominated by a single magnon band and can be understood analytically. In momentum space, this regime is characterized by spectral weight near $q=π$. The damping time $τ$, which separates the short-time magnon-dominated behavior from the late-time hydrodynamics, grows rapidly upon cooling, consistent with an activated form $τ(β)\sim βe^{Δβ}$ with a gap scale set by the magnon band. At longer times, the spectral weight transfers to $q=0$ and the running decay exponent drifts toward the superdiffusive value $z=3/2$. Finite-temperature energy transport therefore provides a bridge between microscopic magnon physics and late-time superdiffusion in the PXP model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论理论分析、解析推导和数值模拟（如“可以解析理解”、“运行衰减指数漂移”），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：PXP模型中的有限温度能量输运现象，特别是从相干磁子到超扩散行为的交叉。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在PXP链中，有限温度能量输运呈现从短时相干磁子动力学到长时超扩散（z≈3/2）的交叉行为，且阻尼时间随冷却呈激活形式增长，从而将微观磁子物理与宏观超扩散联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在PXP链中，有限温度能量输运呈现从短时相干磁子动力学到长时超扩散（z≈3/2）的交叉行为，且阻尼时间随冷却呈激活形式增长，从而将微观磁子物理与宏观超扩散联系起来。；创新点：揭示了PXP模型中有限温度能量输运如何从微观磁子动力学逐步演化为长时超扩散，提供了连接微观机制与反常水动力学的桥梁。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析推导（如单磁子能带分析）、数值计算（如能量自关联函数、动量空间谱权重分析、衰减指数提取）。

papers.title: Frequency-dependent stress response under thermal cycle: A thermal-crystal plasticity and dynamic mode decomposition study
papers.abstract: Thermal cycle environments involving repeated temperature changes are common conditions observed in modern engineering processes. Under such conditions, materials undergo repeated thermal expansion and contraction, forming complex thermal stress fields. Thermal-crystal plasticity simulations that account for stress fields and thermal conduction at the polycrystalline microstructure scale are an effective method for numerically reproducing thermal cycle environments. However, the influence of thermal cycle frequency on the temporal behavior of the stress field and plastic response has not yet been fully understood, partly because a systematic analysis method capable of simultaneously capturing spatial heterogeneity and temporal evolution remains limited. In this study, we predicted the thermal stress field generated under different thermal cycle frequencies using thermal-crystal plasticity simulations and investigated the effect of frequency on the spatiotemporal structure of the stress response. The present framework illustrates that the resulting thermal-mechanical response can be represented as a superposition of multiple effective temporal components, reflecting the increased complexity of the system behavior. By employing dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) as a diagnostic and post-processing technique, we demonstrate that the spatiotemporal structure of the stress field under thermal cycle conditions can be systematically extracted and compactly represented. This approach enables a quantitative characterization of frequency-dependent changes in the thermal stress response beyond conventional averaging or snapshot-based analyses. The results highlight the utility of DMD as a framework for organizing complex simulation data and for interpreting the temporal structure of plastic response under cyclic thermal loading.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“thermal-crystal plasticity simulations”（热-晶体塑性模拟）、“dynamic mode decomposition”（动态模式分解），属于数值模拟与数据分析方法。；研究对象：多晶材料在热循环环境下的热应力场与塑性响应，具体关注热循环频率对应力时空行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热循环频率显著影响应力场的时空结构，该热-力学响应可表示为多个有效时间分量的叠加，系统行为随频率变化而复杂化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热循环频率显著影响应力场的时空结构，该热-力学响应可表示为多个有效时间分量的叠加，系统行为随频率变化而复杂化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：首次将动态模式分解（DMD）应用于热循环条件下的热-晶体塑性模拟数据，实现了对频率依赖的应力响应时空结构的定量表征，超越了传统的平均或快照分析方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用热-晶体塑性模拟（thermal-crystal plasticity simulations）预测不同频率下的热应力场，并结合动态模式分解（DMD）作为诊断和后处理技术，系统提取并紧凑表示应力场的时空结构。

papers.title: Non-Bloch Quantum Geometry of Non-Hermitian Systems
papers.abstract: We formulate quantum geometry for non-Hermitian systems under open boundary conditions. By defining quantum-geometric quantities in both real-space and non-Bloch representations, we establish a unified framework beyond conventional Bloch band theory. Our central result is an exact equivalence between the real-space integrated quantum metric and a non-Bloch integrated quantum metric defined on the generalized Brillouin zone. We further introduce localized non-Bloch Wannier functions in the presence of the non-Hermitian skin effect and show that the non-Bloch integrated quantum metric gives the gauge-invariant part of their spread functional. These results establish quantum geometry as a natural framework for characterizing open-boundary non-Hermitian band structures and the localization properties encoded in skin modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formulate、define、establish、introduce、show。；研究对象：非厄米系统在开边界条件下的量子几何性质，特别是非布洛赫量子几何。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了实空间积分量子度量与非布洛赫积分量子度量之间的精确等价关系，并证明非布洛赫积分量子度量给出了局域化非布洛赫Wannier函数展宽泛函的规范不变部分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了实空间积分量子度量与非布洛赫积分量子度量之间的精确等价关系，并证明非布洛赫积分量子度量给出了局域化非布洛赫Wannier函数展宽泛函的规范不变部分。；创新点：将量子几何框架拓展至开边界非厄米系统，揭示了非布洛赫量子度量与趋肤模局域化性质之间的内在联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：在实空间和非布洛赫表示中分别定义量子几何量，基于广义布里渊区建立统一框架，并引入非布洛赫Wannier函数分析非厄米趋肤效应。

papers.title: Harnessing hidden quantum metric response in a 2D magnet via nonlocal photovoltaic effect
papers.abstract: The quantum geometry of Bloch wavefunctions underpins a wealth of emergent phenomena in quantum materials. Its imaginary part, the Berry curvature, has long been recognized as a key source for hallmark effects such as quantum Hall and topological phenomena, etc. The real part of quantum geometry, the quantum metric, has recently garnered considerable attention due to predictions of a range of unconventional nonlinear and nonequilibrium responses. Such responses usually vanish in centrosymmetric systems, largely restricting relevant studies to non-centrosymmetric materials. Here we challenge this convention by revealing that the vanished quantum metric response can survive in a hidden form. Using a non-local photovoltaic scheme in a layered magnetic semiconductor, we spatially separate mutually compensating photocurrents and thereby detect such hidden quantum metric response. We demonstrate this effect across distinct magnetic states and down to the ultrathin limit. Moreover, we realize reconfigurable, nonvolatile and probabilistic photodetection enabled by the quantum metric response. These results not only fundamentally expand the material landscape for quantum geometric physics, but also open new gateway to harvest the quantum geometric contributions for state-of-the-art nonvolatile reprogrammable sensing and computing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“使用非局域光伏方案”（Using a non-local photovoltaic scheme）、“在层状磁性半导体中”（in a layered magnetic semiconductor）、“实现可重构、非易失性和概率性光电探测”（realize reconfigurable, nonvolatile and probabilistic photodetection），这些均为实验性描述。；研究对象：二维磁性半导体中的量子度规响应（quantum metric response），具体表现为非局域光伏效应（nonlocal photovoltaic effect）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作发现，在中心对称体系中本应消失的量子度规响应，可以通过非局域光伏方案以“隐藏”形式存在并被探测到。这一效应在不同磁态和超薄极限下均能被观察到，并可用于实现可重构、非易失性的概率性光电探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作发现，在中心对称体系中本应消失的量子度规响应，可以通过非局域光伏方案以“隐藏”形式存在并被探测到。这一效应在不同磁态和超薄极限下均能被观察到，并可用于实现可重构、非易失性的概率性光电探测。；创新点：挑战了“量子度规响应在中心对称体系中消失”的传统认知，揭示了其可以“隐藏”形式存在，并通过非局域测量方案将其提取出来。这极大地扩展了量子几何物理研究的材料范围（不再局限于非中心对称材料），并为基于量子几何贡献的非易失性可重构传感与计算应用开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用非局域光伏测量方案（non-local photovoltaic scheme），在层状磁性半导体中空间分离相互补偿的光电流，从而探测隐藏的量子度规响应。

papers.title: Transconductance as a Probe of Valley Thermodynamics in Multilayer WSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Transconductance is a central figure of merit in field-effect transistors, typically governed by charge accumulation and carrier mobility. In multilayer WSe$_2$ transistors, however, it is shown to carry a nonlinear transport signature of inter-valley carrier redistribution between the $K$ and $Γ$ valleys. This valley-crossover contribution suppresses transconductance in bilayer WSe$_2$ and reverses sign in trilayer, while remaining absent in single-valley systems. Unlike extrinsic mechanisms such as trap-state filling or contact resistance, the anomaly leaves the subthreshold swing unchanged and cannot be reproduced within conventional single-valley transport models. Introducing the valley susceptibility $χ_v \equiv \partial f_Γ/\partial V_{\rm GS}$, bounded by an intrinsic thermodynamic limit $(4k_BT)^{-1}$, we quantify this response and show that it reaches ${\sim}0.20\,\mathrm{V}^{-1}$ in bilayer WSe$_2$ near threshold at room temperature. The sign, magnitude, and temperature dependence of the anomaly provide directly measurable fingerprints of valley thermodynamics, establishing transconductance as an electrical probe of internal electronic degrees of freedom and revealing a previously hidden nonlinear response in standard transistor measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了在多层WSe₂晶体管中观测到的非线性输运特征，并给出了具体的实验测量结果（如跨导符号反转、亚阈值摆幅不变等）。；研究对象：多层WSe₂晶体管中的谷热力学，具体研究K谷与Γ谷之间的载流子重新分布对跨导的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 跨导在多层WSe₂晶体管中表现出由K谷与Γ谷间载流子重新分布引起的非线性输运特征，该特征在双层WSe₂中抑制跨导，在三层中使跨导符号反转，而在单谷体系中不存在。这一异常现象可作为谷热力学的电学探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：跨导在多层WSe₂晶体管中表现出由K谷与Γ谷间载流子重新分布引起的非线性输运特征，该特征在双层WSe₂中抑制跨导，在三层中使跨导符号反转，而在单谷体系中不存在。这一异常现象可作为谷热力学的电学探针。；创新点：首次将跨导这一标准晶体管性能指标发展为探测内部电子自由度（谷自由度）的热力学探针，揭示了传统单谷输运模型无法解释的隐藏非线性响应，并建立了可直接测量的谷热力学指纹（符号、大小、温度依赖性）。
papers.method_zh: 通过测量场效应晶体管的跨导（transconductance）作为栅极电压的函数，分析其非线性行为；引入谷磁化率χ_v ≡ ∂f_Γ/∂V_GS，并利用其热力学极限(4k_BT)^{-1}来量化谷间响应。

papers.title: The Thermodynamic Costs of Simple Linear Regression
papers.abstract: The construction of models from data is a significant contributor to the energetic costs of computation. Because of this, understanding how foundational thermodynamic bounds apply to modeling algorithms will be increasingly important. Here, we study the thermodynamic costs of a basic and fundamental modeling algorithm: simple linear regression. Following Landauer, we approximate the thermodynamic lower bound on irreversibly performing both exact linear regression and linear regression via stochastic gradient descent as implemented on floating-point numbers. From this, we derive energycost aware scaling laws for the optimal dataset size for training a linear regression model given a generalization error dependent demand for inference. Additionally, we discuss a method to lower bound the entropy production from the mismatch cost for algorithms with continuous input variables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic lower bound、Landauer、entropy production、mismatch cost。；研究对象：简单线性回归算法（simple linear regression）及其实现（包括精确回归和随机梯度下降）的热力学成本。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了在浮点数实现下，精确线性回归与随机梯度下降线性回归的不可逆操作的热力学下界，并给出了在给定泛化误差需求下，训练线性回归模型的最优数据集规模的能耗感知标度律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了在浮点数实现下，精确线性回归与随机梯度下降线性回归的不可逆操作的热力学下界，并给出了在给定泛化误差需求下，训练线性回归模型的最优数据集规模的能耗感知标度律。；创新点：将Landauer热力学下界应用于具体的机器学习算法（简单线性回归），并建立了能耗与数据集规模、泛化误差需求之间的标度关系。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于Landauer原理，对浮点数上实现的精确线性回归和随机梯度下降线性回归的不可逆操作进行热力学下界近似；并讨论了针对连续输入变量算法，从失配成本（mismatch cost）出发对熵产生进行下界估计的方法。

papers.title: Mass Generation from Embedding Geometry in Surface Nematics
papers.abstract: We show that a nematic field constrained to a curved embedded surface develops an emergent geometric mass in its leading isotropic interaction sector. An auxiliary embedding-space closure mediated by the surface spin connection yields a massive scalar mode \(χ_n\) with mass set by the extrinsic curvature invariant \(m^2=K_{ab}K^{ab}\). This mass arises directly from embedding geometry, promoting the intrinsic massless nematic interaction into a geometry-controlled massive field. The resulting theory identifies Gaussian curvature as a distributed geometric charge and establishes embedding geometry as the regulator of defect interactions on curved nematic membranes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We show、theory、identifies。；研究对象：曲面向列相薄膜（curved nematic membranes）中由嵌入几何诱导的质量生成现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 约束在弯曲嵌入曲面上的向列场，在其各向同性相互作用主导区段中会产生一个由外曲率不变量 \(m^2=K_{ab}K^{ab}\) 决定质量的标量模式 \(\chi_n\)，从而将原本无质量的向列相互作用转变为几何调控的有质量场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：约束在弯曲嵌入曲面上的向列场，在其各向同性相互作用主导区段中会产生一个由外曲率不变量 \(m^2=K_{ab}K^{ab}\) 决定质量的标量模式 \(\chi_n\)，从而将原本无质量的向列相互作用转变为几何调控的有质量场。；创新点：首次揭示嵌入几何本身（而非传统Higgs机制或自发对称性破缺）可直接作为向列场质量的来源，并将高斯曲率重新解释为分布式的几何电荷。摘要未突出说明与已有曲面向列相模型的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过曲面自旋联络（spin connection）引入辅助嵌入空间闭包条件，推导出几何质量项，并利用高斯曲率作为分布几何电荷来识别缺陷相互作用。

papers.title: Activation Functions, Statistics and Learning of Higher-Order Interactions in Restricted Boltzmann Machines
papers.abstract: The great success of neural networks in recognizing hidden patterns and correlations in complex data lies in the way they take advantage of the large number of parameters and nonlinear single-unit activation, jointly. Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) provide a simple yet powerful framework for studying the impact of activation nonlinearities on performance and representation. In this work, we exploit the duality between RBMs and models of interacting binary variables to study the statistics of the interactions induced by RBM ensembles with different hidden unit activation functions. We characterize the space of representable models analytically in terms of moments of the distribution of induced interactions for four commonly used activation functions: Linear, Step, ReLU, and Exponential. Quantitative predictions of the analytical calculations on learning show a very good agreement with results of the simulations of the training process. In particular, our analysis shows that there are certain data structures, namely those generated by models of interacting variables with large interaction terms beyond pairwise, that are difficult to represent, and thus to learn, for any RBM. Yet, we find that rapidly increasing nonlinearities, such as the Exponential function, can facilitate the representation and learning of such data structures for a specific range of parameters that is determined analytically.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：duality、analytical calculations、statistics of interactions、representable models）；研究对象：受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）中由不同隐藏单元激活函数诱导的高阶相互作用的统计特性与学习能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 存在某些由大相互作用项（超越两体）的相互作用变量模型生成的数据结构，对任何RBM都难以表示和学习；但快速增强的非线性激活函数（如指数函数）可在特定参数范围内促进此类数据结构的表示与学习。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：存在某些由大相互作用项（超越两体）的相互作用变量模型生成的数据结构，对任何RBM都难以表示和学习；但快速增强的非线性激活函数（如指数函数）可在特定参数范围内促进此类数据结构的表示与学习。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用RBM与相互作用二元变量模型之间的对偶性，对四种常用激活函数（线性、阶跃、ReLU、指数）诱导的相互作用分布矩进行解析表征，并通过模拟训练过程验证解析预测。

papers.title: Electronic and Magnonic Properties of $g$-Wave Altermagnetism in Intercalated Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism is a recently identified class of magnetic order characterized by unconventional momentum-dependent spin splitting in the absence of net magnetization, and understanding its electronic and magnetic properties is essential for revealing its fundamental physics and potential applications. In this work we investigate two intercalated transition-metal dichalcogenides, Fe$_{1/4}$NbS$_2$ and V$_{1/3}$NbS$_2$, as candidate altermagnetic materials by using effective tight-binding and spin models complemented by first-principles calculations. We show that the $g$-wave electronic spin splitting originates from bond-dependent hopping anisotropy, leading to material-dependent nodal structures. For the magnetic excitations, the emergence of chiral splitting in the magnon dispersion is controlled by single-ion anisotropy, which manifests as altermagnetic-like nodal structures when spins are oriented along an easy-axis. Conversely, this altermagnetic signature disappears when the spins are aligned in an easy-plane. Beyond linear spin-wave theory, we find that $1/S$ corrections from magnon--magnon interactions preserve the symmetry and nodal structure of the band splitting while generally reducing its magnitude, with strong antiferromagnetic exchange leading to a non-negligible renormalization of the chiral splitting. Our findings establish intercalated transition-metal dichalcogenides as promising platforms for understanding the interplay between crystal symmetry, non-relativistic spin splitting, and magnetic properties in altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。依据：摘要中明确提到使用了“有效紧束缚模型和自旋模型，并辅以第一性原理计算”。；研究对象：插层过渡金属二硫属化物（TMDs）中的g波交变磁性（altermagnetism），具体材料为Fe$_{1/4}$NbS$_2$和V$_{1/3}$NbS$_2$。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Fe$_{1/4}$NbS$_2$和V$_{1/3}$NbS$_2$中，g波电子自旋劈裂源于键依赖的跳跃各向异性，而磁子色散中的手性劈裂则由单离子各向异性控制，且该交变磁性特征在易面磁化时消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Fe$_{1/4}$NbS$_2$和V$_{1/3}$NbS$_2$中，g波电子自旋劈裂源于键依赖的跳跃各向异性，而磁子色散中的手性劈裂则由单离子各向异性控制，且该交变磁性特征在易面磁化时消失。；创新点：首次在插层过渡金属二硫属化物中系统研究了g波交变磁性的电子和磁子性质，揭示了键依赖跳跃各向异性与单离子各向异性分别对电子和磁子能带劈裂的不同作用机制，并考虑了超越线性自旋波理论的磁子相互作用修正。
papers.method_zh: 有效紧束缚模型、自旋模型、第一性原理计算、线性自旋波理论、1/S微扰修正（考虑磁子-磁子相互作用）。

papers.title: Atomistic Modeling of Chemical Disorder in Materials: Bridging Classical Methods and AI-Assisted Approaches
papers.abstract: Chemical disorder, originating from the mixed occupation of crystallographic sites by multiple elements, is widespread in alloys, ceramics, and compositionally complex materials, where short- and long-range orderings can strongly influence properties. A central obstacle is the representation gap between experiments and simulations: experiments often report disorder as partial occupancies and ensemble-averaged behaviors, whereas atomistic simulations and AI workflows usually require fully specified configurations. Tackling this gap requires computational methods that convert averaged disorder descriptions into representative configurational ensembles while balancing cost, bias, and fidelity. This challenge has become more urgent in AI-driven computational discovery, where ignoring disorder may cause AI workflows to misrank stability, misjudge novelty, and misdirect experiments with too-idealized representations. This Review highlights how classical and AI-driven methods can bridge this representation gap. We assess the strengths and limitations of approaches spanning mean-field theories, cluster expansion, quasi-random approximations, Monte Carlo, and emerging schemes powered by universal interatomic potentials and generative models.
