We further highlight how AI can accelerate classical computational schemes by lowering the cost of microstate evaluation, configurational exploration, and atomistic-to-thermodynamic closure. We also emphasize how AI can enable disorder-native capabilities, including workflow triage, ordering-sensitive and alchemical representations, generative models of disordered structures and distributions, and kinetics-aware disorder prediction. Together, this framework outlines a practical roadmap toward disorder-native AI, which can transform chemical disorder from a representational obstacle into a controllable variable for realistic AI-accelerated materials discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（混合类型）。判断依据关键词：atomistic modeling, computational methods, AI-driven methods, Review。；研究对象：化学无序（chemical disorder）材料，包括合金、陶瓷和成分复杂材料中的短程与长程有序现象，以及如何将实验中的平均无序描述转化为原子模拟所需的确定构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 化学无序在实验与模拟之间存在“表征鸿沟”，而经典方法（如平均场理论、团簇展开、准随机近似、蒙特卡洛）与新兴AI方法（通用原子间势、生成模型）可以协同填补这一鸿沟，使无序从表征障碍转变为可控变量，加速真实材料的AI驱动发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：化学无序在实验与模拟之间存在“表征鸿沟”，而经典方法（如平均场理论、团簇展开、准随机近似、蒙特卡洛）与新兴AI方法（通用原子间势、生成模型）可以协同填补这一鸿沟，使无序从表征障碍转变为可控变量，加速真实材料的AI驱动发现。；创新点：系统性地提出了“无序原生AI”（disorder-native AI）的路线图，强调AI不仅能加速经典计算（如降低微观态评估成本、构型探索、原子-热力学闭合），还能实现无序原生能力（工作流分类、有序敏感与炼金术表示、无序结构与分布的生成模型、动力学感知无序预测），从而将化学无序从表征障碍转变为可控变量。
papers.method_zh: 综述了多种计算方法：平均场理论、团簇展开、准随机近似、蒙特卡洛模拟，以及AI辅助方法（通用原子间势、生成模型、有序敏感表示、动力学感知无序预测等）。

papers.title: The analysis of heat capacity of MnGe metallic helimagnet
papers.abstract: Zero-field heat capacity of metallic helimagnet MnGe was analyzed based on the results of resistivity decomposition published previously by our group for the same crystal. Current procedure allowed identifying along with ($i$) electronic ($\tildeγ$ $\approx$ 7 mJ/mol$\cdot$K$^2$) and ($ii$) phononic ($Θ_D$ $\approx$ 350 K) components ($iii$) the additional term, caused by the presence of spin fluctuations (SFs). The last contribution was found to exist in a wide range of temperatures in both paramagnetic (PM) and magnetically ordered states. However, its amplitude appears to be significantly lower in comparison with phononic component. The obtained value of spin fluctuation temperature $θ_{sf}$(MnGe) $\approx$ 330 K correlates well with previous estimations, as well as with results of various experiments, which predict the existence of SFs in MnGe at least up to 250 $-$ 300 K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：对零场热容数据进行分析，并引用此前课题组对同一晶体的电阻率分解结果。；研究对象：金属螺旋磁体MnGe的热容，特别是其自旋涨落（SFs）对热容的贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MnGe的零场热容中，除了电子和声子贡献外，还存在一个由自旋涨落引起的额外项。该自旋涨落贡献在顺磁态和磁有序态的宽温区内均存在，但其幅度显著低于声子贡献。自旋涨落温度θ_sf(MnGe) ≈ 330 K，与先前估算及多种实验预测（自旋涨落至少存在至250-300 K）吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MnGe的零场热容中，除了电子和声子贡献外，还存在一个由自旋涨落引起的额外项。该自旋涨落贡献在顺磁态和磁有序态的宽温区内均存在，但其幅度显著低于声子贡献。自旋涨落温度θ_sf(MnGe) ≈ 330 K，与先前估算及多种实验预测（自旋涨落至少存在至250-300 K）吻合良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于此前课题组对同一晶体的电阻率分解结果，对零场热容数据进行分解分析，识别出电子项（~7 mJ/mol·K²）、声子项（德拜温度Θ_D ≈ 350 K）以及自旋涨落项。

papers.title: Banded non-Hermitian random matrices, neural networks, and eigenvalue degeneracies
papers.abstract: We study two-banded, non-Hermitian random matrices inspired by sparse neural networks with a circular, 1d topology. We focus on two paradigmatic models, an SSH chain and a ladder model, which have both non-Hermitian directional bias and random sign disorder in the hoppings. The random sign disorder, which follows Dale's Law, leads to localization of the eigenstates, while the directional bias drives a delocalization transition in these states. The competition between disorder and directional bias results in rich eigenspectra with loops of extended states in the complex plane surrounded by regions of localized ones, and the eigenvalues are all confined to an annular region. Furthermore, the distinct band structures of the SSH chain and ladder model lead to different delocalization phenomena. Even in the absence of disorder, tuning the directional bias can lead to an eigenvalue degeneracy, which is an exceptional point for the SSH chain but a diabolic point for the ladder. In the presence of the disorder, these special eigenvalue degeneracies are preserved and also highlight key stages in the delocalization process. For both models, increasing the directional bias initially delocalizes states starting from within the bands. For the SSH chain, for large enough directional bias, the delocalized states open up a hole in the spectrum in the complex plane, similar to prior results for single band systems. But for the ladder model, as the directional bias is increased, the states delocalize in two stages, leading to two separate loops of extended states with localized states in between. The precise contours on which the extended states reside can be predicted from the Lyapunov exponents associated with products of random transfer matrices, in agreement with direct numerical diagonalization. Although we focus on periodic boundaries, results are discussed for open boundaries as well.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：随机矩阵、数值对角化、Lyapunov指数、转移矩阵乘积。；研究对象：受稀疏神经网络启发的双带非厄米随机矩阵模型，具体包括具有一维环形拓扑的SSH链和梯子模型，研究其本征态局域化与退局域化转变、复平面能谱结构以及本征值简并现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随机符号无序（遵循Dale定律）导致本征态局域化，而方向性偏置驱动退局域化转变，两者竞争产生丰富的复平面能谱结构（如扩展态环与局域态区域交替出现）；SSH链和梯子模型因能带结构不同，表现出不同的退局域化行为，且方向性偏置可导致本征值简并（SSH链为异常点，梯子模型为二重点）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随机符号无序（遵循Dale定律）导致本征态局域化，而方向性偏置驱动退局域化转变，两者竞争产生丰富的复平面能谱结构（如扩展态环与局域态区域交替出现）；SSH链和梯子模型因能带结构不同，表现出不同的退局域化行为，且方向性偏置可导致本征值简并（SSH链为异常点，梯子模型为二重点）。；创新点：将神经网络中Dale定律（符号固定）引入非厄米随机矩阵，系统研究了双带系统中无序与方向性偏置的竞争，揭示了梯子模型特有的两阶段退局域化过程及双环扩展态结构，并区分了SSH链与梯子模型中本征值简并点的不同拓扑性质（异常点 vs. 二重点）。
papers.method_zh: 采用非厄米随机矩阵理论，结合随机转移矩阵乘积的Lyapunov指数分析，并通过直接数值对角化验证；模型基于稀疏神经网络的一维环形拓扑，引入满足Dale定律的随机符号无序和方向性偏置。

papers.title: Hidden weak-pairing superconductivity of non-interacting anyons obeying $\frac{1}{3}$ statistics
papers.abstract: We show that a non-interacting gas of charge-$e/3$ anyons with exchange statistics $θ=-π/3$ can superconduct through a hidden weak-pairing mechanism. Such an anyon gas arises naturally in doped fractional Chern insulators at filling $1/3$ or $2/3$, where projective lattice translations enforce three degenerate anyon pockets. Exploiting this three-pocket structure, we develop a flux-attachment construction in which the average statistical flux vanishes, thereby mapping the problem to three species of composite fermions (CFs) in zero effective magnetic field. We show that the anyon statistics itself, encoded in statistical gauge field fluctuations, supplies the pairing glue and drives the CFs into a $p-\mathrm{i}p$ paired state, which corresponds to a $f-\mathrm{i}f$ physical superconductor. The CF strong-pairing phase is adiabatically connected to Laughlin's picture of anyon superconductivity, where charge-$e/3$ anyons bind into charge-$2e/3$ molecules, which then lead to superconductivity. By contrast, the more natural weak-pairing phase of CFs realizes a distinct superconducting phase - its edge is characterized by a chiral central charge $c_-=-1/2$, in contrast to the prediction of integer $c_-$ for the anyon superconductor based on Laughlin's picture, thereby resolving the discrepancy between previous theories and recent numerical results. Our theory provides a natural framework for understanding superconductivity near fractional Chern insulators, as observed in recent experiments. Finally, we discuss extensions of our theory that predict new chiral superconductors adjacent to FCIs at other fillings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“我们证明”、“我们发展”、“我们展示”等理论推导和构造性语言，没有提及任何实验数据或数值模拟结果。；研究对象：论文研究的是服从 $1/3$ 交换统计（即统计角 $\theta=-\pi/3$）的非相互作用任意子气体，以及由此产生的超导态。具体体系是掺杂的分数陈绝缘体（FCI）在填充因子 $1/3$ 或 $2/3$ 时的任意子气体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，服从 $1/3$ 统计的非相互作用任意子气体可以通过一种“隐藏的弱配对机制”实现超导。该超导态的边缘具有手征中心荷 $c_-=-1/2$，这与基于Laughlin图像的传统任意子超导理论预测的整数 $c_-$ 不同，从而解决了理论与近期数值结果之间的分歧。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，服从 $1/3$ 统计的非相互作用任意子气体可以通过一种“隐藏的弱配对机制”实现超导。该超导态的边缘具有手征中心荷 $c_-=-1/2$，这与基于Laughlin图像的传统任意子超导理论预测的整数 $c_-$ 不同，从而解决了理论与近期数值结果之间的分歧。；创新点：论文的主要创新点在于：1）揭示了非相互作用任意子气体中隐藏的弱配对超导机制，并建立了与复合费米子图像的严格映射。2）预言了该超导态具有非整数的边缘手征中心荷 $c_-=-1/2$，这为区分其与基于Laughlin图像的传统任意子超导体提供了关键特征，并解释了理论与数值结果的矛盾。
papers.method_zh: 论文采用了一种通量附着（flux-attachment）的构造方法。通过利用由投影晶格平移对称性导致的三个简并任意子口袋结构，使得平均统计通量为零，从而将问题映射为三种复合费米子（CFs）在零有效磁场下的问题。论文进一步证明，任意子统计本身（编码在统计规范场涨落中）提供了配对胶水，驱动复合费米子进入 $p-\mathrm{i}p$ 配对态。

papers.title: Work to insert a particle into an active fluid
papers.abstract: The chemical potential is defined as the work to quasi-statically add a particle to an equilibrium system. Inspired by this definition, we investigate how the work to add a particle to an active fluid depends on the activity, density, and insertion protocol. We find that the average work is protocol dependent and decreases with activity. Moreover, the work fluctuations retain asymmetric non-Gaussian tails even for slow particle insertions. We then compare the average particle-insertion work to the steady-state densities observed when two active fluids are brought into diffusive contact and observe opposing trends between density and work.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate、compare、protocol dependent、work fluctuations）；研究对象：活性流体（active fluid）中插入一个粒子所需的功，以及该功与活性、密度和插入协议的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平均插入功依赖于插入协议，并随活性增加而减小；即使缓慢插入，功的涨落仍保留非对称的非高斯尾部。此外，将两种活性流体置于扩散接触时，稳态密度与平均插入功之间呈现相反趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平均插入功依赖于插入协议，并随活性增加而减小；即使缓慢插入，功的涨落仍保留非对称的非高斯尾部。此外，将两种活性流体置于扩散接触时，稳态密度与平均插入功之间呈现相反趋势。；创新点：将平衡态化学势的定义推广到活性流体，揭示了活性对插入功及其涨落的影响，并发现密度与功之间的非单调关系。
papers.method_zh: 通过定义类似于平衡态化学势的准静态插入功，对活性流体进行理论分析，比较不同插入协议下的平均功与涨落，并与扩散接触下的稳态密度进行对比。

papers.title: Optical control of conductivity type and valley polarization via persistent photoconductivity in (Pb,Sn)Se quantum wells
papers.abstract: The ability to tune the Fermi level of semiconductors is at the heart of modern electronics. Here, we demonstrate that persistent photoconductivity (PPC) enables tuning of carrier density, conductivity type, and, consequently, the valley polarization in (Pb,Sn)Se/(Pb,Eu)Se quantum wells. Illumination of these samples induces Fermi level shifts that convert the system from a threefold-degenerate $\bar{M}$-valley two-dimensional hole gas to a single $\barΓ$-valley-polarized electron gas with similar values of mobility. The optically induced state persists for more than $10^{3}$ minutes at cryogenic temperatures and enables stepwise optical gating without the need for device processing. These transitions are confirmed by the sign inversion of the Hall slope and the modification of quantum Hall plateau degeneracies measured in magnetic fields up to 35 T. Landau level $k\cdot p$ model calculations quantitatively reproduce the experimental data. Furthermore, studies of weak-field magnetoresistance demonstrate the significance of quantum localization phenomena at the transition between the weakly and strongly localized regimes in compensated narrow-gap semiconductors. Spectral studies allow us to identify the critical role of the barrier material and determine the photon energies that can reverse the PPC effect. The persistent light-induced upward shift of the Fermi level in the $p$-type quantum well is explained in terms of specific energy positions of donor and acceptor defect states in the studied system. Our results demonstrate that PPC is a powerful optical gating tool for the IV-VI quantum wells, a versatile platform for reconfigurable valleytronic architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：persistent photoconductivity、Hall slope sign inversion、quantum Hall plateau、magnetoresistance、spectral studies）；研究对象：(Pb,Sn)Se/(Pb,Eu)Se量子阱中的持续光电导效应、载流子类型与谷极化的光学调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过持续光电导效应，可在(Pb,Sn)Se量子阱中实现从三重简并M-谷二维空穴气到单一Γ-谷极化电子气的可逆转变，且光致状态在低温下可保持超过1000分钟，从而实现无需器件加工的光学门控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过持续光电导效应，可在(Pb,Sn)Se量子阱中实现从三重简并M-谷二维空穴气到单一Γ-谷极化电子气的可逆转变，且光致状态在低温下可保持超过1000分钟，从而实现无需器件加工的光学门控。；创新点：首次在IV-VI族量子阱中利用持续光电导效应实现载流子类型和谷极化的光学调控，并展示了其作为可重构谷电子学平台的光学门控潜力。摘要未突出说明与以往光学调控方法的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延生长量子阱样品；强磁场（最高35 T）下的霍尔效应与量子霍尔平台测量；弱场磁阻研究量子局域化现象；光谱学实验确定光子能量对PPC效应的反转作用；Landau能级k·p模型计算定量拟合实验数据。

papers.title: First-passage processes in a deterministic one-dimensional cellular automaton model of traffic flow
papers.abstract: We present analytical results for first-passage processes in a deterministic one-dimensional cellular automaton (CA) model of traffic flow. Starting at time $t=0$ from a random initial state with car density p, at every time step $t\ge 1$ each car moves one step to the right if the cell on its right is empty, and is stopped if it is occupied by another car. The model, which coincides with CA rule 184 in Wolfram's numbering scheme, exhibits a continuous dynamical phase transition at $p=1/2$, between a low-density free-flowing phase and a high-density congested phase. Using the framework of first-passage processes, we derive a closed-form expression for the distribution $P(T_{FS}=t)$ of first-stopping (FS) times, which is the probability that a randomly selected car will be stopped for the first time at time $t$. We also obtain a closed-form expression for the stopping probability $P_S(t)$, which is the probability that a randomly selected car will be stopped at time $t$. In the low-density phase of $0<p<1/2$, the probability $P_S(t)$ yields a closed-form expression for the distribution $P(T_{LS}=t)$ of last-stopping (LS) times, which is the probability that a randomly selected car will be stopped for the last time at time $t$, beyond which it will move freely indefinitely. In this regime, we analyze the relation between the LS time and the number of stopping events $N_S$ which take place up to that time. We present closed-form expressions for the joint distribution $P(T_{LS}=t,N_S=n)$, for the two conditional distributions that emanate from it and for the marginal distribution $P(N_S=n)$. These results provide insight on the time scales of congestion and relaxation in deterministic traffic flow from the point of view of individual cars. In a broader context, they provide insight on complex relaxation processes that involve many interacting particles, such as deterministic surface growth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical results、closed-form expression、framework of first-passage processes。；研究对象：确定性一维元胞自动机交通流模型（CA rule 184），具体研究该模型中单个车辆的首次停车时间、末次停车时间及停车事件数的统计分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低密度自由流相（0<p<1/2）和高密度拥堵相（p>1/2）中，分别推导出了首次停车时间分布、停车概率以及末次停车时间分布的闭式表达式，揭示了确定性交通流中个体车辆层面的拥堵与松弛时间尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低密度自由流相（0<p<1/2）和高密度拥堵相（p>1/2）中，分别推导出了首次停车时间分布、停车概率以及末次停车时间分布的闭式表达式，揭示了确定性交通流中个体车辆层面的拥堵与松弛时间尺度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用首次通过过程（first-passage processes）理论框架，对确定性一维元胞自动机（CA rule 184）进行解析分析，推导出多个概率分布的闭式表达式。

papers.title: Deconfined Boundary Phase Transition of a Quantum Critical Heisenberg Model
papers.abstract: We investigate the boundary phases of a (2+1)-dimensional quantum critical Heisenberg model with a dangling spin chain. By introducing a multispin $Q$-term along the boundary, we drive a continuous boundary transition from an antiferromagnetic (AF) order to a valence-bond solid (VBS) order. Using large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we locate the critical point at $Q_{c}=0.310(11)$, and obtain the critical exponents at $Q_{c}$, including $y_{s}=0.81(4)$ and the scaling dimensions of AF and VBS order parameters $Δ_{s}=0.660(15)$ and $Δ_{v}=0.204(14)$. The weak long-range AF order for $Q<Q_{c}$ is stabilized by quasi-long-range effective interactions mediated by the critical bulk state, while the VBS phase restores the ordinary critical behavior. Our findings highlight the synergy between topological terms and quasi-long-range interactions in low-dimensional quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations、critical exponents、scaling dimensions）；研究对象：一个(2+1)维量子临界海森堡模型，其边界悬挂有一条自旋链，并引入多自旋Q项驱动边界相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入边界多自旋Q项，驱动了从反铁磁（AF）序到价键固体（VBS）序的连续边界相变；弱长程AF序由临界体态介导的准长程有效相互作用稳定，而VBS相则恢复普通临界行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入边界多自旋Q项，驱动了从反铁磁（AF）序到价键固体（VBS）序的连续边界相变；弱长程AF序由临界体态介导的准长程有效相互作用稳定，而VBS相则恢复普通临界行为。；创新点：揭示了拓扑项与准长程相互作用在低维量子多体系统中的协同效应，具体表现为边界临界行为由体态临界性通过准长程有效相互作用调控。
papers.method_zh: 大规模量子蒙特卡洛模拟（large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations），用于定位临界点Q_c=0.310(11)并提取临界指数（y_s=0.81(4)）以及AF和VBS序参量的标度维数（Δ_s=0.660(15)，Δ_v=0.204(14)）。

papers.title: Collective charge measurement in quantum dot chains: controlling barrier occupation and tunneling current
papers.abstract: We investigate nonequilibrium transport in a triple-quantum-dot (TQD) system, where the central dot acts as a discrete tunnel barrier, subject to continuous monitoring by a quantum point contact (QPC) that is capacitively coupled to all three dots with independently tunable strengths. We show that this global measurement scheme affects transport in a qualitatively distinct manner from single-site measurement. By engineering structured dephasing, measurement provides a significant improvement in the barrier occupation and tunneling current. In the strong-measurement limit, the steady state becomes independent of the underlying Hamiltonian parameters, and the barrier occupation can approach 1/2 for suitable measurement configurations. We identify an optimal measurement configuration that maximizes the steady-state current and show that near-optimal performance can be achieved with a simple central-dot readout scheme.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate（理论研究）、steady state（稳态分析）、measurement scheme（测量方案设计）。；研究对象：三量子点（TQD）系统，其中中心量子点作为离散隧穿势垒，所有三个量子点均与一个量子点接触（QPC）电容耦合，且耦合强度可独立调节。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 全局测量方案（同时监测三个量子点）对输运的影响与单点测量有本质区别；通过设计结构化退相干，测量可显著改善势垒占据数和隧穿电流，且在强测量极限下稳态与哈密顿量参数无关，势垒占据数可接近1/2。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：全局测量方案（同时监测三个量子点）对输运的影响与单点测量有本质区别；通过设计结构化退相干，测量可显著改善势垒占据数和隧穿电流，且在强测量极限下稳态与哈密顿量参数无关，势垒占据数可接近1/2。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于量子点接触（QPC）连续监测的全局测量方案，通过调节各量子点与QPC的电容耦合强度来工程化退相干，研究非平衡输运的稳态性质。

papers.title: Non-Gaussianity of random quantum states
papers.abstract: We study the fermionic non-Gaussianity in typical quantum states, focusing on Haar random states of qubits with or without a global $U(1)$ symmetry. Using the Weingarten calculus, we derive analytical predictions for the non-Gaussianity, defined as the relative entropy between the reduced density matrix and its Gaussianized counterpart. We identify two regimes controlled by the ratio between the subsystem and the system size, $\ell/L$. For $\ell/L < 1/2$, the non-Gaussianity vanishes in the absence of symmetries, because typical reduced density matrices are exponentially close to the maximally mixed state. In the presence of a global $U(1)$ symmetry, instead, it remains small but finite. By contrast, in the regime $\ell/L > 1/2$, the non-Gaussianity becomes extensive. These results establish the typical scaling of fermionic non-Gaussianity in random states and analyze how this is modified by the presence of global symmetries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Weingarten calculus、analytical predictions、relative entropy。；研究对象：随机量子态（Haar随机态）中的费米子非高斯性，包括有无全局U(1)对称性的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 费米子非高斯性的大小由子系统与系统尺寸之比ℓ/L控制：当ℓ/L < 1/2时，无对称性下非高斯性消失（因约化密度矩阵指数接近最大混合态），有U(1)对称性时非高斯性虽小但有限；当ℓ/L > 1/2时，非高斯性变为广延量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：费米子非高斯性的大小由子系统与系统尺寸之比ℓ/L控制：当ℓ/L < 1/2时，无对称性下非高斯性消失（因约化密度矩阵指数接近最大混合态），有U(1)对称性时非高斯性虽小但有限；当ℓ/L > 1/2时，非高斯性变为广延量。；创新点：首次建立了随机态中费米子非高斯性的典型标度行为，并揭示了全局对称性如何修改这一标度。
papers.method_zh: 利用Weingarten微积分对Haar随机态进行解析推导，以相对熵（约化密度矩阵与其高斯化版本之间的相对熵）定义非高斯性。

papers.title: Magnetic phases in the $J_{1}$-$J_{2}$ antiferromagnetic XY model on the honeycomb lattice
papers.abstract: We study ground-state properties and phase diagram of the $J_{1}$-$J_{2}$ antiferromagnetic XY model on the honeycomb lattice by means of the developed corner transfer matrix renormalization group algorithm with the two-site unit cell and the infinite spiral projected entangled pair states ansatz. We identify the main phases: Néel, Ising, collinear, and incommensurate spiral phases, as well as the transitions between them, as functions of the ratio $J_{2}/J_{1}$. In the regime of competing types of ordering, we show that the energies of the dimerized states are systematically higher than the energies in the collinear phase. This collinear phase transforms to the incommensurate spiral phase through the second-order phase transition upon a further increase of $J_2/J_1$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：corner transfer matrix renormalization group algorithm（角转移矩阵重正化群算法）、infinite spiral projected entangled pair states ansatz（无限螺旋投影纠缠对态变分法）。；研究对象：蜂窝晶格上的 $J_{1}$-$J_{2}$ 反铁磁 XY 模型，具体研究其基态性质与相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定了该模型的主要磁相（Néel相、Ising相、共线相和非公度螺旋相）以及随 $J_{2}/J_{1}$ 比值变化的相变过程；发现二聚化态的能量始终高于共线相，且共线相通过二级相变转变为非公度螺旋相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定了该模型的主要磁相（Néel相、Ising相、共线相和非公度螺旋相）以及随 $J_{2}/J_{1}$ 比值变化的相变过程；发现二聚化态的能量始终高于共线相，且共线相通过二级相变转变为非公度螺旋相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用双位点单胞的角转移矩阵重正化群算法（CTMRG）和无限螺旋投影纠缠对态（iPEPs）变分法进行数值计算。

papers.title: Signatures of Gaussian superconducting fluctuations in nonlocal noise magnetometry
papers.abstract: We calculate the two-point magnetic noise spectrum arising from Gaussian superconducting fluctuations, a quantity directly measurable by spin qubit pairs such as nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond. The analysis utilizes the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory, reflecting the direct contribution of fluctuating Cooper pairs to the current correlations and consequent magnetic noise. We treat both two-dimensional systems and wires, considering them in equilibrium and under a uniform electric field. The signal is expected to be strongest in high-temperature superconductors, and we contrast our findings with the predicted signatures of a vortex liquid to offer an additional route to elucidate the nature of fluctuations in these systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“计算”“分析”“利用”等理论推导词汇，未提及实验数据或样品制备。；研究对象：高斯型超导涨落产生的两点磁噪声谱，具体针对二维系统和纳米线，并考虑平衡态及均匀电场下的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过含时金兹堡-朗道理论计算发现，超导涨落导致的库珀对电流关联会直接贡献可测量的磁噪声信号，该信号在高温超导体中最强，且与涡旋液体的特征信号不同，为区分超导涨落本质提供了新途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过含时金兹堡-朗道理论计算发现，超导涨落导致的库珀对电流关联会直接贡献可测量的磁噪声信号，该信号在高温超导体中最强，且与涡旋液体的特征信号不同，为区分超导涨落本质提供了新途径。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 含时金兹堡-朗道理论（TDGL），用于计算电流关联函数及由此产生的两点磁噪声谱。

papers.title: Generalized Hydrodynamics of Bloch Oscillations in the Absence of a Lattice
papers.abstract: Objects subjected to a constant force generally increase their velocity over time. This expectation fails whenever their energy is a smooth and periodic function of momentum, resulting in periodic Bloch oscillations instead. Periodic dispersions, typical of lattice systems, can also emerge in continuum media through strong interactions. Here, we study the phenomenon of such Bloch oscillations in the absence of a lattice in a paradigmatic model of integrable quantum gases: the two-component Yang-Gaudin model. We derive a generalized-hydrodynamic theory of Bloch oscillations for a finite density of impurities embedded in a homogeneous interacting background, which we show to persist superimposed to a drift due to the acceleration of the center of mass. Moreover, we show the single-impurity oscillation period is renormalized at finite impurity density when two-magnon bound states are populated. Our results are relevant for ultracold atom experiments, where impurities can be created at controllable densities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive a generalized-hydrodynamic theory”（推导广义流体动力学理论），属于理论推导，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：研究在无晶格条件下出现的布洛赫振荡现象，具体体系为可积量子气体中的双组分Yang-Gaudin模型，关注有限密度杂质在均匀相互作用背景中的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无晶格的连续介质中，强相互作用可导致类似晶格系统的周期性色散关系，从而产生布洛赫振荡；该振荡叠加在质心加速引起的漂移之上，且单杂质振荡周期在有限杂质密度下因双磁子束缚态的出现而发生重整化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无晶格的连续介质中，强相互作用可导致类似晶格系统的周期性色散关系，从而产生布洛赫振荡；该振荡叠加在质心加速引起的漂移之上，且单杂质振荡周期在有限杂质密度下因双磁子束缚态的出现而发生重整化。；创新点：首次在无晶格的连续可积量子气体中建立布洛赫振荡的广义流体动力学理论，并揭示了有限杂质密度下双磁子束缚态对振荡周期的重整化效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义流体动力学（Generalized Hydrodynamics）理论框架，对双组分Yang-Gaudin模型中的布洛赫振荡进行解析推导。

papers.title: Imaging stripe dynamics in trilayer nickelate La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$
papers.abstract: Since the discovery of high-temperature superconductivity in nickelate superconductors, it is an open question how closely the superconducting state resembles that of cuprate superconductors. One salient feature of the phase diagram of the high-temperature cuprate superconductors is stripe order. Despite their prevalence, real-space imaging has been limited to the charge sector. Here we use spin-polarised scanning tunnelling microscopy to visualize the local magnetic and charge distribution emerging due to a stripe order in the trilayer nickelate La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$. The stripe order exhibits a four unit cell periodicity, closely resembling that seen in cuprates, and opens a near-complete $\sim66\mathrm{meV}$ gap at the Fermi level. Crucially, discrete phase slips can be triggered by tunneling electrons above a $\sim 20\mathrm{meV}$ threshold, allowing imaging of stripe dynamics at the atomic scale. These results highlight the importance of correlation physics driving stripe-like orders in lanthanum nickelates with striking similarities to the cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了spin-polarised scanning tunnelling microscopy（自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜）进行实验观测。；研究对象：三层镍氧化物La₄Ni₃O₁₀中的条纹序（stripe order）及其动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在La₄Ni₃O₁₀中观测到与铜氧化物超导体高度相似的四倍晶胞周期条纹序，该条纹序在费米能级处打开约66 meV的近完全能隙，且可通过隧穿电子在约20 meV阈值以上触发离散的相位滑移，实现原子尺度的条纹动力学成像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在La₄Ni₃O₁₀中观测到与铜氧化物超导体高度相似的四倍晶胞周期条纹序，该条纹序在费米能级处打开约66 meV的近完全能隙，且可通过隧穿电子在约20 meV阈值以上触发离散的相位滑移，实现原子尺度的条纹动力学成像。；创新点：首次在实空间中对镍氧化物中的条纹序进行自旋分辨成像，并实现了对条纹动力学（离散相位滑移）的原子尺度观测，揭示了与铜氧化物超导体在条纹序方面的显著相似性。
papers.method_zh: 自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜（spin-polarised STM），用于同时成像局域磁性和电荷分布。

papers.title: Detecting vortex motion through spatially correlated nonequilibrium noise
papers.abstract: Resistive transport near a superconducting phase can arise from the motion of normal-state quasiparticles or that of vortices. The conductivity alone does not distinguish between these mechanisms. We propose an unambiguous method for telling them apart, using the recently developed experimental tool of covariance magnetometry, which uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to probe real-time spatiotemporal correlations in magnetic noise. Our key insight is that, under an applied current, the underlying charge carriers leave a directional fingerprint in the spatially correlated magnetic noise above the sample: ordinary electric carriers drift parallel to the current, whereas vortices, owing to the Magnus force, drift perpendicular to it. The noise covariance detects this anisotropy and identifies the vortex-driven nature of transport. We compute the noise correlations expected for a representative thin-film superconductor and demonstrate that the anisotropic signal is well within the reach of current experimental capabilities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose an unambiguous method, compute the noise correlations, demonstrate）；研究对象：超导态附近电阻输运中涡旋运动与正常态准粒子运动的区分，具体针对薄膜超导体中的磁噪声空间关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量样品上方空间关联磁噪声的各向异性（涡旋因马格努斯力垂直于电流漂移，而正常载流子平行于电流漂移），可明确区分电阻输运是由涡旋运动还是正常态准粒子运动导致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量样品上方空间关联磁噪声的各向异性（涡旋因马格努斯力垂直于电流漂移，而正常载流子平行于电流漂移），可明确区分电阻输运是由涡旋运动还是正常态准粒子运动导致。；创新点：利用协方差磁测量技术探测实时空间关联磁噪声的各向异性，首次提出通过噪声协方差的方向性指纹来区分涡旋与正常载流子对输运的贡献。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算与数值模拟：基于金刚石氮-空位（NV）中心实现的协方差磁测量技术，计算代表性薄膜超导体在施加电流下的磁噪声空间关联函数。

papers.title: Stochastic trajectories and excursions in a double quantum dot system
papers.abstract: We investigate the trajectory-level dynamics of a double quantum dot system using the newly developed formalism of stochastic excursions. This approach extends full counting statistics by enabling a filtering of complex trajectories into sub-trajectories, which provide access to the intricate correlations between thermodynamic currents and excursion times. Counting observables are the main object of study in the stochastic excursion framework. Those are defined as a linear combination of transition counts multiplied by their assigned weights within one excursion. For three main counting observables -- charge current, dynamical activity, and entropy production -- we compute averages and noise contributions and show how they provide insights into the operation of the double quantum dot system. At the trajectory level, we analyze outcome distributions for transport and connect the results with trade-offs between successful and unsuccessful events that shape overall performance. We further introduce state observables, which depend on the state visited rather than the transition itself, and discuss the population of the two dots, as well as their correlations. Finally, we discuss thermodynamics of precision through thermo-kinetic uncertainty relations, showing how current precision in different regimes is fundamentally constrained either by entropy production or by dynamical activity. Altogether, our work is a case study that highlights the utility of the excursion framework as a toolkit to analyze many quantities of interest and to uncover the structure of nonequilibrium fluctuations. Moreover, it also suggests new avenues for refining uncertainty relations and understanding transport in mesoscopic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stochastic excursions formalism、full counting statistics、trajectory-level dynamics。；研究对象：双量子点系统中的随机轨迹与子轨迹动力学，具体涉及电荷输运、动力学活性和熵产生等热力学量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用随机游走框架，通过分析电荷电流、动力学活性和熵产生等计数可观测量在子轨迹中的平均值与噪声，揭示了双量子点系统中成功与失败事件之间的权衡关系，并发现电流精度在不同参数区域分别受熵产生或动力学活性的基本约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用随机游走框架，通过分析电荷电流、动力学活性和熵产生等计数可观测量在子轨迹中的平均值与噪声，揭示了双量子点系统中成功与失败事件之间的权衡关系，并发现电流精度在不同参数区域分别受熵产生或动力学活性的基本约束。；创新点：将随机游走框架系统应用于双量子点系统，实现了对复杂轨迹的过滤与子轨迹分析，从而揭示热力学流与游走时间之间的精细关联，并展示了该框架在细化不确定关系和理解介观系统输运中的新应用潜力。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机游走（stochastic excursions）形式论，对完整计数统计进行子轨迹过滤，计算计数可观测量（如电荷电流、动力学活性、熵产生）的平均值与噪声，并引入状态可观测量（如双点占据数及其关联），同时结合热力学-动力学不确定关系分析精度约束。

papers.title: Interpretable Computer Vision for Defect Detection in X-ray Tomography of Aerospace SiC/SiC Composites
papers.abstract: Non-destructive testing of aerospace SiC/SiC composites via X-ray computed tomography (XCT) relies on expert visual assessment, with current workflows offering limited traceability for accept/reject decisions. Deep convolutional networks can automate defect detection, yet their black-box nature conflicts with the transparency that industrial inspection practice demands. To close this gap, we introduce p-ResNet-50, a convolutional framework extended with a prototype layer that couples high detection accuracy with case-based explanations. Six learned prototypes are explicitly aligned with expert-defined semantic categories-healthy matrix, matrix--air interfaces, pores, line-like defects, and mixed morphologies-so that every classification is traceable to a physically meaningful reference. Two novel regularisation terms, anchor-based and medoid-based, tether prototypes to expert-selected patches and prevent prototype collapse, addressing a known limitation of prototype networks. Latent-space analysis via UMAP delineates semantically coherent sub-domains and maps zones of uncertainty where misclassifications concentrate, giving inspectors an explicit picture of where the model is-and is not-reliable. The framework is validated on an XCT patch dataset of approximately 12,000 patches extracted from four defect-rich SiC/SiC laboratory specimens. Taking a black-box ResNet-50 as a baseline (ROC-AUC = 0.991), the prototype extension achieves comparable performance (accuracy 0.957 vs. 0.959; ROC-AUC 0.994 vs. 0.993) while trading a slight reduction in sensitivity for higher precision and specificity. Each decision is backed by representative evidence patches, and the model explicitly flags its uncertainty regions. Beyond defect mapping, the framework establishes a reusable methodology for embedding domain-expert knowledge into prototype networks, applicable to other XCT inspection scenarios requiring traceable, auditable decisions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：实验部分涉及X射线计算机断层扫描（XCT）实验数据采集；计算部分涉及深度学习卷积网络（p-ResNet-50）的构建、训练与验证。；研究对象：航空用SiC/SiC复合材料中的缺陷检测。具体物理现象为利用XCT图像识别材料内部的孔隙、线状缺陷、基体-空气界面等微观结构特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入原型层（prototype layer）的卷积神经网络p-ResNet-50，在保持与黑箱模型（ResNet-50）相当的高检测精度（ROC-AUC约0.99）的同时，实现了可解释的缺陷检测，每个分类决策都能追溯到物理上有意义的参考图像块。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入原型层（prototype layer）的卷积神经网络p-ResNet-50，在保持与黑箱模型（ResNet-50）相当的高检测精度（ROC-AUC约0.99）的同时，实现了可解释的缺陷检测，每个分类决策都能追溯到物理上有意义的参考图像块。；创新点：1. 将原型网络（prototype network）应用于工业XCT缺陷检测，解决了深度学习黑箱特性与工业检测透明度要求之间的矛盾。2. 提出了两种新的正则化项（anchor-based和medoid-based），有效解决了原型网络中常见的原型坍缩问题，并将学习到的六个原型与专家定义的语义类别（如健康基体、孔隙等）显式对齐。3. 通过UMAP潜在空间分析，明确标定了模型可靠与不可靠的区域，为检测结果提供了不确定性量化。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用深度卷积神经网络（p-ResNet-50），该网络在标准ResNet-50架构基础上扩展了一个原型层。训练中引入了两种新的正则化项（anchor-based和medoid-based）来锚定原型并防止原型坍缩。使用UMAP进行潜在空间分析以描绘语义子域和不确定性区域。数据集为从四个富含缺陷的实验室SiC/SiC试样中提取的约12,000个XCT图像块。

papers.title: Concurrent enforcement of polyconvexity and true-stress-true-strain monotonicity in incompressible isotropic hyperelasticity: application to neural network constitutive models
papers.abstract: The design of physics-augmented neural networks (PANNs) for the purposes of constitutive modeling has received considerable attention as of late for a variety of material behaviors. Here, we revisit the classical framework of isotropic incompressible hyperelasticity in light of recent advances in the study of constitutive inequalities. We show that polyconvexity implies true-stress-true-strain monotonicity for a large class of incompressible strain-energy functions. The resulting elastic law obeys the physically reasonable Legendre-Hadamard (or ellipticity) condition as well as the notion of increasing stress with increasing strain. These results then inform the architecture of four distinct PANNs which are subsequently calibrated to three different sets of experimental data each. We show that different PANN parametrizations - satisfying the same constitutive constraints a priori - have varying approximation power for the description of material behavior. Moreover, even when distinct parametrizations perform comparatively well within the calibration regime, they show pronounced differences in extrapolation. This observation motivates a critical discussion about the predictive power of PANNs which also has implications for the modeling of more complex material behavior by virtue of neural networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：constitutive inequalities, polyconvexity, neural network constitutive models）；研究对象：不可压缩各向同性超弹性材料，以及用于本构建模的物理增强神经网络（PANNs）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于一大类不可压缩应变能函数，多凸性（polyconvexity）蕴含真应力-真应变单调性，从而同时满足Legendre-Hadamard条件（椭圆性）和应力随应变增加的性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于一大类不可压缩应变能函数，多凸性（polyconvexity）蕴含真应力-真应变单调性，从而同时满足Legendre-Hadamard条件（椭圆性）和应力随应变增加的性质。；创新点：将多凸性与真应力-真应变单调性之间的蕴含关系严格证明，并系统比较了满足相同先验约束的不同PANN参数化形式在材料行为描述中的逼近能力与外推预测差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（基于经典超弹性框架与不等式约束分析），并结合四种不同架构的物理增强神经网络（PANNs）进行数值校准与实验数据拟合。

papers.title: Stringy T-duality on the lattice and the twisted Villain model
papers.abstract: We address the question of whether dualities formulated in continuum field theory can be realised exactly at finite lattice spacing, rather than only emerging in the infrared. In this context, we construct a lattice framework for a genuinely stringy form of T-duality. We extend the exact lattice T-duality of the compact boson to curved backgrounds with non-trivial circle fibrations, where the duality is no longer exhausted by the familiar exchange of momentum and winding, but also involves global topological data. To this end, we define the twisted Villain model, which couples the lattice fibre field to cochains encoding the bundle connection and the fibre-horizontal component of the $B$-field. We realise this structure in lattice models for several fibred backgrounds and recover the characteristic bundle-flux exchange of T-duality. Using a half-gauging procedure, we derive the associated lattice defect action and show that it defines a topological defect. This establishes that the distinctive topological features of T-duality on curved manifolds can be captured exactly in a lattice model, implying that this duality is not tied to a particular continuum representation is present in lattice-regularised models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lattice framework、duality、topological defect、half-gauging procedure。；研究对象：格点规范理论中的弦论T-对偶性，具体研究具有非平凡圆纤维丛的弯曲背景（如纤维化流形）上的格点模型，以及与之相关的扭曲Villain模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了格点上的弦论T-对偶框架，证明在弯曲背景中T-对偶不仅涉及动量与缠绕模式的交换，还包含全局拓扑数据（如丛通量交换），并且这些拓扑特征可以在有限格点间距下精确实现，而非仅出现在红外极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了格点上的弦论T-对偶框架，证明在弯曲背景中T-对偶不仅涉及动量与缠绕模式的交换，还包含全局拓扑数据（如丛通量交换），并且这些拓扑特征可以在有限格点间距下精确实现，而非仅出现在红外极限。；创新点：将紧致玻色子的精确格点T-对偶推广到具有非平凡圆纤维丛的弯曲背景，首次在格点模型中实现了弯曲流形上T-对偶的全局拓扑特征（如丛通量交换），表明该对偶性并非仅存在于连续场论表示中，而是可以在格点正则化模型中精确捕捉。
papers.method_zh: 采用格点场论方法，定义了扭曲Villain模型，将格点纤维场与表示丛联络和B场纤维-水平分量的上链耦合；通过半规范（half-gauging）过程推导格点缺陷作用量，并证明其定义了一个拓扑缺陷。

papers.title: Accelerated "on-the-fly" coupled-cluster path-integral molecular dynamics: Impact of nuclear quantum effects on an asymmetric proton
papers.abstract: We present an accelerated ``on-the-fly'' coupled-cluster path-integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) method for finite-temperature simulations in which electron correlation and nuclear quantum effects are treated simultaneously. The approach is based on our quantum ring-polymer contraction (qRPC) technique, in which the inexpensive Hartree-Fock potential is evaluated on the full ring-polymer, while the expensive coupled-cluster correction is evaluated on the centroid only. This qRPC decomposition is combined with a second-generation Car-Parrinello-like dynamics of the Hartree-Fock reference and a basis-consistent extrapolation of the coupled-cluster and de-excitation amplitudes. The combination of all three acceleration layers is essential for making correlated PIMD calculations feasible. We apply the method to a proton shared by water and formaldehyde. Relative to classical nuclei, nuclear quantum effects broaden covalent X--H bond-length distributions, reduce the bias of the shared proton toward formaldehyde, and shift the mean proton-transfer coordinate from 0.206 to 0.135A. The probability of finding the proton closer to formaldehyde decreases from 81.7$\%$ to 61.1$\%$. The corresponding nuclear magnetic shielding tensors show that electron correlation and nuclear quantum effects are of comparable magnitude and can act in opposite directions. These results demonstrate that predictive simulations of asymmetric hydrogen bonds require a simultaneous treatment of correlated electronic structure and nuclear quantum fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：coupled-cluster path-integral molecular dynamics (PIMD)、on-the-fly、finite-temperature simulations。；研究对象：不对称氢键体系，具体为水与甲醛共享的一个质子（proton shared by water and formaldehyde）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 核量子效应会显著改变不对称氢键中质子的分布：使共价X-H键长分布变宽，降低质子偏向甲醛的倾向，并将平均质子转移坐标从0.206 Å移至0.135 Å。电子关联与核量子效应大小相当且可能方向相反，因此必须同时处理才能实现预测性模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：核量子效应会显著改变不对称氢键中质子的分布：使共价X-H键长分布变宽，降低质子偏向甲醛的倾向，并将平均质子转移坐标从0.206 Å移至0.135 Å。电子关联与核量子效应大小相当且可能方向相反，因此必须同时处理才能实现预测性模拟。；创新点：通过结合qRPC、第二代类Car-Parrinello动力学和基组一致外推三层加速技术，首次使关联电子结构的路径积分分子动力学（PIMD）计算变得可行，从而能够同时处理电子关联和核量子效应对不对称氢键的影响。
papers.method_zh: 加速的“on-the-fly”耦合簇路径积分分子动力学（PIMD）方法。具体包含三层加速技术：量子环聚合物收缩（qRPC）技术（在完整环聚合物上计算廉价Hartree-Fock势，仅在质心上计算昂贵耦合簇修正）、第二代类Car-Parrinello动力学处理Hartree-Fock参考态、以及基组一致的耦合簇与退激发振幅外推。

papers.title: Spin Hall effect and Berry curvature of gravitons from quantum field theory
papers.abstract: Based on quantum field theory of linearized gravity, we formulate the Wigner function for right- and left-handed gravitons. By applying the Wigner transformation to the second-order metric perturbations in the graviton energy-momentum tensor obtained from the Einstein-Hilbert action, we demonstrate the emergence of the spin Hall effect of gravitons in curved spacetime. This effect originates from the Berry curvature of gravitons, which has opposite signs for right- and left-handed helicities, and leads to a helicity-dependent splitting of the graviton energy Hall current. The magnitude of this splitting is found to be exactly twice that of the corresponding spin Hall current for photons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum field theory, Wigner function, formulation, demonstrate。；研究对象：引力子的自旋霍尔效应及其贝里曲率，具体为在弯曲时空中传播的右旋和左旋引力子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引力子在弯曲时空中会出现自旋霍尔效应，该效应源于引力子的贝里曲率，且引力子能量霍尔电流的自旋分裂幅度恰好是光子对应自旋霍尔电流的两倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引力子在弯曲时空中会出现自旋霍尔效应，该效应源于引力子的贝里曲率，且引力子能量霍尔电流的自旋分裂幅度恰好是光子对应自旋霍尔电流的两倍。；创新点：首次从量子场论框架出发，严格推导了引力子的自旋霍尔效应，并定量给出了其与光子自旋霍尔效应的倍数关系。
papers.method_zh: 基于线性化引力的量子场论，构建了右旋和左旋引力子的Wigner函数；通过对爱因斯坦-希尔伯特作用量导出的引力子能量-动量张量中的二阶度规扰动进行Wigner变换。

papers.title: Engineering Tunable Synthetic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Chains in Liquid Crystal Microcavities
papers.abstract: Optical microcavities have emerged as a powerful platform for emulating topological phases challenging to realize in conventional materials, offering precise control over dispersion, light confinement, and interactions. Among them, liquid crystal microcavities (LCMCs) offer exceptional tunability at room temperature, enabling voltage-controlled polarisation splitting, photonic spin-orbit coupling, and photonic potentials generated by self-assembled textures, such as cholesteric torons and uniform lying helix (ULH). Here, we design a LCMC hosting a dimerized ULH texture and show that the corresponding photonic potential describes two coupled Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chains with orthogonal linear polarisations, acting as an effective pseudospin degree of freedom. The applied voltage tunes the interchain coupling, enabling polarisation-dependent interactions. These results establish LCMCs as a versatile platform for tunable synthetic topological Hamiltonians.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：design、show、results establish，结合液晶微腔实验平台）；研究对象：液晶微腔中可调谐的合成Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链，具体为二聚化均匀躺卧螺旋（ULH）织构中的光子拓扑态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在液晶微腔中设计二聚化ULH织构，可构建两个正交线偏振耦合的SSH链，其有效赝自旋自由度由偏振态提供；外加电压可调控链间耦合，实现偏振依赖的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在液晶微腔中设计二聚化ULH织构，可构建两个正交线偏振耦合的SSH链，其有效赝自旋自由度由偏振态提供；外加电压可调控链间耦合，实现偏振依赖的相互作用。；创新点：首次在液晶微腔中实现可调谐的合成SSH链，并利用偏振作为赝自旋自由度，通过电压动态调控链间耦合，为构建可调谐合成拓扑哈密顿量提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验设计液晶微腔（LCMC），利用自组装织构（如胆甾相torons和ULH）产生光子势，通过电压控制偏振分裂、自旋-轨道耦合及光子势，并测量偏振依赖的耦合行为。

papers.title: Near-Field Vibrational Energy Transfer for Mid-Infrared Upconversion in Plasmonic Nanogaps
papers.abstract: Förster energy transfer underpins modern photonics, yet establishing an analogous vibrational pathway in the mid-infrared (MIR) remains highly challenging, as sub-picosecond intramolecular vibrational redistribution (IVR) suppresses intermolecular coupling. Here we demonstrate vibrational donor--acceptor transfer in the MIR and subsequent upconversion to visible luminescence enabled by sub-2 nm plasmonic nanogaps. The extreme lateral field confinement in metal--molecule--metal ring cavities defined by self-assembled molecular spacers couples efficiently to in-plane molecular dipoles. Continuous-wave MIR excitation selectively populates $-\mathrm{C}\equiv\mathrm{N}$ vibrational donors, and plasmon-enhanced near-field coupling transfers this energy to nearby electronic acceptors, generating anti-Stokes visible emission under low power densities. Upconversion efficiencies exceeding $0.3\%$ are observed, limited by competition between the plasmon-mediated transfer rate and IVR. These results show that extreme plasmonic confinement can redirect molecular vibrational relaxation pathways, opening a route toward vibrational nanophotonics, intermolecular interactions for bioimaging, and room-temperature MIR detection based on molecular degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体实验现象（如“连续波中红外激发选择性布居-C≡N振动供体”、“产生反斯托克斯可见发光”）和实验结构（“亚2纳米等离激元纳米间隙”、“金属-分子-金属环形腔”）。；研究对象：中红外波段分子间振动能量转移及上转换发光现象，具体体系为通过自组装分子间隔层定义的亚2纳米等离激元纳米间隙中的金属-分子-金属环形腔。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在亚2纳米等离激元纳米间隙中实现了中红外振动供体-受体能量转移，并随后上转换为可见发光，上转换效率超过0.3%。结果表明极端等离激元局域化可以重新定向分子振动弛豫路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在亚2纳米等离激元纳米间隙中实现了中红外振动供体-受体能量转移，并随后上转换为可见发光，上转换效率超过0.3%。结果表明极端等离激元局域化可以重新定向分子振动弛豫路径。；创新点：首次在中红外波段建立类似Förster能量转移的振动供体-受体路径，并利用亚2纳米等离激元纳米间隙克服亚皮秒分子内振动再分布（IVR）对分子间耦合的抑制，实现高效上转换。
papers.method_zh: 采用自组装分子间隔层构建亚2纳米金属-分子-金属环形腔，利用极端横向场局域效应；使用连续波中红外激发选择性布居-C≡N振动供体，通过等离激元增强近场耦合将能量转移至邻近电子受体，产生反斯托克斯可见发光。

papers.title: Universal logic gates for coupled period-doubling systems
papers.abstract: We propose a general architecture for universal logic operations using NAND and NOR gates on classical information encoded in period-doubled states of periodically-driven systems. The protocol involves applying a single pulse that simultaneously couple two input nodes with an output node. We show that the states of the nodes can be precisely controlled by tuning the coupling strength and pulse duration, allowing for robust logic gate operation. To highlight the universality of the protocol, we demonstrate its applicability on different systems, such as classical networks of dissi- pative parametric oscillators (DPO), quantum networks of Kerr parametric oscillators (KPO), and the periodically-driven open Dicke lattice model (DLM) emulating discrete time crystals (DTCs). We identify the parameter regimes in which the logic gate architecture is valid, and we showcase its robustness in the presence of fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出通用架构和协议，并通过理论分析展示其在不同系统（DPO、KPO、DLM）中的适用性，未提及实验实现或数值计算细节。；研究对象：周期倍增系统（period-doubling systems）中的经典信息逻辑门操作，具体包括耗散参量振荡器（DPO）经典网络、Kerr参量振荡器（KPO）量子网络以及模拟离散时间晶体（DTC）的周期驱动开放Dicke晶格模型（DLM）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节耦合强度和脉冲持续时间，可精确控制节点状态，实现基于NAND和NOR门的通用逻辑运算，且该架构在存在涨落时具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节耦合强度和脉冲持续时间，可精确控制节点状态，实现基于NAND和NOR门的通用逻辑运算，且该架构在存在涨落时具有鲁棒性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：提出一种通用协议，通过施加单脉冲同时耦合两个输入节点与一个输出节点，利用周期倍增态编码经典信息，并分析不同系统（DPO、KPO、DLM）中逻辑门有效的参数区间。

papers.title: Ultrafast Nano-Imaging and Optical Control of Hyperbolic Phonon Polaritons at hBN/WS$_2$ Heterojunctions
papers.abstract: Manipulating nanoscale light-matter interactions on ultrafast time scales is indispensable for future polaritonic devices. Hyperbolic phonon polaritons (HPhPs) in van der Waals materials enable deep subwavelength confinement of electromagnetic fields in the infrared region and long-distance propagation of polaritonic waves. However, achieving ultrafast imaging and optical control of HPhPs remains a major challenge. Here, we demonstrate the direct observation of transient modulation of HPhPs induced by local photocarrier generation in WS$_2$/hBN heterostructures using ultrafast infrared scanning near-field optical microscopy. We implement grating-based spectral filtering of broadband near-field scattering to simultaneously achieve nanoscale and femtosecond spatiotemporal resolution together with fine spectral selectivity. This ultrafast nano-imaging technique reveals that photocarriers in WS$_2$ modulate the polaritonic field amplitudes and wavelengths of HPhPs in hBN. Theoretical simulations corroborate that these changes arise from photoinduced changes in WS$_2$ dielectric properties. This approach offers a versatile platform for exploring ultrafast polaritonic dynamics at the nanoscale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、direct observation、ultrafast infrared scanning near-field optical microscopy。；研究对象：WS₂/hBN异质结中的双曲声子极化激元（HPhPs），具体研究光生载流子对hBN中HPhPs的瞬态调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用超快红外扫描近场光学显微镜，直接观测到WS₂中光生载流子对hBN中HPhPs的场振幅和波长的瞬态调制，证实该调制源于WS₂介电性质的光致变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用超快红外扫描近场光学显微镜，直接观测到WS₂中光生载流子对hBN中HPhPs的场振幅和波长的瞬态调制，证实该调制源于WS₂介电性质的光致变化。；创新点：首次实现HPhPs的超快成像与光学控制，并直接观测到异质结中光生载流子对HPhPs的瞬态调制。
papers.method_zh: 超快红外扫描近场光学显微镜（ultrafast infrared scanning near-field optical microscopy），结合基于光栅的宽带近场散射光谱滤波技术，实现纳米级空间分辨率、飞秒级时间分辨率及精细光谱选择性。

papers.title: Prebiotic magnetite enables chirality-magnetic surface feedback
papers.abstract: The emergence of biomolecular homochirality requires both an initial symmetry-breaking event and a mechanism to amplify and preserve a chiral imbalance. Magnetic minerals have been shown to function as chiral agents through the chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect and may have enabled homochirality on early Earth, yet the magnetic properties of magnetite formed under realistic prebiotic conditions remain unexplored. Here we show that magnetite synthesized through two geochemically plausible pathways - UV-driven photo-oxidation and nitrite-mediated oxidation of Fe(II) - produces particles dominated by single-vortex and multi-vortex magnetic domain states. Magnetic measurements and electron microscopy confirm that these populations differ markedly from the nano-fabricated thin-film substrates conventionally used in previous CISS experiments. Using 3D micromagnetic simulations, we demonstrate that single-domain and vortex-state grains undergo irreversible, exchange-driven re-magnetization when interacting with spin-polarized homochiral compounds. This magnetic irreversibility provides a robust mechanism for storing and reinforcing weak chiral bias, suggesting that prebiotic magnetite could have contributed to the emergence and stabilization of persistent chiral bias on the early Earth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。关键词：synthesized（合成）、magnetic measurements（磁性测量）、electron microscopy（电子显微镜）、3D micromagnetic simulations（三维微磁学模拟）。；研究对象：前生命条件下合成的磁铁矿（magnetite）及其与手性分子相互作用产生的磁性-手性表面反馈机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过两种地质化学途径合成的磁铁矿颗粒主要处于单涡旋和多涡旋磁畴态，这些颗粒与自旋极化手性化合物相互作用时会发生不可逆的交换驱动再磁化，从而为存储和增强微弱手性偏差提供稳健机制，可能促进了早期地球上手性均一性的出现和稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过两种地质化学途径合成的磁铁矿颗粒主要处于单涡旋和多涡旋磁畴态，这些颗粒与自旋极化手性化合物相互作用时会发生不可逆的交换驱动再磁化，从而为存储和增强微弱手性偏差提供稳健机制，可能促进了早期地球上手性均一性的出现和稳定。；创新点：首次研究了在真实前生命条件下合成的磁铁矿（而非传统纳米制备薄膜）的磁畴态，并揭示了其与手性分子相互作用时产生的不可逆磁化机制，为手性偏差的放大和存储提供了新的物理途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用紫外驱动光氧化和亚硝酸盐介导氧化两种地质化学途径合成磁铁矿，并通过磁性测量和电子显微镜表征其磁畴态；计算上使用三维微磁学模拟研究单畴和涡旋态颗粒与自旋极化手性化合物相互作用时的磁化行为。

papers.title: Subsystem relaxation and a calibrated sampling diagnostic for programmable quantum annealers
papers.abstract: Programmable quantum annealers are used as open-system samplers, but it is unclear when reverse annealing erases preparation memory and what the readout represents. Here we implement a subsystem-environment protocol on two D-Wave quantum annealers, varying environment size, coupling, disorder, preparation, geometry and QPU generation. A six-qubit subsystem becomes initial-state independent when the environment is large or strongly coupled, while quenched disorder and atypical environment states arrest relaxation. Pairing the memory order parameter with the distance to a calibrated conditional-Boltzmann reference yields a diagnostic that flags rare wrong-basin trapping memory loss alone misses; memory-retaining conditions stay far from the reference (median 0.35). Relaxed ferromagnetic readouts are near-deterministic, so small distances there are a consistency check, not a thermometric test. In a mixed-frustration benchmark, the local-update model practitioners assume mispredicts QPU relaxation roughly sevenfold, whereas non-local classical sampling recovers it. We provide a subsystem-level validation protocol for quantum-annealer sampling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：implemented on two D-Wave quantum annealers、varying environment size、QPU generation、readout）；研究对象：可编程量子退火器（D-Wave量子退火器）作为开放系统采样器时的子系统弛豫行为，以及读出结果的可靠性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当环境足够大或耦合足够强时，六量子比特子系统会失去对初始态的依赖，达到弛豫；而淬火无序和非典型环境态会阻碍弛豫。通过将记忆序参量与校准条件玻尔兹曼参考的距离结合，可诊断出仅靠记忆丢失无法发现的“错误盆地”陷阱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当环境足够大或耦合足够强时，六量子比特子系统会失去对初始态的依赖，达到弛豫；而淬火无序和非典型环境态会阻碍弛豫。通过将记忆序参量与校准条件玻尔兹曼参考的距离结合，可诊断出仅靠记忆丢失无法发现的“错误盆地”陷阱。；创新点：提出了一个子系统级别的验证协议，用于诊断量子退火器采样是否真正达到热化，并揭示了局域更新模型对QPU弛豫的预测存在约七倍的偏差，而非局域经典采样能更好地复现实验结果。
papers.method_zh: 在两种D-Wave量子退火器上实施子系统-环境协议，系统性地改变环境大小、耦合强度、无序程度、初始态制备、几何结构以及量子处理单元（QPU）代次。使用记忆序参量（memory order parameter）和校准条件玻尔兹曼参考（calibrated conditional-Boltzmann reference）的距离作为诊断工具，并与局域更新模型及非局域经典采样进行对比。

papers.title: Translation-invariant quantum low-density parity-check codes from compactified fracton models
papers.abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes with translation symmetry and local checks have been studied extensively, leading to a wide variety of fracton codes in three or more dimensions which lack a complete unifying picture. Recently, the study of translation-invariant codes with long-range checks has revealed impressive performance for small fixed-size instances in two dimensions. Here, we provide a unifying picture for a large family of translation-invariant codes, both local and long-range, that captures many fracton codes and all Abelian Two-Block Group Algebra (A2BGA) codes, including the Bivariate Bicycle (BB) codes. The balanced product structure of A2BGA codes leads to a local parent code that is a hypergraph product fracton model in a higher dimension. Different compactifications of a parent code produce a wide variety of descendant codes which provides a unifying picture for their properties. In particular, all BB codes with the same check weight are derived from a single parent hypergraph product fracton model. This construction allows us to extend Wang and Pryadko's code-parameter bounds for Generalized Bicycle codes to A2BGA codes. We conjecture that the transversal gates and energy barriers of the translation-invariant descendant codes are limited by those of their parent fracton models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：提供统一图像（unifying picture）、构造（construction）、推测（conjecture）。；研究对象：具有平移不变性的量子低密度奇偶校验码（translation-invariant quantum LDPC codes），特别是阿贝尔双块群代数（A2BGA）码和分形子模型（fracton models）的紧致化（compactification）关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有阿贝尔双块群代数（A2BGA）码（包括双变量自行车（BB）码）均可视为一个高维超图乘积分形子模型的紧致化后代，从而为一大类平移不变码（包括局域和长程校验码）提供了统一的理论图像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有阿贝尔双块群代数（A2BGA）码（包括双变量自行车（BB）码）均可视为一个高维超图乘积分形子模型的紧致化后代，从而为一大类平移不变码（包括局域和长程校验码）提供了统一的理论图像。；创新点：首次将双变量自行车（BB）码与高维分形子模型通过紧致化建立统一联系，并证明所有具有相同校验权重的BB码均源自同一个父代超图乘积分形子模型。摘要未突出说明该构造是否可实验实现。
papers.method_zh: 采用平衡积（balanced product）结构，将A2BGA码的父代（parent code）构造为高维超图乘积分形子模型，并通过不同紧致化方式得到各种后代码（descendant codes）。利用该构造将广义自行车码的码参数界推广到A2BGA码。

papers.title: Floquet-Engineered Odd-Parity Altermagnetic Higher-Order Topology in a Two-Dimensional Antiferromagnet Cr$_2$CH$_2$
papers.abstract: Periodic driving provides a platform to dynamically tailor quantum states of matter, yet its impact on symmetry-protected topological phases remains incompletely understood. Here, we demonstrate that periodic driving enables the realization of an odd-parity altermagnetic (AM) higher-order topological insulator (HOTI) phase in the Cr$_2$CH$_2$ monolayer. In equilibrium, Cr$_2$CH$_2$ is a 2D antiferromagnetic (AFM) HOTI protected by $\mathcal C_3$ rotational symmetry, characterized by a symmetry indicator $χ^{(3)}$ = $\{-2,1\}$ and robust corner states. Under circularly polarized light (CPL), the system develops a f-wave altermagnetic state governed by the symmetry $[C_{2}||\overline{3}_{001}]$ with odd-parity spin splitting. Despite substantial Floquet-induced band renormalization, the $\mathcal C_3$-protected corner states remain intact over a broad range of driving strengths, highlighting the altermagnetic higher-order topology under Floquet driving. As the light intensity increases, the system gradually evolves into an altermagnetic semimetallic state. These results establish a direct connection between magnetism and topology in a periodically driven AFM system, offering a route toward the control of coupled spin and topological transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：demonstrate（理论论证）、Floquet driving（周期性驱动）、symmetry analysis（对称性分析）。；研究对象：二维反铁磁单层材料 Cr₂CH₂ 中的 Floquet 工程化奇宇称交变磁高阶拓扑绝缘体相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在圆偏振光驱动下，Cr₂CH₂ 单层从平衡态的反铁磁高阶拓扑绝缘体转变为奇宇称 f 波交变磁高阶拓扑绝缘体，且 C₃ 旋转对称性保护的角态在较宽驱动强度范围内保持稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在圆偏振光驱动下，Cr₂CH₂ 单层从平衡态的反铁磁高阶拓扑绝缘体转变为奇宇称 f 波交变磁高阶拓扑绝缘体，且 C₃ 旋转对称性保护的角态在较宽驱动强度范围内保持稳定。；创新点：首次在周期性驱动的反铁磁体系中实现奇宇称交变磁高阶拓扑绝缘体，建立了 Floquet 驱动下磁性与拓扑之间的直接联系，为耦合自旋与拓扑输运的调控提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析（C₃ 旋转对称性、[C₂||\overline{3}_{001}] 对称性）和 Floquet 理论（周期性驱动下的能带重整化），通过计算对称性指标 χ⁽³⁾ = {-2,1} 及角态特征来表征拓扑相。

papers.title: Importance of nuclear quantum effects on the structure of supercooled water around its liquid--liquid critical point
papers.abstract: Supercooled water is expected to exhibit a liquid--liquid phase transition between low- and high-density liquid states, possibly terminating in a liquid--liquid critical point in the experimentally difficult no man's land. Because the hydrogen atoms are light, nuclear quantum effects (NQE) may alter the structural signatures used to identify this transition. Here, we compare classical molecular dynamics and path-integral molecular dynamics simulations of a flexible q-TIP4P/F-like water model in the deeply supercooled regime. The classical simulations show a pronounced density change at 180 K between 180 and 220 MPa, whereas the path-integral simulations exhibit a smoother pressure dependence. Radial distribution functions and bond-order parameters show that NQE broaden pair correlations, reduce the tetrahedral order of the first hydration shell, and slightly increase the Steinhardt $Q_6$ parameter. These results demonstrate that NQE modify both low- and high-density liquid structures and therefore need to be included when interpreting structural signatures of the liquid--liquid transition in supercooled water.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular dynamics simulations、path-integral molecular dynamics simulations。；研究对象：过冷水在液-液临界点附近的结构，特别是核量子效应对其低密度和高密度液体结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 核量子效应会显著改变过冷水的结构特征：使径向分布函数和键序参数中的对关联展宽、降低第一水合层的四面体有序度、略微增加Steinhardt Q₆参数，因此必须在解释液-液转变的结构信号时予以考虑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：核量子效应会显著改变过冷水的结构特征：使径向分布函数和键序参数中的对关联展宽、降低第一水合层的四面体有序度、略微增加Steinhardt Q₆参数，因此必须在解释液-液转变的结构信号时予以考虑。；创新点：首次在过冷水液-液临界点附近系统比较了经典模拟与路径积分模拟，定量揭示了核量子效应对低密度和高密度液体结构的不同影响，并指出忽略核量子效应可能导致对液-液转变结构信号的误判。
papers.method_zh: 采用经典分子动力学模拟和路径积分分子动力学模拟，使用柔性q-TIP4P/F类水模型，在深度过冷区（约180 K、180–220 MPa）进行比较研究。

papers.title: On the single field formulation in magnetostatics
papers.abstract: We systematically discuss the equivalence of two variational formulations of magnetostatics, in terms of magnetization and magnetic field on the one hand and the single field formulation using only magnetic induction. To demonstrate that this link is stable also when the magnetic laws are coupled with other variational static models, elasticity is included in the models as well. Interestingly, despite the fact that the corresponding magnetoelastic energy densities in the material can be computed via Legendre-Fenchel transform in the magnetic state variables, the two formulations are not linked by standard convex duality on the level of the functionals. In addition, convexity and coercivity of the given functional are neither required for the transformation nor always preserved by it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确讨论“变分公式的等价性”、“Legendre-Fenchel变换”、“凸对偶”等理论框架，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：静磁学中的单场公式化，以及磁弹性耦合系统。具体涉及磁化强度、磁场与磁感应强度之间的变分表述关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管磁弹性能量密度可通过Legendre-Fenchel变换在磁状态变量间计算，但两种变分公式（基于磁化强度与磁场 vs. 仅基于磁感应强度的单场公式）在泛函层面上并不通过标准的凸对偶相联系。此外，给定泛函的凸性和强制性既不是变换的必要条件，也不一定在变换后保持。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管磁弹性能量密度可通过Legendre-Fenchel变换在磁状态变量间计算，但两种变分公式（基于磁化强度与磁场 vs. 仅基于磁感应强度的单场公式）在泛函层面上并不通过标准的凸对偶相联系。此外，给定泛函的凸性和强制性既不是变换的必要条件，也不一定在变换后保持。；创新点：揭示了静磁学中两种变分公式之间缺乏标准凸对偶联系这一反直觉事实，并指出凸性与强制性在变换中的非必要性及非保持性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 变分法、Legendre-Fenchel变换、凸分析理论。通过将弹性力学纳入静磁学模型，系统论证两种变分表述的等价性及其在耦合系统中的稳定性。

papers.title: Spectral fringes without subcycles in Schwinger pair production and Dirac materials
papers.abstract: Spectral fringes in Schwinger pair creation are usually attributed to structured driving, such as carrier oscillations, pulse trains, or multiple creation events. We show that pronounced fringes can arise even for smooth, carrier-free single-lobe electric-field pulses. Two bell-shaped profiles that are nearly indistinguishable in real time - a Gaussian pulse and a weakly deformed variant - produce qualitatively different longitudinal momentum spectra in the nonadiabatic crossover: the Gaussian spectrum remains smooth, whereas the deformed pulse develops strong fringes as the Keldysh parameter approaches unity. Exact numerical solutions in scalar and spinor QED agree with a semiclassical turning-point analysis and trace the effect to a turning-point dominance transition, where the leading saddle becomes irrelevant and subleading contributions interfere. We demonstrate the same mechanism in a solid-state Schwinger analog described by a gapped two-dimensional Dirac model relevant to epitaxial graphene on SiC, and discuss an energy-resolved pump-probe route to observing the predicted modulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“半经典转折点分析”“精确数值解”“标量/旋量QED”等理论框架，以及“固体施温格模拟”的理论模型。；研究对象：施温格对产生过程中的光谱条纹现象，以及固体中对应的狄拉克材料（如外延石墨烯/SiC上的二维有隙狄拉克模型）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使使用平滑、无载波振荡的单瓣电场脉冲（如高斯脉冲），在近绝热交叉区域（凯尔迪什参数接近1）也能产生显著的光谱条纹；该条纹源于转折点主导性转变，即主鞍点失效后次主导贡献的干涉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使使用平滑、无载波振荡的单瓣电场脉冲（如高斯脉冲），在近绝热交叉区域（凯尔迪什参数接近1）也能产生显著的光谱条纹；该条纹源于转折点主导性转变，即主鞍点失效后次主导贡献的干涉。；创新点：打破了以往认为光谱条纹必须依赖结构化驱动（如载波振荡、脉冲序列或多产生事件）的认知，揭示了平滑单脉冲中由转折点主导性转变引发的干涉机制，并推广至固体狄拉克材料。
papers.method_zh: 采用标量/旋量QED的精确数值解，结合半经典转折点分析方法；在固体模拟中，使用二维有隙狄拉克模型（对应外延石墨烯/SiC体系）进行数值求解。

papers.title: Informational blueprints reveal condition-dependent gene regulatory architectures
papers.abstract: While coding regions in the genome have a direct interpretation in terms of protein products, significant fractions are non-coding and yet control essential biological functions. Unlike the genetic code, there is no "lookup table" that identifies where regulatory proteins, known as transcription factors (TFs), bind. Here, we extract these binding sites by distilling sequences of nucleotide letters into collective coordinates (hyperletters) representing the binding sites that are active under specific environmental conditions. Going beyond local information footprints between individual bases and expression levels, our $\textit{information blueprint}$ algorithm compresses the global information by optimising filters that simultaneously scan an entire promoter sequence. Inspired by renormalisation-group techniques, we identify TF binding sites as coarse-grained variables combining groups of correlated mutations with the highest collective impact on gene expression. We validate our approach on experimental data for $\textit{E. coli}$ and discover novel regulatory elements illustrating its deployment at scale across growth conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：信息蓝图算法、粗粒化变量、重正化群技术。；研究对象：基因调控序列，具体为大肠杆菌（E. coli）中转录因子（TF）结合位点的识别与解析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种名为“信息蓝图”的算法，能够从非编码DNA序列中提取出在特定环境条件下活跃的转录因子结合位点，并发现新的调控元件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种名为“信息蓝图”的算法，能够从非编码DNA序列中提取出在特定环境条件下活跃的转录因子结合位点，并发现新的调控元件。；创新点：超越了传统的基于单个碱基与表达水平之间局部信息足迹的方法，首次实现了对整个启动子序列的全局信息压缩，并能在不同生长条件下规模化部署以发现新的调控元件。
papers.method_zh: 采用信息蓝图算法，该算法受重正化群技术启发，通过优化滤波器同时扫描整个启动子序列，将核苷酸字母序列蒸馏为集体坐标（超字母），从而识别出对基因表达具有最高集体影响的粗粒化变量（即TF结合位点）。

papers.title: Collective excitations in quantum gravity condensates
papers.abstract: A central open problem in quantum gravity is to understand how continuum spacetime emerges from quantum-geometric degrees of freedom in a background-independent setting. A many-body perspective suggests that spacetime emerges as a hydrodynamic phase of many atoms of quantum geometry. This idea underlies several approaches to quantum gravity, and it has been explicitly realised in the group field theory formalism. However, quantum fluctuations beyond the mean-field regime remain largely unexplored. We fill this gap by importing Bogolyubov theory to quantum gravity condensates, showing that leading beyond-mean-field effects manifest as collective excitations, in direct analogy with phonons in laboratory BECs. We implement the construction in a tractable group field theory model, where condensates of quantum-geometric atoms reproduce nonsingular expanding cosmologies, and derive the leading beyond-mean-field corrections to the emergent Friedmann dynamics. These results identify a new class of quantum-gravity excitations and establish a controlled bridge between microscopic quantum-gravitational dynamics, many-body collective phenomena, and signatures of spacetime emergence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Bogolyubov theory、group field theory、many-body perspective。；研究对象：量子引力中的时空涌现问题，具体研究量子几何凝聚体（quantum gravity condensates）中的集体激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在平均场近似之外，量子引力凝聚体的主要量子涨落效应表现为集体激发，与实验室玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中的声子直接类似。这些激发对涌现出的弗里德曼宇宙动力学产生了超越平均场的修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在平均场近似之外，量子引力凝聚体的主要量子涨落效应表现为集体激发，与实验室玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中的声子直接类似。这些激发对涌现出的弗里德曼宇宙动力学产生了超越平均场的修正。；创新点：首次将Bogolyubov理论系统应用于量子引力凝聚体，填补了该领域在平均场近似之外量子涨落研究的空白，并建立了一个从微观量子引力动力学到多体集体现象及时空涌现特征的受控桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bogolyubov理论框架，将其引入到群场论（group field theory）形式中，对一个可解的群场论模型进行超越平均场近似的分析。

papers.title: Noise-induced Simulability Transition from Operator Scrambling
papers.abstract: The complexity of simulating quantum many-body dynamics, or quantum computations, in the Heisenberg picture is governed by the scrambling of initially simple operators into superpositions of exponentially many Pauli strings. The corresponding expansion coefficients define the Pauli spectrum, whose structure controls the performance of classical algorithms based on truncating Pauli expansions. Here we determine the finite-depth Pauli spectrum of random quantum circuits, both in the noiseless case and in the presence of local noise, through its moments, given by the operator stabilizer Rényi entropies. In noiseless circuits, we uncover a hierarchy in the approach to the fully scrambled regime: low moments equilibrate at relatively short depths, while higher moments, which are sensitive to rare, large-amplitude Pauli coefficients, require parametrically larger depths. In noisy circuits, scrambling competes with an effective suppression of operator spreading. Above a critical error per cycle $γ_c N=\mathcal{O}(1)$, the operator fails to reach the fully scrambled distribution and remains supported on an atypically sparse subset of Pauli strings. Conversely, below this scale, we rigorously show that classical simulation remains exponentially hard, demonstrating that finite noise does not automatically imply classical simulability. The resulting noise-induced transition in operator complexity therefore delineates the boundary between intrinsically hard quantum dynamics and those that remain classically accessible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：determine the Pauli spectrum、rigorously show、noise-induced transition。；研究对象：量子多体动力学（或量子计算）在Heisenberg绘景下的经典模拟复杂性，具体研究随机量子电路在无噪声和有局部噪声情况下的Pauli谱（Pauli spectrum）及其对经典可模拟性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无噪声电路中，Pauli谱的不同阶矩（对应不同阶的Rényi熵）达到完全混沌状态的深度存在层级结构；在有噪声电路中，当每个循环的错误率超过一个临界值（γ_c N = O(1)）时，算符无法达到完全混沌分布，其复杂性降低，从而在算符复杂性中诱导出一个噪声驱动的可模拟性相变，该相变划定了本质上困难的量子动力学与经典可访问动力学之间的边界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无噪声电路中，Pauli谱的不同阶矩（对应不同阶的Rényi熵）达到完全混沌状态的深度存在层级结构；在有噪声电路中，当每个循环的错误率超过一个临界值（γ_c N = O(1)）时，算符无法达到完全混沌分布，其复杂性降低，从而在算符复杂性中诱导出一个噪声驱动的可模拟性相变，该相变划定了本质上困难的量子动力学与经典可访问动力学之间的边界。；创新点：1. 揭示了无噪声随机量子电路中Pauli谱不同阶矩达到混沌的深度存在层级结构（低阶矩先于高阶矩平衡）。2. 严格证明了在低于临界噪声强度时，经典模拟仍然是指数级困难的，反驳了“有限噪声自动导致经典可模拟性”的直观认识。3. 提出了一个由噪声诱导的、关于算符复杂性的相变，为区分量子优势与经典可模拟性提供了新的理论判据。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算随机量子电路的Pauli谱的矩（即算符稳定子Rényi熵），分别分析无噪声和有局部噪声两种情况。在无噪声情况下，研究不同阶矩随电路深度的演化；在有噪声情况下，通过严格证明（rigorously show）来论证噪声强度对算符扩展的抑制效应，并确定临界错误率。

papers.title: Bifurcation of the quasi-stationary velocity of strongly discrete transition waves driven by gravity
papers.abstract: Transition waves are common in multistable mechanical metamaterials, and the dynamics of weakly discrete transition waves under driving forces have been extensively discussed. However, as lattice effects become more pronounced, strongly discrete transition waves may exhibit dynamics that cannot be predicted by the continuum limit. Here, by tilting a bistable chain, we introduce a gravitational perturbation term into the dynamical equations, under which the transition waves are continuously accelerated. In the strongly discrete regime, we find that transition waves under gravitational driving possess quasi-stationary velocity plateaus (QSVPs), and the number of these plateaus first increases and then decreases as the tilt angle increases. We theoretically elucidate that the emergence of the velocity plateaus originates from the balance between gravitational driving and phonon radiation. In further analysis, the theoretical model reveals that the balance point undergoes a bifurcation at the radiation resonance, which leads to a change in the number of velocity plateaus. Our study extends the investigation of transition waves into the strongly discrete regime, and the emergence of multiple velocity plateaus opens up new possibilities for programmable solitary waves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“理论阐明”“理论模型揭示”，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：强离散双稳态力学超材料链中由重力驱动的过渡波（transition waves），具体为倾斜双稳态链中准稳态速度平台（QSVPs）的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强离散体系中，重力驱动的过渡波存在多个准稳态速度平台，且平台数量随倾斜角增大先增后减；该现象源于重力驱动与声子辐射之间的平衡，且平衡点在辐射共振处发生分岔，导致平台数量变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强离散体系中，重力驱动的过渡波存在多个准稳态速度平台，且平台数量随倾斜角增大先增后减；该现象源于重力驱动与声子辐射之间的平衡，且平衡点在辐射共振处发生分岔，导致平台数量变化。；创新点：将过渡波研究从弱离散体系拓展至强离散体系，发现并解释了重力驱动下多个准稳态速度平台的出现及其分岔行为，为可编程孤子波提供了新可能性。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：通过引入重力扰动项（倾斜双稳态链）建立动力学方程，分析强离散极限下过渡波的准稳态速度平台，并利用平衡点分岔理论解释平台数量的变化机制。

papers.title: Systematic study of one-point kinetic energy density functionals for atomic nuclei
papers.abstract: To explore the applicability of orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT) in nuclear physics, we perform a systematic benchmark of 36 one-point kinetic energy density functionals, which are originally developed for electron systems in condensed matter physics. It is found that the direct use of the original parameters for electron systems leads to inconsistent performance, with certain functionals exhibiting physically unacceptable asymptotic behaviors. However, through parameter re-optimization targeting nuclear densities, different mathematical forms of generalized gradient approximation (GGA) functionals converge to a consistent root-mean-square error of approximately 13 MeV. From a physical perspective, this consistent behavior signifies that the optimized semi-local GGAs have successfully captured the macroscopic, liquid-drop-like background of the nucleus, while the residual deviations appear as periodic oscillations at the magic numbers that could reflect the quantum shell effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT)、benchmark、parameter re-optimization。；研究对象：原子核体系。具体研究无轨道密度泛函理论（OF-DFT）中用于描述原子核动能的一类泛函（one-point kinetic energy density functionals）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过参数重优化，原本用于电子系统的广义梯度近似（GGA）动能泛函能够统一收敛到约13 MeV的均方根误差，成功捕捉原子核的宏观液滴背景，但剩余偏差在幻数处呈现周期性振荡，反映了量子壳层效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过参数重优化，原本用于电子系统的广义梯度近似（GGA）动能泛函能够统一收敛到约13 MeV的均方根误差，成功捕捉原子核的宏观液滴背景，但剩余偏差在幻数处呈现周期性振荡，反映了量子壳层效应。；创新点：将凝聚态物理中成熟的OF-DFT动能泛函系统引入核物理领域，并通过参数重优化揭示了半局域GGA泛函在描述原子核宏观液滴背景方面的统一能力，同时识别出壳层效应导致的周期性偏差。
papers.method_zh: 系统基准测试（systematic benchmark）：对36种原本为凝聚态电子系统开发的一阶动能密度泛函进行测试，并针对核密度进行参数重优化（parameter re-optimization），比较不同数学形式的GGA泛函在原子核上的表现。

papers.title: Geometric Brownian motion with intermittent entries and exits
papers.abstract: We study a generalized geometric Brownian motion framework that incorporates both entries of new units and exit mechanisms for the current population, extending earlier stochastic resetting models where these rates are treated as identical. The model captures realistic features observed in many economic observables, which can be explained as market-driven firm entries/exits, worker inflow/outflow, and income growth/loss. This model is not conservative and, despite the asymmetry in the entry and exit rates, we find that the system eventually relaxes to a stationary distribution. Moreover, our analysis reveals three distinct dynamical regimes in the moments of the distribution, arising from the interplay between volatility, drift, entry, and exit rates. We further derive the survival probability and the mean first-passage time associated with the observed variable reaching certain threshold under the competing entry-exit processes. Interestingly, we identify an optimal exit rate that minimizes the mean first-passage time, providing insights into how entry and exit policies can influence the outcome of the system. These results should be useful for understanding the long-run behavior of economic systems in which growth, volatility, entry, and exit jointly shape the evolution of heterogeneous units.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：generalized geometric Brownian motion framework、stochastic resetting models、analysis、derive。；研究对象：一种广义几何布朗运动模型，该模型包含新单元的进入和当前群体的退出机制，用于描述经济系统中企业进入/退出、工人流入/流出、收入增长/损失等非保守经济可观测量的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管进入和退出速率不对称，系统最终会弛豫到一个稳态分布；并且存在由波动率、漂移、进入和退出速率相互作用导致的三个不同的分布矩动力学区域。此外，存在一个最优退出速率，可使平均首次通过时间最小化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管进入和退出速率不对称，系统最终会弛豫到一个稳态分布；并且存在由波动率、漂移、进入和退出速率相互作用导致的三个不同的分布矩动力学区域。此外，存在一个最优退出速率，可使平均首次通过时间最小化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义几何布朗运动框架，扩展了早期随机重置模型，通过解析推导分析了系统的稳态分布、分布矩的动力学区域、生存概率以及平均首次通过时间。
